Job 3:16 [KJV]  Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.

Job 3:17 [HEB]  שָׁ֣ם רְ֭שָׁעִים חָ֣דְלוּ רֹ֑גֶז וְשָׁ֥ם יָ֝נ֗וּחוּ יְגִ֣יעֵי כֹֽחַ
Job 3:17 [KJV]  There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.

Job 3:18 [HEB]  יַ֭חַד אֲסִירִ֣ים שַׁאֲנָ֑נוּ לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ ק֣וֹל נֹגֵֽשׂ
Job 3:18 [KJV]  There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.

Job 3:19 [HEB]  קָטֹ֣ן וְ֭גָדוֹל שָׁ֣ם ה֑וּא וְ֝עֶ֗בֶד חָפְשִׁ֥י מֵאֲדֹנָֽיו
Job 3:19 [KJV]  The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.

Job 3:20 [HEB]  לָ֤מָּה יִתֵּ֣ן לְעָמֵ֣ל א֑וֹר וְ֝חַיִּ֗ים לְמָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ
Job 3:20 [KJV]  Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;

Job 3:21 [HEB]  הַֽמְחַכִּ֣ים לַמָּ֣וֶת וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וַֽ֝יַּחְפְּרֻ֗הוּ מִמַּטְמוֹנִֽים
Job 3:21 [KJV]  Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;

Job 3:22 [HEB]  הַשְּׂמֵחִ֥ים אֱלֵי גִ֑יל יָ֝שִׂ֗ישׂוּ כִּ֣י יִמְצְאוּ קָֽבֶר
Job 3:22 [KJV]  Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

Job 3:23 [HEB]  לְ֭גֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר דַּרְכּ֣וֹ נִסְתָּ֑רָה וַיָּ֖סֶךְ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בַּעֲדֽוֹ
Job 3:23 [KJV]  Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?

Job 3:24 [HEB]  כִּֽי לִפְנֵ֣י לַ֭חְמִי אַנְחָתִ֣י תָבֹ֑א וַֽיִּתְּכ֥וּ כַ֝מַּ֗יִם שַׁאֲגֹתָֽי
Job 3:24 [KJV]  For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.

Job 3:25 [HEB]  כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד פָּ֭חַדְתִּי וַיֶּאֱתָיֵ֑נִי וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָ֝גֹ֗רְתִּי יָ֣בֹא לִֽי
Job 3:25 [KJV]  For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.

Job 3:26 [HEB]  לֹ֤א שָׁלַ֨וְתִּי וְלֹ֖א שָׁקַ֥טְתִּי וְֽלֹא נָ֗חְתִּי וַיָּ֥בֹא רֹֽגֶז
Job 3:26 [KJV]  I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.


--- Job Chapter 4 ---
Job 4:1 [HEB]  וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 4:1 [KJV]  Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

Job 4:2 [HEB]  הֲנִסָּ֬ה דָבָ֣ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ תִּלְאֶ֑ה וַעְצֹ֥ר בְּ֝מִלִּ֗ין מִ֣י יוּכָֽל
Job 4:2 [KJV]  If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?

Job 4:3 [HEB]  הִ֭נֵּה יִסַּ֣רְתָּ רַבִּ֑ים וְיָדַ֖יִם רָפ֣וֹת תְּחַזֵּֽק
Job 4:3 [KJV]  Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

Job 4:4 [HEB]  כּ֭וֹשֵׁל יְקִימ֣וּן מִלֶּ֑יךָ וּבִרְכַּ֖יִם כֹּרְע֣וֹת תְּאַמֵּֽץ
Job 4:4 [KJV]  Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

Job 4:5 [HEB]  כִּ֤י עַתָּ֨ה תָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֣יךָ וַתֵּ֑לֶא תִּגַּ֥ע עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ וַתִּבָּהֵֽל
Job 4:5 [KJV]  But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

Job 4:6 [HEB]  הֲלֹ֣א יִ֭רְאָתְךָ כִּסְלָתֶ֑ךָ תִּ֝קְוָתְךָ֗ וְתֹ֣ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ
Job 4:6 [KJV]  Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?

Job 4:7 [HEB]  זְכָר נָ֗א מִ֤י ה֣וּא נָקִ֣י אָבָ֑ד וְ֝אֵיפֹ֗ה יְשָׁרִ֥ים נִכְחָֽדוּ
Job 4:7 [KJV]  Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?

Job 4:8 [HEB]  כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתִי חֹ֣רְשֵׁי אָ֑וֶן וְזֹרְעֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל יִקְצְרֻֽהוּ
Job 4:8 [KJV]  Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.

Job 4:9 [HEB]  מִנִּשְׁמַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וּמֵר֖וּחַ אַפּ֣וֹ יִכְלֽוּ
Job 4:9 [KJV]  By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.

Job 4:10 [HEB]  שַׁאֲגַ֣ת אַ֭רְיֵה וְק֣וֹל שָׁ֑חַל וְשִׁנֵּ֖י כְפִירִ֣ים נִתָּֽעוּ
Job 4:10 [KJV]  The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

Job 4:11 [HEB]  לַ֭יִשׁ אֹבֵ֣ד מִבְּלִי טָ֑רֶף וּבְנֵ֥י לָ֝בִ֗יא יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ
Job 4:11 [KJV]  The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion’s whelps are scattered abroad.

Job 4:12 [HEB]  וְ֭אֵלַי דָּבָ֣ר יְגֻנָּ֑ב וַתִּקַּ֥ח אָ֝זְנִ֗י שֵׁ֣מֶץ מֶֽנְהֽוּ
Job 4:12 [KJV]  Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.

Job 4:13 [HEB]  בִּ֭שְׂעִפִּים מֵחֶזְיֹנ֣וֹת לָ֑יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֥ל תַּ֝רְדֵּמָ֗ה עַל אֲנָשִֽׁים
Job 4:13 [KJV]  In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,

Job 4:14 [HEB]  פַּ֣חַד קְ֭רָאַנִי וּרְעָדָ֑ה וְרֹ֖ב עַצְמוֹתַ֣י הִפְחִֽיד
Job 4:14 [KJV]  Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.

Job 4:15 [HEB]  וְ֭רוּחַ עַל פָּנַ֣י יַחֲלֹ֑ף תְּ֝סַמֵּ֗ר שַֽׂעֲרַ֥ת בְּשָׂרִֽי
Job 4:15 [KJV]  Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:

Job 4:16 [HEB]  יַעֲמֹ֤ד וְֽלֹא אַכִּ֬יר מַרְאֵ֗הוּ תְּ֭מוּנָה לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י דְּמָמָ֖ה וָק֣וֹל אֶשְׁמָֽע
Job 4:16 [KJV]  It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,

Job 4:17 [HEB]  הַֽ֭אֱנוֹשׁ מֵאֱל֣וֹהַ יִצְדָּ֑ק אִ֥ם מֵ֝עֹשֵׂ֗הוּ יִטְהַר גָּֽבֶר
Job 4:17 [KJV]  Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?

Job 4:18 [HEB]  הֵ֣ן בַּ֭עֲבָדָיו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וּ֝בְמַלְאָכָ֗יו יָשִׂ֥ים תָּהֳלָֽה
Job 4:18 [KJV]  Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:

Job 4:19 [HEB]  אַ֤ף שֹׁכְנֵ֬י בָֽתֵּי חֹ֗מֶר אֲשֶׁר בֶּעָפָ֥ר יְסוֹדָ֑ם יְ֝דַכְּא֗וּם לִפְנֵי עָֽשׁ
Job 4:19 [KJV]  How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?

Job 4:20 [HEB]  מִבֹּ֣קֶר לָעֶ֣רֶב יֻכַּ֑תּוּ מִבְּלִ֥י מֵ֝שִׂ֗ים לָנֶ֥צַח יֹאבֵֽדוּ
Job 4:20 [KJV]  They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.

Job 4:21 [HEB]  הֲלֹא נִסַּ֣ע יִתְרָ֣ם בָּ֑ם יָ֝מ֗וּתוּ וְלֹ֣א בְחָכְמָֽה
Job 4:21 [KJV]  Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.


--- Job Chapter 5 ---
Job 5:1 [HEB]  קְֽרָא נָ֭א הֲיֵ֣שׁ עוֹנֶ֑ךָּ וְאֶל מִ֖י מִקְּדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּפְנֶֽה
Job 5:1 [KJV]  Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?

Job 5:2 [HEB]  כִּֽי לֶֽ֭אֱוִיל יַהֲרָג כָּ֑עַשׂ וּ֝פֹתֶ֗ה תָּמִ֥ית קִנְאָֽה
Job 5:2 [KJV]  For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.

Job 5:3 [HEB]  אֲֽנִי רָ֭אִיתִי אֱוִ֣יל מַשְׁרִ֑ישׁ וָאֶקּ֖וֹב נָוֵ֣הוּ פִתְאֹֽם
Job 5:3 [KJV]  I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

Job 5:4 [HEB]  יִרְחֲק֣וּ בָנָ֣יו מִיֶּ֑שַׁע וְיִֽדַּכְּא֥וּ בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל
Job 5:4 [KJV]  His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.

Job 5:5 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֤ר קְצִיר֨וֹ רָ֘עֵ֤ב יֹאכֵ֗ל וְאֶֽל מִצִּנִּ֥ים יִקָּחֵ֑הוּ וְשָׁאַ֖ף צַמִּ֣ים חֵילָֽם
Job 5:5 [KJV]  Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.

Job 5:6 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹא יֵצֵ֣א מֵעָפָ֣ר אָ֑וֶן וּ֝מֵאֲדָמָ֗ה לֹא יִצְמַ֥ח עָמָֽל
Job 5:6 [KJV]  Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

Job 5:7 [HEB]  כִּֽי אָ֭דָם לְעָמָ֣ל יוּלָּ֑ד וּבְנֵי רֶ֝֗שֶׁף יַגְבִּ֥יהוּ עֽוּף
Job 5:7 [KJV]  Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

Job 5:8 [HEB]  אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶדְרֹ֣שׁ אֶל אֵ֑ל וְאֶל אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אָשִׂ֥ים דִּבְרָתִֽי
Job 5:8 [KJV]  I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:

Job 5:9 [HEB]  עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת וְאֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת עַד אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר
Job 5:9 [KJV]  Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:

Job 5:10 [HEB]  הַנֹּתֵ֣ן מָ֭טָר עַל פְּנֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְשֹׁ֥לֵֽחַ מַ֝יִם עַל פְּנֵ֥י חוּצֽוֹת
Job 5:10 [KJV]  Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:

Job 5:11 [HEB]  לָשׂ֣וּם שְׁפָלִ֣ים לְמָר֑וֹם וְ֝קֹדְרִ֗ים שָׂ֣גְבוּ יֶֽשַׁע
Job 5:11 [KJV]  To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.

Job 5:12 [HEB]  מֵ֭פֵר מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת עֲרוּמִ֑ים וְֽלֹא תַעֲשֶׂ֥ינָה יְ֝דֵיהֶ֗ם תּוּשִׁיָּֽה
Job 5:12 [KJV]  He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

Job 5:13 [HEB]  לֹכֵ֣ד חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּעָרְמָ֑ם וַעֲצַ֖ת נִפְתָּלִ֣ים נִמְהָֽרָה
Job 5:13 [KJV]  He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.

Job 5:14 [HEB]  יוֹמָ֥ם יְפַגְּשׁוּ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וְ֝כַלַּ֗יְלָה יְֽמַשְׁשׁ֥וּ בַֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם
Job 5:14 [KJV]  They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope in the noonday as in the night.

Job 5:15 [HEB]  וַיֹּ֣שַׁע מֵ֭חֶרֶב מִפִּיהֶ֑ם וּמִיַּ֖ד חָזָ֣ק אֶבְיֽוֹן
Job 5:15 [KJV]  But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

Job 5:16 [HEB]  וַתְּהִ֣י לַדַּ֣ל תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝עֹלָ֗תָה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ
Job 5:16 [KJV]  So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

Job 5:17 [HEB]  הִנֵּ֤ה אַשְׁרֵ֣י אֱ֭נוֹשׁ יוֹכִחֶ֣נּֽוּ אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּמוּסַ֥ר שַׁ֝דַּ֗י אַל תִּמְאָֽס
Job 5:17 [KJV]  Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:

Job 5:18 [HEB]  כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַכְאִ֣יב וְיֶחְבָּ֑שׁ יִ֝מְחַ֗ץ וידו וְיָדָ֥יו תִּרְפֶּֽינָה
Job 5:18 [KJV]  For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

Job 5:19 [HEB]  בְּשֵׁ֣שׁ צָ֭רוֹת יַצִּילֶ֑ךָּ וּבְשֶׁ֓בַע לֹא יִגַּ֖ע בְּךָ֣ רָֽע
Job 5:19 [KJV]  He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

Job 5:20 [HEB]  בְּ֭רָעָב פָּֽדְךָ֣ מִמָּ֑וֶת וּ֝בְמִלְחָמָ֗ה מִ֣ידֵי חָֽרֶב
Job 5:20 [KJV]  In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.

Job 5:21 [HEB]  בְּשׁ֣וֹט לָ֭שׁוֹן תֵּחָבֵ֑א וְֽלֹא תִירָ֥א מִ֝שֹּׁ֗ד כִּ֣י יָבֽוֹא
Job 5:21 [KJV]  Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

Job 5:22 [HEB]  לְשֹׁ֣ד וּלְכָפָ֣ן תִּשְׂחָ֑ק וּֽמֵחַיַּ֥ת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אַל תִּירָֽא
Job 5:22 [KJV]  At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

Job 5:23 [HEB]  כִּ֤י עִם אַבְנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֣ה בְרִיתֶ֑ךָ וְחַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה הָשְׁלְמָה לָֽךְ
Job 5:23 [KJV]  For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

Job 5:24 [HEB]  וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּי שָׁל֣וֹם אָהֳלֶ֑ךָ וּֽפָקַדְתָּ֥ נָ֝וְךָ וְלֹ֣א תֶחֱטָֽא
Job 5:24 [KJV]  And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.

Job 5:25 [HEB]  וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּי רַ֣ב זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֶ֗יךָ כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ
Job 5:25 [KJV]  Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

Job 5:26 [HEB]  תָּב֣וֹא בְכֶ֣לַח אֱלֵי קָ֑בֶר כַּעֲל֖וֹת גָּדִ֣ישׁ בְּעִתּֽוֹ
Job 5:26 [KJV]  Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.

Job 5:27 [HEB]  הִנֵּה זֹ֭את חֲקַרְנ֥וּהָ כֶּֽן הִ֑יא שְׁ֝מָעֶ֗נָּה וְאַתָּ֥ה דַֽע לָֽךְ
Job 5:27 [KJV]  Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.


--- Job Chapter 6 ---
Job 6:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 6:1 [KJV]  But Job answered and said,

Job 6:2 [HEB]  ל֗וּ שָׁק֣וֹל יִשָּׁקֵ֣ל כַּעְשִׂ֑י והיתי וְ֝הַוָּתִ֗י בְּֽמֹאזְנַ֥יִם יִשְׂאוּ יָֽחַד
Job 6:2 [KJV]  Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!

Job 6:3 [HEB]  כִּֽי עַתָּ֗ה מֵח֣וֹל יַמִּ֣ים יִכְבָּ֑ד עַל כֵּ֝֗ן דְּבָרַ֥י לָֽעוּ
Job 6:3 [KJV]  For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.

Job 6:4 [HEB]  כִּ֤י חִצֵּ֪י שַׁדַּ֡י עִמָּדִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲ֭מָתָם שֹׁתָ֣ה רוּחִ֑י בִּעוּתֵ֖י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַֽעַרְכֽוּנִי
Job 6:4 [KJV]  For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

Job 6:5 [HEB]  הֲיִֽנְהַק פֶּ֥רֶא עֲלֵי דֶ֑שֶׁא אִ֥ם יִגְעֶה שּׁ֝֗וֹר עַל בְּלִילֽוֹ
Job 6:5 [KJV]  Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?

Job 6:6 [HEB]  הֲיֵאָכֵ֣ל תָּ֭פֵל מִבְּלִי מֶ֑לַח אִם יֶשׁ טַ֝֗עַם בְּרִ֣יר חַלָּמֽוּת
Job 6:6 [KJV]  Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

Job 6:7 [HEB]  מֵאֲנָ֣ה לִנְגּ֣וֹעַ נַפְשִׁ֑י הֵ֝֗מָּה כִּדְוֵ֥י לַחְמִֽי
Job 6:7 [KJV]  The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.

Job 6:8 [HEB]  מִֽי יִ֭תֵּן תָּב֣וֹא שֶֽׁאֱלָתִ֑י וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י יִתֵּ֥ן אֱלֽוֹהַּ
Job 6:8 [KJV]  Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!

Job 6:9 [HEB]  וְיֹאֵ֣ל אֱ֭לוֹהַּ וִֽידַכְּאֵ֑נִי יַתֵּ֥ר יָ֝ד֗וֹ וִֽיבַצְּעֵֽנִי
Job 6:9 [KJV]  Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

Job 6:10 [HEB]  וּ֥תְהִי ע֨וֹד נֶ֘חָ֤מָתִ֗י וַאֲסַלְּדָ֣ה בְ֭חִילָה לֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל כִּי לֹ֥א כִ֝חַ֗דְתִּי אִמְרֵ֥י קָדֽוֹשׁ
Job 6:10 [KJV]  Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

Job 6:11 [HEB]  מַה כֹּחִ֥י כִֽי אֲיַחֵ֑ל וּמַה קִּ֝צִּ֗י כִּֽי אַאֲרִ֥יךְ נַפְשִֽׁי
Job 6:11 [KJV]  What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?

Job 6:12 [HEB]  אִם כֹּ֣חַ אֲבָנִ֣ים כֹּחִ֑י אִֽם בְּשָׂרִ֥י נָחֽוּשׁ
Job 6:12 [KJV]  Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?

Job 6:13 [HEB]  הַאִ֬ם אֵ֣ין עֶזְרָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְ֝תֻשִׁיָּ֗ה נִדְּחָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנִּי
Job 6:13 [KJV]  Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?

Job 6:14 [HEB]  לַמָּ֣ס מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ חָ֑סֶד וְיִרְאַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲזֽוֹב
Job 6:14 [KJV]  To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

Job 6:15 [HEB]  אַ֭חַי בָּגְד֣וּ כְמוֹ נָ֑חַל כַּאֲפִ֖יק נְחָלִ֣ים יַעֲבֹֽרוּ
Job 6:15 [KJV]  My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;

Job 6:16 [HEB]  הַקֹּדְרִ֥ים מִנִּי קָ֑רַח עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ יִתְעַלֶּם שָֽׁלֶג
Job 6:16 [KJV]  Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:

Job 6:17 [HEB]  בְּ֭עֵת יְזֹרְב֣וּ נִצְמָ֑תוּ בְּ֝חֻמּ֗וֹ נִדְעֲכ֥וּ מִמְּקוֹמָֽם
Job 6:17 [KJV]  What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

Job 6:18 [HEB]  יִ֭לָּ֣פְתוּ אָרְח֣וֹת דַּרְכָּ֑ם יַעֲל֖וּ בַתֹּ֣הוּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ
Job 6:18 [KJV]  The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.

Job 6:19 [HEB]  הִ֭בִּיטוּ אָרְח֣וֹת תֵּמָ֑א הֲלִיכֹ֥ת שְׁ֝בָ֗א קִוּוּ לָֽמוֹ
Job 6:19 [KJV]  The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.

Job 6:20 [HEB]  בֹּ֥שׁוּ כִּֽי בָטָ֑ח בָּ֥אוּ עָ֝דֶ֗יהָ וַיֶּחְפָּֽרוּ
Job 6:20 [KJV]  They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.

Job 6:21 [HEB]  כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה הֱיִ֣יתֶם לא ל֑וֹ תִּֽרְא֥וּ חֲ֝תַ֗ת וַתִּירָֽאוּ
Job 6:21 [KJV]  For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.

Job 6:22 [HEB]  הֲֽכִי אָ֭מַרְתִּי הָ֣בוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מִכֹּחֲכֶ֗ם שִׁחֲד֥וּ בַעֲדִֽי
Job 6:22 [KJV]  Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?

Job 6:23 [HEB]  וּמַלְּט֥וּנִי מִיַּד צָ֑ר וּמִיַּ֖ד עָרִיצִ֣ים תִּפְדּֽוּנִי
Job 6:23 [KJV]  Or, Deliver me from the enemy’s hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

Job 6:24 [HEB]  ה֭וֹרוּנִי וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרִ֑ישׁ וּמַה שָּׁ֝גִ֗יתִי הָבִ֥ינוּ לִֽי
Job 6:24 [KJV]  Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

Job 6:25 [HEB]  מַה נִּמְרְצ֥וּ אִמְרֵי יֹ֑שֶׁר וּמַה יּוֹכִ֖יחַ הוֹכֵ֣חַ מִכֶּֽם
Job 6:25 [KJV]  How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

Job 6:26 [HEB]  הַלְהוֹכַ֣ח מִלִּ֣ים תַּחְשֹׁ֑בוּ וּ֝לְר֗וּחַ אִמְרֵ֥י נֹאָֽשׁ
Job 6:26 [KJV]  Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?

Job 6:27 [HEB]  אַף עַל יָת֥וֹם תַּפִּ֑ילוּ וְ֝תִכְר֗וּ עַל רֵֽיעֲכֶֽם
Job 6:27 [KJV]  Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.

Job 6:28 [HEB]  וְ֭עַתָּה הוֹאִ֣ילוּ פְנוּ בִ֑י וְעַל פְּ֝נֵיכֶ֗ם אִם אֲכַזֵּֽב
Job 6:28 [KJV]  Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.

Job 6:29 [HEB]  שֻֽׁבוּ נָ֭א אַל תְּהִ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה ושבי וְשׁ֥וּבוּ ע֝וֹד צִדְקִי בָֽהּ
Job 6:29 [KJV]  Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.

Job 6:30 [HEB]  הֲיֵשׁ בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֥י עַוְלָ֑ה אִם חִ֝כִּ֗י לֹא יָבִ֥ין הַוּֽוֹת
Job 6:30 [KJV]  Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?


--- Job Chapter 7 ---
Job 7:1 [HEB]  הֲלֹא צָבָ֣א לֶאֱנ֣וֹשׁ על עֲלֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְכִימֵ֖י שָׂכִ֣יר יָמָֽיו
Job 7:1 [KJV]  Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?

Job 7:2 [HEB]  כְּעֶ֥בֶד יִשְׁאַף צֵ֑ל וּ֝כְשָׂכִ֗יר יְקַוֶּ֥ה פָעֳלֽוֹ
Job 7:2 [KJV]  As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:

Job 7:3 [HEB]  כֵּ֤ן הָנְחַ֣לְתִּי לִ֭י יַרְחֵי שָׁ֑וְא וְלֵיל֥וֹת עָ֝מָ֗ל מִנּוּ לִֽי
Job 7:3 [KJV]  So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

Job 7:4 [HEB]  אִם שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מָתַ֣י אָ֭קוּם וּמִדַּד עָ֑רֶב וְשָׂבַ֖עְתִּי נְדֻדִ֣ים עֲדֵי נָֽשֶׁף
Job 7:4 [KJV]  When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

Job 7:5 [HEB]  לָ֘בַ֤שׁ בְּשָׂרִ֣י רִ֭מָּה וגיש וְג֣וּשׁ עָפָ֑ר עוֹרִ֥י רָ֝גַ֗ע וַיִּמָּאֵֽס
Job 7:5 [KJV]  My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.

Job 7:6 [HEB]  יָמַ֣י קַ֭לּוּ מִנִּי אָ֑רֶג וַ֝יִּכְל֗וּ בְּאֶ֣פֶס תִּקְוָֽה
Job 7:6 [KJV]  My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

Job 7:7 [HEB]  זְ֭כֹר כִּי ר֣וּחַ חַיָּ֑י לֹא תָשׁ֥וּב עֵ֝ינִ֗י לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב
Job 7:7 [KJV]  O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.

Job 7:8 [HEB]  לֹֽא תְ֭שׁוּרֵנִי עֵ֣ין רֹ֑אִי עֵינֶ֖יךָ בִּ֣י וְאֵינֶֽנִּי
Job 7:8 [KJV]  The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.

Job 7:9 [HEB]  כָּלָ֣ה עָ֭נָן וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ כֵּ֥ן יוֹרֵ֥ד שְׁ֝א֗וֹל לֹ֣א יַעֲלֶֽה
Job 7:9 [KJV]  As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.

Job 7:10 [HEB]  לֹא יָשׁ֣וּב ע֣וֹד לְבֵית֑וֹ וְלֹא יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקֹמֽוֹ
Job 7:10 [KJV]  He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.

Job 7:11 [HEB]  גַּם אֲנִי֮ לֹ֤א אֶחֱשָׂ֫ךְ פִּ֥י אֲֽ֭דַבְּרָה בְּצַ֣ר רוּחִ֑י אָ֝שִׂ֗יחָה בְּמַ֣ר נַפְשִֽׁי
Job 7:11 [KJV]  Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

Job 7:12 [HEB]  הֲֽיָם אָ֭נִי אִם תַּנִּ֑ין כִּֽי תָשִׂ֖ים עָלַ֣י מִשְׁמָֽר
Job 7:12 [KJV]  Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?

Job 7:13 [HEB]  כִּֽי אָ֭מַרְתִּי תְּנַחֲמֵ֣נִי עַרְשִׂ֑י יִשָּׂ֥א בְ֝שִׂיחִ֗י מִשְׁכָּבִֽי
Job 7:13 [KJV]  When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;

Job 7:14 [HEB]  וְחִתַּתַּ֥נִי בַחֲלֹמ֑וֹת וּֽמֵחֶזְיֹנ֥וֹת תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי
Job 7:14 [KJV]  Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:

Job 7:15 [HEB]  וַתִּבְחַ֣ר מַחֲנָ֣ק נַפְשִׁ֑י מָ֝֗וֶת מֵֽעַצְמוֹתָֽי
Job 7:15 [KJV]  So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.

Job 7:16 [HEB]  מָ֭אַסְתִּי לֹא לְעֹלָ֣ם אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה חֲדַ֥ל מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי כִּי הֶ֥בֶל יָמָֽי
Job 7:16 [KJV]  I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.

Job 7:17 [HEB]  מָֽה אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כִּ֣י תְגַדְּלֶ֑נּוּ וְכִי תָשִׁ֖ית אֵלָ֣יו לִבֶּֽךָ
Job 7:17 [KJV]  What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?

Job 7:18 [HEB]  וַתִּפְקְדֶ֥נּוּ לִבְקָרִ֑ים לִ֝רְגָעִ֗ים תִּבְחָנֶֽנּוּ
Job 7:18 [KJV]  And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?

Job 7:19 [HEB]  כַּ֭מָּה לֹא תִשְׁעֶ֣ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי לֹֽא תַ֝רְפֵּ֗נִי עַד בִּלְעִ֥י רֻקִּֽי
Job 7:19 [KJV]  How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

Job 7:20 [HEB]  חָטָ֡אתִי מָ֤ה אֶפְעַ֨ל לָךְ֮ נֹצֵ֪ר הָאָ֫דָ֥ם לָ֤מָה שַׂמְתַּ֣נִי לְמִפְגָּ֣ע לָ֑ךְ וָאֶהְיֶ֖ה עָלַ֣י לְמַשָּֽׂא
Job 7:20 [KJV]  I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?

Job 7:21 [HEB]  וּמֶ֤ה לֹא תִשָּׂ֣א פִשְׁעִי֮ וְתַעֲבִ֪יר אֶת עֲוֺ֫נִ֥י כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה לֶעָפָ֣ר אֶשְׁכָּ֑ב וְשִׁ֖חֲרְתַּ֣נִי וְאֵינֶֽנִּי
Job 7:21 [KJV]  And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.


--- Job Chapter 8 ---
Job 8:1 [HEB]  וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשּׁוּחִ֗י וַיֹאמַֽר
Job 8:1 [KJV]  Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

Job 8:2 [HEB]  עַד אָ֥ן תְּמַלֶּל אֵ֑לֶּה וְר֥וּחַ כַּ֝בִּיר אִמְרֵי פִֽיךָ
Job 8:2 [KJV]  How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?

Job 8:3 [HEB]  הַ֭אֵל יְעַוֵּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְאִם שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יְעַוֵּֽת צֶֽדֶק
Job 8:3 [KJV]  Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

Job 8:4 [HEB]  אִם בָּנֶ֥יךָ חָֽטְאוּ ל֑וֹ וַֽ֝יְשַׁלְּחֵ֗ם בְּיַד פִּשְׁעָֽם
Job 8:4 [KJV]  If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;

Job 8:5 [HEB]  אִם אַ֭תָּה תְּשַׁחֵ֣ר אֶל אֵ֑ל וְאֶל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י תִּתְחַנָּֽן
Job 8:5 [KJV]  If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;

Job 8:6 [HEB]  אִם זַ֥ךְ וְיָשָׁ֗ר אָ֥תָּה כִּי עַ֭תָּה יָעִ֣יר עָלֶ֑יךָ וְ֝שִׁלַּ֗ם נְוַ֣ת צִדְקֶֽךָ
Job 8:6 [KJV]  If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

Job 8:7 [HEB]  וְהָיָ֣ה רֵאשִׁיתְךָ֣ מִצְעָ֑ר וְ֝אַחֲרִיתְךָ֗ יִשְׂגֶּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
Job 8:7 [KJV]  Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

Job 8:8 [HEB]  כִּֽי שְׁאַל נָ֭א לְדֹ֣ר רִישׁ֑וֹן וְ֝כוֹנֵ֗ן לְחֵ֣קֶר אֲבוֹתָֽם
Job 8:8 [KJV]  For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:

Job 8:9 [HEB]  כִּֽי תְמ֣וֹל אֲ֭נַחְנוּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע כִּ֤י צֵ֖ל יָמֵ֣ינוּ עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ
Job 8:9 [KJV]  (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)

Job 8:10 [HEB]  הֲלֹא הֵ֣ם י֭וֹרוּךָ יֹ֣אמְרוּ לָ֑ךְ וּ֝מִלִּבָּ֗ם יוֹצִ֥אוּ מִלִּֽים
Job 8:10 [KJV]  Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

Job 8:11 [HEB]  הֲיִֽגְאֶה גֹּ֭מֶא בְּלֹ֣א בִצָּ֑ה יִשְׂגֶּה אָ֥חוּ בְלִי מָֽיִם
Job 8:11 [KJV]  Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?

Job 8:12 [HEB]  עֹדֶ֣נּוּ בְ֭אִבּוֹ לֹ֣א יִקָּטֵ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָל חָצִ֣יר יִיבָֽשׁ
Job 8:12 [KJV]  Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.

Job 8:13 [HEB]  כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל שֹׁ֣כְחֵי אֵ֑ל וְתִקְוַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף תֹּאבֵֽד
Job 8:13 [KJV]  So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish:

Job 8:14 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁר יָק֥וֹט כִּסְל֑וֹ וּבֵ֥ית עַ֝כָּבִ֗ישׁ מִבְטַחֽוֹ
Job 8:14 [KJV]  Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider’s web.

Job 8:15 [HEB]  יִשָּׁעֵ֣ן עַל בֵּ֭יתוֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֑ד יַחֲזִ֥יק בּ֝֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יָקֽוּם
Job 8:15 [KJV]  He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

Job 8:16 [HEB]  רָטֹ֣ב ה֭וּא לִפְנֵי שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְעַ֥ל גַּ֝נָּת֗וֹ יֹֽנַקְתּ֥וֹ תֵצֵֽא
Job 8:16 [KJV]  He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.

Job 8:17 [HEB]  עַל גַּ֭ל שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣יו יְסֻבָּ֑כוּ בֵּ֖ית אֲבָנִ֣ים יֶחֱזֶֽה
Job 8:17 [KJV]  His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.

Job 8:18 [HEB]  אִם יְבַלְּעֶ֥נּוּ מִמְּקוֹמ֑וֹ וְכִ֥חֶשׁ בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א רְאִיתִֽיךָ
Job 8:18 [KJV]  If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.

Job 8:19 [HEB]  הֶן ה֭וּא מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝מֵעָפָ֗ר אַחֵ֥ר יִצְמָֽחוּ
Job 8:19 [KJV]  Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.

Job 8:20 [HEB]  הֶן אֵ֭ל לֹ֣א יִמְאַס תָּ֑ם וְלֹֽא יַ֝חֲזִ֗יק בְּיַד מְרֵעִֽים
Job 8:20 [KJV]  Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:

Job 8:21 [HEB]  עַד יְמַלֵּ֣ה שְׂח֣וֹק פִּ֑יךָ וּשְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ תְרוּעָֽה
Job 8:21 [KJV]  Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.

Job 8:22 [HEB]  שֹׂנְאֶ֥יךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ בֹ֑שֶׁת וְאֹ֖הֶל רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֵינֶֽנּוּ
Job 8:22 [KJV]  They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.


--- Job Chapter 9 ---
Job 9:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 9:1 [KJV]  Then Job answered and said,

Job 9:2 [HEB]  אָ֭מְנָם יָדַ֣עְתִּי כִי כֵ֑ן וּמַה יִּצְדַּ֖ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם אֵֽל
Job 9:2 [KJV]  I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?

Job 9:3 [HEB]  אִם יַ֭חְפֹּץ לָרִ֣יב עִמּ֑וֹ לֹֽא יַ֝עֲנֶ֗נּוּ אַחַ֥ת מִנִּי אָֽלֶף
Job 9:3 [KJV]  If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.

Job 9:4 [HEB]  חֲכַ֣ם לֵ֭בָב וְאַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֑חַ מִֽי הִקְשָׁ֥ה אֵ֝לָ֗יו וַיִּשְׁלָֽם
Job 9:4 [KJV]  He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?

Job 9:5 [HEB]  הַמַּעְתִּ֣יק הָ֭רִים וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֑עוּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲפָכָ֣ם בְּאַפּֽוֹ
Job 9:5 [KJV]  Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.

Job 9:6 [HEB]  הַמַּרְגִּ֣יז אֶ֭רֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָ֑הּ וְ֝עַמּוּדֶ֗יהָ יִתְפַלָּצֽוּן
Job 9:6 [KJV]  Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.

Job 9:7 [HEB]  הָאֹמֵ֣ר לַ֭חֶרֶס וְלֹ֣א יִזְרָ֑ח וּבְעַ֖ד כּוֹכָבִ֣ים יַחְתֹּֽם
Job 9:7 [KJV]  Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.

Job 9:8 [HEB]  נֹטֶ֣ה שָׁמַ֣יִם לְבַדּ֑וֹ וְ֝דוֹרֵ֗ךְ עַל בָּ֥מֳתֵי יָֽם
Job 9:8 [KJV]  Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.

Job 9:9 [HEB]  עֹֽשֶׂה עָ֭שׁ כְּסִ֥יל וְכִימָ֗ה וְחַדְרֵ֥י תֵמָֽן
Job 9:9 [KJV]  Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.

Job 9:10 [HEB]  עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת עַד אֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר וְנִפְלָא֗וֹת עַד אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר
Job 9:10 [KJV]  Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.

Job 9:11 [HEB]  הֵ֤ן יַעֲבֹ֣ר עָ֭לַי וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝יַחֲלֹ֗ף וְֽלֹא אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ
Job 9:11 [KJV]  Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

Job 9:12 [HEB]  הֵ֣ן יַ֭חְתֹּף מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ מִֽי יֹאמַ֥ר אֵ֝לָ֗יו מַֽה תַּעֲשֶֽׂה
Job 9:12 [KJV]  Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?

Job 9:13 [HEB]  אֱ֭לוֹהַּ לֹא יָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ תחתו תַּחְתָּ֥יו שָׁ֝חֲח֗וּ עֹ֣זְרֵי רָֽהַב
Job 9:13 [KJV]  If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.

Job 9:14 [HEB]  אַ֭ף כִּֽי אָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑נּוּ אֶבְחֲרָ֖ה דְבָרַ֣י עִמּֽוֹ
Job 9:14 [KJV]  How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?

Job 9:15 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם צָ֭דַקְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶעֱנֶ֑ה לִ֝מְשֹׁפְטִ֗י אֶתְחַנָּֽן
Job 9:15 [KJV]  Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.

Job 9:16 [HEB]  אִם קָרָ֥אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑נִי לֹֽא אַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּֽי יַאֲזִ֥ין קוֹלִֽי
Job 9:16 [KJV]  If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.

Job 9:17 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂעָרָ֥ה יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְהִרְבָּ֖ה פְצָעַ֣י חִנָּֽם
Job 9:17 [KJV]  For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.

Job 9:18 [HEB]  לֹֽא יִ֭תְּנֵנִי הָשֵׁ֣ב רוּחִ֑י כִּ֥י יַ֝שְׂבִּעַ֗נִי מַמְּרֹרִֽים
Job 9:18 [KJV]  He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.

Job 9:19 [HEB]  אִם לְכֹ֣חַ אַמִּ֣יץ הִנֵּ֑ה וְאִם לְ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מִ֣י יוֹעִידֵֽנִי
Job 9:19 [KJV]  If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?

Job 9:20 [HEB]  אִם אֶ֭צְדָּק פִּ֣י יַרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי תָּֽם אָ֝֗נִי וַֽיַּעְקְשֵֽׁנִי
Job 9:20 [KJV]  If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.

Job 9:21 [HEB]  תָּֽם אָ֭נִי לֹֽא אֵדַ֥ע נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶמְאַ֥ס חַיָּֽי
Job 9:21 [KJV]  Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

Job 9:22 [HEB]  אַחַ֗ת הִ֥יא עַל כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֑רְתִּי תָּ֥ם וְ֝רָשָׁ֗ע ה֣וּא מְכַלֶּֽה
Job 9:22 [KJV]  This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

Job 9:23 [HEB]  אִם שׁ֭וֹט יָמִ֣ית פִּתְאֹ֑ם לְמַסַּ֖ת נְקִיִּ֣ם יִלְעָֽג
Job 9:23 [KJV]  If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

Job 9:24 [HEB]  אֶ֤רֶץ נִתְּנָ֬ה בְֽיַד רָשָׁ֗ע פְּנֵֽי שֹׁפְטֶ֥יהָ יְכַסֶּ֑ה אִם לֹ֖א אֵפ֣וֹא מִי הֽוּא
Job 9:24 [KJV]  The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?

Job 9:25 [HEB]  וְיָמַ֣י קַ֭לּוּ מִנִּי רָ֑ץ בָּֽ֝רְח֗וּ לֹא רָא֥וּ טוֹבָֽה
Job 9:25 [KJV]  Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.

Job 9:26 [HEB]  חָ֭לְפוּ עִם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת אֵבֶ֑ה כְּ֝נֶ֗שֶׁר יָט֥וּשׂ עֲלֵי אֹֽכֶל
Job 9:26 [KJV]  They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.

Job 9:27 [HEB]  אִם אָ֭מְרִי אֶשְׁכְּחָ֣ה שִׂיחִ֑י אֶעֶזְבָ֖ה פָנַ֣י וְאַבְלִֽיגָה
Job 9:27 [KJV]  If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:

Job 9:28 [HEB]  יָגֹ֥רְתִּי כָל עַצְּבֹתָ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי לֹ֥א תְנַקֵּֽנִי
Job 9:28 [KJV]  I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

Job 9:29 [HEB]  אָנֹכִ֥י אֶרְשָׁ֑ע לָמָּה זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל אִיגָֽע
Job 9:29 [KJV]  If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?

Job 9:30 [HEB]  אִם הִתְרָחַ֥צְתִּי במו בְמֵי שָׁ֑לֶג וַ֝הֲזִכּ֗וֹתִי בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפָּֽי
Job 9:30 [KJV]  If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

Job 9:31 [HEB]  אָ֭ז בַּשַּׁ֣חַת תִּטְבְּלֵ֑נִי וְ֝תִֽעֲב֗וּנִי שַׂלְמוֹתָֽי
Job 9:31 [KJV]  Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.

Job 9:32 [HEB]  כִּי לֹא אִ֣ישׁ כָּמֹ֣נִי אֶֽעֱנֶ֑נּוּ נָב֥וֹא יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט
Job 9:32 [KJV]  For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.

Job 9:33 [HEB]  לֹ֣א יֵשׁ בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ מוֹכִ֑יחַ יָשֵׁ֖ת יָד֣וֹ עַל שְׁנֵֽינוּ
Job 9:33 [KJV]  Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.

Job 9:34 [HEB]  יָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י שִׁבְט֑וֹ וְ֝אֵמָת֗וֹ אַֽל תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי
Job 9:34 [KJV]  Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

Job 9:35 [HEB]  אַֽ֭דַבְּרָה וְלֹ֣א אִירָאֶ֑נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹא כֵ֥ן אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עִמָּדִֽי
Job 9:35 [KJV]  Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.


--- Job Chapter 10 ---
Job 10:1 [HEB]  נָֽקְטָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֗י בְּחַ֫יָּ֥י אֶֽעֶזְבָ֣ה עָלַ֣י שִׂיחִ֑י אֲ֝דַבְּרָה֗ בְּמַ֣ר נַפְשִֽׁי
Job 10:1 [KJV]  My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

Job 10:2 [HEB]  אֹמַ֣ר אֶל אֱ֭לוֹהַּ אַל תַּרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי הֽ֝וֹדִיעֵ֗נִי עַ֣ל מַה תְּרִיבֵֽנִי
Job 10:2 [KJV]  I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.

Job 10:3 [HEB]  הֲט֤וֹב לְךָ֨ כִּֽי תַעֲשֹׁ֗ק כִּֽי תִ֭מְאַס יְגִ֣יעַ כַּפֶּ֑יךָ וְעַל עֲצַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים הוֹפָֽעְתָּ
Job 10:3 [KJV]  Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

Job 10:4 [HEB]  הַעֵינֵ֣י בָשָׂ֣ר לָ֑ךְ אִם כִּרְא֖וֹת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ תִּרְאֶֽה
Job 10:4 [KJV]  Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?

Job 10:5 [HEB]  הֲכִימֵ֣י אֱנ֣וֹשׁ יָמֶ֑יךָ אִם שְׁ֝נוֹתֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣ימֵי גָֽבֶר
Job 10:5 [KJV]  Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man’s days,

Job 10:6 [HEB]  כִּֽי תְבַקֵּ֥שׁ לַעֲוֺנִ֑י וּ֭לְחַטָּאתִ֥י תִדְרֽוֹשׁ
Job 10:6 [KJV]  That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?

Job 10:7 [HEB]  עַֽל דַּ֭עְתְּךָ כִּי לֹ֣א אֶרְשָׁ֑ע וְאֵ֖ין מִיָּדְךָ֣ מַצִּֽיל
Job 10:7 [KJV]  Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.

Job 10:8 [HEB]  יָדֶ֣יךָ עִ֭צְּבוּנִי וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֑וּנִי יַ֥חַד סָ֝בִ֗יב וַֽתְּבַלְּעֵֽנִי
Job 10:8 [KJV]  Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

Job 10:9 [HEB]  זְכָר נָ֭א כִּי כַחֹ֣מֶר עֲשִׂיתָ֑נִי וְֽאֶל עָפָ֥ר תְּשִׁיבֵֽנִי
Job 10:9 [KJV]  Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?

Job 10:10 [HEB]  הֲלֹ֣א כֶ֭חָלָב תַּתִּיכֵ֑נִי וְ֝כַגְּבִנָּ֗ה תַּקְפִּיאֵֽנִי
Job 10:10 [KJV]  Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

Job 10:11 [HEB]  ע֣וֹר וּ֭בָשָׂר תַּלְבִּישֵׁ֑נִי וּֽבַעֲצָמ֥וֹת וְ֝גִידִ֗ים תְּסֹכְכֵֽנִי
Job 10:11 [KJV]  Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.

Job 10:12 [HEB]  חַיִּ֣ים וָ֭חֶסֶד עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִמָּדִ֑י וּ֝פְקֻדָּתְךָ֗ שָֽׁמְרָ֥ה רוּחִֽי
Job 10:12 [KJV]  Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

Job 10:13 [HEB]  וְ֭אֵלֶּה צָפַ֣נְתָּ בִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי זֹ֥את עִמָּֽךְ
Job 10:13 [KJV]  And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.

Job 10:14 [HEB]  אִם חָטָ֥אתִי וּשְׁמַרְתָּ֑נִי וּ֝מֵעֲוֺנִ֗י לֹ֣א תְנַקֵּֽנִי
Job 10:14 [KJV]  If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

Job 10:15 [HEB]  אִם רָשַׁ֡עְתִּי אַלְלַ֬י לִ֗י וְ֭צָדַקְתִּי לֹא אֶשָּׂ֣א רֹאשִׁ֑י שְׂבַ֥ע קָ֝ל֗וֹן וּרְאֵ֥ה עָנְיִֽי
Job 10:15 [KJV]  If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;

Job 10:16 [HEB]  וְ֭יִגְאֶה כַּשַּׁ֣חַל תְּצוּדֵ֑נִי וְ֝תָשֹׁ֗ב תִּתְפַּלָּא בִֽי
Job 10:16 [KJV]  For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.

Job 10:17 [HEB]  תְּחַדֵּ֬שׁ עֵדֶ֨יךָ נֶגְדִּ֗י וְתֶ֣רֶב כַּֽ֭עַשְׂךָ עִמָּדִ֑י חֲלִיפ֖וֹת וְצָבָ֣א עִמִּֽי
Job 10:17 [KJV]  Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.

Job 10:18 [HEB]  וְלָ֣מָּה מֵ֭רֶחֶם הֹצֵאתָ֑נִי אֶ֝גְוַ֗ע וְעַ֣יִן לֹא תִרְאֵֽנִי
Job 10:18 [KJV]  Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!

Job 10:19 [HEB]  כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא הָיִ֣יתִי אֶהְיֶ֑ה מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן לַקֶּ֥בֶר אוּבָֽל
Job 10:19 [KJV]  I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

Job 10:20 [HEB]  הֲלֹא מְעַ֣ט יָמַ֣י יחדל וַחֲדָ֑ל ישית וְשִׁ֥ית מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי וְאַבְלִ֥יגָה מְּעָֽט
Job 10:20 [KJV]  Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

Job 10:21 [HEB]  בְּטֶ֣רֶם אֵ֭לֵךְ וְלֹ֣א אָשׁ֑וּב אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָֽוֶת
Job 10:21 [KJV]  Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

Job 10:22 [HEB]  אֶ֤רֶץ עֵיפָ֨תָה כְּמ֥וֹ אֹ֗פֶל צַ֭לְמָוֶת וְלֹ֥א סְדָרִ֗ים וַתֹּ֥פַע כְּמוֹ אֹֽפֶל
Job 10:22 [KJV]  A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.


--- Job Chapter 11 ---
Job 11:1 [HEB]  וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַֽנַּעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 11:1 [KJV]  Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

Job 11:2 [HEB]  הֲרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֵעָנֶ֑ה וְאִם אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפָתַ֣יִם יִצְדָּֽק
Job 11:2 [KJV]  Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?

Job 11:3 [HEB]  בַּ֭דֶּיךָ מְתִ֣ים יַחֲרִ֑ישׁו וַ֝תִּלְעַ֗ג וְאֵ֣ין מַכְלִֽם
Job 11:3 [KJV]  Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

Job 11:4 [HEB]  וַ֭תֹּאמֶר זַ֣ךְ לִקְחִ֑י וּ֝בַ֗ר הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֶֽיךָ
Job 11:4 [KJV]  For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.

Job 11:5 [HEB]  וְֽאוּלָ֗ם מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן אֱל֣וֹהַּ דַּבֵּ֑ר וְיִפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתָ֣יו עִמָּֽךְ
Job 11:5 [KJV]  But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;

Job 11:6 [HEB]  וְיַגֶּד לְךָ֨ תַּֽעֲלֻמ֣וֹת חָכְמָה֮ כִּֽי כִפְלַ֪יִם לְֽת֫וּשִׁיָּ֥ה וְדַ֡ע כִּֽי יַשֶּׁ֥ה לְךָ֥ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵעֲוֺנֶֽךָ
Job 11:6 [KJV]  And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.

Job 11:7 [HEB]  הַחֵ֣קֶר אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּמְצָ֑א אִ֤ם עַד תַּכְלִ֖ית שַׁדַּ֣י תִּמְצָֽא
Job 11:7 [KJV]  Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

Job 11:8 [HEB]  גָּבְהֵ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם מַה תִּפְעָ֑ל עֲמֻקָּ֥ה מִ֝שְּׁא֗וֹל מַה תֵּדָֽע
Job 11:8 [KJV]  It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?

Job 11:9 [HEB]  אֲרֻכָּ֣ה מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִדָּ֑הּ וּ֝רְחָבָ֗ה מִנִּי יָֽם
Job 11:9 [KJV]  The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

Job 11:10 [HEB]  אִם יַחֲלֹ֥ף וְיַסְגִּ֑יר וְ֝יַקְהִ֗יל וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ
Job 11:10 [KJV]  If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?

Job 11:11 [HEB]  כִּי ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע מְתֵי שָׁ֑וְא וַיַּרְא אָ֝֗וֶן וְלֹ֣א יִתְבּוֹנָֽן
Job 11:11 [KJV]  For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?

Job 11:12 [HEB]  וְאִ֣ישׁ נָ֭בוּב יִלָּבֵ֑ב וְעַ֥יִר פֶּ֝֗רֶא אָדָ֥ם יִוָּלֵֽד
Job 11:12 [KJV]  For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass’s colt.

Job 11:13 [HEB]  אִם אַ֭תָּ֗ה הֲכִינ֣וֹתָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ֖ אֵלָ֣יו כַּפֶּֽךָ
Job 11:13 [KJV]  If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;

Job 11:14 [HEB]  אִם אָ֣וֶן בְּ֭יָדְךָ הַרְחִיקֵ֑הוּ וְאַל תַּשְׁכֵּ֖ן בְּאֹהָלֶ֣יךָ עַוְלָֽה
Job 11:14 [KJV]  If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.

Job 11:15 [HEB]  כִּי אָ֤ז תִּשָּׂ֣א פָנֶ֣יךָ מִמּ֑וּם וְהָיִ֥יתָ מֻ֝צָ֗ק וְלֹ֣א תִירָֽא
Job 11:15 [KJV]  For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:

Job 11:16 [HEB]  כִּי אַ֭תָּה עָמָ֣ל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח כְּמַ֖יִם עָבְר֣וּ תִזְכֹּֽר
Job 11:16 [KJV]  Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:

Job 11:17 [HEB]  וּֽ֭מִצָּהֳרַיִם יָק֣וּם חָ֑לֶד תָּ֝עֻ֗פָה כַּבֹּ֥קֶר תִּהְיֶֽה
Job 11:17 [KJV]  And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday: thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.

Job 11:18 [HEB]  וּֽ֭בָטַחְתָּ כִּי יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝חָפַרְתָּ֗ לָבֶ֥טַח תִּשְׁכָּֽב
Job 11:18 [KJV]  And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.

Job 11:19 [HEB]  וְֽ֭רָבַצְתָּ וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְחִלּ֖וּ פָנֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים
Job 11:19 [KJV]  Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

Job 11:20 [HEB]  וְעֵינֵ֥י רְשָׁעִ֗ים תִּ֫כְלֶ֥ינָה וּ֭מָנוֹס אָבַ֣ד מִנְהֶ֑ם וְ֝תִקְוָתָ֗ם מַֽפַּח נָֽפֶשׁ
Job 11:20 [KJV]  But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.


--- Job Chapter 12 ---
Job 12:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 12:1 [KJV]  And Job answered and said,

Job 12:2 [HEB]  אָ֭מְנָם כִּ֣י אַתֶּם עָ֑ם וְ֝עִמָּכֶ֗ם תָּמ֥וּת חָכְמָֽה
Job 12:2 [KJV]  No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

Job 12:3 [HEB]  גַּם לִ֤י לֵבָ֨ב כְּֽמוֹכֶ֗ם לֹא נֹפֵ֣ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּ֑ם וְאֶת מִי אֵ֥ין כְּמוֹ אֵֽלֶּה
Job 12:3 [KJV]  But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

Job 12:4 [HEB]  שְׂחֹ֤ק לְרֵעֵ֨הוּ אֶֽהְיֶ֗ה קֹרֵ֣א לֶ֭אֱלוֹהַּ וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ שְׂ֝ח֗וֹק צַדִּ֥יק תָּמִֽים
Job 12:4 [KJV]  I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.

Job 12:5 [HEB]  לַפִּ֣יד בּ֭וּז לְעַשְׁתּ֣וּת שַׁאֲנָ֑ן נָ֝כ֗וֹן לְמ֣וֹעֲדֵי רָֽגֶל
Job 12:5 [KJV]  He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

Job 12:6 [HEB]  יִשְׁלָ֤יוּ אֹֽהָלִ֨ים לְשֹׁ֥דְדִ֗ים וּֽ֭בַטֻּחוֹת לְמַרְגִּ֣יזֵי אֵ֑ל לַאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבִ֖יא אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּיָדֽוֹ
Job 12:6 [KJV]  The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.

Job 12:7 [HEB]  וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁאַל נָ֣א בְהֵמ֣וֹת וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ וְע֥וֹף הַ֝שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְיַגֶּד לָֽךְ
Job 12:7 [KJV]  But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:

Job 12:8 [HEB]  א֤וֹ שִׂ֣יחַ לָאָ֣רֶץ וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ דְּגֵ֣י הַיָּֽם
Job 12:8 [KJV]  Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

Job 12:9 [HEB]  מִ֭י לֹא יָדַ֣ע בְּכָל אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֥י יַד יְ֝הוָה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּֽאת
Job 12:9 [KJV]  Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?

Job 12:10 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ נֶ֣פֶשׁ כָּל חָ֑י וְ֝ר֗וּחַ כָּל בְּשַׂר אִֽישׁ
Job 12:10 [KJV]  In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.

Job 12:11 [HEB]  הֲלֹא אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ אֹ֣כֶל יִטְעַם לֽוֹ
Job 12:11 [KJV]  Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?

Job 12:12 [HEB]  בִּֽישִׁישִׁ֥ים חָכְמָ֑ה וְאֹ֖רֶךְ יָמִ֣ים תְּבוּנָֽה
Job 12:12 [KJV]  With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.

Job 12:13 [HEB]  עִ֭מּוֹ חָכְמָ֣ה וּגְבוּרָ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ עֵצָ֥ה וּתְבוּנָֽה
Job 12:13 [KJV]  With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

Job 12:14 [HEB]  הֵ֣ן יַ֭הֲרוֹס וְלֹ֣א יִבָּנֶ֑ה יִסְגֹּ֥ר עַל אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֹ֣א יִפָּתֵֽחַ
Job 12:14 [KJV]  Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

Job 12:15 [HEB]  הֵ֤ן יַעְצֹ֣ר בַּמַּ֣יִם וְיִבָ֑שׁוּ וִֽ֝ישַׁלְּחֵ֗ם וְיַ֖הַפְכוּ אָֽרֶץ
Job 12:15 [KJV]  Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

Job 12:16 [HEB]  עִ֭מּוֹ עֹ֣ז וְתֽוּשִׁיָּ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ שֹׁגֵ֥ג וּמַשְׁגֶּֽה
Job 12:16 [KJV]  With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.

Job 12:17 [HEB]  מוֹלִ֣יךְ יוֹעֲצִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְֽשֹׁפְטִ֥ים יְהוֹלֵֽל
Job 12:17 [KJV]  He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.

Job 12:18 [HEB]  מוּסַ֣ר מְלָכִ֣ים פִּתֵּ֑חַ וַיֶּאְסֹ֥ר אֵ֝ז֗וֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶֽם
Job 12:18 [KJV]  He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.

Job 12:19 [HEB]  מוֹלִ֣יךְ כֹּהֲנִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְאֵֽתָנִ֣ים יְסַלֵּֽף
Job 12:19 [KJV]  He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.

Job 12:20 [HEB]  מֵסִ֣יר שָׂ֭פָה לְנֶאֱמָנִ֑ים וְטַ֖עַם זְקֵנִ֣ים יִקָּֽח
Job 12:20 [KJV]  He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.

Job 12:21 [HEB]  שׁוֹפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל נְדִיבִ֑ים וּמְזִ֖יחַ אֲפִיקִ֣ים רִפָּֽה
Job 12:21 [KJV]  He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

Job 12:22 [HEB]  מְגַלֶּ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקוֹת מִנִּי חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַיֹּצֵ֖א לָא֣וֹר צַלְמָֽוֶת
Job 12:22 [KJV]  He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

Job 12:23 [HEB]  מַשְׂגִּ֣יא לַ֭גּוֹיִם וַֽיְאַבְּדֵ֑ם שֹׁטֵ֥חַ לַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם וַיַּנְחֵֽם
Job 12:23 [KJV]  He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.

Job 12:24 [HEB]  מֵסִ֗יר לֵ֭ב רָאשֵׁ֣י עַם הָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא דָֽרֶךְ
Job 12:24 [KJV]  He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

Job 12:25 [HEB]  יְמַֽשְׁשׁוּ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְלֹא א֑וֹר וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם כַּשִּׁכּֽוֹר
Job 12:25 [KJV]  They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.


--- Job Chapter 13 ---
Job 13:1 [HEB]  הֶן כֹּ֭ל רָאֲתָ֣ה עֵינִ֑י שָֽׁמְעָ֥ה אָ֝זְנִ֗י וַתָּ֥בֶן לָֽהּ
Job 13:1 [KJV]  Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.

Job 13:2 [HEB]  כְּֽ֭דַעְתְּכֶם יָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם אָ֑נִי לֹא נֹפֵ֖ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּֽם
Job 13:2 [KJV]  What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.

Job 13:3 [HEB]  אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶל שַׁדַּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְהוֹכֵ֖חַ אֶל אֵ֣ל אֶחְפָּֽץ
Job 13:3 [KJV]  Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.

Job 13:4 [HEB]  וְֽאוּלָ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם טֹֽפְלֵי שָׁ֑קֶר רֹפְאֵ֖י אֱלִ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם
Job 13:4 [KJV]  But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

Job 13:5 [HEB]  מִֽי יִ֭תֵּן הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישׁ֑וּן וּתְהִ֖י לָכֶ֣ם לְחָכְמָֽה
Job 13:5 [KJV]  O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.

Job 13:6 [HEB]  שִׁמְעוּ נָ֥א תוֹכַחְתִּ֑י וְרִב֖וֹת שְׂפָתַ֣י הַקְשִֽׁיבוּ
Job 13:6 [KJV]  Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

Job 13:7 [HEB]  הַ֭לְאֵל תְּדַבְּר֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה וְ֝ל֗וֹ תְּֽדַבְּר֥וּ רְמִיָּֽה
Job 13:7 [KJV]  Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?

Job 13:8 [HEB]  הֲפָנָ֥יו תִּשָּׂא֑וּן אִם לָאֵ֥ל תְּרִיבֽוּן
Job 13:8 [KJV]  Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?

Job 13:9 [HEB]  הֲ֭טוֹב כִּֽי יַחְקֹ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם כְּהָתֵ֥ל בֶּ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ תְּהָתֵ֥לּוּ בֽוֹ
Job 13:9 [KJV]  Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?

Job 13:10 [HEB]  הוֹכֵ֣חַ יוֹכִ֣יחַ אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם בַּ֝סֵּ֗תֶר פָּנִ֥ים תִּשָּׂאֽוּן
Job 13:10 [KJV]  He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.

Job 13:11 [HEB]  הֲלֹ֣א שְׂ֭אֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵ֣ת אֶתְכֶ֑ם וּ֝פַחְדּ֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל עֲלֵיכֶֽם
Job 13:11 [KJV]  Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?

Job 13:12 [HEB]  זִֽ֭כְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי אֵ֑פֶר לְגַבֵּי חֹ֝֗מֶר גַּבֵּיכֶֽם
Job 13:12 [KJV]  Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.

Job 13:13 [HEB]  הַחֲרִ֣ישׁוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אָ֑נִי וְיַעֲבֹ֖ר עָלַ֣י מָֽה
Job 13:13 [KJV]  Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.

Job 13:14 [HEB]  עַל מָ֤ה אֶשָּׂ֣א בְשָׂרִ֣י בְשִׁנָּ֑י וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אָשִׂ֥ים בְּכַפִּֽי
Job 13:14 [KJV]  Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?

Job 13:15 [HEB]  הֵ֣ן יִ֭קְטְלֵנִי לא ל֣וֹ אֲיַחֵ֑ל אַךְ דְּ֝רָכַ֗י אֶל פָּנָ֥יו אוֹכִֽיחַ
Job 13:15 [KJV]  Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.

Job 13:16 [HEB]  גַּם הוּא לִ֥י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי לֹ֥א לְ֝פָנָ֗יו חָנֵ֥ף יָבֽוֹא
Job 13:16 [KJV]  He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.

Job 13:17 [HEB]  שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝אַֽחֲוָתִ֗י בְּאָזְנֵיכֶֽם
Job 13:17 [KJV]  Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.

Job 13:18 [HEB]  הִנֵּה נָ֭א עָרַ֣כְתִּי מִשְׁפָּ֑ט יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י אֶצְדָּֽק
Job 13:18 [KJV]  Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.

Job 13:19 [HEB]  מִי ה֭וּא יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י כִּֽי עַתָּ֖ה אַחֲרִ֣ישׁ וְאֶגְוָֽע
Job 13:19 [KJV]  Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.

Job 13:20 [HEB]  אַךְ שְׁ֭תַּיִם אַל תַּ֣עַשׂ עִמָּדִ֑י אָ֥ז מִ֝פָּנֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א אֶסָּתֵֽר
Job 13:20 [KJV]  Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.

Job 13:21 [HEB]  כַּ֭פְּךָ מֵעָלַ֣י הַרְחַ֑ק וְ֝אֵ֥מָתְךָ֗ אַֽל תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי
Job 13:21 [KJV]  Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.

Job 13:22 [HEB]  וּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה אֽוֹ אֲ֝דַבֵּ֗ר וַהֲשִׁיבֵֽנִי
Job 13:22 [KJV]  Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.

Job 13:23 [HEB]  כַּמָּ֣ה לִ֭י עֲוֺנ֣וֹת וְחַטָּא֑וֹת פִּֽשְׁעִ֥י וְ֝חַטָּאתִ֗י הֹדִיעֵֽנִי
Job 13:23 [KJV]  How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.

Job 13:24 [HEB]  לָֽמָּה פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר וְתַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לָֽךְ
Job 13:24 [KJV]  Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?

Job 13:25 [HEB]  הֶעָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֣ף תַּעֲר֑וֹץ וְאֶת קַ֖שׁ יָבֵ֣שׁ תִּרְדֹּֽף
Job 13:25 [KJV]  Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?

Job 13:26 [HEB]  כִּֽי תִכְתֹּ֣ב עָלַ֣י מְרֹר֑וֹת וְ֝תוֹרִישֵׁ֗נִי עֲוֺנ֥וֹת נְעוּרָֽי
Job 13:26 [KJV]  For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.

Job 13:27 [HEB]  וְתָ֘שֵׂ֤ם בַּסַּ֨ד רַגְלַ֗י וְתִשְׁמ֥וֹר כָּל אָרְחוֹתָ֑י עַל שָׁרְשֵׁ֥י רַ֝גְלַ֗י תִּתְחַקֶּֽה
Job 13:27 [KJV]  Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.

Job 13:28 [HEB]  וְ֭הוּא כְּרָקָ֣ב יִבְלֶ֑ה כְּ֝בֶ֗גֶד אֲכָ֣לוֹ עָֽשׁ
Job 13:28 [KJV]  And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.


--- Job Chapter 14 ---
Job 14:1 [HEB]  אָ֭דָם יְל֣וּד אִשָּׁ֑ה קְצַ֥ר יָ֝מִ֗ים וּֽשְׂבַֽע רֹֽגֶז
Job 14:1 [KJV]  Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.

Job 14:2 [HEB]  כְּצִ֣יץ יָ֭צָא וַיִּמָּ֑ל וַיִּבְרַ֥ח כַּ֝צֵּ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֽוֹד
Job 14:2 [KJV]  He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

Job 14:3 [HEB]  אַף עַל זֶ֭ה פָּקַ֣חְתָּ עֵינֶ֑ךָ וְאֹ֘תִ֤י תָבִ֖יא בְמִשְׁפָּ֣ט עִמָּֽךְ
Job 14:3 [KJV]  And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?

Job 14:4 [HEB]  מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן טָ֭הוֹר מִטָּמֵ֗א לֹ֣א אֶחָֽד
Job 14:4 [KJV]  Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

Job 14:5 [HEB]  אִ֥ם חֲרוּצִ֨ים יָמָ֗יו מִֽסְפַּר חֳדָשָׁ֥יו אִתָּ֑ךְ חקו חֻקָּ֥יו עָ֝שִׂ֗יתָ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר
Job 14:5 [KJV]  Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

Job 14:6 [HEB]  שְׁעֵ֣ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וְיֶחְדָּ֑ל עַד יִ֝רְצֶ֗ה כְּשָׂכִ֥יר יוֹמֽוֹ
Job 14:6 [KJV]  Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.

Job 14:7 [HEB]  כִּ֤י יֵ֥שׁ לָעֵ֗ץ תִּ֫קְוָ֥ה אִֽם יִ֭כָּרֵת וְע֣וֹד יַחֲלִ֑יף וְ֝יֹֽנַקְתּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תֶחְדָּֽל
Job 14:7 [KJV]  For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

Job 14:8 [HEB]  אִם יַזְקִ֣ין בָּאָ֣רֶץ שָׁרְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בֶעָפָ֗ר יָמ֥וּת גִּזְעֽוֹ
Job 14:8 [KJV]  Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

Job 14:9 [HEB]  מֵרֵ֣יחַ מַ֣יִם יַפְרִ֑חַ וְעָשָׂ֖ה קָצִ֣יר כְּמוֹ נָֽטַע
Job 14:9 [KJV]  Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

Job 14:10 [HEB]  וְגֶ֣בֶר יָ֭מוּת וַֽיֶּחֱלָ֑שׁ וַיִּגְוַ֖ע אָדָ֣ם וְאַיּֽוֹ
Job 14:10 [KJV]  But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

Job 14:11 [HEB]  אָֽזְלוּ מַ֭יִם מִנִּי יָ֑ם וְ֝נָהָ֗ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְיָבֵֽשׁ
Job 14:11 [KJV]  As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:

Job 14:12 [HEB]  וְאִ֥ישׁ שָׁכַ֗ב וְֽלֹא יָ֫ק֥וּם עַד בִּלְתִּ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ וְלֹֽא יֵ֝עֹ֗רוּ מִשְּׁנָתָֽם
Job 14:12 [KJV]  So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

Job 14:13 [HEB]  מִ֤י יִתֵּ֨ן בִּשְׁא֬וֹל תַּצְפִּנֵ֗נִי תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי עַד שׁ֣וּב אַפֶּ֑ךָ תָּ֤שִׁ֥ית לִ֖י חֹ֣ק וְתִזְכְּרֵֽנִי
Job 14:13 [KJV]  O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

Job 14:14 [HEB]  אִם יָמ֥וּת גֶּ֗בֶר הֲיִ֫חְיֶ֥ה כָּל יְמֵ֣י צְבָאִ֣י אֲיַחֵ֑ל עַד בּ֝֗וֹא חֲלִיפָתִֽי
Job 14:14 [KJV]  If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.

Job 14:15 [HEB]  תִּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ךָּ לְֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ תִכְסֹֽף
Job 14:15 [KJV]  Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.

Job 14:16 [HEB]  כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה צְעָדַ֣י תִּסְפּ֑וֹר לֹֽא תִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹר עַל חַטָּאתִֽי
Job 14:16 [KJV]  For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?

Job 14:17 [HEB]  חָתֻ֣ם בִּצְר֣וֹר פִּשְׁעִ֑י וַ֝תִּטְפֹּ֗ל עַל עֲוֺנִֽי
Job 14:17 [KJV]  My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.

Job 14:18 [HEB]  וְ֭אוּלָם הַר נוֹפֵ֣ל יִבּ֑וֹל וְ֝צ֗וּר יֶעְתַּ֥ק מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ
Job 14:18 [KJV]  And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.

Job 14:19 [HEB]  אֲבָנִ֤ים שָׁ֥חֲקוּ מַ֗יִם תִּשְׁטֹֽף סְפִיחֶ֥יהָ עֲפַר אָ֑רֶץ וְתִקְוַ֖ת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ הֶאֱבַֽדְתָּ
Job 14:19 [KJV]  The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.

Job 14:20 [HEB]  תִּתְקְפֵ֣הוּ לָ֭נֶצַח וַֽיַּהֲלֹ֑ךְ מְשַׁנֶּ֥ה פָ֝נָ֗יו וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ
Job 14:20 [KJV]  Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

Job 14:21 [HEB]  יִכְבְּד֣וּ בָ֭נָיו וְלֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וְ֝יִצְעֲר֗וּ וְֽלֹא יָבִ֥ין לָֽמוֹ
Job 14:21 [KJV]  His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

Job 14:22 [HEB]  אַךְ בְּ֭שָׂרוֹ עָלָ֣יו יִכְאָ֑ב וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו תֶּאֱבָֽל
Job 14:22 [KJV]  But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.


--- Job Chapter 15 ---
Job 15:1 [HEB]  וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 15:1 [KJV]  Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

Job 15:2 [HEB]  הֶֽחָכָ֗ם יַעֲנֶ֥ה דַֽעַת ר֑וּחַ וִֽימַלֵּ֖א קָדִ֣ים בִּטְנֽוֹ
Job 15:2 [KJV]  Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?

Job 15:3 [HEB]  הוֹכֵ֣חַ בְּ֭דָבָר לֹ֣א יִסְכּ֑וֹן וּ֝מִלִּ֗ים לֹא יוֹעִ֥יל בָּֽם
Job 15:3 [KJV]  Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

Job 15:4 [HEB]  אַף אַ֭תָּה תָּפֵ֣ר יִרְאָ֑ה וְתִגְרַ֥ע שִׂ֝יחָ֗ה לִפְנֵי אֵֽל
Job 15:4 [KJV]  Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.

Job 15:5 [HEB]  כִּ֤י יְאַלֵּ֣ף עֲוֺנְךָ֣ פִ֑יךָ וְ֝תִבְחַ֗ר לְשׁ֣וֹן עֲרוּמִֽים
Job 15:5 [KJV]  For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

Job 15:6 [HEB]  יַרְשִֽׁיעֲךָ֣ פִ֣יךָ וְלֹא אָ֑נִי וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ יַעֲנוּ בָֽךְ
Job 15:6 [KJV]  Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

Job 15:7 [HEB]  הֲרִאישׁ֣וֹן אָ֭דָם תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתָּ
Job 15:7 [KJV]  Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?

Job 15:8 [HEB]  הַבְס֣וֹד אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּשְׁמָ֑ע וְתִגְרַ֖ע אֵלֶ֣יךָ חָכְמָֽה
Job 15:8 [KJV]  Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

Job 15:9 [HEB]  מַה יָּ֭דַעְתָּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע תָּ֝בִ֗ין וְֽלֹא עִמָּ֥נוּ הֽוּא
Job 15:9 [KJV]  What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?

Job 15:10 [HEB]  גַּם שָׂ֣ב גַּם יָשִׁ֣ישׁ בָּ֑נוּ כַּבִּ֖יר מֵאָבִ֣יךָ יָמִֽים
Job 15:10 [KJV]  With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.

Job 15:11 [HEB]  הַמְעַ֣ט מִ֭מְּךָ תַּנְחֻמ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל וְ֝דָבָ֗ר לָאַ֥ט עִמָּֽךְ
Job 15:11 [KJV]  Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?

Job 15:12 [HEB]  מַה יִּקָּחֲךָ֥ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּֽמַה יִּרְזְמ֥וּן עֵינֶֽיךָ
Job 15:12 [KJV]  Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,

Job 15:13 [HEB]  כִּֽי תָשִׁ֣יב אֶל אֵ֣ל רוּחֶ֑ךָ וְהֹצֵ֖אתָ מִפִּ֣יךָ מִלִּֽין
Job 15:13 [KJV]  That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?

Job 15:14 [HEB]  מָֽה אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי יִזְכֶּ֑ה וְכִֽי יִ֝צְדַּ֗ק יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה
Job 15:14 [KJV]  What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

Job 15:15 [HEB]  הֵ֣ן בקדשו בִּ֭קְדֹשָׁיו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וְ֝שָׁמַ֗יִם לֹא זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו
Job 15:15 [KJV]  Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.

Job 15:16 [HEB]  אַ֭ף כִּֽי נִתְעָ֥ב וְֽנֶאֱלָ֑ח אִישׁ שֹׁתֶ֖ה כַמַּ֣יִם עַוְלָֽה
Job 15:16 [KJV]  How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?

Job 15:17 [HEB]  אֲחַוְךָ֥ שְֽׁמַֽע לִ֑י וְזֶֽה חָ֝זִ֗יתִי וַאֲסַפֵּֽרָה
Job 15:17 [KJV]  I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;

Job 15:18 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁר חֲכָמִ֥ים יַגִּ֑ידוּ וְלֹ֥א כִֽ֝חֲד֗וּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם
Job 15:18 [KJV]  Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:

Job 15:19 [HEB]  לָהֶ֣ם לְ֭בַדָּם נִתְּנָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא עָ֖בַר זָ֣ר בְּתוֹכָֽם
Job 15:19 [KJV]  Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

Job 15:20 [HEB]  כָּל יְמֵ֣י רָ֭שָׁע ה֣וּא מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל וּמִסְפַּ֥ר שָׁ֝נִ֗ים נִצְפְּנ֥וּ לֶעָרִֽיץ
Job 15:20 [KJV]  The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.

Job 15:21 [HEB]  קוֹל פְּחָדִ֥ים בְּאָזְנָ֑יו בַּ֝שָּׁל֗וֹם שׁוֹדֵ֥ד יְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ
Job 15:21 [KJV]  A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

Job 15:22 [HEB]  לֹא יַאֲמִ֣ין שׁ֭וּב מִנִּי חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וצפו וְצָפ֖וּי ה֣וּא אֱלֵי חָֽרֶב
Job 15:22 [KJV]  He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

Job 15:23 [HEB]  נֹ֘דֵ֤ד ה֣וּא לַלֶּ֣חֶם אַיֵּ֑ה יָדַ֓ע כִּֽי נָכ֖וֹן בְּיָד֣וֹ יֽוֹם חֹֽשֶׁךְ
Job 15:23 [KJV]  He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

Job 15:24 [HEB]  יְֽ֭בַעֲתֻהוּ צַ֣ר וּמְצוּקָ֑ה תִּ֝תְקְפֵ֗הוּ כְּמֶ֤לֶךְ עָתִ֬יד לַכִּידֽוֹר
Job 15:24 [KJV]  Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

Job 15:25 [HEB]  כִּֽי נָטָ֣ה אֶל אֵ֣ל יָד֑וֹ וְאֶל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְגַּבָּֽר
Job 15:25 [KJV]  For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.

Job 15:26 [HEB]  יָר֣וּץ אֵלָ֣יו בְּצַוָּ֑אר בַּ֝עֲבִ֗י גַּבֵּ֥י מָֽגִנָּֽיו
Job 15:26 [KJV]  He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:

Job 15:27 [HEB]  כִּֽי כִסָּ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּחֶלְבּ֑וֹ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ פִּימָ֣ה עֲלֵי כָֽסֶל
Job 15:27 [KJV]  Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.

Job 15:28 [HEB]  וַיִּשְׁכּ֤וֹן עָ֘רִ֤ים נִכְחָד֗וֹת בָּ֭תִּים לֹא יֵ֣שְׁבוּ לָ֑מוֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הִתְעַתְּד֣וּ לְגַלִּֽים
Job 15:28 [KJV]  And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.

Job 15:29 [HEB]  לֹֽא יֶ֭עְשַׁר וְלֹא יָק֣וּם חֵיל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא יִטֶּ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ מִנְלָֽם
Job 15:29 [KJV]  He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

Job 15:30 [HEB]  לֹֽא יָס֨וּר מִנִּי חֹ֗שֶׁךְ יֹֽ֭נַקְתּוֹ תְּיַבֵּ֣שׁ שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת וְ֝יָס֗וּר בְּר֣וּחַ פִּֽיו
Job 15:30 [KJV]  He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

Job 15:31 [HEB]  אַל יַאֲמֵ֣ן בשו בַּשָּׁ֣יו נִתְעָ֑ה כִּי שָׁ֝֗וְא תִּהְיֶ֥ה תְמוּרָתֽוֹ
Job 15:31 [KJV]  Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.

Job 15:32 [HEB]  בְּֽלֹא י֭וֹמוֹ תִּמָּלֵ֑א וְ֝כִפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רַעֲנָֽנָה
Job 15:32 [KJV]  It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.

Job 15:33 [HEB]  יַחְמֹ֣ס כַּגֶּ֣פֶן בִּסְר֑וֹ וְיַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ כַּ֝זַּ֗יִת נִצָּתֽוֹ
Job 15:33 [KJV]  He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

Job 15:34 [HEB]  כִּֽי עֲדַ֣ת חָנֵ֣ף גַּלְמ֑וּד וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ אָכְלָ֥ה אָֽהֳלֵי שֹֽׁחַד
Job 15:34 [KJV]  For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

Job 15:35 [HEB]  הָרֹ֣ה עָ֭מָל וְיָ֣לֹד אָ֑וֶן וּ֝בִטְנָ֗ם תָּכִ֥ין מִרְמָֽה
Job 15:35 [KJV]  They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.


--- Job Chapter 16 ---
Job 16:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 16:1 [KJV]  Then Job answered and said,

Job 16:2 [HEB]  שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי כְאֵ֣לֶּה רַבּ֑וֹת מְנַחֲמֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם
Job 16:2 [KJV]  I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.

Job 16:3 [HEB]  הֲקֵ֥ץ לְדִבְרֵי ר֑וּחַ א֥וֹ מַה יַּ֝מְרִֽיצְךָ֗ כִּ֣י תַעֲנֶֽה
Job 16:3 [KJV]  Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?

Job 16:4 [HEB]  גַּ֤ם אָנֹכִי֮ כָּכֶ֪ם אֲדַ֫בֵּ֥רָה ל֤וּ יֵ֪שׁ נַפְשְׁכֶ֡ם תַּ֤חַת נַפְשִׁ֗י אַחְבִּ֣ירָה עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם בְּמִלִּ֑ים וְאָנִ֥יעָה עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם בְּמ֣וֹ רֹאשִֽׁי
Job 16:4 [KJV]  I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.

Job 16:5 [HEB]  אֲאַמִּצְכֶ֥ם בְּמוֹ פִ֑י וְנִ֖יד שְׂפָתַ֣י יַחְשֹֽׂךְ
Job 16:5 [KJV]  But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.

Job 16:6 [HEB]  אִֽם אֲ֭דַבְּרָה לֹא יֵחָשֵׂ֣ךְ כְּאֵבִ֑י וְ֝אַחְדְּלָ֗ה מַה מִנִּ֥י יַהֲלֹֽךְ
Job 16:6 [KJV]  Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?

Job 16:7 [HEB]  אַךְ עַתָּ֥ה הֶלְאָ֑נִי הֲ֝שִׁמּ֗וֹתָ כָּל עֲדָתִֽי
Job 16:7 [KJV]  But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.

Job 16:8 [HEB]  וַֽ֭תִּקְמְטֵנִי לְעֵ֣ד הָיָ֑ה וַיָּ֥קָם בִּ֥י כַ֝חֲשִׁ֗י בְּפָנַ֥י יַעֲנֶֽה
Job 16:8 [KJV]  And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

Job 16:9 [HEB]  אַפּ֤וֹ טָרַ֨ף וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֵ֗נִי חָרַ֣ק עָלַ֣י בְּשִׁנָּ֑יו צָרִ֓י יִלְט֖וֹשׁ עֵינָ֣יו לִֽי
Job 16:9 [KJV]  He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

Job 16:10 [HEB]  פָּעֲר֬וּ עָלַ֨י בְּפִיהֶ֗ם בְּ֭חֶרְפָּה הִכּ֣וּ לְחָיָ֑י יַ֝֗חַד עָלַ֥י יִתְמַלָּאֽוּן
Job 16:10 [KJV]  They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.

Job 16:11 [HEB]  יַסְגִּירֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל אֶ֣ל עֲוִ֑יל וְעַל יְדֵ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְטֵֽנִי
Job 16:11 [KJV]  God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

Job 16:12 [HEB]  שָׁ֘לֵ֤ו הָיִ֨יתִי וַֽיְפַרְפְּרֵ֗נִי וְאָחַ֣ז בְּ֭עָרְפִּי וַֽיְפַצְפְּצֵ֑נִי וַיְקִימֵ֥נִי ל֝֗וֹ לְמַטָּרָֽה
Job 16:12 [KJV]  I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.

Job 16:13 [HEB]  יָ֘סֹ֤בּוּ עָלַ֨י רַבָּ֗יו יְפַלַּ֣ח כִּ֭לְיוֹתַי וְלֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מְרֵרָֽתִי
Job 16:13 [KJV]  His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.

Job 16:14 [HEB]  יִפְרְצֵ֣נִי פֶ֭רֶץ עַל פְּנֵי פָ֑רֶץ יָרֻ֖ץ עָלַ֣י כְּגִבּֽוֹר
Job 16:14 [KJV]  He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.

Job 16:15 [HEB]  שַׂ֣ק תָּ֭פַרְתִּי עֲלֵ֣י גִלְדִּ֑י וְעֹלַ֖לְתִּי בֶעָפָ֣ר קַרְנִֽי
Job 16:15 [KJV]  I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.

Job 16:16 [HEB]  פָּנַ֣י חמרמרה חֳ֭מַרְמְרוּ מִנִּי בֶ֑כִי וְעַ֖ל עַפְעַפַּ֣י צַלְמָֽוֶת
Job 16:16 [KJV]  My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

Job 16:17 [HEB]  עַ֭ל לֹא חָמָ֣ס בְּכַפָּ֑י וּֽתְפִלָּתִ֥י זַכָּֽה
Job 16:17 [KJV]  Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.

Job 16:18 [HEB]  אֶ֭רֶץ אַל תְּכַסִּ֣י דָמִ֑י וְֽאַל יְהִ֥י מָ֝ק֗וֹם לְזַעֲקָתִֽי
Job 16:18 [KJV]  O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.

Job 16:19 [HEB]  גַּם עַ֭תָּה הִנֵּה בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם עֵדִ֑י וְ֝שָׂהֲדִ֗י בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים
Job 16:19 [KJV]  Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

Job 16:20 [HEB]  מְלִיצַ֥י רֵעָ֑י אֶל אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ דָּלְפָ֥ה עֵינִֽי
Job 16:20 [KJV]  My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.

Job 16:21 [HEB]  וְיוֹכַ֣ח לְגֶ֣בֶר עִם אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּֽבֶן אָדָ֥ם לְרֵעֵֽהוּ
Job 16:21 [KJV]  O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!

Job 16:22 [HEB]  כִּֽי שְׁנ֣וֹת מִסְפָּ֣ר יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ וְאֹ֖רַח לֹא אָשׁ֣וּב אֶהֱלֹֽךְ
Job 16:22 [KJV]  When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.


--- Job Chapter 17 ---
Job 17:1 [HEB]  רוּחִ֣י חֻ֭בָּלָה יָמַ֥י נִזְעָ֗כוּ קְבָרִ֥ים לִֽי
Job 17:1 [KJV]  My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.

Job 17:2 [HEB]  אִם לֹ֣א הֲ֭תֻלִים עִמָּדִ֑י וּ֝בְהַמְּרוֹתָ֗ם תָּלַ֥ן עֵינִֽי
Job 17:2 [KJV]  Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?

Job 17:3 [HEB]  שִֽׂימָה נָּ֭א עָרְבֵ֣נִי עִמָּ֑ךְ מִֽי ה֝֗וּא לְיָדִ֥י יִתָּקֵֽעַ
Job 17:3 [KJV]  Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?

Job 17:4 [HEB]  כִּֽי לִ֭בָּם צָפַ֣נְתָּ מִּשָּׂ֑כֶל עַל כֵּ֝֗ן לֹ֣א תְרֹמֵֽם
Job 17:4 [KJV]  For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.

Job 17:5 [HEB]  לְ֭חֵלֶק יַגִּ֣יד רֵעִ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו תִּכְלֶֽנָה
Job 17:5 [KJV]  He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

Job 17:6 [HEB]  וְֽ֭הִצִּגַנִי לִמְשֹׁ֣ל עַמִּ֑ים וְתֹ֖פֶת לְפָנִ֣ים אֶֽהְיֶֽה
Job 17:6 [KJV]  He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.

Job 17:7 [HEB]  וַתֵּ֣כַהּ מִכַּ֣עַשׂ עֵינִ֑י וִֽיצֻרַ֖י כַּצֵּ֣ל כֻּלָּֽם
Job 17:7 [KJV]  Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.

Job 17:8 [HEB]  יָשֹׁ֣מּוּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים עַל זֹ֑את וְ֝נָקִ֗י עַל חָנֵ֥ף יִתְעֹרָֽר
Job 17:8 [KJV]  Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

Job 17:9 [HEB]  וְיֹאחֵ֣ז צַדִּ֣יק דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּֽטֳהָר יָ֝דַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף אֹֽמֶץ
Job 17:9 [KJV]  The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

Job 17:10 [HEB]  וְֽאוּלָ֗ם כֻּלָּ֣ם תָּ֭שֻׁבוּ וּבֹ֣אוּ נָ֑א וְלֹֽא אֶמְצָ֖א בָכֶ֣ם חָכָֽם
Job 17:10 [KJV]  But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.

Job 17:11 [HEB]  יָמַ֣י עָ֭בְרוּ זִמֹּתַ֣י נִתְּק֑וּ מ֖וֹרָשֵׁ֣י לְבָבִֽי
Job 17:11 [KJV]  My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

Job 17:12 [HEB]  לַ֭יְלָה לְי֣וֹם יָשִׂ֑ימוּ א֝֗וֹר קָר֥וֹב מִפְּנֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ
Job 17:12 [KJV]  They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.

Job 17:13 [HEB]  אִם אֲ֭קַוֶּה שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתִ֑י בַּ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ רִפַּ֥דְתִּי יְצוּעָֽי
Job 17:13 [KJV]  If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

Job 17:14 [HEB]  לַשַּׁ֣חַת קָ֭רָאתִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אִמִּ֥י וַ֝אֲחֹתִ֗י לָֽרִמָּֽה
Job 17:14 [KJV]  I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.

Job 17:15 [HEB]  וְ֭אַיֵּה אֵפ֣וֹ תִקְוָתִ֑י וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י מִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה
Job 17:15 [KJV]  And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

Job 17:16 [HEB]  בַּדֵּ֣י שְׁאֹ֣ל תֵּרַ֑דְנָה אִם יַ֖חַד עַל עָפָ֣ר נָֽחַת
Job 17:16 [KJV]  They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.


--- Job Chapter 18 ---
Job 18:1 [HEB]  וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשֻּׁחִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 18:1 [KJV]  Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

Job 18:2 [HEB]  עַד אָ֤נָה תְּשִׂימ֣וּן קִנְצֵ֣י לְמִלִּ֑ין תָּ֝בִ֗ינוּ וְאַחַ֥ר נְדַבֵּֽר
Job 18:2 [KJV]  How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

Job 18:3 [HEB]  מַ֭דּוּעַ נֶחְשַׁ֣בְנוּ כַבְּהֵמָ֑ה נִ֝טְמִ֗ינוּ בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם
Job 18:3 [KJV]  Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

Job 18:4 [HEB]  טֹֽרֵ֥ף נַפְשׁ֗וֹ בְּאַ֫פּ֥וֹ הַ֭לְמַעַנְךָ תֵּעָ֣זַב אָ֑רֶץ וְיֶעְתַּק צ֝֗וּר מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ
Job 18:4 [KJV]  He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?

Job 18:5 [HEB]  גַּ֤ם א֣וֹר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא יִ֝גַּ֗הּ שְׁבִ֣יב אִשּֽׁוֹ
Job 18:5 [KJV]  Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

Job 18:6 [HEB]  א֭וֹר חָשַׁ֣ךְ בְּאָהֳל֑וֹ וְ֝נֵר֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו יִדְעָֽךְ
Job 18:6 [KJV]  The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.

Job 18:7 [HEB]  יֵֽ֭צְרוּ צַעֲדֵ֣י אוֹנ֑וֹ וְֽתַשְׁלִיכֵ֥הוּ עֲצָתֽוֹ
Job 18:7 [KJV]  The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

Job 18:8 [HEB]  כִּֽי שֻׁלַּ֣ח בְּרֶ֣שֶׁת בְּרַגְלָ֑יו וְעַל שְׂ֝בָכָ֗ה יִתְהַלָּֽךְ
Job 18:8 [KJV]  For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.

Job 18:9 [HEB]  יֹאחֵ֣ז בְּעָקֵ֣ב פָּ֑ח יַחֲזֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו צַמִּֽים
Job 18:9 [KJV]  The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.

Job 18:10 [HEB]  טָמ֣וּן בָּאָ֣רֶץ חַבְל֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכֻּדְתּ֗וֹ עֲלֵ֣י נָתִֽיב
Job 18:10 [KJV]  The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

Job 18:11 [HEB]  סָ֭בִיב בִּֽעֲתֻ֣הוּ בַלָּה֑וֹת וֶהֱפִיצֻ֥הוּ לְרַגְלָֽיו
Job 18:11 [KJV]  Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.

Job 18:12 [HEB]  יְהִי רָעֵ֥ב אֹנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֵ֗יד נָכ֥וֹן לְצַלְעֽוֹ
Job 18:12 [KJV]  His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.

Job 18:13 [HEB]  יֹ֭אכַל בַּדֵּ֣י עוֹר֑וֹ יֹאכַ֥ל בַּ֝דָּ֗יו בְּכ֣וֹר מָֽוֶת
Job 18:13 [KJV]  It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

Job 18:14 [HEB]  יִנָּתֵ֣ק מֵ֭אָהֳלוֹ מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְ֝תַצְעִדֵ֗הוּ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּלָּהֽוֹת
Job 18:14 [KJV]  His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

Job 18:15 [HEB]  תִּשְׁכּ֣וֹן בְּ֭אָהֳלוֹ מִבְּלִי ל֑וֹ יְזֹרֶ֖ה עַל נָוֵ֣הוּ גָפְרִֽית
Job 18:15 [KJV]  It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

Job 18:16 [HEB]  מִ֭תַּחַת שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣יו יִבָ֑שׁוּ וּ֝מִמַּ֗עַל יִמַּ֥ל קְצִירֽוֹ
Job 18:16 [KJV]  His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

Job 18:17 [HEB]  זִֽכְרוֹ אָ֭בַד מִנִּי אָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא שֵׁ֥ם ל֝֗וֹ עַל פְּנֵי חֽוּץ
Job 18:17 [KJV]  His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

Job 18:18 [HEB]  יֶ֭הְדְּפֻהוּ מֵא֣וֹר אֶל חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּֽמִתֵּבֵ֥ל יְנִדֻּֽהוּ
Job 18:18 [KJV]  He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

Job 18:19 [HEB]  לֹ֘א נִ֤ין ל֣וֹ וְלֹא נֶ֣כֶד בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין שָׂ֝רִ֗יד בִּמְגוּרָֽיו
Job 18:19 [KJV]  He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

Job 18:20 [HEB]  עַל י֭וֹמוֹ נָשַׁ֣מּוּ אַחֲרֹנִ֑ים וְ֝קַדְמֹנִ֗ים אָ֣חֲזוּ שָֽׂעַר
Job 18:20 [KJV]  They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.

Job 18:21 [HEB]  אַךְ אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁכְּנ֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וְ֝זֶ֗ה מְק֣וֹם לֹא יָדַֽע אֵֽל
Job 18:21 [KJV]  Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.


--- Job Chapter 19 ---
Job 19:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 19:1 [KJV]  Then Job answered and said,

Job 19:2 [HEB]  עַד אָ֭נָה תּוֹגְי֣וּן נַפְשִׁ֑י וּֽתְדַכְּאוּנַ֥נִי בְמִלִּֽים
Job 19:2 [KJV]  How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

Job 19:3 [HEB]  זֶ֤ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּ֭עָמִים תַּכְלִימ֑וּנִי לֹֽא תֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ לִֽי
Job 19:3 [KJV]  These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.

Job 19:4 [HEB]  וְאַף אָמְנָ֥ם שָׁגִ֑יתִי אִ֝תִּ֗י תָּלִ֥ין מְשׁוּגָתִֽי
Job 19:4 [KJV]  And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

Job 19:5 [HEB]  אִם אָ֭מְנָם עָלַ֣י תַּגְדִּ֑ילוּ וְתוֹכִ֥יחוּ עָ֝לַ֗י חֶרְפָּתִּֽי
Job 19:5 [KJV]  If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

Job 19:6 [HEB]  דְּֽעוּ אֵ֭פוֹ כִּי אֱל֣וֹהַּ עִוְּתָ֑נִי וּ֝מְצוּד֗וֹ עָלַ֥י הִקִּֽיף
Job 19:6 [KJV]  Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.

Job 19:7 [HEB]  הֵ֤ן אֶצְעַ֣ק חָ֭מָס וְלֹ֣א אֵעָנֶ֑ה אֲ֝שַׁוַּ֗ע וְאֵ֣ין מִשְׁפָּֽט
Job 19:7 [KJV]  Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

Job 19:8 [HEB]  אָרְחִ֣י גָ֭דַר וְלֹ֣א אֶעֱב֑וֹר וְעַ֥ל נְ֝תִיבוֹתַ֗י חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יָשִֽׂים
Job 19:8 [KJV]  He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

Job 19:9 [HEB]  כְּ֭בוֹדִי מֵעָלַ֣י הִפְשִׁ֑יט וַ֝יָּ֗סַר עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשִֽׁי
Job 19:9 [KJV]  He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

Job 19:10 [HEB]  יִתְּצֵ֣נִי סָ֭בִיב וָאֵלַ֑ךְ וַיַּסַּ֥ע כָּ֝עֵ֗ץ תִּקְוָתִֽי
Job 19:10 [KJV]  He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.

Job 19:11 [HEB]  וַיַּ֣חַר עָלַ֣י אַפּ֑וֹ וַיַּחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי ל֣וֹ כְצָרָֽיו
Job 19:11 [KJV]  He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.

Job 19:12 [HEB]  יַ֤חַד יָ֘בֹ֤אוּ גְדוּדָ֗יו וַיָּסֹ֣לּוּ עָלַ֣י דַּרְכָּ֑ם וַיַּחֲנ֖וּ סָבִ֣יב לְאָהֳלִֽי
Job 19:12 [KJV]  His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.

Job 19:13 [HEB]  אַ֭חַי מֵעָלַ֣י הִרְחִ֑יק וְ֝יֹדְעַ֗י אַךְ זָ֥רוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי
Job 19:13 [KJV]  He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

Job 19:14 [HEB]  חָדְל֥וּ קְרוֹבָ֑י וּֽמְיֻדָּעַ֥י שְׁכֵחֽוּנִי
Job 19:14 [KJV]  My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

Job 19:15 [HEB]  גָּ֘רֵ֤י בֵיתִ֣י וְ֭אַמְהֹתַי לְזָ֣ר תַּחְשְׁבֻ֑נִי נָ֝כְרִ֗י הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֵיהֶֽם
Job 19:15 [KJV]  They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

Job 19:16 [HEB]  לְעַבְדִּ֣י קָ֭רָאתִי וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה בְּמוֹ פִ֝֗י אֶתְחַנֶּן לֽוֹ
Job 19:16 [KJV]  I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.

Job 19:17 [HEB]  ר֭וּחִֽי זָ֣רָה לְאִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝חַנֹּתִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י בִטְנִֽי
Job 19:17 [KJV]  My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s sake of mine own body.

Job 19:18 [HEB]  גַּם עֲ֭וִילִים מָ֣אֲסוּ בִ֑י אָ֝ק֗וּמָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ בִֽי
Job 19:18 [KJV]  Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.

Job 19:19 [HEB]  תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי כָּל מְתֵ֣י סוֹדִ֑י וְזֶֽה אָ֝הַ֗בְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ בִֽי
Job 19:19 [KJV]  All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.

Job 19:20 [HEB]  בְּעוֹרִ֣י וּ֭בִבְשָׂרִי דָּבְקָ֣ה עַצְמִ֑י וָ֝אֶתְמַלְּטָ֗ה בְּע֣וֹר שִׁנָּֽי
Job 19:20 [KJV]  My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

Job 19:21 [HEB]  חָנֻּ֬נִי חָנֻּ֣נִי אַתֶּ֣ם רֵעָ֑י כִּ֥י יַד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נָ֣גְעָה בִּֽי
Job 19:21 [KJV]  Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.

Job 19:22 [HEB]  לָ֭מָּה תִּרְדְּפֻ֣נִי כְמוֹ אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י לֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ
Job 19:22 [KJV]  Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

Job 19:23 [HEB]  מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן אֵ֭פוֹ וְיִכָּתְב֣וּן מִלָּ֑י מִֽי יִתֵּ֖ן בַּסֵּ֣פֶר וְיֻחָֽקוּ
Job 19:23 [KJV]  Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!

Job 19:24 [HEB]  בְּעֵט בַּרְזֶ֥ל וְעֹפָ֑רֶת לָ֝עַ֗ד בַּצּ֥וּר יֵחָצְבֽוּן
Job 19:24 [KJV]  That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!

Job 19:25 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי גֹּ֣אֲלִי חָ֑י וְ֝אַחֲר֗וֹן עַל עָפָ֥ר יָקֽוּם
Job 19:25 [KJV]  For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

Job 19:26 [HEB]  וְאַחַ֣ר ע֭וֹרִֽי נִקְּפוּ זֹ֑את וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י אֶֽחֱזֶ֥ה אֱלֽוֹהַּ
Job 19:26 [KJV]  And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:

Job 19:27 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִ֨י אֶֽחֱזֶה לִּ֗י וְעֵינַ֣י רָא֣וּ וְלֹא זָ֑ר כָּל֖וּ כִלְיֹתַ֣י בְּחֵקִֽי
Job 19:27 [KJV]  Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

Job 19:28 [HEB]  כִּ֣י תֹ֭אמְרוּ מַה נִּרְדָּף ל֑וֹ וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ דָּ֝בָ֗ר נִמְצָא בִֽי
Job 19:28 [KJV]  But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?

Job 19:29 [HEB]  גּ֤וּרוּ לָכֶ֨ם מִפְּנֵי חֶ֗רֶב כִּֽי חֵ֭מָה עֲוֺנ֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב לְמַ֖עַן תֵּדְע֣וּן שדין שַׁדּֽוּן
Job 19:29 [KJV]  Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.


--- Job Chapter 20 ---
Job 20:1 [HEB]  וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַנַּֽעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 20:1 [KJV]  Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

Job 20:2 [HEB]  לָ֭כֵן שְׂעִפַּ֣י יְשִׁיב֑וּנִי וּ֝בַעֲב֗וּר ח֣וּשִׁי בִֽי
Job 20:2 [KJV]  Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.

Job 20:3 [HEB]  מוּסַ֣ר כְּלִמָּתִ֣י אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וְ֝ר֗וּחַ מִֽבִּינָתִ֥י יַעֲנֵֽנִי
Job 20:3 [KJV]  I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.

Job 20:4 [HEB]  הֲזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתָּ מִנִּי עַ֑ד מִנִּ֤י שִׂ֖ים אָדָ֣ם עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ
Job 20:4 [KJV]  Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,

Job 20:5 [HEB]  כִּ֤י רִנְנַ֣ת רְ֭שָׁעִים מִקָּר֑וֹב וְשִׂמְחַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף עֲדֵי רָֽגַע
Job 20:5 [KJV]  That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?

Job 20:6 [HEB]  אִם יַעֲלֶ֣ה לַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שִׂיא֑וֹ וְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ לָעָ֥ב יַגִּֽיעַ
Job 20:6 [KJV]  Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;

Job 20:7 [HEB]  כְּֽ֭גֶלֲלוֹ לָנֶ֣צַח יֹאבֵ֑ד רֹ֝אָ֗יו יֹאמְר֥וּ אַיּֽוֹ
Job 20:7 [KJV]  Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

Job 20:8 [HEB]  כַּחֲל֣וֹם יָ֭עוּף וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָא֑וּהוּ וְ֝יֻדַּ֗ד כְּחֶזְי֥וֹן לָֽיְלָה
Job 20:8 [KJV]  He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

Job 20:9 [HEB]  עַ֣יִן שְׁ֭זָפַתּוּ וְלֹ֣א תוֹסִ֑יף וְלֹא ע֝֗וֹד תְּשׁוּרֶ֥נּוּ מְקוֹמֽוֹ
Job 20:9 [KJV]  The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.

Job 20:10 [HEB]  בָּ֭נָיו יְרַצּ֣וּ דַלִּ֑ים וְ֝יָדָ֗יו תָּשֵׁ֥בְנָה אוֹנֽוֹ
Job 20:10 [KJV]  His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.

Job 20:11 [HEB]  עַ֭צְמוֹתָיו מָלְא֣וּ עלומו עֲלוּמָ֑יו וְ֝עִמּ֗וֹ עַל עָפָ֥ר תִּשְׁכָּֽב
Job 20:11 [KJV]  His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.

Job 20:12 [HEB]  אִם תַּמְתִּ֣יק בְּפִ֣יו רָעָ֑ה יַ֝כְחִידֶ֗נָּה תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֽוֹ
Job 20:12 [KJV]  Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;

Job 20:13 [HEB]  יַחְמֹ֣ל עָ֭לֶיהָ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑נָּה וְ֝יִמְנָעֶ֗נָּה בְּת֣וֹךְ חִכּֽוֹ
Job 20:13 [KJV]  Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:

Job 20:14 [HEB]  לַ֭חְמוֹ בְּמֵעָ֣יו נֶהְפָּ֑ךְ מְרוֹרַ֖ת פְּתָנִ֣ים בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ
Job 20:14 [KJV]  Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.

Job 20:15 [HEB]  חַ֣יִל בָּ֭לַע וַיְקִאֶ֑נּוּ מִ֝בִּטְנ֗וֹ יוֹרִשֶׁ֥נּוּ אֵֽל
Job 20:15 [KJV]  He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.

Job 20:16 [HEB]  רֹאשׁ פְּתָנִ֥ים יִינָ֑ק תַּֽ֝הַרְגֵ֗הוּ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֶפְעֶֽה
Job 20:16 [KJV]  He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.

Job 20:17 [HEB]  אַל יֵ֥רֶא בִפְלַגּ֑וֹת נַהֲרֵ֥י נַ֝חֲלֵ֗י דְּבַ֣שׁ וְחֶמְאָֽה
Job 20:17 [KJV]  He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.

Job 20:18 [HEB]  מֵשִׁ֣יב יָ֭גָע וְלֹ֣א יִבְלָ֑ע כְּחֵ֥יל תְּ֝מוּרָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲלֹֽס
Job 20:18 [KJV]  That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.

Job 20:19 [HEB]  כִּֽי רִ֭צַּץ עָזַ֣ב דַּלִּ֑ים בַּ֥יִת גָּ֝זַ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יִבֶנֵֽהוּ
Job 20:19 [KJV]  Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;

Job 20:20 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹא יָדַ֣ע שָׁלֵ֣ו בְּבִטְנ֑וֹ בַּ֝חֲמוּד֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט
Job 20:20 [KJV]  Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
