Job 20:21 [HEB]  אֵין שָׂרִ֥יד לְאָכְל֑וֹ עַל כֵּ֝֗ן לֹא יָחִ֥יל טוּבֽוֹ
Job 20:21 [KJV]  There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.

Job 20:22 [HEB]  בִּמְלֹ֣אות שִׂ֭פְקוֹ יֵ֣צֶר ל֑וֹ כָּל יַ֖ד עָמֵ֣ל תְּבוֹאֶֽנּוּ
Job 20:22 [KJV]  In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.

Job 20:23 [HEB]  יְהִ֤י לְמַלֵּ֬א בִטְנ֗וֹ יְֽשַׁלַּח בּ֭וֹ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ וְיַמְטֵ֥ר עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ בִּלְחוּמֽוֹ
Job 20:23 [KJV]  When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.

Job 20:24 [HEB]  יִ֭בְרַח מִנֵּ֣שֶׁק בַּרְזֶ֑ל תַּ֝חְלְפֵ֗הוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת נְחוּשָֽׁה
Job 20:24 [KJV]  He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.

Job 20:25 [HEB]  שָׁלַף֮ וַיֵּצֵ֪א מִגֵּ֫וָ֥ה וּ֭בָרָק מִֽמְּרֹרָת֥וֹ יַהֲלֹ֗ךְ עָלָ֥יו אֵמִֽים
Job 20:25 [KJV]  It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

Job 20:26 [HEB]  כָּל חֹשֶׁךְ֮ טָמ֪וּן לִצְפּ֫וּנָ֥יו תְּ֭אָכְלֵהוּ אֵ֣שׁ לֹֽא נֻפָּ֑ח יֵ֖רַע שָׂרִ֣יד בְּאָהֳלֽוֹ
Job 20:26 [KJV]  All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.

Job 20:27 [HEB]  יְגַלּ֣וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם עֲוֺנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֶ֗רֶץ מִתְקוֹמָ֘מָ֥ה לֽוֹ
Job 20:27 [KJV]  The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.

Job 20:28 [HEB]  יִ֭גֶל יְב֣וּל בֵּית֑וֹ נִ֝גָּר֗וֹת בְּי֣וֹם אַפּֽוֹ
Job 20:28 [KJV]  The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

Job 20:29 [HEB]  זֶ֤ה חֵֽלֶק אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְנַחֲלַ֖ת אִמְר֣וֹ מֵאֵֽל
Job 20:29 [KJV]  This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.


--- Job Chapter 21 ---
Job 21:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 21:1 [KJV]  But Job answered and said,

Job 21:2 [HEB]  שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וּתְהִי זֹ֝֗את תַּנְח֥וּמֹֽתֵיכֶֽם
Job 21:2 [KJV]  Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.

Job 21:3 [HEB]  שָׂ֭אוּנִי וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְאַחַ֖ר דַּבְּרִ֣י תַלְעִֽיג
Job 21:3 [KJV]  Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

Job 21:4 [HEB]  הֶ֭אָנֹכִי לְאָדָ֣ם שִׂיחִ֑י וְאִם מַ֝דּ֗וּעַ לֹא תִקְצַ֥ר רוּחִֽי
Job 21:4 [KJV]  As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?

Job 21:5 [HEB]  פְּנוּ אֵלַ֥י וְהָשַׁ֑מּוּ וְשִׂ֖ימוּ יָ֣ד עַל פֶּֽה
Job 21:5 [KJV]  Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.

Job 21:6 [HEB]  וְאִם זָכַ֥רְתִּי וְנִבְהָ֑לְתִּי וְאָחַ֥ז בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י פַּלָּצֽוּת
Job 21:6 [KJV]  Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.

Job 21:7 [HEB]  מַדּ֣וּעַ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִחְי֑וּ עָ֝תְק֗וּ גַּם גָּ֥בְרוּ חָֽיִל
Job 21:7 [KJV]  Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?

Job 21:8 [HEB]  זַרְעָ֤ם נָכ֣וֹן לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם עִמָּ֑ם וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֗ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם
Job 21:8 [KJV]  Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

Job 21:9 [HEB]  בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם שָׁל֣וֹם מִפָּ֑חַד וְלֹ֤א שֵׁ֖בֶט אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם
Job 21:9 [KJV]  Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

Job 21:10 [HEB]  שׁוֹר֣וֹ עִ֭בַּר וְלֹ֣א יַגְעִ֑ל תְּפַלֵּ֥ט פָּ֝רָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א תְשַׁכֵּֽל
Job 21:10 [KJV]  Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

Job 21:11 [HEB]  יְשַׁלְּח֣וּ כַ֭צֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝יַלְדֵיהֶ֗ם יְרַקֵּדֽוּן
Job 21:11 [KJV]  They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

Job 21:12 [HEB]  יִ֭שְׂאוּ כְּתֹ֣ף וְכִנּ֑וֹר וְ֝יִשְׂמְח֗וּ לְק֣וֹל עוּגָֽב
Job 21:12 [KJV]  They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.

Job 21:13 [HEB]  יבלו יְכַלּ֣וּ בַטּ֣וֹב יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בְרֶ֗גַע שְׁא֣וֹל יֵחָֽתּוּ
Job 21:13 [KJV]  They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.

Job 21:14 [HEB]  וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְדַ֥עַת דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א חָפָֽצְנוּ
Job 21:14 [KJV]  Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

Job 21:15 [HEB]  מַה שַׁדַּ֥י כִּֽי נַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ וּמַה נּ֝וֹעִ֗יל כִּ֣י נִפְגַּע בּֽוֹ
Job 21:15 [KJV]  What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

Job 21:16 [HEB]  הֵ֤ן לֹ֣א בְיָדָ֣ם טוּבָ֑ם עֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי
Job 21:16 [KJV]  Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

Job 21:17 [HEB]  כַּמָּ֤ה נֵר רְשָׁ֘עִ֤ים יִדְעָ֗ךְ וְיָבֹ֣א עָלֵ֣ימוֹ אֵידָ֑ם חֲ֝בָלִ֗ים יְחַלֵּ֥ק בְּאַפּֽוֹ
Job 21:17 [KJV]  How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.

Job 21:18 [HEB]  יִהְי֗וּ כְּתֶ֥בֶן לִפְנֵי ר֑וּחַ וּ֝כְמֹ֗ץ גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה
Job 21:18 [KJV]  They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.

Job 21:19 [HEB]  אֱל֗וֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן לְבָנָ֥יו אוֹנ֑וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם אֵלָ֣יו וְיֵדָֽע
Job 21:19 [KJV]  God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.

Job 21:20 [HEB]  יִרְא֣וּ עינו עֵינָ֣יו כִּיד֑וֹ וּמֵחֲמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יִשְׁתֶּֽה
Job 21:20 [KJV]  His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

Job 21:21 [HEB]  כִּ֤י מַה חֶפְצ֣וֹ בְּבֵית֣וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וּמִסְפַּ֖ר חֳדָשָׁ֣יו חֻצָּֽצוּ
Job 21:21 [KJV]  For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?

Job 21:22 [HEB]  הַלְאֵ֥ל יְלַמֶּד דָּ֑עַת וְ֝ה֗וּא רָמִ֥ים יִשְׁפּֽוֹט
Job 21:22 [KJV]  Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.

Job 21:23 [HEB]  זֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּעֶ֣צֶם תֻּמּ֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ שַׁלְאֲנַ֥ן וְשָׁלֵֽיו
Job 21:23 [KJV]  One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

Job 21:24 [HEB]  עֲ֭טִינָיו מָלְא֣וּ חָלָ֑ב וּמֹ֖חַ עַצְמוֹתָ֣יו יְשֻׁקֶּֽה
Job 21:24 [KJV]  His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.

Job 21:25 [HEB]  וְזֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ מָרָ֑ה וְלֹֽא אָ֝כַ֗ל בַּטּוֹבָֽה
Job 21:25 [KJV]  And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.

Job 21:26 [HEB]  יַ֭חַד עַל עָפָ֣ר יִשְׁכָּ֑בוּ וְ֝רִמָּ֗ה תְּכַסֶּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם
Job 21:26 [KJV]  They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.

Job 21:27 [HEB]  הֵ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וּ֝מְזִמּ֗וֹת עָלַ֥י תַּחְמֹֽסוּ
Job 21:27 [KJV]  Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

Job 21:28 [HEB]  כִּ֤י תֹֽאמְר֗וּ אַיֵּ֥ה בֵית נָדִ֑יב וְ֝אַיֵּ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל מִשְׁכְּנ֬וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים
Job 21:28 [KJV]  For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?

Job 21:29 [HEB]  הֲלֹ֣א שְׁ֭אֶלְתֶּם ע֣וֹבְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ וְ֝אֹתֹתָ֗ם לֹ֣א תְנַכֵּֽרוּ
Job 21:29 [KJV]  Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,

Job 21:30 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לְי֣וֹם אֵ֭יד יֵחָ֣שֶׂךְ רָ֑ע לְי֖וֹם עֲבָר֣וֹת יוּבָֽלוּ
Job 21:30 [KJV]  That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.

Job 21:31 [HEB]  מִֽי יַגִּ֣יד עַל פָּנָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֽוּא עָ֝שָׂ֗ה מִ֣י יְשַׁלֶּם לֽוֹ
Job 21:31 [KJV]  Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?

Job 21:32 [HEB]  וְ֭הוּא לִקְבָר֣וֹת יוּבָ֑ל וְֽעַל גָּדִ֥ישׁ יִשְׁקֽוֹד
Job 21:32 [KJV]  Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.

Job 21:33 [HEB]  מָֽתְקוּ ל֗וֹ רִגְבֵ֫י נָ֥חַל וְ֭אַחֲרָיו כָּל אָדָ֣ם יִמְשׁ֑וֹךְ וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר
Job 21:33 [KJV]  The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.

Job 21:34 [HEB]  וְ֭אֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמ֣וּנִי הָ֑בֶל וּ֝תְשֽׁוּבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם נִשְׁאַר מָֽעַל
Job 21:34 [KJV]  How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?


--- Job Chapter 22 ---
Job 22:1 [HEB]  וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּמָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 22:1 [KJV]  Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

Job 22:2 [HEB]  הַלְאֵ֥ל יִסְכָּן גָּ֑בֶר כִּֽי יִסְכֹּ֖ן עָלֵ֣ימוֹ מַשְׂכִּֽיל
Job 22:2 [KJV]  Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?

Job 22:3 [HEB]  הַחֵ֣פֶץ לְ֭שַׁדַּי כִּ֣י תִצְדָּ֑ק וְאִם בֶּ֝֗צַע כִּֽי תַתֵּ֥ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ
Job 22:3 [KJV]  Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?

Job 22:4 [HEB]  הֲֽ֭מִיִּרְאָ֣תְךָ יֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ יָב֥וֹא עִ֝מְּךָ֗ בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט
Job 22:4 [KJV]  Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?

Job 22:5 [HEB]  הֲלֹ֣א רָעָֽתְךָ֣ רַבָּ֑ה וְאֵֽין קֵ֝֗ץ לַעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ
Job 22:5 [KJV]  Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?

Job 22:6 [HEB]  כִּֽי תַחְבֹּ֣ל אַחֶ֣יךָ חִנָּ֑ם וּבִגְדֵ֖י עֲרוּמִּ֣ים תַּפְשִֽׁיט
Job 22:6 [KJV]  For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

Job 22:7 [HEB]  לֹא מַ֭יִם עָיֵ֣ף תַּשְׁקֶ֑ה וּ֝מֵרָעֵ֗ב תִּֽמְנַֽע לָֽחֶם
Job 22:7 [KJV]  Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

Job 22:8 [HEB]  וְאִ֣ישׁ זְ֭רוֹעַ ל֣וֹ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּנְשׂ֥וּא פָ֝נִ֗ים יֵ֣שֶׁב בָּֽהּ
Job 22:8 [KJV]  But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.

Job 22:9 [HEB]  אַ֭לְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּ֣חְתָּ רֵיקָ֑ם וּזְרֹע֖וֹת יְתֹמִ֣ים יְדֻכָּֽא
Job 22:9 [KJV]  Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

Job 22:10 [HEB]  עַל כֵּ֭ן סְבִיבוֹתֶ֣יךָ פַחִ֑ים וִֽ֝יבַהֶלְךָ פַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹֽם
Job 22:10 [KJV]  Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

Job 22:11 [HEB]  אוֹ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ לֹֽא תִרְאֶ֑ה וְֽשִׁפְעַת מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ
Job 22:11 [KJV]  Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.

Job 22:12 [HEB]  הֲֽלֹא אֱ֭לוֹהַּ גֹּ֣בַהּ שָׁמָ֑יִם וּרְאֵ֤ה רֹ֖אשׁ כּוֹכָבִ֣ים כִּי רָֽמּוּ
Job 22:12 [KJV]  Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

Job 22:13 [HEB]  וְֽ֭אָמַרְתָּ מַה יָּ֣דַֽע אֵ֑ל הַבְעַ֖ד עֲרָפֶ֣ל יִשְׁפּֽוֹט
Job 22:13 [KJV]  And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?

Job 22:14 [HEB]  עָבִ֣ים סֵֽתֶר ל֭וֹ וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֑ה וְח֥וּג שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יִתְהַלָּֽךְ
Job 22:14 [KJV]  Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.

Job 22:15 [HEB]  הַאֹ֣רַח עוֹלָ֣ם תִּשְׁמֹ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר דָּרְכ֣וּ מְתֵי אָֽוֶן
Job 22:15 [KJV]  Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

Job 22:16 [HEB]  אֲשֶֽׁר קֻמְּט֥וּ וְלֹא עֵ֑ת נָ֝הָ֗ר יוּצַ֥ק יְסוֹדָֽם
Job 22:16 [KJV]  Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

Job 22:17 [HEB]  הָאֹמְרִ֣ים לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּמַה יִּפְעַ֖ל שַׁדַּ֣י לָֽמוֹ
Job 22:17 [KJV]  Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?

Job 22:18 [HEB]  וְה֤וּא מִלֵּ֣א בָתֵּיהֶ֣ם ט֑וֹב וַעֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי
Job 22:18 [KJV]  Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

Job 22:19 [HEB]  יִרְא֣וּ צַדִּיקִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְ֝נָקִ֗י יִלְעַג לָֽמוֹ
Job 22:19 [KJV]  The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

Job 22:20 [HEB]  אִם לֹ֣א נִכְחַ֣ד קִימָ֑נוּ וְ֝יִתְרָ֗ם אָ֣כְלָה אֵֽשׁ
Job 22:20 [KJV]  Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.

Job 22:21 [HEB]  הַסְכֶּן נָ֣א עִמּ֑וֹ וּשְׁלם בָּ֝הֶ֗ם תְּֽבוֹאַתְךָ֥ טוֹבָֽה
Job 22:21 [KJV]  Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.

Job 22:22 [HEB]  קַח נָ֣א מִפִּ֣יו תּוֹרָ֑ה וְשִׂ֥ים אֲ֝מָרָ֗יו בִּלְבָבֶֽךָ
Job 22:22 [KJV]  Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

Job 22:23 [HEB]  אִם תָּשׁ֣וּב עַד שַׁ֭דַּי תִּבָּנֶ֑ה תַּרְחִ֥יק עַ֝וְלָ֗ה מֵאָהֳלֶֽךָ
Job 22:23 [KJV]  If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.

Job 22:24 [HEB]  וְשִׁית עַל עָפָ֥ר בָּ֑צֶר וּבְצ֖וּר נְחָלִ֣ים אוֹפִֽיר
Job 22:24 [KJV]  Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.

Job 22:25 [HEB]  וְהָיָ֣ה שַׁדַּ֣י בְּצָרֶ֑יךָ וְכֶ֖סֶף תּוֹעָפ֣וֹת לָֽךְ
Job 22:25 [KJV]  Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.

Job 22:26 [HEB]  כִּי אָ֭ז עַל שַׁדַּ֣י תִּתְעַנָּ֑ג וְתִשָּׂ֖א אֶל אֱל֣וֹהַּ פָּנֶֽיךָ
Job 22:26 [KJV]  For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.

Job 22:27 [HEB]  תַּעְתִּ֣יר אֵ֭לָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶ֑ךָּ וּנְדָרֶ֥יךָ תְשַׁלֵּֽם
Job 22:27 [KJV]  Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.

Job 22:28 [HEB]  וְֽתִגְזַר א֭וֹמֶר וְיָ֣קָם לָ֑ךְ וְעַל דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ נָ֣גַֽהּ אֽוֹר
Job 22:28 [KJV]  Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.

Job 22:29 [HEB]  כִּֽי הִ֭שְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּוָ֑ה וְשַׁ֖ח עֵינַ֣יִם יוֹשִֽׁעַ
Job 22:29 [KJV]  When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.

Job 22:30 [HEB]  יְֽמַלֵּ֥ט אִֽי נָקִ֑י וְ֝נִמְלַ֗ט בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ
Job 22:30 [KJV]  He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.


--- Job Chapter 23 ---
Job 23:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 23:1 [KJV]  Then Job answered and said,

Job 23:2 [HEB]  גַּם הַ֭יּוֹם מְרִ֣י שִׂחִ֑י יָ֝דִ֗י כָּבְדָ֥ה עַל אַנְחָתִֽי
Job 23:2 [KJV]  Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

Job 23:3 [HEB]  מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי וְאֶמְצָאֵ֑הוּ אָ֝ב֗וֹא עַד תְּכוּנָתֽוֹ
Job 23:3 [KJV]  Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!

Job 23:4 [HEB]  אֶעֶרְכָ֣ה לְפָנָ֣יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝פִ֗י אֲמַלֵּ֥א תוֹכָחֽוֹת
Job 23:4 [KJV]  I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

Job 23:5 [HEB]  אֵ֭דְעָה מִלִּ֣ים יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָבִ֗ינָה מַה יֹּ֥אמַר לִֽי
Job 23:5 [KJV]  I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.

Job 23:6 [HEB]  הַבְּרָב כֹּ֭חַ יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י לֹ֥א אַךְ ה֝֗וּא יָשִׂ֥ם בִּֽי
Job 23:6 [KJV]  Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.

Job 23:7 [HEB]  שָׁ֗ם יָ֭שָׁר נוֹכָ֣ח עִמּ֑וֹ וַאֲפַלְּטָ֥ה לָ֝נֶ֗צַח מִשֹּׁפְטִֽי
Job 23:7 [KJV]  There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

Job 23:8 [HEB]  הֵ֤ן קֶ֣דֶם אֶהֱלֹ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְ֝אָח֗וֹר וְֽלֹא אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ
Job 23:8 [KJV]  Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:

Job 23:9 [HEB]  שְׂמֹ֣אול בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ וְלֹא אָ֑חַז יַעְטֹ֥ף יָ֝מִ֗ין וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶֽה
Job 23:9 [KJV]  On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:

Job 23:10 [HEB]  כִּֽי יָ֭דַע דֶּ֣רֶךְ עִמָּדִ֑י בְּ֝חָנַ֗נִי כַּזָּהָ֥ב אֵצֵֽא
Job 23:10 [KJV]  But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

Job 23:11 [HEB]  בַּ֭אֲשֻׁרוֹ אָחֲזָ֣ה רַגְלִ֑י דַּרְכּ֖וֹ שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי וְלֹא אָֽט
Job 23:11 [KJV]  My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.

Job 23:12 [HEB]  מִצְוַ֣ת שְׂ֭פָתָיו וְלֹ֣א אָמִ֑ישׁ מֵ֝חֻקִּ֗י צָפַ֥נְתִּי אִמְרֵי פִֽיו
Job 23:12 [KJV]  Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

Job 23:13 [HEB]  וְה֣וּא בְ֭אֶחָד וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ אִוְּתָ֣ה וַיָּֽעַשׂ
Job 23:13 [KJV]  But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

Job 23:14 [HEB]  כִּ֭י יַשְׁלִ֣ים חֻקִּ֑י וְכָהֵ֖נָּה רַבּ֣וֹת עִמּֽוֹ
Job 23:14 [KJV]  For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.

Job 23:15 [HEB]  עַל כֵּ֭ן מִפָּנָ֣יו אֶבָּהֵ֑ל אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן וְאֶפְחַ֥ד מִמֶּֽנּוּ
Job 23:15 [KJV]  Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.

Job 23:16 [HEB]  וְ֭אֵל הֵרַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הִבְהִילָֽנִי
Job 23:16 [KJV]  For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:

Job 23:17 [HEB]  כִּֽי לֹ֣א נִ֭צְמַתִּי מִפְּנֵי חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י כִּסָּה אֹֽפֶל
Job 23:17 [KJV]  Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.


--- Job Chapter 24 ---
Job 24:1 [HEB]  מַדּ֗וּעַ מִ֭שַּׁדַּי לֹא נִצְפְּנ֣וּ עִתִּ֑ים וידעו וְ֝יֹדְעָ֗יו לֹא חָ֥זוּ יָמָֽיו
Job 24:1 [KJV]  Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?

Job 24:2 [HEB]  גְּבֻל֥וֹת יַשִּׂ֑יגוּ עֵ֥דֶר גָּ֝זְל֗וּ וַיִּרְעֽוּ
Job 24:2 [KJV]  Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.

Job 24:3 [HEB]  חֲמ֣וֹר יְתוֹמִ֣ים יִנְהָ֑גוּ יַ֝חְבְּל֗וּ שׁ֣וֹר אַלְמָנָֽה
Job 24:3 [KJV]  They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

Job 24:4 [HEB]  יַטּ֣וּ אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים מִדָּ֑רֶךְ יַ֥חַד חֻ֝בְּא֗וּ עֲנִיֵּי אָֽרֶץ
Job 24:4 [KJV]  They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

Job 24:5 [HEB]  הֵ֤ן פְּרָאִ֨ים בַּֽמִּדְבָּ֗ר יָצְא֣וּ בְּ֭פָעֳלָם מְשַׁחֲרֵ֣י לַטָּ֑רֶף עֲרָבָ֥ה ל֥וֹ לֶ֝֗חֶם לַנְּעָרִֽים
Job 24:5 [KJV]  Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.

Job 24:6 [HEB]  בַּ֭שָּׂדֶה בְּלִיל֣וֹ יקצירו יִקְצ֑וֹרוּ וְכֶ֖רֶם רָשָׁ֣ע יְלַקֵּֽשׁוּ
Job 24:6 [KJV]  They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.

Job 24:7 [HEB]  עָר֣וֹם יָ֭לִינוּ מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת בַּקָּרָֽה
Job 24:7 [KJV]  They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.

Job 24:8 [HEB]  מִזֶּ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים יִרְטָ֑בוּ וּֽמִבְּלִ֥י מַ֝חְסֶ֗ה חִבְּקוּ צֽוּר
Job 24:8 [KJV]  They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

Job 24:9 [HEB]  יִ֭גְזְלוּ מִשֹּׁ֣ד יָת֑וֹם וְֽעַל עָנִ֥י יַחְבֹּֽלוּ
Job 24:9 [KJV]  They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.

Job 24:10 [HEB]  עָר֣וֹם הִ֭לְּכוּ בְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וּ֝רְעֵבִ֗ים נָ֣שְׂאוּ עֹֽמֶר
Job 24:10 [KJV]  They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;

Job 24:11 [HEB]  בֵּין שׁוּרֹתָ֥ם יַצְהִ֑ירוּ יְקָבִ֥ים דָּ֝רְכ֗וּ וַיִּצְמָֽאוּ
Job 24:11 [KJV]  Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

Job 24:12 [HEB]  מֵ֘עִ֤יר מְתִ֨ים יִנְאָ֗קוּ וְנֶֽפֶשׁ חֲלָלִ֥ים תְּשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וֶ֝אֱל֗וֹהַּ לֹא יָשִׂ֥ים תִּפְלָֽה
Job 24:12 [KJV]  Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.

Job 24:13 [HEB]  הֵ֤מָּה הָיוּ֮ בְּֽמֹרְדֵ֫י א֥וֹר לֹֽא הִכִּ֥ירוּ דְרָכָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יָ֝שְׁב֗וּ בִּנְתִיבֹתָֽיו
Job 24:13 [KJV]  They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

Job 24:14 [HEB]  לָא֡וֹר יָ֘ק֤וּם רוֹצֵ֗חַ יִֽקְטָל עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וּ֝בַלַּ֗יְלָה יְהִ֣י כַגַּנָּֽב
Job 24:14 [KJV]  The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.

Job 24:15 [HEB]  וְעֵ֤ין נֹאֵ֨ף שָׁ֤מְרָֽה נֶ֣שֶׁף לֵ֭אמֹר לֹא תְשׁוּרֵ֣נִי עָ֑יִן וְסֵ֖תֶר פָּנִ֣ים יָשִֽׂים
Job 24:15 [KJV]  The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.

Job 24:16 [HEB]  חָתַ֥ר בַּחֹ֗שֶׁךְ בָּ֫תִּ֥ים יוֹמָ֥ם חִתְּמוּ לָ֗מוֹ לֹא יָ֥דְעוּ אֽוֹר
Job 24:16 [KJV]  In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.

Job 24:17 [HEB]  כִּ֤י יַחְדָּ֨ו בֹּ֣קֶר לָ֣מוֹ צַלְמָ֑וֶת כִּֽי יַ֝כִּ֗יר בַּלְה֥וֹת צַלְמָֽוֶת
Job 24:17 [KJV]  For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.

Job 24:18 [HEB]  קַֽל ה֤וּא עַל פְּנֵי מַ֗יִם תְּקֻלַּ֣ל חֶלְקָתָ֣ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא יִ֝פְנֶה דֶּ֣רֶךְ כְּרָמִֽים
Job 24:18 [KJV]  He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.

Job 24:19 [HEB]  צִיָּ֤ה גַם חֹ֗ם יִגְזְל֥וּ מֵֽימֵי שֶׁ֗לֶג שְׁא֣וֹל חָטָֽאוּ
Job 24:19 [KJV]  Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.

Job 24:20 [HEB]  יִשְׁכָּ֘חֵ֤הוּ רֶ֨חֶם מְתָ֘ק֤וֹ רִמָּ֗ה ע֥וֹד לֹֽא יִזָּכֵ֑ר וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֖ר כָּעֵ֣ץ עַוְלָֽה
Job 24:20 [KJV]  The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.

Job 24:21 [HEB]  רֹעֶ֣ה עֲ֭קָרָה לֹ֣א תֵלֵ֑ד וְ֝אַלְמָנָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְיֵטִֽיב
Job 24:21 [KJV]  He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.

Job 24:22 [HEB]  וּמָשַׁ֣ךְ אַבִּירִ֣ים בְּכֹח֑וֹ יָ֝ק֗וּם וְֽלֹא יַאֲמִ֥ין בַּֽחַיִּֽין
Job 24:22 [KJV]  He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.

Job 24:23 [HEB]  יִתֶּן ל֣וֹ לָ֭בֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵ֑ן וְ֝עֵינֵ֗יהוּ עַל דַּרְכֵיהֶֽם
Job 24:23 [KJV]  Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.

Job 24:24 [HEB]  ר֤וֹמּוּ מְּעַ֨ט וְֽאֵינֶ֗נּוּ וְֽהֻמְּכ֗וּ כַּכֹּ֥ל יִקָּפְצ֑וּן וּכְרֹ֖אשׁ שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת יִמָּֽלוּ
Job 24:24 [KJV]  They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.

Job 24:25 [HEB]  וְאִם לֹ֣א אֵ֭פוֹ מִ֣י יַכְזִיבֵ֑נִי וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְ֝אַ֗ל מִלָּתִֽי
Job 24:25 [KJV]  And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?


--- Job Chapter 25 ---
Job 25:1 [HEB]  וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשֻּׁחִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 25:1 [KJV]  Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

Job 25:2 [HEB]  הַמְשֵׁ֣ל וָפַ֣חַד עִמּ֑וֹ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו
Job 25:2 [KJV]  Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.

Job 25:3 [HEB]  הֲיֵ֣שׁ מִ֭סְפָּר לִגְדוּדָ֑יו וְעַל מִ֝֗י לֹא יָק֥וּם אוֹרֵֽהוּ
Job 25:3 [KJV]  Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?

Job 25:4 [HEB]  וּמַה יִּצְדַּ֣ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם אֵ֑ל וּמַה יִּ֝זְכֶּ֗ה יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה
Job 25:4 [KJV]  How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

Job 25:5 [HEB]  הֵ֣ן עַד יָ֭רֵחַ וְלֹ֣א יַאֲהִ֑יל וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים לֹא זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו
Job 25:5 [KJV]  Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.

Job 25:6 [HEB]  אַ֭ף כִּֽי אֱנ֣וֹשׁ רִמָּ֑ה וּבֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם תּוֹלֵעָֽה
Job 25:6 [KJV]  How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?


--- Job Chapter 26 ---
Job 26:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 26:1 [KJV]  But Job answered and said,

Job 26:2 [HEB]  מֶה עָזַ֥רְתָּ לְלֹא כֹ֑חַ ה֝וֹשַׁ֗עְתָּ זְר֣וֹעַ לֹא עֹֽז
Job 26:2 [KJV]  How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?

Job 26:3 [HEB]  מַה יָּ֭עַצְתָּ לְלֹ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝תוּשִׁיָּ֗ה לָרֹ֥ב הוֹדָֽעְתָּ
Job 26:3 [KJV]  How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?

Job 26:4 [HEB]  אֶת מִ֭י הִגַּ֣דְתָּ מִלִּ֑ין וְנִשְׁמַת מִ֝י יָצְאָ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ
Job 26:4 [KJV]  To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

Job 26:5 [HEB]  הָרְפָאִ֥ים יְחוֹלָ֑לוּ מִתַּ֥חַת מַ֝֗יִם וְשֹׁכְנֵיהֶֽם
Job 26:5 [KJV]  Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

Job 26:6 [HEB]  עָר֣וֹם שְׁא֣וֹל נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָֽאֲבַדּֽוֹן
Job 26:6 [KJV]  Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

Job 26:7 [HEB]  נֹטֶ֣ה צָפ֣וֹן עַל תֹּ֑הוּ תֹּ֥לֶה אֶ֝֗רֶץ עַל בְּלִי מָֽה
Job 26:7 [KJV]  He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

Job 26:8 [HEB]  צֹרֵֽר מַ֥יִם בְּעָבָ֑יו וְלֹא נִבְקַ֖ע עָנָ֣ן תַּחְתָּֽם
Job 26:8 [KJV]  He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

Job 26:9 [HEB]  מְאַחֵ֥ז פְּנֵי כִסֵּ֑ה פַּרְשֵׁ֖ז עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנֽוֹ
Job 26:9 [KJV]  He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.

Job 26:10 [HEB]  חֹֽק חָ֭ג עַל פְּנֵי מָ֑יִם עַד תַּכְלִ֖ית א֣וֹר עִם חֹֽשֶׁךְ
Job 26:10 [KJV]  He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.

Job 26:11 [HEB]  עַמּוּדֵ֣י שָׁמַ֣יִם יְרוֹפָ֑פוּ וְ֝יִתְמְה֗וּ מִגַּעֲרָתֽוֹ
Job 26:11 [KJV]  The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

Job 26:12 [HEB]  בְּ֭כֹחוֹ רָגַ֣ע הַיָּ֑ם ובתובנתו וּ֝בִתְבוּנָת֗וֹ מָ֣חַץ רָֽהַב
Job 26:12 [KJV]  He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.

Job 26:13 [HEB]  בְּ֭רוּחוֹ שָׁמַ֣יִם שִׁפְרָ֑ה חֹֽלֲלָ֥ה יָ֝ד֗וֹ נָחָ֥שׁ בָּרִֽיחַ
Job 26:13 [KJV]  By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.

Job 26:14 [HEB]  הֶן אֵ֤לֶּה קְצ֬וֹת דרכו דְּרָכָ֗יו וּמַה שֵּׁ֣מֶץ דָּ֭בָר נִשְׁמַע בּ֑וֹ וְרַ֥עַם גבורתו גְּ֝בוּרוֹתָ֗יו מִ֣י יִתְבּוֹנָֽן
Job 26:14 [KJV]  Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?


--- Job Chapter 27 ---
Job 27:1 [HEB]  וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 27:1 [KJV]  Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

Job 27:2 [HEB]  חַי אֵ֭ל הֵסִ֣יר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הֵמַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי
Job 27:2 [KJV]  As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;

Job 27:3 [HEB]  כִּֽי כָל ע֣וֹד נִשְׁמָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְר֖וּחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּאַפִּֽי
Job 27:3 [KJV]  All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;

Job 27:4 [HEB]  אִם תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנִ֗י אִם יֶהְגֶּ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה
Job 27:4 [KJV]  My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

Job 27:5 [HEB]  חָלִ֣ילָה לִּי֮ אִם אַצְדִּ֪יק אֶ֫תְכֶ֥ם עַד אֶגְוָ֑ע לֹא אָסִ֖יר תֻּמָּתִ֣י מִמֶּֽנִּי
Job 27:5 [KJV]  God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.

Job 27:6 [HEB]  בְּצִדְקָתִ֣י הֶ֭חֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֑הָ לֹֽא יֶחֱרַ֥ף לְ֝בָבִ֗י מִיָּמָֽי
Job 27:6 [KJV]  My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

Job 27:7 [HEB]  יְהִ֣י כְ֭רָשָׁע אֹ֣יְבִ֑י וּמִתְקוֹמְמִ֥י כְעַוָּֽל
Job 27:7 [KJV]  Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.

Job 27:8 [HEB]  כִּ֤י מַה תִּקְוַ֣ת חָ֭נֵף כִּ֣י יִבְצָ֑ע כִּ֤י יֵ֖שֶׁל אֱל֣וֹהַּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ
Job 27:8 [KJV]  For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?

Job 27:9 [HEB]  הַֽ֭צַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵ֑ל כִּֽי תָב֖וֹא עָלָ֣יו צָרָֽה
Job 27:9 [KJV]  Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?

Job 27:10 [HEB]  אִם עַל שַׁדַּ֥י יִתְעַנָּ֑ג יִקְרָ֖א אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּכָל עֵֽת
Job 27:10 [KJV]  Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?

Job 27:11 [HEB]  אוֹרֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֣ם בְּיַד אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם שַׁ֝דַּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲכַחֵֽד
Job 27:11 [KJV]  I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

Job 27:12 [HEB]  הֵן אַתֶּ֣ם כֻּלְּכֶ֣ם חֲזִיתֶ֑ם וְלָמָּה זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ
Job 27:12 [KJV]  Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?

Job 27:13 [HEB]  זֶ֤ה חֵֽלֶק אָדָ֖ם רָשָׁ֥ע עִם אֵ֑ל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת עָ֝רִיצִ֗ים מִשַּׁדַּ֥י יִקָּֽחוּ
Job 27:13 [KJV]  This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.

Job 27:14 [HEB]  אִם יִרְבּ֣וּ בָנָ֣יו לְמוֹ חָ֑רֶב וְ֝צֶאֱצָאָ֗יו לֹ֣א יִשְׂבְּעוּ לָֽחֶם
Job 27:14 [KJV]  If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

Job 27:15 [HEB]  שרידו שְׂ֭רִידָיו בַּמָּ֣וֶת יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה
Job 27:15 [KJV]  Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.

Job 27:16 [HEB]  אִם יִצְבֹּ֣ר כֶּעָפָ֣ר כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝כַחֹ֗מֶר יָכִ֥ין מַלְבּֽוּשׁ
Job 27:16 [KJV]  Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;

Job 27:17 [HEB]  יָ֭כִין וְצַדִּ֣יק יִלְבָּ֑שׁ וְ֝כֶ֗סֶף נָקִ֥י יַחֲלֹֽק
Job 27:17 [KJV]  He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

Job 27:18 [HEB]  בָּנָ֣ה כָעָ֣שׁ בֵּית֑וֹ וּ֝כְסֻכָּ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה נֹצֵֽר
Job 27:18 [KJV]  He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.

Job 27:19 [HEB]  עָשִׁ֣יר יִ֭שְׁכַּב וְלֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף עֵינָ֖יו פָּקַ֣ח וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ
Job 27:19 [KJV]  The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.

Job 27:20 [HEB]  תַּשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ כַ֭מַּיִם בַּלָּה֑וֹת לַ֝֗יְלָה גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה
Job 27:20 [KJV]  Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.

Job 27:21 [HEB]  יִשָּׂאֵ֣הוּ קָדִ֣ים וְיֵלַ֑ךְ וִֽ֝ישָׂעֲרֵ֗הוּ מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ
Job 27:21 [KJV]  The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.

Job 27:22 [HEB]  וְיַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָיו וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל מִ֝יָּד֗וֹ בָּר֥וֹחַ יִבְרָֽח
Job 27:22 [KJV]  For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.

Job 27:23 [HEB]  יִשְׂפֹּ֣ק עָלֵ֣ימוֹ כַפֵּ֑ימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹ֥ק עָ֝לָ֗יו מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ
Job 27:23 [KJV]  Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.


--- Job Chapter 28 ---
Job 28:1 [HEB]  כִּ֤י יֵ֣שׁ לַכֶּ֣סֶף מוֹצָ֑א וּ֝מָק֗וֹם לַזָּהָ֥ב יָזֹֽקּוּ
Job 28:1 [KJV]  Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.

Job 28:2 [HEB]  בַּ֭רְזֶל מֵעָפָ֣ר יֻקָּ֑ח וְ֝אֶ֗בֶן יָצ֥וּק נְחוּשָֽׁה
Job 28:2 [KJV]  Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

Job 28:3 [HEB]  קֵ֤ץ שָׂ֤ם לַחֹ֗שֶׁךְ וּֽלְכָל תַּ֭כְלִית ה֣וּא חוֹקֵ֑ר אֶ֖בֶן אֹ֣פֶל וְצַלְמָֽוֶת
Job 28:3 [KJV]  He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

Job 28:4 [HEB]  פָּ֤רַץ נַ֨חַל מֵֽעִם גָּ֗ר הַֽנִּשְׁכָּחִ֥ים מִנִּי רָ֑גֶל דַּ֖לּוּ מֵאֱנ֣וֹשׁ נָֽעוּ
Job 28:4 [KJV]  The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

Job 28:5 [HEB]  אֶ֗רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יֵֽצֵא לָ֑חֶם וְ֝תַחְתֶּ֗יהָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ כְּמוֹ אֵֽשׁ
Job 28:5 [KJV]  As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

Job 28:6 [HEB]  מְקוֹם סַפִּ֥יר אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְעַפְרֹ֖ת זָהָ֣ב לֽוֹ
Job 28:6 [KJV]  The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.

Job 28:7 [HEB]  נָ֭תִיב לֹֽא יְדָ֣עוֹ עָ֑יִט וְלֹ֥א שְׁ֝זָפַ֗תּוּ עֵ֣ין אַיָּֽה
Job 28:7 [KJV]  There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture’s eye hath not seen:

Job 28:8 [HEB]  לֹֽא הִדְרִיכֻ֥הוּ בְנֵי שָׁ֑חַץ לֹֽא עָדָ֖ה עָלָ֣יו שָֽׁחַל
Job 28:8 [KJV]  The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

Job 28:9 [HEB]  בַּֽ֭חַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַ֣ח יָד֑וֹ הָפַ֖ךְ מִשֹּׁ֣רֶשׁ הָרִֽים
Job 28:9 [KJV]  He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.

Job 28:10 [HEB]  בַּ֭צּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִ֣ים בִּקֵּ֑עַ וְכָל יְ֝קָ֗ר רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֽוֹ
Job 28:10 [KJV]  He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.

Job 28:11 [HEB]  מִ֭בְּכִי נְהָר֣וֹת חִבֵּ֑שׁ וְ֝תַעֲלֻמָ֗הּ יֹ֣צִא אֽוֹר
Job 28:11 [KJV]  He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

Job 28:12 [HEB]  וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תִּמָּצֵ֑א וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה
Job 28:12 [KJV]  But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?

Job 28:13 [HEB]  לֹא יָדַ֣ע אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עֶרְכָּ֑הּ וְלֹ֥א תִ֝מָּצֵ֗א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּֽים
Job 28:13 [KJV]  Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

Job 28:14 [HEB]  תְּה֣וֹם אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א בִי הִ֑יא וְיָ֥ם אָ֝מַ֗ר אֵ֣ין עִמָּדִֽי
Job 28:14 [KJV]  The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.

Job 28:15 [HEB]  לֹא יֻתַּ֣ן סְג֣וֹר תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יִ֝שָּׁקֵ֗ל כֶּ֣סֶף מְחִירָֽהּ
Job 28:15 [KJV]  It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

Job 28:16 [HEB]  לֹֽא תְ֭סֻלֶּה בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִ֑יר בְּשֹׁ֖הַם יָקָ֣ר וְסַפִּֽיר
Job 28:16 [KJV]  It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

Job 28:17 [HEB]  לֹא יַעַרְכֶ֣נָּה זָ֭הָב וּזְכוֹכִ֑ית וּתְמ֖וּרָתָ֣הּ כְּלִי פָֽז
Job 28:17 [KJV]  The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

Job 28:18 [HEB]  רָאמ֣וֹת וְ֭גָבִישׁ לֹ֣א יִזָּכֵ֑ר וּמֶ֥שֶׁךְ חָ֝כְמָ֗ה מִפְּנִינִֽים
Job 28:18 [KJV]  No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

Job 28:19 [HEB]  לֹֽא יַ֭עַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת כּ֑וּשׁ בְּכֶ֥תֶם טָ֝ה֗וֹר לֹ֣א תְסֻלֶּֽה
Job 28:19 [KJV]  The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

Job 28:20 [HEB]  וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה
Job 28:20 [KJV]  Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

Job 28:21 [HEB]  וְֽ֭נֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵ֣י כָל חָ֑י וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם נִסְתָּֽרָה
Job 28:21 [KJV]  Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.

Job 28:22 [HEB]  אֲבַדּ֣וֹן וָ֭מָוֶת אָ֣מְר֑וּ בְּ֝אָזְנֵ֗ינוּ שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ שִׁמְעָֽהּ
Job 28:22 [KJV]  Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

Job 28:23 [HEB]  אֱ֭לֹהִים הֵבִ֣ין דַּרְכָּ֑הּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יָדַ֥ע אֶת מְקוֹמָֽהּ
Job 28:23 [KJV]  God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.

Job 28:24 [HEB]  כִּי ה֭וּא לִקְצוֹת הָאָ֣רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט תַּ֖חַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִרְאֶֽה
Job 28:24 [KJV]  For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;

Job 28:25 [HEB]  לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָר֣וּחַ מִשְׁקָ֑ל וּ֝מַ֗יִם תִּכֵּ֥ן בְּמִדָּֽה
Job 28:25 [KJV]  To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

Job 28:26 [HEB]  בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ לַמָּטָ֣ר חֹ֑ק וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת
Job 28:26 [KJV]  When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:

Job 28:27 [HEB]  אָ֣ז רָ֭אָהּ וַֽיְסַפְּרָ֑הּ הֱ֝כִינָ֗הּ וְגַם חֲקָרָֽהּ
Job 28:27 [KJV]  Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

Job 28:28 [HEB]  וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָֽאָדָ֗ם הֵ֤ן יִרְאַ֣ת אֲ֭דֹנָי הִ֣יא חָכְמָ֑ה וְס֖וּר מֵרָ֣ע בִּינָֽה
Job 28:28 [KJV]  And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the LORD, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.


--- Job Chapter 29 ---
Job 29:1 [HEB]  וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 29:1 [KJV]  Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

Job 29:2 [HEB]  מִֽי יִתְּנֵ֥נִי כְיַרְחֵי קֶ֑דֶם כִּ֝ימֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵֽנִי
Job 29:2 [KJV]  Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;

Job 29:3 [HEB]  בְּהִלּ֣וֹ נֵ֭רוֹ עֲלֵ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י לְ֝אוֹרוֹ אֵ֣לֶךְ חֹֽשֶׁךְ
Job 29:3 [KJV]  When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;

Job 29:4 [HEB]  כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הָ֭יִיתִי בִּימֵ֣י חָרְפִּ֑י בְּס֥וֹד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ עֲלֵ֣י אָהֳלִֽי
Job 29:4 [KJV]  As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;

Job 29:5 [HEB]  בְּע֣וֹד שַׁ֭דַּי עִמָּדִ֑י סְבִ֖יבוֹתַ֣י נְעָרָֽי
Job 29:5 [KJV]  When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

Job 29:6 [HEB]  בִּרְחֹ֣ץ הֲלִיכַ֣י בְּחֵמָ֑ה וְצ֥וּר יָצ֥וּק עִ֝מָּדִ֗י פַּלְגֵי שָֽׁמֶן
Job 29:6 [KJV]  When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

Job 29:7 [HEB]  בְּצֵ֣אתִי שַׁ֣עַר עֲלֵי קָ֑רֶת בָּ֝רְח֗וֹב אָכִ֥ין מוֹשָׁבִֽי
Job 29:7 [KJV]  When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!

Job 29:8 [HEB]  רָא֣וּנִי נְעָרִ֣ים וְנֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וִֽ֝ישִׁישִׁים קָ֣מוּ עָמָֽדוּ
Job 29:8 [KJV]  The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.

Job 29:9 [HEB]  שָׂ֭רִים עָצְר֣וּ בְמִלִּ֑ים וְ֝כַ֗ף יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לְפִיהֶֽם
Job 29:9 [KJV]  The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

Job 29:10 [HEB]  קוֹל נְגִידִ֥ים נֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם לְחִכָּ֥ם דָּבֵֽקָה
Job 29:10 [KJV]  The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

Job 29:11 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אֹ֣זֶן שָׁ֭מְעָה וַֽתְּאַשְּׁרֵ֑נִי וְעַ֥יִן רָ֝אֲתָ֗ה וַתְּעִידֵֽנִי
Job 29:11 [KJV]  When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:

Job 29:12 [HEB]  כִּֽי אֲ֭מַלֵּט עָנִ֣י מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝יָת֗וֹם וְֽלֹא עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ
Job 29:12 [KJV]  Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.

Job 29:13 [HEB]  בִּרְכַּ֣ת אֹ֭בֵד עָלַ֣י תָּבֹ֑א וְלֵ֖ב אַלְמָנָ֣ה אַרְנִֽן
Job 29:13 [KJV]  The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

Job 29:14 [HEB]  צֶ֣דֶק לָ֭בַשְׁתִּי וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁ֑נִי כִּֽמְעִ֥יל וְ֝צָנִ֗יף מִשְׁפָּטִֽי
Job 29:14 [KJV]  I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.

Job 29:15 [HEB]  עֵינַ֣יִם הָ֭יִיתִי לַֽעִוֵּ֑ר וְרַגְלַ֖יִם לַפִּסֵּ֣חַ אָֽנִי
Job 29:15 [KJV]  I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

Job 29:16 [HEB]  אָ֣ב אָ֭נֹכִֽי לָֽאֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים וְרִ֖ב לֹא יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵֽהוּ
Job 29:16 [KJV]  I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.

Job 29:17 [HEB]  וָֽ֭אֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּע֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וּ֝מִשִּׁנָּ֗יו אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ טָֽרֶף
Job 29:17 [KJV]  And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

Job 29:18 [HEB]  וָ֭אֹמַר עִם קִנִּ֣י אֶגְוָ֑ע וְ֝כַח֗וֹל אַרְבֶּ֥ה יָמִֽים
Job 29:18 [KJV]  Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.

Job 29:19 [HEB]  שָׁרְשִׁ֣י פָת֣וּחַ אֱלֵי מָ֑יִם וְ֝טַ֗ל יָלִ֥ין בִּקְצִירִֽי
Job 29:19 [KJV]  My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.

Job 29:20 [HEB]  כְּ֭בוֹדִי חָדָ֣שׁ עִמָּדִ֑י וְ֝קַשְׁתִּ֗י בְּיָדִ֥י תַחֲלִֽיף
Job 29:20 [KJV]  My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

Job 29:21 [HEB]  לִֽי שָׁמְע֥וּ וְיִחֵ֑לּוּ וְ֝יִדְּמ֗וּ לְמ֣וֹ עֲצָתִֽי
Job 29:21 [KJV]  Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

Job 29:22 [HEB]  אַחֲרֵ֣י דְ֭בָרִי לֹ֣א יִשְׁנ֑וּ וְ֝עָלֵ֗ימוֹ תִּטֹּ֥ף מִלָּתִֽי
Job 29:22 [KJV]  After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.

Job 29:23 [HEB]  וְיִֽחֲל֣וּ כַמָּטָ֣ר לִ֑י וּ֝פִיהֶ֗ם פָּעֲר֥וּ לְמַלְקֽוֹשׁ
Job 29:23 [KJV]  And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

Job 29:24 [HEB]  אֶשְׂחַ֣ק אֲ֭לֵהֶם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ינוּ וְא֥וֹר פָּ֝נַ֗י לֹ֣א יַפִּילֽוּן
Job 29:24 [KJV]  If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

Job 29:25 [HEB]  אֶֽבֲחַ֣ר דַּרְכָּם֮ וְאֵשֵׁ֪ב רֹ֥אשׁ וְ֭אֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּגְּד֑וּד כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲבֵלִ֣ים יְנַחֵֽם
Job 29:25 [KJV]  I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.


--- Job Chapter 30 ---
Job 30:1 [HEB]  וְעַתָּ֤ה שָֽׂחֲק֣וּ עָלַי֮ צְעִירִ֥ים מִמֶּ֗נִּי לְיָ֫מִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר מָאַ֥סְתִּי אֲבוֹתָ֑ם לָ֝שִׁ֗ית עִם כַּלְבֵ֥י צֹאנִֽי
Job 30:1 [KJV]  But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

Job 30:2 [HEB]  גַּם כֹּ֣חַ יְ֭דֵיהֶם לָ֣מָּה לִּ֑י עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ אָ֣בַד כָּֽלַח
Job 30:2 [KJV]  Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?

Job 30:3 [HEB]  בְּחֶ֥סֶר וּבְכָפָ֗ן גַּ֫לְמ֥וּד הַֽעֹרְקִ֥ים צִיָּ֑ה אֶ֝֗מֶשׁ שׁוֹאָ֥ה וּמְשֹׁאָֽה
Job 30:3 [KJV]  For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.

Job 30:4 [HEB]  הַקֹּטְפִ֣ים מַלּ֣וּחַ עֲלֵי שִׂ֑יחַ וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ רְתָמִ֣ים לַחְמָֽם
Job 30:4 [KJV]  Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.

Job 30:5 [HEB]  מִן גֵּ֥ו יְגֹרָ֑שׁוּ יָרִ֥יעוּ עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ כַּגַּנָּֽב
Job 30:5 [KJV]  They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)

Job 30:6 [HEB]  בַּעֲר֣וּץ נְחָלִ֣ים לִשְׁכֹּ֑ן חֹרֵ֖י עָפָ֣ר וְכֵפִֽים
Job 30:6 [KJV]  To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.

Job 30:7 [HEB]  בֵּין שִׂיחִ֥ים יִנְהָ֑קוּ תַּ֖חַת חָר֣וּל יְסֻפָּֽחוּ
Job 30:7 [KJV]  Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.

Job 30:8 [HEB]  בְּֽנֵי נָ֭בָל גַּם בְּנֵ֣י בְלִי שֵׁ֑ם נִ֝כְּא֗וּ מִן הָאָֽרֶץ
Job 30:8 [KJV]  They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.

Job 30:9 [HEB]  וְ֭עַתָּה נְגִינָתָ֣ם הָיִ֑יתִי וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמִלָּֽה
Job 30:9 [KJV]  And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.

Job 30:10 [HEB]  תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי רָ֣חֲקוּ מֶ֑נִּי וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י לֹא חָ֥שְׂכוּ רֹֽק
Job 30:10 [KJV]  They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.

Job 30:11 [HEB]  כִּֽי יתרו יִתְרִ֣י פִ֭תַּח וַיְעַנֵּ֑נִי וְ֝רֶ֗סֶן מִפָּנַ֥י שִׁלֵּֽחוּ
Job 30:11 [KJV]  Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.

Job 30:12 [HEB]  עַל יָמִין֮ פִּרְחַ֪ח יָ֫ק֥וּמוּ רַגְלַ֥י שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ וַיָּסֹ֥לּוּ עָ֝לַ֗י אָרְח֥וֹת אֵידָֽם
Job 30:12 [KJV]  Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

Job 30:13 [HEB]  נָתְס֗וּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י לְהַוָּתִ֥י יֹעִ֑ילוּ לֹ֖א עֹזֵ֣ר לָֽמוֹ
Job 30:13 [KJV]  They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.

Job 30:14 [HEB]  כְּפֶ֣רֶץ רָחָ֣ב יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ תַּ֥חַת שֹׁ֝אָ֗ה הִתְגַּלְגָּֽלוּ
Job 30:14 [KJV]  They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.

Job 30:15 [HEB]  הָהְפַּ֥ךְ עָלַ֗י בַּלָּ֫ה֥וֹת תִּרְדֹּ֣ף כָּ֭רוּחַ נְדִבָתִ֑י וּ֝כְעָ֗ב עָבְרָ֥ה יְשֻׁעָתִֽי
Job 30:15 [KJV]  Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.

Job 30:16 [HEB]  וְעַתָּ֗ה עָ֭לַי תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ נַפְשִׁ֑י יֹ֭אחֲז֣וּנִי יְמֵי עֹֽנִי
Job 30:16 [KJV]  And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

Job 30:17 [HEB]  לַ֗יְלָה עֲ֭צָמַי נִקַּ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְ֝עֹרְקַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁכָּבֽוּן
Job 30:17 [KJV]  My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.

Job 30:18 [HEB]  בְּרָב כֹּ֭חַ יִתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ לְבוּשִׁ֑י כְּפִ֖י כֻתָּנְתִּ֣י יַֽאַזְרֵֽנִי
Job 30:18 [KJV]  By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

Job 30:19 [HEB]  הֹרָ֥נִי לַחֹ֑מֶר וָ֝אֶתְמַשֵּׁ֗ל כֶּעָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר
Job 30:19 [KJV]  He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.

Job 30:20 [HEB]  אֲשַׁוַּ֣ע אֵ֭לֶיךָ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֵ֑נִי עָ֝מַ֗דְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּ֥נֶן בִּֽי
Job 30:20 [KJV]  I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.

Job 30:21 [HEB]  תֵּהָפֵ֣ךְ לְאַכְזָ֣ר לִ֑י בְּעֹ֖צֶם יָדְךָ֣ תִשְׂטְמֵֽנִי
Job 30:21 [KJV]  Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.

Job 30:22 [HEB]  תִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי אֶל ר֭וּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵ֑נִי וּ֝תְמֹגְגֵ֗נִי תשוה תּוּשִׁיָּֽה
Job 30:22 [KJV]  Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.

Job 30:23 [HEB]  כִּֽי יָ֭דַעְתִּי מָ֣וֶת תְּשִׁיבֵ֑נִי וּבֵ֖ית מוֹעֵ֣ד לְכָל חָֽי
Job 30:23 [KJV]  For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.

Job 30:24 [HEB]  אַ֣ךְ לֹא בְ֭עִי יִשְׁלַח יָ֑ד אִם בְּ֝פִיד֗וֹ לָהֶ֥ן שֽׁוּעַ
Job 30:24 [KJV]  Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.

Job 30:25 [HEB]  אִם לֹ֣א בָ֭כִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה י֑וֹם עָֽגְמָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י לָאֶבְיֽוֹן
Job 30:25 [KJV]  Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?

Job 30:26 [HEB]  כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב קִ֭וִּיתִי וַיָּ֣בֹא רָ֑ע וַֽאֲיַחֲלָ֥ה לְ֝א֗וֹר וַיָּ֥בֹא אֹֽפֶל
Job 30:26 [KJV]  When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.

Job 30:27 [HEB]  מֵעַ֖י רֻתְּח֥וּ וְלֹא דָ֗מּוּ קִדְּמֻ֥נִי יְמֵי עֹֽנִי
Job 30:27 [KJV]  My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.

Job 30:28 [HEB]  קֹדֵ֣ר הִ֭לַּכְתִּי בְּלֹ֣א חַמָּ֑ה קַ֖מְתִּי בַקָּהָ֣ל אֲשַׁוֵּֽעַ
Job 30:28 [KJV]  I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.

Job 30:29 [HEB]  אָ֭ח הָיִ֣יתִי לְתַנִּ֑ים וְ֝רֵ֗עַ לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה
Job 30:29 [KJV]  I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.

Job 30:30 [HEB]  ע֭וֹרִי שָׁחַ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְעַצְמִי חָ֝֗רָה מִנִּי חֹֽרֶב
Job 30:30 [KJV]  My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.

Job 30:31 [HEB]  וַיְהִ֣י לְ֭אֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִ֑י וְ֝עֻגָבִ֗י לְק֣וֹל בֹּכִֽים
Job 30:31 [KJV]  My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.


--- Job Chapter 31 ---
Job 31:1 [HEB]  בְּ֭רִית כָּרַ֣תִּי לְעֵינָ֑י וּמָ֥ה אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן עַל בְּתוּלָֽה
Job 31:1 [KJV]  I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?

Job 31:2 [HEB]  וּמֶ֤ה חֵ֣לֶק אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת שַׁ֝דַּ֗י מִמְּרֹמִֽים
Job 31:2 [KJV]  For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?

Job 31:3 [HEB]  הֲלֹא אֵ֥יד לְעַוָּ֑ל וְ֝נֵ֗כֶר לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
Job 31:3 [KJV]  Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?

Job 31:4 [HEB]  הֲלֹא ה֭וּא יִרְאֶ֣ה דְרָכָ֑י וְֽכָל צְעָדַ֥י יִסְפּֽוֹר
Job 31:4 [KJV]  Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?

Job 31:5 [HEB]  אִם הָלַ֥כְתִּי עִם שָׁ֑וְא וַתַּ֖חַשׁ עַל מִרְמָ֣ה רַגְלִֽי
Job 31:5 [KJV]  If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;

Job 31:6 [HEB]  יִשְׁקְלֵ֥נִי בְמֹאזְנֵי צֶ֑דֶק וְיֵדַ֥ע אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִֽי
Job 31:6 [KJV]  Let me be weighed in an even balance that God may know mine integrity.

Job 31:7 [HEB]  אִ֥ם תִּטֶּ֣ה אַשֻּׁרִי֮ מִנִּ֪י הַ֫דָּ֥רֶךְ וְאַחַ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי הָלַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑י וּ֝בְכַפַּ֗י דָּ֣בַק מֻאֽוּם
Job 31:7 [KJV]  If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;

Job 31:8 [HEB]  אֶ֭זְרְעָה וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל וְֽצֶאֱצָאַ֥י יְשֹׁרָֽשׁוּ
Job 31:8 [KJV]  Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.

Job 31:9 [HEB]  אִם נִפְתָּ֣ה לִ֭בִּי עַל אִשָּׁ֑ה וְעַל פֶּ֖תַח רֵעִ֣י אָרָֽבְתִּי
Job 31:9 [KJV]  If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;

Job 31:10 [HEB]  תִּטְחַ֣ן לְאַחֵ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ יִכְרְע֥וּן אֲחֵרִֽין
Job 31:10 [KJV]  Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.

Job 31:11 [HEB]  כִּי הוא הִ֥יא זִמָּ֑ה והיא וְ֝ה֗וּא עָוֺ֥ן פְּלִילִֽים
Job 31:11 [KJV]  For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

Job 31:12 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אֵ֣שׁ הִ֭יא עַד אֲבַדּ֣וֹן תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּֽבְכָל תְּב֖וּאָתִ֣י תְשָׁרֵֽשׁ
Job 31:12 [KJV]  For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.

Job 31:13 [HEB]  אִם אֶמְאַ֗ס מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַ֭בְדִּי וַאֲמָתִ֑י בְּ֝רִבָ֗ם עִמָּדִֽי
Job 31:13 [KJV]  If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;

Job 31:14 [HEB]  וּמָ֣ה אֶֽ֭עֱשֶׂה כִּֽי יָק֣וּם אֵ֑ל וְכִֽי יִ֝פְקֹ֗ד מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ
Job 31:14 [KJV]  What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?

Job 31:15 [HEB]  הֲֽ֝לֹא בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד
Job 31:15 [KJV]  Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?

Job 31:16 [HEB]  אִם אֶ֭מְנַע מֵחֵ֣פֶץ דַּלִּ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י אַלְמָנָ֣ה אֲכַלֶּֽה
Job 31:16 [KJV]  If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

Job 31:17 [HEB]  וְאֹכַ֣ל פִּתִּ֣י לְבַדִּ֑י וְלֹא אָכַ֖ל יָת֣וֹם מִמֶּֽנָּה
Job 31:17 [KJV]  Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;

Job 31:18 [HEB]  כִּ֣י מִ֭נְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַ֣נִי כְאָ֑ב וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן אִמִּ֣י אַנְחֶֽנָּה
Job 31:18 [KJV]  (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)

Job 31:19 [HEB]  אִם אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֭וֹבֵד מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָאֶבְיֽוֹן
Job 31:19 [KJV]  If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;

Job 31:20 [HEB]  אִם לֹ֣א בֵרֲכ֣וּנִי חלצו חֲלָצָ֑יו וּמִגֵּ֥ז כְּ֝בָשַׂי יִתְחַמָּֽם
Job 31:20 [KJV]  If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

Job 31:21 [HEB]  אִם הֲנִיפ֣וֹתִי עַל יָת֣וֹם יָדִ֑י כִּֽי אֶרְאֶ֥ה בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר עֶזְרָתִֽי
Job 31:21 [KJV]  If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:

Job 31:22 [HEB]  כְּ֭תֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָ֣ה תִפּ֑וֹל וְ֝אֶזְרֹעִ֗י מִקָּנָ֥ה תִשָּׁבֵֽר
Job 31:22 [KJV]  Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.

Job 31:23 [HEB]  כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד אֵ֭לַי אֵ֣יד אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִשְּׂאֵת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל
Job 31:23 [KJV]  For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.

Job 31:24 [HEB]  אִם שַׂ֣מְתִּי זָהָ֣ב כִּסְלִ֑י וְ֝לַכֶּ֗תֶם אָמַ֥רְתִּי מִבְטַחִֽי
Job 31:24 [KJV]  If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;

Job 31:25 [HEB]  אִם אֶ֭שְׂמַח כִּי רַ֣ב חֵילִ֑י וְכִֽי כַ֝בִּ֗יר מָצְאָ֥ה יָדִֽי
Job 31:25 [KJV]  If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;

Job 31:26 [HEB]  אִם אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֖וֹר כִּ֣י יָהֵ֑ל וְ֝יָרֵ֗חַ יָקָ֥ר הֹלֵֽךְ
Job 31:26 [KJV]  If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;

Job 31:27 [HEB]  וַיִּ֣פְתְּ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר לִבִּ֑י וַתִּשַּׁ֖ק יָדִ֣י לְפִֽי
Job 31:27 [KJV]  And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:

Job 31:28 [HEB]  גַּם ה֭וּא עָוֺ֣ן פְּלִילִ֑י כִּֽי כִחַ֖שְׁתִּי לָאֵ֣ל מִמָּֽעַל
Job 31:28 [KJV]  This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.

Job 31:29 [HEB]  אִם אֶ֭שְׂמַח בְּפִ֣יד מְשַׂנְאִ֑י וְ֝הִתְעֹרַ֗רְתִּי כִּֽי מְצָ֥אוֹ רָֽע
Job 31:29 [KJV]  If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:

Job 31:30 [HEB]  וְלֹא נָתַ֣תִּי לַחֲטֹ֣א חִכִּ֑י לִשְׁאֹ֖ל בְּאָלָ֣ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ
Job 31:30 [KJV]  Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.

Job 31:31 [HEB]  אִם לֹ֣א אָ֭מְרוּ מְתֵ֣י אָהֳלִ֑י מִֽי יִתֵּ֥ן מִ֝בְּשָׂר֗וֹ לֹ֣א נִשְׂבָּֽע
Job 31:31 [KJV]  If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.

Job 31:32 [HEB]  בַּ֭חוּץ לֹא יָלִ֣ין גֵּ֑ר דְּ֝לָתַ֗י לָאֹ֥רַח אֶפְתָּֽח
Job 31:32 [KJV]  The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.

Job 31:33 [HEB]  אִם כִּסִּ֣יתִי כְאָדָ֣ם פְּשָׁעָ֑י לִטְמ֖וֹן בְּחֻבִּ֣י עֲוֺֽנִי
Job 31:33 [KJV]  If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:

Job 31:34 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱר֨וֹץ הָ֘מ֤וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וּבוּז מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת יְחִתֵּ֑נִי וָ֝אֶדֹּ֗ם לֹא אֵ֥צֵא פָֽתַח
Job 31:34 [KJV]  Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?

Job 31:35 [HEB]  מִ֤י יִתֶּן לִ֨י שֹׁ֘מֵ֤עַֽ לִ֗י הֶן תָּ֭וִי שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְסֵ֥פֶר כָּ֝תַ֗ב אִ֣ישׁ רִיבִֽי
Job 31:35 [KJV]  Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.

Job 31:36 [HEB]  אִם לֹ֣א עַל שִׁ֭כְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶ֑נּוּ אֶֽעֶנְדֶ֖נּוּ עֲטָר֣וֹת לִֽי
Job 31:36 [KJV]  Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.

Job 31:37 [HEB]  מִסְפַּ֣ר צְ֭עָדַי אַגִּידֶ֑נּוּ כְּמוֹ נָ֝גִ֗יד אֲקָרֲבֶֽנּוּ
Job 31:37 [KJV]  I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.

Job 31:38 [HEB]  אִם עָ֭לַי אַדְמָתִ֣י תִזְעָ֑ק וְ֝יַ֗חַד תְּלָמֶ֥יהָ יִבְכָּיֽוּן
Job 31:38 [KJV]  If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;

Job 31:39 [HEB]  אִם כֹּ֭חָהּ אָכַ֣לְתִּי בְלִי כָ֑סֶף וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלֶ֣יהָ הִפָּֽחְתִּי
Job 31:39 [KJV]  If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:

Job 31:40 [HEB]  תַּ֤חַת חִטָּ֨ה יֵ֥צֵא ח֗וֹחַ וְתַֽחַת שְׂעֹרָ֥ה בָאְשָׁ֑ה תַּ֝֗מּוּ דִּבְרֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב
Job 31:40 [KJV]  Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.


--- Job Chapter 32 ---
Job 32:1 [HEB]  וַֽיִּשְׁבְּת֡וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ֭אֵלֶּה מֵעֲנ֣וֹת אֶת אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צַדִּ֣יק בְּעֵינָֽיו
Job 32:1 [KJV]  So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

Job 32:2 [HEB]  וַיִּ֤חַר אַ֨ף אֱלִיה֣וּא בֶן בַּרַכְאֵ֣ל הַבּוּזִי֮ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֪חַ֫ת רָ֥ם בְּ֭אִיּוֹב חָרָ֣ה אַפּ֑וֹ עַֽל צַדְּק֥וֹ נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ מֵאֱלֹהִֽים
Job 32:2 [KJV]  Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

Job 32:3 [HEB]  וּבִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעָיו֮ חָרָ֪ה אַ֫פּ֥וֹ עַ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא מָצְא֣וּ מַעֲנֶ֑ה וַ֝יַּרְשִׁ֗יעוּ אֶת אִיּֽוֹב
Job 32:3 [KJV]  Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

Job 32:4 [HEB]  וֶֽאֱלִיה֗וּ חִכָּ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב בִּדְבָרִ֑ים כִּ֤י זְֽקֵנִים הֵ֖מָּה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ לְיָמִֽים
Job 32:4 [KJV]  Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.

Job 32:5 [HEB]  וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלִיה֗וּא כִּ֘י אֵ֤ין מַעֲנֶ֗ה בְּ֭פִי שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיִּ֥חַר אַפּֽוֹ
Job 32:5 [KJV]  When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.

Job 32:6 [HEB]  וַיַּ֤עַן אֱלִיה֖וּא בֶן בַּֽרַכְאֵ֥ל הַבּוּזִ֗י וַיֹּ֫אמַ֥ר צָ֘עִ֤יר אֲנִ֣י לְ֭יָמִים וְאַתֶּ֣ם יְשִׁישִׁ֑ים עַל כֵּ֖ן זָחַ֥לְתִּי וָֽאִירָ֓א מֵחַוֺּ֖ת דֵּעִ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם
Job 32:6 [KJV]  And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.

Job 32:7 [HEB]  אָ֭מַרְתִּי יָמִ֣ים יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝נִ֗ים יֹדִ֥יעוּ חָכְמָֽה
Job 32:7 [KJV]  I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.

Job 32:8 [HEB]  אָ֭כֵן רֽוּחַ הִ֣יא בֶאֱנ֑וֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּבִינֵֽם
Job 32:8 [KJV]  But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

Job 32:9 [HEB]  לֹֽא רַבִּ֥ים יֶחְכָּ֑מוּ וּ֝זְקֵנִ֗ים יָבִ֥ינוּ מִשְׁפָּֽט
Job 32:9 [KJV]  Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.

Job 32:10 [HEB]  לָכֵ֣ן אָ֭מַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה לִּ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵּעִ֣י אַף אָֽנִי
Job 32:10 [KJV]  Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

Job 32:11 [HEB]  הֵ֤ן הוֹחַ֨לְתִּי לְֽדִבְרֵיכֶ֗ם אָ֭זִין עַד תְּב֥וּנֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם עַֽד תַּחְקְר֥וּן מִלִּֽין
Job 32:11 [KJV]  Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.

Job 32:12 [HEB]  וְעָֽדֵיכֶ֗ם אֶתְבּ֫וֹנָ֥ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵ֣ין לְאִיּ֣וֹב מוֹכִ֑יחַ עוֹנֶ֖ה אֲמָרָ֣יו מִכֶּֽם
Job 32:12 [KJV]  Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:

Job 32:13 [HEB]  פֶּן תֹּ֣֭אמְרוּ מָצָ֣אנוּ חָכְמָ֑ה אֵ֖ל יִדְּפֶ֣נּוּ לֹא אִֽישׁ
Job 32:13 [KJV]  Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.

Job 32:14 [HEB]  וְלֹא עָרַ֣ךְ אֵלַ֣י מִלִּ֑ין וּ֝בְאִמְרֵיכֶ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ
Job 32:14 [KJV]  Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.

Job 32:15 [HEB]  חַ֭תּוּ לֹא עָ֣נוּ ע֑וֹד הֶעְתִּ֖יקוּ מֵהֶ֣ם מִלִּֽים
Job 32:15 [KJV]  They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.

Job 32:16 [HEB]  וְ֭הוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ כִּ֥י עָ֝מְד֗וּ לֹא עָ֥נוּ עֽוֹד
Job 32:16 [KJV]  When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)

Job 32:17 [HEB]  אַעֲנֶ֣ה אַף אֲנִ֣י חֶלְקִ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣י אַף אָֽנִי
Job 32:17 [KJV]  I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

Job 32:18 [HEB]  כִּ֭י מָלֵ֣תִי מִלִּ֑ים הֱ֝צִיקַ֗תְנִי ר֣וּחַ בִּטְנִֽי
Job 32:18 [KJV]  For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.

Job 32:19 [HEB]  הִנֵּֽה בִטְנִ֗י כְּיַ֥יִן לֹא יִפָּתֵ֑חַ כְּאֹב֥וֹת חֲ֝דָשִׁ֗ים יִבָּקֵֽעַ
Job 32:19 [KJV]  Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.

Job 32:20 [HEB]  אֲדַבְּרָ֥ה וְיִֽרְוַֽח לִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתַ֣י וְאֶֽעֱנֶֽה
Job 32:20 [KJV]  I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.

Job 32:21 [HEB]  אַל נָ֭א אֶשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְאֶל אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲכַנֶּֽה
Job 32:21 [KJV]  Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

Job 32:22 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֲכַנֶּ֑ה כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט יִשָּׂאֵ֥נִי עֹשֵֽׂנִי
Job 32:22 [KJV]  For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.


--- Job Chapter 33 ---
Job 33:1 [HEB]  וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב מִלָּ֑י וְֽכָל דְּבָרַ֥י הַאֲזִֽינָה
Job 33:1 [KJV]  Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

Job 33:2 [HEB]  הִנֵּה נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑י דִּבְּרָ֖ה לְשׁוֹנִ֣י בְחִכִּֽי
Job 33:2 [KJV]  Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

Job 33:3 [HEB]  יֹֽשֶׁר לִבִּ֥י אֲמָרָ֑י וְדַ֥עַת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י בָּר֥וּר מִלֵּֽלוּ
Job 33:3 [KJV]  My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.

Job 33:4 [HEB]  רֽוּחַ אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְנִי וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽנִי
Job 33:4 [KJV]  The spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

Job 33:5 [HEB]  אִם תּוּכַ֥ל הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי עֶרְכָ֥ה לְ֝פָנַ֗י הִתְיַצָּֽבָה
Job 33:5 [KJV]  If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.

Job 33:6 [HEB]  הֵן אֲנִ֣י כְפִ֣יךָ לָאֵ֑ל מֵ֝חֹ֗מֶר קֹרַ֥צְתִּי גַם אָֽנִי
Job 33:6 [KJV]  Behold, I am according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay.

Job 33:7 [HEB]  הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֭מָתִי לֹ֣א תְבַעֲתֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝אַכְפִּ֗י עָלֶ֥יךָ לֹא יִכְבָּֽד
Job 33:7 [KJV]  Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.

Job 33:8 [HEB]  אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְאָזְנָ֑י וְק֖וֹל מִלִּ֣ין אֶשְׁמָֽע
Job 33:8 [KJV]  Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,

Job 33:9 [HEB]  זַ֥ךְ אֲנִ֗י בְּֽלִ֫י פָ֥שַׁע חַ֥ף אָנֹכִ֑י וְלֹ֖א עָוֺ֣ן לִֽי
Job 33:9 [KJV]  I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.

Job 33:10 [HEB]  הֵ֣ן תְּ֭נוּאוֹת עָלַ֣י יִמְצָ֑א יַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לֽוֹ
Job 33:10 [KJV]  Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,

Job 33:11 [HEB]  יָשֵׂ֣ם בַּסַּ֣ד רַגְלָ֑י יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כָּל אָרְחֹתָֽי
Job 33:11 [KJV]  He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

Job 33:12 [HEB]  הֶן זֹ֣את לֹא צָדַ֣קְתָּ אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי יִרְבֶּ֥ה אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵאֱנֽוֹשׁ
Job 33:12 [KJV]  Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.

Job 33:13 [HEB]  מַ֭דּוּעַ אֵלָ֣יו רִיב֑וֹתָ כִּ֥י כָל דְּ֝בָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַעֲנֶֽה
Job 33:13 [KJV]  Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.

Job 33:14 [HEB]  כִּֽי בְאַחַ֥ת יְדַבֶּר אֵ֑ל וּ֝בִשְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה
Job 33:14 [KJV]  For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.

Job 33:15 [HEB]  בַּחֲל֤וֹם חֶזְי֬וֹן לַ֗יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֣ל תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה עַל אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝תְנוּמ֗וֹת עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב
Job 33:15 [KJV]  In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

Job 33:16 [HEB]  אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם יַחְתֹּֽם
Job 33:16 [KJV]  Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

Job 33:17 [HEB]  לְ֭הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְגֵוָ֖ה מִגֶּ֣בֶר יְכַסֶּֽה
Job 33:17 [KJV]  That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

Job 33:18 [HEB]  יַחְשֹׂ֣ךְ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי שָׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ מֵעֲבֹ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁלַח
Job 33:18 [KJV]  He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

Job 33:19 [HEB]  וְהוּכַ֣ח בְּ֭מַכְאוֹב עַל מִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ וריב וְר֖וֹב עֲצָמָ֣יו אֵתָֽן
Job 33:19 [KJV]  He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:

Job 33:20 [HEB]  וְזִֽהֲמַ֣תּוּ חַיָּת֣וֹ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מַאֲכַ֥ל תַּאֲוָֽה
Job 33:20 [KJV]  So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.

Job 33:21 [HEB]  יִ֣כֶל בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מֵרֹ֑אִי ושפי וְשֻׁפּ֥וּ עַ֝צְמוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ
Job 33:21 [KJV]  His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

Job 33:22 [HEB]  וַתִּקְרַ֣ב לַשַּׁ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ לַֽמְמִתִֽים
Job 33:22 [KJV]  Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.

Job 33:23 [HEB]  אִם יֵ֤שׁ עָלָ֨יו מַלְאָ֗ךְ מֵלִ֗יץ אֶחָ֥ד מִנִּי אָ֑לֶף לְהַגִּ֖יד לְאָדָ֣ם יָשְׁרֽוֹ
Job 33:23 [KJV]  If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:

Job 33:24 [HEB]  וַיְחֻנֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵהוּ מֵרֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר
Job 33:24 [KJV]  Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

Job 33:25 [HEB]  רֻֽטֲפַ֣שׁ בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מִנֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽיו
Job 33:25 [KJV]  His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:

Job 33:26 [HEB]  יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל אֱל֨וֹהַּ וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ וַיַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָיו בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׁב לֶ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ צִדְקָתֽוֹ
Job 33:26 [KJV]  He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.

Job 33:27 [HEB]  יָשֹׁ֤ר עַל אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי וְיָשָׁ֥ר הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְלֹא שָׁ֥וָה לִֽי
Job 33:27 [KJV]  He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;

Job 33:28 [HEB]  פָּדָ֣ה נפשי נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מֵעֲבֹ֣ר בַּשָּׁ֑חַת וחיתי וְ֝חַיָּתוֹ בָּא֥וֹר תִּרְאֶֽה
Job 33:28 [KJV]  He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.

Job 33:29 [HEB]  הֶן כָּל אֵ֭לֶּה יִפְעַל אֵ֑ל פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁל֣וֹשׁ עִם גָּֽבֶר
Job 33:29 [KJV]  Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,

Job 33:30 [HEB]  לְהָשִׁ֣יב נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי שָׁ֑חַת לֵ֝א֗וֹר בְּא֣וֹר הַֽחַיִּים
Job 33:30 [KJV]  To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

Job 33:31 [HEB]  הַקְשֵׁ֖ב אִיּ֥וֹב שְֽׁמַֽע לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וְאָנֹכִ֥י אֲדַבֵּֽר
Job 33:31 [KJV]  Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.

Job 33:32 [HEB]  אִם יֵשׁ מִלִּ֥ין הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי דַּ֝בֵּ֗ר כִּֽי חָפַ֥צְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽךָּ
Job 33:32 [KJV]  If thou hast anything to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.

Job 33:33 [HEB]  אִם אַ֭יִן אַתָּ֥ה שְֽׁמַֽע לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ֥ חָכְמָֽה
Job 33:33 [KJV]  If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.


--- Job Chapter 34 ---
Job 34:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֥עַן אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 34:1 [KJV]  Furthermore Elihu answered and said,

Job 34:2 [HEB]  שִׁמְע֣וּ חֲכָמִ֣ים מִלָּ֑י וְ֝יֹדְעִ֗ים הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ לִֽי
Job 34:2 [KJV]  Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

Job 34:3 [HEB]  כִּי אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ יִטְעַ֥ם לֶאֱכֹֽל
Job 34:3 [KJV]  For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.

Job 34:4 [HEB]  מִשְׁפָּ֥ט נִבְחֲרָה לָּ֑נוּ נֵדְעָ֖ה בֵינֵ֣ינוּ מַה טּֽוֹב
Job 34:4 [KJV]  Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.

Job 34:5 [HEB]  כִּֽי אָ֭מַר אִיּ֣וֹב צָדַ֑קְתִּי וְ֝אֵ֗ל הֵסִ֥יר מִשְׁפָּטִֽי
Job 34:5 [KJV]  For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.

Job 34:6 [HEB]  עַל מִשְׁפָּטִ֥י אֲכַזֵּ֑ב אָנ֖וּשׁ חִצִּ֣י בְלִי פָֽשַׁע
Job 34:6 [KJV]  Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.

Job 34:7 [HEB]  מִי גֶ֥בֶר כְּאִיּ֑וֹב יִֽשְׁתֶּה לַּ֥עַג כַּמָּֽיִם
Job 34:7 [KJV]  What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?

Job 34:8 [HEB]  וְאָרַ֣ח לְ֭חֶבְרָה עִם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וְ֝לָלֶ֗כֶת עִם אַנְשֵׁי רֶֽשַׁע
Job 34:8 [KJV]  Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.

Job 34:9 [HEB]  כִּֽי אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א יִסְכָּן גָּ֑בֶר בִּ֝רְצֹת֗וֹ עִם אֱלֹהִֽים
Job 34:9 [KJV]  For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.

Job 34:10 [HEB]  לָכֵ֤ן אַ֥נֲשֵׁ֥י לֵבָ֗ב שִׁמְע֫וּ לִ֥י חָלִ֖לָה לָאֵ֥ל מֵרֶ֗שַׁע וְשַׁדַּ֥י מֵעָֽוֶל
Job 34:10 [KJV]  Therefore hearken unto me ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

Job 34:11 [HEB]  כִּ֤י פֹ֣עַל אָ֭דָם יְשַׁלֶּם ל֑וֹ וּֽכְאֹ֥רַח אִ֝֗ישׁ יַמְצִאֶֽנּוּ
Job 34:11 [KJV]  For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

Job 34:12 [HEB]  אַף אָמְנָ֗ם אֵ֥ל לֹֽא יַרְשִׁ֑יעַ וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹֽא יְעַוֵּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּֽט
Job 34:12 [KJV]  Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.

Job 34:13 [HEB]  מִֽי פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו אָ֑רְצָה וּמִ֥י שָׂ֝֗ם תֵּבֵ֥ל כֻּלָּֽהּ
Job 34:13 [KJV]  Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?

Job 34:14 [HEB]  אִם יָשִׂ֣ים אֵלָ֣יו לִבּ֑וֹ רוּח֥וֹ וְ֝נִשְׁמָת֗וֹ אֵלָ֥יו יֶאֱסֹֽף
Job 34:14 [KJV]  If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;

Job 34:15 [HEB]  יִגְוַ֣ע כָּל בָּשָׂ֣ר יָ֑חַד וְ֝אָדָ֗ם עַל עָפָ֥ר יָשֽׁוּב
Job 34:15 [KJV]  All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.

Job 34:16 [HEB]  וְאִם בִּ֥ינָה שִׁמְעָה זֹּ֑את הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְק֣וֹל מִלָּֽי
Job 34:16 [KJV]  If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.

Job 34:17 [HEB]  הַאַ֬ף שׂוֹנֵ֣א מִשְׁפָּ֣ט יַחֲב֑וֹשׁ וְאִם צַדִּ֖יק כַּבִּ֣יר תַּרְשִֽׁיעַ
Job 34:17 [KJV]  Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?

Job 34:18 [HEB]  הַאֲמֹ֣ר לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בְּלִיָּ֑עַל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע אֶל נְדִיבִֽים
Job 34:18 [KJV]  Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?

Job 34:19 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא נָשָׂ֨א פְּנֵ֥י שָׂרִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א נִכַּר שׁ֭וֹעַ לִפְנֵי דָ֑ל כִּֽי מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדָ֣יו כֻּלָּֽם
Job 34:19 [KJV]  How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.

Job 34:20 [HEB]  רֶ֤גַע יָמֻתוּ֮ וַחֲצ֪וֹת לָ֥יְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁ֣וּ עָ֣ם וְיַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְיָסִ֥ירוּ אַ֝בִּ֗יר לֹ֣א בְיָֽד
Job 34:20 [KJV]  In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.

Job 34:21 [HEB]  כִּי עֵ֭ינָיו עַל דַּרְכֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְֽכָל צְעָדָ֥יו יִרְאֶֽה
Job 34:21 [KJV]  For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.

Job 34:22 [HEB]  אֵֽין חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וְאֵ֣ין צַלְמָ֑וֶת לְהִסָּ֥תֶר שָׁ֝֗ם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
Job 34:22 [KJV]  There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

Job 34:23 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹ֣א עַל אִ֭ישׁ יָשִׂ֣ים ע֑וֹד לַהֲלֹ֥ךְ אֶל אֵ֝֗ל בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט
Job 34:23 [KJV]  For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.

Job 34:24 [HEB]  יָרֹ֣עַ כַּבִּירִ֣ים לֹא חֵ֑קֶר וַיַּעֲמֵ֖ד אֲחֵרִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם
Job 34:24 [KJV]  He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.

Job 34:25 [HEB]  לָכֵ֗ן יַ֭כִּיר מַעְבָּֽדֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָ֥פַךְ לַ֝֗יְלָה וְיִדַּכָּֽאוּ
Job 34:25 [KJV]  Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

Job 34:26 [HEB]  תַּֽחַת רְשָׁעִ֥ים סְפָקָ֗ם בִּמְק֥וֹם רֹאִֽים
Job 34:26 [KJV]  He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

Job 34:27 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל כֵּ֭ן סָ֣רוּ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֑יו וְכָל דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ
Job 34:27 [KJV]  Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:

Job 34:28 [HEB]  לְהָבִ֣יא עָ֭לָיו צַֽעֲקַת דָּ֑ל וְצַעֲקַ֖ת עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע
Job 34:28 [KJV]  So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.

Job 34:29 [HEB]  וְה֤וּא יַשְׁקִ֨ט וּמִ֥י יַרְשִׁ֗עַ וְיַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נִים וּמִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ וְעַל גּ֖וֹי וְעַל אָדָ֣ם יָֽחַד
Job 34:29 [KJV]  When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:

Job 34:30 [HEB]  מִ֭מְּלֹךְ אָדָ֥ם חָנֵ֗ף מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי עָֽם
Job 34:30 [KJV]  That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.

Job 34:31 [HEB]  כִּֽי אֶל אֵ֭ל הֶאָמַ֥ר נָשָׂ֗אתִי לֹ֣א אֶחְבֹּֽל
Job 34:31 [KJV]  Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:

Job 34:32 [HEB]  בִּלְעֲדֵ֣י אֶ֭חֱזֶה אַתָּ֣ה הֹרֵ֑נִי אִֽם עָ֥וֶל פָּ֝עַ֗לְתִּי לֹ֣א אֹסִֽיף
Job 34:32 [KJV]  That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.

Job 34:33 [HEB]  הַֽמֵעִמְּךָ֬ יְשַׁלְמֶ֨נָּה כִּֽי מָאַ֗סְתָּ כִּי אַתָּ֣ה תִבְחַ֣ר וְלֹא אָ֑נִי וּֽמַה יָדַ֥עְתָּ דַבֵּֽר
Job 34:33 [KJV]  Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.

Job 34:34 [HEB]  אַנְשֵׁ֣י לֵ֭בָב יֹ֣אמְרוּ לִ֑י וְגֶ֥בֶר חָ֝כָ֗ם שֹׁמֵ֥עַֽ לִֽי
Job 34:34 [KJV]  Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.

Job 34:35 [HEB]  אִ֭יּוֹב לֹא בְדַ֣עַת יְדַבֵּ֑ר וּ֝דְבָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א בְהַשְׂכֵּֽיל
Job 34:35 [KJV]  Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.

Job 34:36 [HEB]  אָבִ֗י יִבָּחֵ֣ן אִיּ֣וֹב עַד נֶ֑צַח עַל תְּ֝שֻׁבֹ֗ת בְּאַנְשֵׁי אָֽוֶן
Job 34:36 [KJV]  My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.

Job 34:37 [HEB]  כִּ֥י יֹ֘סִ֤יף עַֽל חַטָּאת֣וֹ פֶ֭שַׁע בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ יִסְפּ֑וֹק וְיֶ֖רֶב אֲמָרָ֣יו לָאֵֽל
Job 34:37 [KJV]  For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.


--- Job Chapter 35 ---
Job 35:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֥עַן אֱלִיה֗וּ וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 35:1 [KJV]  Elihu spake moreover, and said,

Job 35:2 [HEB]  הֲ֭זֹאת חָשַׁ֣בְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אָ֝מַ֗רְתָּ צִדְקִ֥י מֵאֵֽל
Job 35:2 [KJV]  Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God’s?

Job 35:3 [HEB]  כִּֽי תֹ֭אמַר מַה יִּסְכָּן לָ֑ךְ מָֽה אֹ֝עִ֗יל מֵֽחַטָּאתִֽי
Job 35:3 [KJV]  For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?

Job 35:4 [HEB]  אֲ֭נִי אֲשִֽׁיבְךָ֣ מִלִּ֑ין וְֽאֶת רֵעֶ֥יךָ עִמָּֽךְ
Job 35:4 [KJV]  I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.

Job 35:5 [HEB]  הַבֵּ֣ט שָׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וְשׁ֥וּר שְׁ֝חָקִ֗ים גָּבְה֥וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ
Job 35:5 [KJV]  Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.

Job 35:6 [HEB]  אִם חָ֭טָאתָ מַה תִּפְעָל בּ֑וֹ וְרַבּ֥וּ פְ֝שָׁעֶ֗יךָ מַה תַּעֲשֶׂה לּֽוֹ
Job 35:6 [KJV]  If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

Job 35:7 [HEB]  אִם צָ֭דַקְתָּ מַה תִּתֶּן ל֑וֹ א֥וֹ מַה מִיָּדְךָ֥ יִקָּֽח
Job 35:7 [KJV]  If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?

Job 35:8 [HEB]  לְאִישׁ כָּמ֥וֹךָ רִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וּלְבֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם צִדְקָתֶֽךָ
Job 35:8 [KJV]  Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.

Job 35:9 [HEB]  מֵ֭רֹב עֲשׁוּקִ֣ים יַזְעִ֑יקוּ יְשַׁוְּע֖וּ מִזְּר֣וֹעַ רַבִּֽים
Job 35:9 [KJV]  By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

Job 35:10 [HEB]  וְֽלֹא אָמַ֗ר אַ֭יֵּה אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֹשָׂ֑י נֹתֵ֖ן זְמִר֣וֹת בַּלָּֽיְלָה
Job 35:10 [KJV]  But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;

Job 35:11 [HEB]  מַ֭לְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמ֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יְחַכְּמֵֽנוּ
Job 35:11 [KJV]  Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?

Job 35:12 [HEB]  שָׁ֣ם יִ֭צְעֲקוּ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י גְּא֣וֹן רָעִֽים
Job 35:12 [KJV]  There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.

Job 35:13 [HEB]  אַךְ שָׁ֭וְא לֹא יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵ֑ל וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה
Job 35:13 [KJV]  Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

Job 35:14 [HEB]  אַ֣ף כִּֽי תֹ֭אמַר לֹ֣א תְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ דִּ֥ין לְ֝פָנָ֗יו וּתְח֥וֹלֵֽל לֽוֹ
Job 35:14 [KJV]  Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.

Job 35:15 [HEB]  וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּי אַ֭יִן פָּקַ֣ד אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא יָדַ֖ע בַּפַּ֣שׁ מְאֹֽד
Job 35:15 [KJV]  But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:

Job 35:16 [HEB]  וְ֭אִיּוֹב הֶ֣בֶל יִפְצֶה פִּ֑יהוּ בִּבְלִי דַ֝֗עַת מִלִּ֥ין יַכְבִּֽר
Job 35:16 [KJV]  Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.


--- Job Chapter 36 ---
Job 36:1 [HEB]  וַיֹּ֥סֶף אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 36:1 [KJV]  Elihu also proceeded, and said,

Job 36:2 [HEB]  כַּתַּר לִ֣י זְ֭עֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּ֑ךָּ כִּ֤י ע֖וֹד לֶאֱל֣וֹהַּ מִלִּֽים
Job 36:2 [KJV]  Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God’s behalf.

Job 36:3 [HEB]  אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִי לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּ֝לְפֹעֲלִ֗י אֶֽתֵּֽן צֶֽדֶק
Job 36:3 [KJV]  I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

Job 36:4 [HEB]  כִּֽי אָ֭מְנָם לֹא שֶׁ֣קֶר מִלָּ֑י תְּמִ֖ים דֵּע֣וֹת עִמָּֽךְ
Job 36:4 [KJV]  For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

Job 36:5 [HEB]  הֶן אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר וְלֹ֣א יִמְאָ֑ס כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב
Job 36:5 [KJV]  Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.

Job 36:6 [HEB]  לֹא יְחַיֶּ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִתֵּֽן
Job 36:6 [KJV]  He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.

Job 36:7 [HEB]  לֹֽא יִגְרַ֥ע מִצַּדִּ֗יק עֵ֫ינָ֥יו וְאֶת מְלָכִ֥ים לַכִּסֵּ֑א וַיֹּשִׁיבֵ֥ם לָ֝נֶ֗צַח וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ
Job 36:7 [KJV]  He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

Job 36:8 [HEB]  וְאִם אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּזִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּן בְּחַבְלֵי עֹֽנִי
Job 36:8 [KJV]  And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

Job 36:9 [HEB]  וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֣ם פָּעֳלָ֑ם וּ֝פִשְׁעֵיהֶ֗ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ
Job 36:9 [KJV]  Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.

Job 36:10 [HEB]  וַיִּ֣גֶל אָ֭זְנָם לַמּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי יְשֻׁב֥וּן מֵאָֽוֶן
Job 36:10 [KJV]  He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

Job 36:11 [HEB]  אִֽם יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽיַ֫עֲבֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֣ם בַּטּ֑וֹב וּ֝שְׁנֵיהֶ֗ם בַּנְּעִימִֽים
Job 36:11 [KJV]  If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

Job 36:12 [HEB]  וְאִם לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁ֣לַח יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ֝יִגְוְע֗וּ כִּבְלִי דָֽעַת
Job 36:12 [KJV]  But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

Job 36:13 [HEB]  וְֽחַנְפֵי לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽם
Job 36:13 [KJV]  But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.

Job 36:14 [HEB]  תָּמֹ֣ת בַּנֹּ֣עַר נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם בַּקְּדֵשִֽׁים
Job 36:14 [KJV]  They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

Job 36:15 [HEB]  יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְעָנְי֑וֹ וְיִ֖גֶל בַּלַּ֣חַץ אָזְנָֽם
Job 36:15 [KJV]  He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.

Job 36:16 [HEB]  וְאַ֤ף הֲסִיתְךָ֨ מִפִּי צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְנַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן
Job 36:16 [KJV]  Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.

Job 36:17 [HEB]  וְדִין רָשָׁ֥ע מָלֵ֑אתָ דִּ֖ין וּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ
Job 36:17 [KJV]  But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.

Job 36:18 [HEB]  כִּֽי חֵ֭מָה פֶּן יְסִֽיתְךָ֣ בְסָ֑פֶק וְרָב כֹּ֝֗פֶר אַל יַטֶּֽךָּ
Job 36:18 [KJV]  Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.

Job 36:19 [HEB]  הֲיַעֲרֹ֣ךְ שׁ֭וּעֲךָ לֹ֣א בְצָ֑ר וְ֝כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי כֹֽחַ
Job 36:19 [KJV]  Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

Job 36:20 [HEB]  אַל תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַלָּ֑יְלָה לַעֲל֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם
Job 36:20 [KJV]  Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

Job 36:21 [HEB]  הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי עַל זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי
Job 36:21 [KJV]  Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

Job 36:22 [HEB]  הֶן אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּכֹח֑וֹ מִ֖י כָמֹ֣הוּ מוֹרֶֽה
Job 36:22 [KJV]  Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?

Job 36:23 [HEB]  מִֽי פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִֽי אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה
Job 36:23 [KJV]  Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

Job 36:24 [HEB]  זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פָעֳל֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר שֹׁרְר֣וּ אֲנָשִֽׁים
Job 36:24 [KJV]  Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

Job 36:25 [HEB]  כָּל אָדָ֥ם חָֽזוּ ב֑וֹ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵרָחֽוֹק
Job 36:25 [KJV]  Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

Job 36:26 [HEB]  הֶן אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣יו וְלֹא חֵֽקֶר
Job 36:26 [KJV]  Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

Job 36:27 [HEB]  כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְאֵדֽוֹ
Job 36:27 [KJV]  For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

Job 36:28 [HEB]  אֲשֶֽׁר יִזְּל֥וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ עֲלֵ֤י אָדָ֬ם רָֽב
Job 36:28 [KJV]  Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.

Job 36:29 [HEB]  אַ֣ף אִם יָ֭בִין מִפְרְשֵׂי עָ֑ב תְּ֝שֻׁא֗וֹת סֻכָּתֽוֹ
Job 36:29 [KJV]  Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?

Job 36:30 [HEB]  הֵן פָּרַ֣שׂ עָלָ֣יו אוֹר֑וֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַיָּ֣ם כִּסָּֽה
Job 36:30 [KJV]  Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.

Job 36:31 [HEB]  כִּי בָ֭ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן אֹ֥כֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר
Job 36:31 [KJV]  For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.

Job 36:32 [HEB]  עַל כַּפַּ֥יִם כִּסָּה א֑וֹר וַיְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣יהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ
Job 36:32 [KJV]  With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.

Job 36:33 [HEB]  יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו רֵע֑וֹ מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל עוֹלֶֽה
Job 36:33 [KJV]  The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.


--- Job Chapter 37 ---
Job 37:1 [HEB]  אַף לְ֭זֹאת יֶחֱרַ֣ד לִבִּ֑י וְ֝יִתַּ֗ר מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ
Job 37:1 [KJV]  At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.

Job 37:2 [HEB]  שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּרֹ֣גֶז קֹל֑וֹ וְ֝הֶ֗גֶה מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא
Job 37:2 [KJV]  Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

Job 37:3 [HEB]  תַּֽחַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם יִשְׁרֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אוֹר֗וֹ עַל כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ
Job 37:3 [KJV]  He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.
