Job 37:4 [HEB]  אַחֲרָ֤יו יִשְׁאַג ק֗וֹל יַ֭רְעֵם בְּק֣וֹל גְּאוֹנ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יְ֝עַקְּבֵ֗ם כִּֽי יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹלֽוֹ
Job 37:4 [KJV]  After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.

Job 37:5 [HEB]  יַרְעֵ֤ם אֵ֣ל בְּ֭קוֹלוֹ נִפְלָא֑וֹת עֹשֶׂ֥ה גְ֝דֹל֗וֹת וְלֹ֣א נֵדָֽע
Job 37:5 [KJV]  God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

Job 37:6 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לַשֶּׁ֨לַג יֹאמַ֗ר הֱוֵ֫א אָ֥רֶץ וְגֶ֥שֶׁם מָטָ֑ר וְ֝גֶ֗שֶׁם מִטְר֥וֹת עֻזּֽוֹ
Job 37:6 [KJV]  For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.

Job 37:7 [HEB]  בְּיַד כָּל אָדָ֥ם יַחְתּ֑וֹם לָ֝דַ֗עַת כָּל אַנְשֵׁ֥י מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ
Job 37:7 [KJV]  He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.

Job 37:8 [HEB]  וַתָּבֹ֣א חַיָּ֣ה בְמוֹ אָ֑רֶב וּבִמְע֖וֹנֹתֶ֣יהָ תִשְׁכֹּֽן
Job 37:8 [KJV]  Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

Job 37:9 [HEB]  מִן הַ֭חֶדֶר תָּב֣וֹא סוּפָ֑ה וּֽמִמְּזָרִ֥ים קָרָֽה
Job 37:9 [KJV]  Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.

Job 37:10 [HEB]  מִנִּשְׁמַת אֵ֥ל יִתֶּן קָ֑רַח וְרֹ֖חַב מַ֣יִם בְּמוּצָֽק
Job 37:10 [KJV]  By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

Job 37:11 [HEB]  אַף בְּ֭רִי יַטְרִ֣יחַ עָ֑ב יָ֝פִ֗יץ עֲנַ֣ן אוֹרֽוֹ
Job 37:11 [KJV]  Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:

Job 37:12 [HEB]  וְה֤וּא מְסִבּ֨וֹת מִתְהַפֵּ֣ךְ בתחבולתו בְּתַחְבּוּלֹתָ֣יו לְפָעֳלָ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצַוֵּ֓ם עַל פְּנֵ֖י תֵבֵ֣ל אָֽרְצָה
Job 37:12 [KJV]  And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.

Job 37:13 [HEB]  אִם לְשֵׁ֥בֶט אִם לְאַרְצ֑וֹ אִם לְ֝חֶ֗סֶד יַמְצִאֵֽהוּ
Job 37:13 [KJV]  He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.

Job 37:14 [HEB]  הַאֲזִ֣ינָה זֹּ֣את אִיּ֑וֹב עֲ֝מֹ֗ד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן נִפְלְא֬וֹת אֵֽל
Job 37:14 [KJV]  Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

Job 37:15 [HEB]  הֲ֭תֵדַע בְּשׂוּם אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝הוֹפִ֗יעַ א֣וֹר עֲנָנֽוֹ
Job 37:15 [KJV]  Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?

Job 37:16 [HEB]  הֲ֭תֵדַע עַל מִפְלְשֵׂי עָ֑ב מִ֝פְלְא֗וֹת תְּמִ֣ים דֵּעִֽים
Job 37:16 [KJV]  Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?

Job 37:17 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁר בְּגָדֶ֥יךָ חַמִּ֑ים בְּהַשְׁקִ֥ט אֶ֝֗רֶץ מִדָּרֽוֹם
Job 37:17 [KJV]  How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?

Job 37:18 [HEB]  תַּרְקִ֣יעַ עִ֭מּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִ֑ים חֲ֝זָקִ֗ים כִּרְאִ֥י מוּצָֽק
Job 37:18 [KJV]  Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?

Job 37:19 [HEB]  ה֭וֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה נֹּ֣אמַר ל֑וֹ לֹ֥א נַ֝עֲרֹ֗ךְ מִפְּנֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ
Job 37:19 [KJV]  Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

Job 37:20 [HEB]  הַֽיְסֻפַּר ל֭וֹ כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אִֽם אָ֥מַר אִ֝֗ישׁ כִּ֣י יְבֻלָּֽע
Job 37:20 [KJV]  Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.

Job 37:21 [HEB]  וְעַתָּ֤ה לֹ֘א רָ֤אוּ א֗וֹר בָּהִ֣יר ה֭וּא בַּשְּׁחָקִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ עָ֝בְרָ֗ה וַֽתְּטַהֲרֵֽם
Job 37:21 [KJV]  And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

Job 37:22 [HEB]  מִ֭צָּפוֹן זָהָ֣ב יֶֽאֱתֶ֑ה עַל אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נ֣וֹרָא הֽוֹד
Job 37:22 [KJV]  Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.

Job 37:23 [HEB]  שַׁדַּ֣י לֹֽא מְ֭צָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא כֹ֑חַ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וְרֹב צְ֝דָקָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽה
Job 37:23 [KJV]  Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.

Job 37:24 [HEB]  לָ֭כֵן יְרֵא֣וּהוּ אֲנָשִׁ֑ים לֹֽא יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה כָּל חַכְמֵי לֵֽב
Job 37:24 [KJV]  Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.


--- Job Chapter 38 ---
Job 38:1 [HEB]  וַיַּֽעַן יְהוָ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב מנ הסערה מִ֥ן הַסְּעָרָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 38:1 [KJV]  Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

Job 38:2 [HEB]  מִ֤י זֶ֨ה מַחְשִׁ֖יךְ עֵצָ֥ה בְמִלִּ֗ין בְּֽלִי דָֽעַת
Job 38:2 [KJV]  Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

Job 38:3 [HEB]  אֱזָר נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ וְ֝אֶשְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי
Job 38:3 [KJV]  Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.

Job 38:4 [HEB]  אֵיפֹ֣ה הָ֭יִיתָ בְּיָסְדִי אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם יָדַ֥עְתָּ בִינָֽה
Job 38:4 [KJV]  Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.

Job 38:5 [HEB]  מִי שָׂ֣ם מְ֭מַדֶּיהָ כִּ֣י תֵדָ֑ע א֤וֹ מִֽי נָטָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יהָ קָּֽו
Job 38:5 [KJV]  Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?

Job 38:6 [HEB]  עַל מָ֭ה אֲדָנֶ֣יהָ הָטְבָּ֑עוּ א֥וֹ מִֽי יָ֝רָ֗ה אֶ֣בֶן פִּנָּתָֽהּ
Job 38:6 [KJV]  Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;

Job 38:7 [HEB]  בְּרָן יַ֭חַד כּ֣וֹכְבֵי בֹ֑קֶר וַ֝יָּרִ֗יעוּ כָּל בְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
Job 38:7 [KJV]  When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

Job 38:8 [HEB]  וַיָּ֣סֶךְ בִּדְלָתַ֣יִם יָ֑ם בְּ֝גִיח֗וֹ מֵרֶ֥חֶם יֵצֵֽא
Job 38:8 [KJV]  Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?

Job 38:9 [HEB]  בְּשׂוּמִ֣י עָנָ֣ן לְבֻשׁ֑וֹ וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל חֲתֻלָּתֽוֹ
Job 38:9 [KJV]  When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

Job 38:10 [HEB]  וָאֶשְׁבֹּ֣ר עָלָ֣יו חֻקִּ֑י וָֽ֝אָשִׂ֗ים בְּרִ֣יחַ וּדְלָתָֽיִם
Job 38:10 [KJV]  And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,

Job 38:11 [HEB]  וָאֹמַ֗ר עַד פֹּ֣ה תָ֭בוֹא וְלֹ֣א תֹסִ֑יף וּפֹ֥א יָ֝שִׁ֗ית בִּגְא֥וֹן גַּלֶּֽיךָ
Job 38:11 [KJV]  And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

Job 38:12 [HEB]  הְֽ֭מִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּ֣יתָ בֹּ֑קֶר ידעתה שחר יִדַּ֖עְתָּה הַשַּׁ֣חַר מְקֹמֽוֹ
Job 38:12 [KJV]  Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;

Job 38:13 [HEB]  לֶ֭אֱחֹז בְּכַנְפ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיִנָּעֲר֖וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִמֶּֽנָּה
Job 38:13 [KJV]  That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

Job 38:14 [HEB]  תִּ֭תְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹ֣מֶר חוֹתָ֑ם וְ֝יִֽתְיַצְּב֗וּ כְּמ֣וֹ לְבֽוּשׁ
Job 38:14 [KJV]  It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.

Job 38:15 [HEB]  וְיִמָּנַ֣ע מֵרְשָׁעִ֣ים אוֹרָ֑ם וּזְר֥וֹעַ רָ֝מָ֗ה תִּשָּׁבֵֽר
Job 38:15 [KJV]  And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.

Job 38:16 [KJV]  Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?

Job 38:17 [KJV]  Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?

Job 38:18 [KJV]  Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.

Job 38:24 [KJV]  By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?

Job 38:25 [HEB]  מִֽי פִלַּ֣ג לַשֶּׁ֣טֶף תְּעָלָ֑ה וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת
Job 38:25 [KJV]  Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

Job 38:28 [HEB]  הֲיֵשׁ לַמָּטָ֥ר אָ֑ב א֥וֹ מִי ה֝וֹלִ֗יד אֶגְלֵי טָֽל

Job 38:30 [KJV]  The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

Job 38:34 [KJV]  Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?

Job 38:39 [KJV]  Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,

Job 38:40 [KJV]  When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?

Job 38:41 [KJV]  Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.

Job 39:14 [KJV]  Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,

Job 39:16 [KJV]  She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;

Job 39:17 [KJV]  Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.

Job 39:18 [HEB]  כָּ֭עֵת בַּמָּר֣וֹם תַּמְרִ֑יא תִּֽשְׂחַ֥ק לַ֝סּ֗וּס וּלְרֹֽכְבֽוֹ
Job 39:18 [KJV]  What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.

Job 39:19 [HEB]  הֲתִתֵּ֣ן לַסּ֣וּס גְּבוּרָ֑ה הֲתַלְבִּ֖ישׁ צַוָּאר֣וֹ רַעְמָֽה
Job 39:19 [KJV]  Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?

Job 39:20 [HEB]  הְֽ֭תַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ כָּאַרְבֶּ֑ה ה֖וֹד נַחְר֣וֹ אֵימָֽה
Job 39:20 [KJV]  Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.

Job 39:21 [HEB]  יַחְפְּר֣וּ בָ֭עֵמֶק וְיָשִׂ֣ישׂ בְּכֹ֑חַ יֵ֝צֵ֗א לִקְרַאת נָֽשֶׁק
Job 39:21 [KJV]  He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.

Job 39:22 [HEB]  יִשְׂחַ֣ק לְ֭פַחַד וְלֹ֣א יֵחָ֑ת וְלֹֽא יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִפְּנֵי חָֽרֶב
Job 39:22 [KJV]  He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.

Job 39:23 [HEB]  עָ֭לָיו תִּרְנֶ֣ה אַשְׁפָּ֑ה לַ֖הַב חֲנִ֣ית וְכִידֽוֹן
Job 39:23 [KJV]  The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.

Job 39:24 [HEB]  בְּרַ֣עַשׁ וְ֭רֹגֶז יְגַמֶּא אָ֑רֶץ וְלֹֽא יַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּי ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר
Job 39:24 [KJV]  He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.

Job 39:25 [HEB]  בְּדֵ֤י שֹׁפָ֨ר יֹ֘אמַ֤ר הֶאָ֗ח וּֽ֭מֵרָחוֹק יָרִ֣יחַ מִלְחָמָ֑ה רַ֥עַם שָׂ֝רִים וּתְרוּעָֽה
Job 39:25 [KJV]  He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

Job 39:26 [HEB]  הֲֽ֭מִבִּינָ֣תְךָ יַֽאֲבֶר נֵ֑ץ יִפְרֹ֖שׂ כנפו כְּנָפָ֣יו לְתֵימָֽן
Job 39:26 [KJV]  Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?

Job 39:27 [HEB]  אִם עַל פִּ֭יךָ יַגְבִּ֣יהַּ נָ֑שֶׁר וְ֝כִ֗י יָרִ֥ים קִנּֽוֹ
Job 39:27 [KJV]  Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?

Job 39:28 [HEB]  סֶ֣לַע יִ֭שְׁכֹּן וְיִתְלֹנָ֑ן עַֽל שֶׁן סֶ֝֗לַע וּמְצוּדָֽה
Job 39:28 [KJV]  She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.

Job 39:29 [HEB]  מִשָּׁ֥ם חָֽפַר אֹ֑כֶל לְ֝מֵרָח֗וֹק עֵינָ֥יו יַבִּֽיטוּ
Job 39:29 [KJV]  From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.

Job 39:30 [HEB]  ואפרחו וְאֶפְרֹחָ֥יו יְעַלְעוּ דָ֑ם וּבַאֲשֶׁ֥ר חֲ֝לָלִ֗ים שָׁ֣ם הֽוּא
Job 39:30 [KJV]  Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.


--- Job Chapter 40 ---
Job 40:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֖עַן יְהוָ֥ה אֶת אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 40:1 [KJV]  Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,

Job 40:2 [HEB]  הֲ֭רֹב עִם שַׁדַּ֣י יִסּ֑וֹר מוֹכִ֖יחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה
Job 40:2 [KJV]  Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.

Job 40:3 [HEB]  וַיַּ֖עַן אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 40:3 [KJV]  Then Job answered the LORD, and said,

Job 40:4 [HEB]  הֵ֣ן קַ֭לֹּתִי מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֑ךָּ יָ֝דִ֗י שַׂ֣מְתִּי לְמוֹ פִֽי
Job 40:4 [KJV]  Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.

Job 40:5 [HEB]  אַחַ֣ת דִּ֭בַּרְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה וּ֝שְׁתַּ֗יִם וְלֹ֣א אוֹסִֽיף
Job 40:5 [KJV]  Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.

Job 40:6 [HEB]  וַיַּֽעַן יְהוָ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב מנ סערה מִ֥ן סְעָרָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 40:6 [KJV]  Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

Job 40:7 [HEB]  אֱזָר נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי
Job 40:7 [KJV]  Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

Job 40:8 [HEB]  הַ֭אַף תָּפֵ֣ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י תַּ֝רְשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן תִּצְדָּֽק
Job 40:8 [KJV]  Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?

Job 40:9 [HEB]  וְאִם זְר֖וֹעַ כָּאֵ֥ל לָ֑ךְ וּ֝בְק֗וֹל כָּמֹ֥הוּ תַרְעֵֽם
Job 40:9 [KJV]  Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

Job 40:10 [HEB]  עֲדֵ֥ה נָ֣א גָֽא֣וֹן וָגֹ֑בַהּ וְה֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תִּלְבָּֽשׁ
Job 40:10 [KJV]  Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.

Job 40:11 [HEB]  הָ֭פֵץ עֶבְר֣וֹת אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּרְאֵ֥ה כָל גֵּ֝אֶ֗ה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵֽהוּ
Job 40:11 [KJV]  Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.

Job 40:12 [HEB]  רְאֵ֣ה כָל גֵּ֭אֶה הַכְנִיעֵ֑הוּ וַהֲדֹ֖ךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם
Job 40:12 [KJV]  Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.

Job 40:13 [HEB]  טָמְנֵ֣ם בֶּעָפָ֣ר יָ֑חַד פְּ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם חֲבֹ֣שׁ בַּטָּמֽוּן
Job 40:13 [KJV]  Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.

Job 40:14 [HEB]  וְגַם אֲנִ֥י אוֹדֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי תוֹשִׁ֖עַ לְךָ֣ יְמִינֶֽךָ
Job 40:14 [KJV]  Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.

Job 40:15 [HEB]  הִנֵּה נָ֣א בְ֭הֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֣יתִי עִמָּ֑ךְ חָ֝צִ֗יר כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹאכֵֽל
Job 40:15 [KJV]  Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.

Job 40:16 [HEB]  הִנֵּה נָ֣א כֹח֣וֹ בְמָתְנָ֑יו וְ֝אֹנ֗וֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵ֥י בִטְנֽוֹ
Job 40:16 [KJV]  Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.

Job 40:17 [HEB]  יַחְפֹּ֣ץ זְנָב֣וֹ כְמוֹ אָ֑רֶז גִּידֵ֖י פחדו פַחֲדָ֣יו יְשֹׂרָֽגוּ
Job 40:17 [KJV]  He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.

Job 40:18 [HEB]  עֲ֭צָמָיו אֲפִיקֵ֣י נְחוּשָׁ֑ה גְּ֝רָמָ֗יו כִּמְטִ֥יל בַּרְזֶֽל
Job 40:18 [KJV]  His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.

Job 40:19 [HEB]  ה֭וּא רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכֵי אֵ֑ל הָ֝עֹשׂוֹ יַגֵּ֥שׁ חַרְבּֽוֹ
Job 40:19 [KJV]  He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.

Job 40:20 [HEB]  כִּֽי ב֭וּל הָרִ֣ים יִשְׂאוּ ל֑וֹ וְֽכָל חַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה יְשַֽׂחֲקוּ שָֽׁם
Job 40:20 [KJV]  Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.

Job 40:21 [HEB]  תַּֽחַת צֶאֱלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֑ב בְּסֵ֖תֶר קָנֶ֣ה וּבִצָּֽה
Job 40:21 [KJV]  He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.

Job 40:22 [HEB]  יְסֻכֻּ֣הוּ צֶאֱלִ֣ים צִֽלֲל֑וֹ יְ֝סֻבּ֗וּהוּ עַרְבֵי נָֽחַל
Job 40:22 [KJV]  The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.

Job 40:23 [HEB]  הֵ֤ן יַעֲשֹׁ֣ק נָ֭הָר לֹ֣א יַחְפּ֑וֹז יִבְטַ֓ח כִּֽי יָגִ֖יחַ יַרְדֵּ֣ן אֶל פִּֽיהוּ
Job 40:23 [KJV]  Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.

Job 40:24 [HEB]  בְּעֵינָ֥יו יִקָּחֶ֑נּוּ בְּ֝מֽוֹקְשִׁ֗ים יִנְקָב אָֽף
Job 40:24 [KJV]  He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.

Job 40:25 [HEB]  תִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ לִוְיָתָ֣ן בְּחַכָּ֑ה וּ֝בְחֶ֗בֶל תַּשְׁקִ֥יעַ לְשֹׁנֽוֹ
Job 40:25 [KJV]  

Job 40:26 [HEB]  הֲתָשִׂ֣ים אַגְמ֣וֹן בְּאַפּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְח֗וֹחַ תִּקּ֥וֹב לֶֽחֱיוֹ
Job 40:26 [KJV]  

Job 40:27 [HEB]  הֲיַרְבֶּ֣ה אֵ֭לֶיךָ תַּחֲנוּנִ֑ים אִם יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ רַכּֽוֹת
Job 40:27 [KJV]  

Job 40:28 [HEB]  הֲיִכְרֹ֣ת בְּרִ֣ית עִמָּ֑ךְ תִּ֝קָּחֶ֗נּוּ לְעֶ֣בֶד עוֹלָֽם
Job 40:28 [KJV]  

Job 40:29 [HEB]  הַֽתְשַׂחֶק בּ֭וֹ כַּצִּפּ֑וֹר וְ֝תִקְשְׁרֶ֗נּוּ לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ
Job 40:29 [KJV]  

Job 40:30 [HEB]  יִכְר֣וּ עָ֭לָיו חַבָּרִ֑ים יֶ֝חֱצ֗וּהוּ בֵּ֣ין כְּֽנַעֲנִֽים

Job 40:31 [KJV]

--- Job Chapter 41 ---
Job 41:1 [HEB]  הֵן תֹּחַלְתּ֥וֹ נִכְזָ֑בָה הֲגַ֖ם אֶל מַרְאָ֣יו יֻטָֽל
Job 41:1 [KJV]  Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?

Job 41:2 [HEB]  לֹֽא אַ֭כְזָר כִּ֣י יְעוּרֶ֑נּוּ וּמִ֥י ה֝֗וּא לְפָנַ֥י יִתְיַצָּֽב
Job 41:2 [KJV]  Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?

Job 41:3 [HEB]  מִ֣י הִ֭קְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם תַּ֖חַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם לִי הֽוּא
Job 41:3 [KJV]  Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?

Job 41:4 [HEB]  לא לֽוֹ אַחֲרִ֥ישׁ בַּדָּ֑יו וּדְבַר גְּ֝בוּר֗וֹת וְחִ֣ין עֶרְכּֽוֹ
Job 41:4 [KJV]  Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?

Job 41:5 [HEB]  מִֽי גִ֭לָּה פְּנֵ֣י לְבוּשׁ֑וֹ בְּכֶ֥פֶל רִ֝סְנ֗וֹ מִ֣י יָבֽוֹא
Job 41:5 [KJV]  Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

Job 41:6 [HEB]  דַּלְתֵ֣י פָ֭נָיו מִ֣י פִתֵּ֑חַ סְבִיב֖וֹת שִׁנָּ֣יו אֵימָֽה
Job 41:6 [KJV]  Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?

Job 41:7 [HEB]  גַּ֭אֲוָה אֲפִיקֵ֣י מָֽגִנִּ֑ים סָ֝ג֗וּר חוֹתָ֥ם צָֽר
Job 41:7 [KJV]  Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?

Job 41:8 [HEB]  אֶחָ֣ד בְּאֶחָ֣ד יִגַּ֑שׁוּ וְ֝ר֗וּחַ לֹא יָב֥וֹא בֵֽינֵיהֶֽם
Job 41:8 [KJV]  Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.

Job 41:9 [HEB]  אִישׁ בְּאָחִ֥יהוּ יְדֻבָּ֑קוּ יִ֝תְלַכְּד֗וּ וְלֹ֣א יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ
Job 41:9 [KJV]  Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

Job 41:10 [HEB]  עֲֽ֭טִישֹׁתָיו תָּ֣הֶל א֑וֹר וְ֝עֵינָ֗יו כְּעַפְעַפֵּי שָֽׁחַר
Job 41:10 [KJV]  None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?

Job 41:11 [HEB]  מִ֭פִּיו לַפִּידִ֣ים יַהֲלֹ֑כוּ כִּיד֥וֹדֵי אֵ֝֗שׁ יִתְמַלָּֽטוּ
Job 41:11 [KJV]  Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.

Job 41:12 [HEB]  מִ֭נְּחִירָיו יֵצֵ֣א עָשָׁ֑ן כְּד֖וּד נָפ֣וּחַ וְאַגְמֹֽן
Job 41:12 [KJV]  I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.

Job 41:13 [HEB]  נַ֭פְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִ֣ים תְּלַהֵ֑ט וְ֝לַ֗הַב מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא
Job 41:13 [KJV]  Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?

Job 41:14 [HEB]  בְּֽ֭צַוָּארוֹ יָלִ֣ין עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו תָּד֥וּץ דְּאָבָֽה
Job 41:14 [KJV]  Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.

Job 41:15 [HEB]  מַפְּלֵ֣י בְשָׂר֣וֹ דָבֵ֑קוּ יָצ֥וּק עָ֝לָ֗יו בַּל יִמּֽוֹט
Job 41:15 [KJV]  His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.

Job 41:16 [HEB]  לִ֭בּוֹ יָצ֣וּק כְּמוֹ אָ֑בֶן וְ֝יָצ֗וּק כְּפֶ֣לַח תַּחְתִּֽית
Job 41:16 [KJV]  One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

Job 41:17 [HEB]  מִ֭שֵּׂתוֹ יָג֣וּרוּ אֵלִ֑ים מִ֝שְּׁבָרִ֗ים יִתְחַטָּֽאוּ
Job 41:17 [KJV]  They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.

Job 41:18 [HEB]  מַשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ חֶ֭רֶב בְּלִ֣י תָק֑וּם חֲנִ֖ית מַסָּ֣ע וְשִׁרְיָֽה
Job 41:18 [KJV]  By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

Job 41:19 [HEB]  יַחְשֹׁ֣ב לְתֶ֣בֶן בַּרְזֶ֑ל לְעֵ֖ץ רִקָּב֣וֹן נְחוּשָֽׁה
Job 41:19 [KJV]  Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.

Job 41:20 [HEB]  לֹֽא יַבְרִיחֶ֥נּוּ בֶן קָ֑שֶׁת לְ֝קַ֗שׁ נֶהְפְּכוּ ל֥וֹ אַבְנֵי קָֽלַע
Job 41:20 [KJV]  Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.

Job 41:21 [HEB]  כְּ֭קַשׁ נֶחְשְׁב֣וּ תוֹתָ֑ח וְ֝יִשְׂחַ֗ק לְרַ֣עַשׁ כִּידֽוֹן
Job 41:21 [KJV]  His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.

Job 41:22 [HEB]  תַּ֭חְתָּיו חַדּ֣וּדֵי חָ֑רֶשׂ יִרְפַּ֖ד חָר֣וּץ עֲלֵי טִֽיט
Job 41:22 [KJV]  In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.

Job 41:23 [HEB]  יַרְתִּ֣יחַ כַּסִּ֣יר מְצוּלָ֑ה יָ֝֗ם יָשִׂ֥ים כַּמֶּרְקָחָֽה
Job 41:23 [KJV]  The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.

Job 41:24 [HEB]  אַ֭חֲרָיו יָאִ֣יר נָתִ֑יב יַחְשֹׁ֖ב תְּה֣וֹם לְשֵׂיבָֽה
Job 41:24 [KJV]  His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.

Job 41:25 [HEB]  אֵֽין עַל עָפָ֥ר מָשְׁל֑וֹ הֶ֝עָשׂ֗וּ לִבְלִי חָֽת
Job 41:25 [KJV]  When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.

Job 41:26 [HEB]  אֵֽת כָּל גָּבֹ֥הַּ יִרְאֶ֑ה ה֝֗וּא מֶ֣לֶךְ עַל כָּל בְּנֵי שָֽׁחַץ
Job 41:26 [KJV]  The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.

Job 41:27 [HEB]  
Job 41:27 [KJV]  He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.

Job 41:28 [HEB]  
Job 41:28 [KJV]  The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.

Job 41:29 [HEB]  
Job 41:29 [KJV]  Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.

Job 41:30 [HEB]  
Job 41:30 [KJV]  Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.

Job 41:31 [HEB]  
Job 41:31 [KJV]  He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.

Job 41:32 [HEB]  
Job 41:32 [KJV]  He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.

Job 41:33 [HEB]  
Job 41:33 [KJV]  Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.

Job 41:34 [HEB]  
Job 41:34 [KJV]  He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.


--- Job Chapter 42 ---
Job 42:1 [HEB]  וַיַּ֖עַן אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר
Job 42:1 [KJV]  Then Job answered the LORD, and said,

Job 42:2 [HEB]  ידעת יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּי כֹ֣ל תּוּכָ֑ל וְלֹא יִבָּצֵ֖ר מִמְּךָ֣ מְזִמָּֽה
Job 42:2 [KJV]  I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

Job 42:3 [HEB]  מִ֤י זֶ֨ה מַעְלִ֥ים עֵצָ֗ה בְּֽלִ֫י דָ֥עַת לָכֵ֣ן הִ֭גַּדְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אָבִ֑ין נִפְלָא֥וֹת מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי וְלֹ֣א אֵדָֽע
Job 42:3 [KJV]  Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

Job 42:4 [HEB]  שְֽׁמַֽע נָ֭א וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי
Job 42:4 [KJV]  Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

Job 42:5 [HEB]  לְשֵֽׁמַע אֹ֥זֶן שְׁמַעְתִּ֑יךָ וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה עֵינִ֥י רָאָֽתְךָ
Job 42:5 [KJV]  I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.

Job 42:6 [HEB]  עַל כֵּ֭ן אֶמְאַ֣ס וְנִחַ֑מְתִּי עַל עָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר
Job 42:6 [KJV]  Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.

Job 42:7 [HEB]  וַיְהִ֗י אַחַ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל אִיּ֑וֹב וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל אֱלִיפַ֣ז הַתֵּֽימָנִ֗י חָרָ֨ה אַפִּ֤י בְךָ֙ וּבִשְׁנֵ֣י רֵעֶ֔יךָ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א דִבַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֛י נְכוֹנָ֖ה כְּעַבְדִּ֥י אִיּֽוֹב
Job 42:7 [KJV]  And it was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.

Job 42:8 [HEB]  וְעַתָּ֡ה קְחֽוּ לָכֶ֣ם שִׁבְעָֽה פָרִים֩ וְשִׁבְעָ֨ה אֵילִ֜ים וּלְכ֣וּ אֶל עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּ֗וֹב וְהַעֲלִיתֶ֤ם עוֹלָה֙ בַּֽעַדְכֶ֔ם וְאִיּ֣וֹב עַבְדִּ֔י יִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֧י אִם פָּנָ֣יו אֶשָּׂ֗א לְבִלְתִּ֞י עֲשׂ֤וֹת עִמָּכֶם֙ נְבָלָ֔ה כִּ֠י לֹ֣א דִבַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֛י נְכוֹנָ֖ה כְּעַבְדִּ֥י אִיּֽוֹב
Job 42:8 [KJV]  Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.

Job 42:9 [HEB]  וַיֵּלְכוּ֩ אֱלִיפַ֨ז הַתֵּֽימָנִ֜י וּבִלְדַּ֣ד הַשּׁוּחִ֗י צֹפַר֙ הַנַּ֣עֲמָתִ֔י וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּשָּׂ֥א יְהוָ֖ה אֶת פְּנֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב
Job 42:9 [KJV]  So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job.

Job 42:10 [HEB]  וַֽיהוָ֗ה שָׁ֚ב אֶת שבית שְׁב֣וּת אִיּ֔וֹב בְּהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וֹ בְּעַ֣ד רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַ֧יֹּסֶף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאִיּ֖וֹב לְמִשְׁנֶֽה
Job 42:10 [KJV]  And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

Job 42:11 [HEB]  וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אֵ֠לָיו כָּל אֶחָ֨יו וְכָל אחיתיו אַחְיוֹתָ֜יו וְכָל יֹדְעָ֣יו לְפָנִ֗ים וַיֹּאכְל֨וּ עִמּ֣וֹ לֶחֶם֮ בְּבֵיתוֹ֒ וַיָּנֻ֤דוּ לוֹ֙ וַיְנַחֲמ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ עַ֚ל כָּל הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הֵבִ֥יא יְהוָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו וַיִּתְּנוּ ל֗וֹ אִ֚ישׁ קְשִׂיטָ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְאִ֕ישׁ נֶ֥זֶם זָהָ֖ב אֶחָֽד
Job 42:11 [KJV]  Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.

Job 42:12 [HEB]  וַֽיהוָ֗ה בֵּרַ֛ךְ אֶת אַחֲרִ֥ית אִיּ֖וֹב מֵרֵאשִׁת֑וֹ וַֽיְהִי ל֡וֹ אַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר אֶ֜לֶף צֹ֗אן וְשֵׁ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ גְּמַלִּ֔ים וְאֶֽלֶף צֶ֥מֶד בָּקָ֖ר וְאֶ֥לֶף אֲתוֹנֽוֹת
Job 42:12 [KJV]  So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

Job 42:13 [HEB]  וַֽיְהִי ל֛וֹ שִׁבְעָ֥נָה בָנִ֖ים וְשָׁל֥וֹשׁ בָּנֽוֹת
Job 42:13 [KJV]  He had also seven sons and three daughters.

Job 42:14 [HEB]  וַיִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם הָֽאַחַת֙ יְמִימָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית קְצִיעָ֑ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖ית קֶ֥רֶן הַפּֽוּךְ
Job 42:14 [KJV]  And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Kerenhappuch.

Job 42:15 [HEB]  וְלֹ֨א נִמְצָ֜א נָשִׁ֥ים יָפ֛וֹת כִּבְנ֥וֹת אִיּ֖וֹב בְּכָל הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֧ם אֲבִיהֶ֛ם נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶֽם
Job 42:15 [KJV]  And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

Job 42:16 [HEB]  וַיְחִ֤י אִיּוֹב֙ אַֽחֲרֵי זֹ֔את מֵאָ֥ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וירא וַיִּרְאֶ֗ה אֶת בָּנָיו֙ וְאֶת בְּנֵ֣י בָנָ֔יו אַרְבָּעָ֖ה דֹּרֽוֹת
Job 42:16 [KJV]  After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, even four generations.

Job 42:17 [HEB]  וַיָּ֣מָת אִיּ֔וֹב זָקֵ֖ן וּשְׂבַ֥ע יָמִֽים
Job 42:17 [KJV]  So Job died, being old and full of days.

--- Psalms Chapter 1 ---
Psalms 1:1 [HEB]  אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב
Psalms 1:1 [KJV]  Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

Psalms 1:2 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אִ֥ם בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה
Psalms 1:2 [KJV]  But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

Psalms 1:3 [HEB]  וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ
Psalms 1:3 [KJV]  And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

Psalms 1:4 [HEB]  לֹא כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲֽשֶׁר תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ
Psalms 1:4 [KJV]  The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

Psalms 1:5 [HEB]  עַל כֵּ֤ן לֹא יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים
Psalms 1:5 [KJV]  Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

Psalms 1:6 [HEB]  כִּֽי יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד
Psalms 1:6 [KJV]  For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.


--- Psalms Chapter 2 ---
Psalms 2:1 [HEB]  לָ֭מָּה רָגְשׁ֣וּ גוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים יֶהְגּוּ רִֽיק
Psalms 2:1 [KJV]  Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

Psalms 2:2 [HEB]  יִ֥תְיַצְּב֨וּ מַלְכֵי אֶ֗רֶץ וְרוֹזְנִ֥ים נֽוֹסְדוּ יָ֑חַד עַל יְ֝הוָה וְעַל מְשִׁיחֽוֹ
Psalms 2:2 [KJV]  The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,

Psalms 2:3 [HEB]  נְֽ֭נַתְּקָה אֶת מֽוֹסְרוֹתֵ֑ימוֹ וְנַשְׁלִ֖יכָה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ עֲבֹתֵֽימוֹ
Psalms 2:3 [KJV]  Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

Psalms 2:4 [HEB]  יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׂחָ֑ק אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י יִלְעַג לָֽמוֹ
Psalms 2:4 [KJV]  He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the LORD shall have them in derision.

Psalms 2:5 [HEB]  אָ֤ז יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֣ימוֹ בְאַפּ֑וֹ וּֽבַחֲרוֹנ֥וֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽמוֹ
Psalms 2:5 [KJV]  Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

Psalms 2:6 [HEB]  וַ֭אֲנִי נָסַ֣כְתִּי מַלְכִּ֑י עַל צִ֝יּ֗וֹן הַר קָדְשִֽׁי
Psalms 2:6 [KJV]  Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

Psalms 2:7 [HEB]  אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה אֶֽ֫ל חֹ֥ק יְֽהוָ֗ה אָמַ֘ר אֵלַ֥י בְּנִ֥י אַ֑תָּה אֲ֝נִ֗י הַיּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽיךָ
Psalms 2:7 [KJV]  I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

Psalms 2:8 [HEB]  שְׁאַ֤ל מִמֶּ֗נִּי וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה ג֭וֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וַ֝אֲחֻזָּתְךָ֗ אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ
Psalms 2:8 [KJV]  Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

Psalms 2:9 [HEB]  תְּ֭רֹעֵם בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט בַּרְזֶ֑ל כִּכְלִ֖י יוֹצֵ֣ר תְּנַפְּצֵֽם
Psalms 2:9 [KJV]  Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

Psalms 2:10 [HEB]  וְ֭עַתָּה מְלָכִ֣ים הַשְׂכִּ֑ילוּ הִ֝וָּסְר֗וּ שֹׁ֣פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ
Psalms 2:10 [KJV]  Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

Psalms 2:11 [HEB]  עִבְד֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה בְּיִרְאָ֑ה וְ֝גִ֗ילוּ בִּרְעָדָֽה
Psalms 2:11 [KJV]  Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

Psalms 2:12 [HEB]  נַשְּׁקוּ בַ֡ר פֶּן יֶאֱנַ֤ף וְתֹ֬אבְדוּ דֶ֗רֶךְ כִּֽי יִבְעַ֣ר כִּמְעַ֣ט אַפּ֑וֹ אַ֝שְׁרֵ֗י כָּל ח֥וֹסֵי בֽוֹ
Psalms 2:12 [KJV]  Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.


--- Psalms Chapter 3 ---
Psalms 3:1 [HEB]  מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בְּ֝בָרְח֗וֹ מִפְּנֵ֤י אַבְשָׁל֬וֹם בְּנֽוֹ
Psalms 3:1 [KJV]  Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.

Psalms 3:2 [HEB]  יְ֭הוָה מָֽה רַבּ֣וּ צָרָ֑י רַ֝בִּ֗ים קָמִ֥ים עָלָֽי
Psalms 3:2 [KJV]  Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.

Psalms 3:3 [HEB]  רַבִּים֮ אֹמְרִ֪ים לְנַ֫פְשִׁ֥י אֵ֤ין יְֽשׁוּעָ֓תָה לּ֬וֹ בֵֽאלֹהִ֬ים סֶֽלָה
Psalms 3:3 [KJV]  But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

Psalms 3:4 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה מָגֵ֣ן בַּעֲדִ֑י כְּ֝בוֹדִ֗י וּמֵרִ֥ים רֹאשִֽׁי
Psalms 3:4 [KJV]  I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

Psalms 3:5 [HEB]  ק֭וֹלִי אֶל יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּֽעֲנֵ֨נִי מֵהַ֖ר קָדְשׁ֣וֹ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 3:5 [KJV]  I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

Psalms 3:6 [HEB]  אֲנִ֥י שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וָֽאִ֫ישָׁ֥נָה הֱקִיצ֑וֹתִי כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה יִסְמְכֵֽנִי
Psalms 3:6 [KJV]  I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

Psalms 3:7 [HEB]  לֹֽא אִ֭ירָא מֵרִבְב֥וֹת עָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סָ֝בִ֗יב שָׁ֣תוּ עָלָֽי
Psalms 3:7 [KJV]  Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

Psalms 3:8 [HEB]  ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה הוֹשִׁ֘יעֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהַ֗י כִּֽי הִכִּ֣יתָ אֶת כָּל אֹיְבַ֣י לֶ֑חִי שִׁנֵּ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ
Psalms 3:8 [KJV]  Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

Psalms 3:9 [HEB]  לַיהוָ֥ה הַיְשׁוּעָ֑ה עַֽל עַמְּךָ֖ בִרְכָתֶ֣ךָ סֶּֽלָה
Psalms 3:9 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 4 ---
Psalms 4:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינ֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 4:1 [KJV]  Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

Psalms 4:2 [HEB]  בְּקָרְאִ֡י עֲנֵ֤נִי אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צִדְקִ֗י בַּ֭צָּר הִרְחַ֣בְתָּ לִּ֑י חָ֝נֵּ֗נִי וּשְׁמַ֥ע תְּפִלָּתִֽי
Psalms 4:2 [KJV]  O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

Psalms 4:3 [HEB]  בְּנֵ֥י אִ֡ישׁ עַד מֶ֬ה כְבוֹדִ֣י לִ֭כְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָב֣וּן רִ֑יק תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ כָזָ֣ב סֶֽלָה
Psalms 4:3 [KJV]  But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.

Psalms 4:4 [HEB]  וּדְע֗וּ כִּֽי הִפְלָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חָסִ֣יד ל֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע בְּקָרְאִ֥י אֵלָֽיו
Psalms 4:4 [KJV]  Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

Psalms 4:5 [HEB]  רִגְז֗וּ וְֽאַל תֶּ֫חֱטָ֥אוּ אִמְר֣וּ בִ֭לְבַבְכֶם עַֽל מִשְׁכַּבְכֶ֗ם וְדֹ֣מּוּ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 4:5 [KJV]  Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.

Psalms 4:6 [HEB]  זִבְח֥וּ זִבְחֵי צֶ֑דֶק וּ֝בִטְח֗וּ אֶל יְהוָֽה
Psalms 4:6 [KJV]  There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

Psalms 4:7 [HEB]  רַבִּ֥ים אֹמְרִים֮ מִֽי יַרְאֵ֪נ֫וּ ט֥וֹב נְֽסָה עָ֭לֵינוּ א֨וֹר פָּנֶ֬יךָ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 4:7 [KJV]  Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

Psalms 4:8 [HEB]  נָתַ֣תָּה שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְלִבִּ֑י מֵעֵ֬ת דְּגָנָ֖ם וְתִֽירוֹשָׁ֣ם רָֽבּוּ
Psalms 4:8 [KJV]  I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

Psalms 4:9 [HEB]  בְּשָׁל֣וֹם יַחְדָּו֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה וְאִ֫ישָׁ֥ן כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה לְבָדָ֑ד לָ֝בֶ֗טַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵֽנִי
Psalms 4:9 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 5 ---
Psalms 5:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶֽל הַנְּחִיל֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 5:1 [KJV]  Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

Psalms 5:2 [HEB]  אֲמָרַ֖י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה יְהוָ֗ה בִּ֣ינָה הֲגִֽיגִי
Psalms 5:2 [KJV]  Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

Psalms 5:3 [HEB]  הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה לְק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗י מַלְכִּ֥י וֵאלֹהָ֑י כִּֽי אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל
Psalms 5:3 [KJV]  My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

Psalms 5:4 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה בֹּ֭קֶר תִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶֽעֱרָךְ לְ֝ךָ֗ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה
Psalms 5:4 [KJV]  For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

Psalms 5:5 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹ֤א אֵֽל חָפֵ֘ץ רֶ֥שַׁע אָ֑תָּה לֹ֖א יְגֻרְךָ֣ רָֽע
Psalms 5:5 [KJV]  The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

Psalms 5:6 [HEB]  לֹֽא יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ הֽ֭וֹלְלִים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
Psalms 5:6 [KJV]  Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

Psalms 5:7 [HEB]  תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֪י כָ֫זָ֥ב אִישׁ דָּמִ֥ים וּמִרְמָ֗ה יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב יְהוָֽה
Psalms 5:7 [KJV]  But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

Psalms 5:8 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֗י בְּרֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּךָ אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑ךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל הֵֽיכַל קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 5:8 [KJV]  Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

Psalms 5:9 [HEB]  יְהוָ֤ה נְחֵ֬נִי בְצִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑י הושר הַיְשַׁ֖ר לְפָנַ֣י דַּרְכֶּֽךָ
Psalms 5:9 [KJV]  For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

Psalms 5:10 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אֵ֪ין בְּפִ֡יהוּ נְכוֹנָה֮ קִרְבָּ֪ם הַ֫וּ֥וֹת קֶֽבֶר פָּת֥וּחַ גְּרוֹנָ֑ם לְ֝שׁוֹנָ֗ם יַחֲלִֽיקוּן
Psalms 5:10 [KJV]  Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

Psalms 5:11 [HEB]  הַֽאֲשִׁימֵ֨ם אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽמֹּעֲצ֪וֹתֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּרֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵ֑מוֹ כִּי מָ֥רוּ בָֽךְ
Psalms 5:11 [KJV]  But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

Psalms 5:12 [HEB]  וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל ח֪וֹסֵי בָ֡ךְ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְ֭רַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ימוֹ וְֽיַעְלְצ֥וּ בְ֝ךָ֗ אֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ
Psalms 5:12 [KJV]  For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

Psalms 5:13 [HEB]  כִּֽי אַתָּה֮ תְּבָרֵ֪ךְ צַ֫דִּ֥יק יְהוָ֑ה כַּ֝צִּנָּ֗ה רָצ֥וֹן תַּעְטְרֶֽנּוּ
Psalms 5:13 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 6 ---
Psalms 6:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ בִּ֭נְגִינוֹת עַֽל הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 6:1 [KJV]  O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

Psalms 6:2 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל בְּאַפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וְֽאַל בַּחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי
Psalms 6:2 [KJV]  Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

Psalms 6:3 [HEB]  חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י אֻמְלַ֫ל אָ֥נִי רְפָאֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י נִבְהֲל֣וּ עֲצָמָֽי
Psalms 6:3 [KJV]  My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?

Psalms 6:4 [HEB]  וְ֭נַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד ואת וְאַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַד מָתָֽי
Psalms 6:4 [KJV]  Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.

Psalms 6:5 [HEB]  שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ
Psalms 6:5 [KJV]  For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

Psalms 6:6 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין בַּמָּ֣וֶת זִכְרֶ֑ךָ בִּ֝שְׁא֗וֹל מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה לָּֽךְ
Psalms 6:6 [KJV]  I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

Psalms 6:7 [HEB]  יָגַ֤עְתִּי בְּֽאַנְחָתִ֗י אַשְׂחֶ֣ה בְכָל לַ֭יְלָה מִטָּתִ֑י בְּ֝דִמְעָתִ֗י עַרְשִׂ֥י אַמְסֶֽה
Psalms 6:7 [KJV]  Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

Psalms 6:8 [HEB]  עָֽשְׁשָׁ֣ה מִכַּ֣עַס עֵינִ֑י עָֽ֝תְקָ֗ה בְּכָל צוֹרְרָֽי
Psalms 6:8 [KJV]  Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

Psalms 6:9 [HEB]  ס֣וּרוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי כָּל פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי שָׁמַ֥ע יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בִּכְיִֽי
Psalms 6:9 [KJV]  The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

Psalms 6:10 [HEB]  שָׁמַ֣ע יְ֭הוָה תְּחִנָּתִ֑י יְ֝הוָ֗ה תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י יִקָּֽח
Psalms 6:10 [KJV]  Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

Psalms 6:11 [HEB]  יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲל֣וּ מְ֭אֹד כָּל אֹיְבָ֑י יָ֝שֻׁ֗בוּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רָֽגַע
Psalms 6:11 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 7 ---
Psalms 7:1 [HEB]  שִׁגָּי֗וֹן לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֥ר לַיהוָ֑ה עַל דִּבְרֵי כ֝֗וּשׁ בֶּן יְמִינִֽי
Psalms 7:1 [KJV]  O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

Psalms 7:2 [HEB]  יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּךָ֣ חָסִ֑יתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי מִכָּל רֹ֝דְפַ֗י וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי
Psalms 7:2 [KJV]  Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

Psalms 7:3 [HEB]  פֶּן יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל
Psalms 7:3 [KJV]  O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

Psalms 7:4 [HEB]  יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי אִם עָשִׂ֣יתִי זֹ֑את אִֽם יֶשׁ עָ֥וֶל בְּכַפָּֽי
Psalms 7:4 [KJV]  If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

Psalms 7:5 [HEB]  אִם גָּ֭מַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִ֥י רָ֑ע וָאֲחַלְּצָ֖ה צוֹרְרִ֣י רֵיקָֽם
Psalms 7:5 [KJV]  Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

Psalms 7:6 [HEB]  יִֽרַדֹּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֨ב נַפְשִׁ֡י וְיַשֵּׂ֗ג וְיִרְמֹ֣ס לָאָ֣רֶץ חַיָּ֑י וּכְבוֹדִ֓י לֶעָפָ֖ר יַשְׁכֵּ֣ן סֶֽלָה
Psalms 7:6 [KJV]  Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

Psalms 7:7 [HEB]  ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ הִ֭נָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְר֣וֹת צוֹרְרָ֑י וְע֥וּרָה אֵ֝לַ֗י מִשְׁפָּ֥ט צִוִּֽיתָ
Psalms 7:7 [KJV]  So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

Psalms 7:8 [HEB]  וַעֲדַ֣ת לְ֭אֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ לַמָּר֥וֹם שֽׁוּבָה
Psalms 7:8 [KJV]  The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

Psalms 7:9 [HEB]  יְהוָה֮ יָדִ֪ין עַ֫מִּ֥ים שָׁפְטֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כְּצִדְקִ֖י וּכְתֻמִּ֣י עָלָֽי
Psalms 7:9 [KJV]  Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

Psalms 7:10 [HEB]  יִגְמָר נָ֬א רַ֨ע רְשָׁעִים֮ וּתְכוֹנֵ֪ן צַ֫דִּ֥יק וּבֹחֵ֣ן לִ֭בּ֗וֹת וּכְלָי֗וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים צַדִּֽיק
Psalms 7:10 [KJV]  My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

Psalms 7:11 [HEB]  מָֽגִנִּ֥י עַל אֱלֹהִ֑ים מ֝וֹשִׁ֗יעַ יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
Psalms 7:11 [KJV]  God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

Psalms 7:12 [HEB]  אֱ֭לֹהִים שׁוֹפֵ֣ט צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝אֵ֗ל זֹעֵ֥ם בְּכָל יֽוֹם
Psalms 7:12 [KJV]  If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

Psalms 7:13 [HEB]  אִם לֹ֣א יָ֭שׁוּב חַרְבּ֣וֹ יִלְט֑וֹשׁ קַשְׁתּ֥וֹ דָ֝רַ֗ךְ וַֽיְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ
Psalms 7:13 [KJV]  He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

Psalms 7:14 [HEB]  וְ֭לוֹ הֵכִ֣ין כְּלֵי מָ֑וֶת חִ֝צָּ֗יו לְֽדֹלְקִ֥ים יִפְעָֽל
Psalms 7:14 [KJV]  Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

Psalms 7:15 [HEB]  הִנֵּ֥ה יְחַבֶּל אָ֑וֶן וְהָרָ֥ה עָ֝מָ֗ל וְיָ֣לַד שָֽׁקֶר
Psalms 7:15 [KJV]  He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

Psalms 7:16 [HEB]  בּ֣וֹר כָּ֭רָֽה וַֽיַּחְפְּרֵ֑הוּ וַ֝יִּפֹּ֗ל בְּשַׁ֣חַת יִפְעָֽל
Psalms 7:16 [KJV]  His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

Psalms 7:17 [HEB]  יָשׁ֣וּב עֲמָל֣וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְעַ֥ל קָ֝דְקֳד֗וֹ חֲמָס֥וֹ יֵרֵֽד
Psalms 7:17 [KJV]  I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

Psalms 7:18 [HEB]  אוֹדֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְק֑וֹ וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה שֵֽׁם יְהוָ֥ה עֶלְיֽוֹן
Psalms 7:18 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 8 ---
Psalms 8:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל הַגִּתִּ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 8:1 [KJV]  O LORD, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

Psalms 8:2 [HEB]  יְהוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מָֽה אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥ה ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ עַל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם
Psalms 8:2 [KJV]  Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

Psalms 8:3 [HEB]  מִפִּ֤י עֽוֹלְלִ֨ים וְֽיֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֪דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם
Psalms 8:3 [KJV]  When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

Psalms 8:4 [HEB]  כִּֽי אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה
Psalms 8:4 [KJV]  What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

Psalms 8:5 [HEB]  מָֽה אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי תִזְכְּרֶ֑נּוּ וּבֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם כִּ֣י תִפְקְדֶֽנּוּ
Psalms 8:5 [KJV]  For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

Psalms 8:6 [HEB]  וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ
Psalms 8:6 [KJV]  Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:

Psalms 8:7 [HEB]  תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת רַגְלָֽיו
Psalms 8:7 [KJV]  All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

Psalms 8:8 [HEB]  צֹנֶ֣ה וַאֲלָפִ֣ים כֻּלָּ֑ם וְ֝גַ֗ם בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדָֽי
Psalms 8:8 [KJV]  The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

Psalms 8:9 [HEB]  צִפּ֣וֹר שָׁ֭מַיִם וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם עֹ֝בֵ֗ר אָרְח֥וֹת יַמִּֽים
Psalms 8:9 [KJV]  O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

Psalms 8:10 [HEB]  יְהוָ֥ה אֲדֹנֵ֑ינוּ מָֽה אַדִּ֥יר שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ בְּכָל הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 8:10 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 9 ---
Psalms 9:1 [HEB]  לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַלְמ֥וּת לַבֵּ֗ן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 9:1 [KJV]  I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

Psalms 9:2 [HEB]  אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל לִבִּ֑י אֲ֝סַפְּרָ֗ה כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 9:2 [KJV]  I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

Psalms 9:3 [HEB]  אֶשְׂמְחָ֣ה וְאֶעֶלְצָ֣ה בָ֑ךְ אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן
Psalms 9:3 [KJV]  When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

Psalms 9:4 [HEB]  בְּשׁוּב אוֹיְבַ֥י אָח֑וֹר יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ וְ֝יֹאבְד֗וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ
Psalms 9:4 [KJV]  For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

Psalms 9:5 [HEB]  כִּֽי עָ֭שִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י וְדִינִ֑י יָשַׁ֥בְתָּ לְ֝כִסֵּ֗א שׁוֹפֵ֥ט צֶֽדֶק
Psalms 9:5 [KJV]  Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

Psalms 9:6 [HEB]  גָּעַ֣רְתָּ ג֭וֹיִם אִבַּ֣דְתָּ רָשָׁ֑ע שְׁמָ֥ם מָ֝חִ֗יתָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד
Psalms 9:6 [KJV]  O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

Psalms 9:7 [HEB]  הָֽאוֹיֵ֨ב תַּ֥מּוּ חֳרָב֗וֹת לָ֫נֶ֥צַח וְעָרִ֥ים נָתַ֑שְׁתָּ אָבַ֖ד זִכְרָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה
Psalms 9:7 [KJV]  But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

Psalms 9:8 [HEB]  וַֽ֭יהוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם יֵשֵׁ֑ב כּוֹנֵ֖ן לַמִּשְׁפָּ֣ט כִּסְאֽוֹ
Psalms 9:8 [KJV]  And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

Psalms 9:9 [HEB]  וְה֗וּא יִשְׁפֹּֽט תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק יָדִ֥ין לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים
Psalms 9:9 [KJV]  The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

Psalms 9:10 [HEB]  וִ֘יהִ֤י יְהוָ֣ה מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַדָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה
Psalms 9:10 [KJV]  And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

Psalms 9:11 [HEB]  וְיִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭ךָ יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 9:11 [KJV]  Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

Psalms 9:12 [HEB]  זַמְּר֗וּ לַ֭יהוָה יֹשֵׁ֣ב צִיּ֑וֹן הַגִּ֥ידוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִֽילוֹתָֽיו
Psalms 9:12 [KJV]  When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

Psalms 9:13 [HEB]  כִּֽי דֹרֵ֣שׁ דָּ֭מִים אוֹתָ֣ם זָכָ֑ר לֹֽא שָׁ֝כַ֗ח צַעֲקַ֥ת עניים עֲנָוִֽים
Psalms 9:13 [KJV]  Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

Psalms 9:14 [HEB]  חָֽנְנֵ֬נִי יְהוָ֗ה רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָ֑י מְ֝רוֹמְמִ֗י מִשַּׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת
Psalms 9:14 [KJV]  That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

Psalms 9:15 [HEB]  לְמַ֥עַן אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה כָּֽל תְּהִלָּ֫תֶ֥יךָ בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵ֥י בַת צִיּ֑וֹן אָ֝גִ֗ילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 9:15 [KJV]  The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

Psalms 9:16 [HEB]  טָבְע֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם בְּשַׁ֣חַת עָשׂ֑וּ בְּרֶֽשֶׁת ז֥וּ טָ֝מָ֗נוּ נִלְכְּדָ֥ה רַגְלָֽם
Psalms 9:16 [KJV]  The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

Psalms 9:17 [HEB]  נ֤וֹדַ֨ע יְהוָה֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בְּפֹ֣עַל כַּ֭פָּיו נוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָשָׁ֑ע הִגָּי֥וֹן סֶֽלָה
Psalms 9:17 [KJV]  The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

Psalms 9:18 [HEB]  יָשׁ֣וּבוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לִשְׁא֑וֹלָה כָּל גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם שְׁכֵחֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 9:18 [KJV]  For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

Psalms 9:19 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לָ֭נֶצַח יִשָּׁכַ֣ח אֶבְי֑וֹן תִּקְוַ֥ת ענוים עֲ֝נִיִּ֗ים תֹּאבַ֥ד לָעַֽד
Psalms 9:19 [KJV]  Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

Psalms 9:20 [HEB]  קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל יָעֹ֣ז אֱנ֑וֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְט֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם עַל פָּנֶֽיךָ
Psalms 9:20 [KJV]  Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

Psalms 9:21 [HEB]  שִׁ֘יתָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה מוֹרָ֗ה לָ֫הֶ֥ם יֵדְע֥וּ גוֹיִ֑ם אֱנ֖וֹשׁ הֵ֣מָּה סֶּֽלָה
Psalms 9:21 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 10 ---
Psalms 10:1 [HEB]  לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּרָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה
Psalms 10:1 [KJV]  Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

Psalms 10:2 [HEB]  בְּגַאֲוַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע יִדְלַ֣ק עָנִ֑י יִתָּפְשׂ֓וּ בִּמְזִמּ֖וֹת ז֣וּ חָשָֽׁבוּ
Psalms 10:2 [KJV]  The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

Psalms 10:3 [HEB]  כִּֽי הִלֵּ֣ל רָ֭שָׁע עַל תַּאֲוַ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֹצֵ֥עַ בֵּ֝רֵ֗ךְ נִ֘אֵ֥ץ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 10:3 [KJV]  For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.

Psalms 10:4 [HEB]  רָשָׁ֗ע כְּגֹ֣בַהּ אַ֭פּוֹ בַּל יִדְרֹ֑שׁ אֵ֥ין אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים כָּל מְזִמּוֹתָֽיו
Psalms 10:4 [KJV]  The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

Psalms 10:5 [HEB]  יָ֘חִ֤ילוּ דרכו דְרָכָ֨יו בְּכָל עֵ֗ת מָר֣וֹם מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּ֑וֹ כָּל צ֝וֹרְרָ֗יו יָפִ֥יחַ בָּהֶֽם
Psalms 10:5 [KJV]  His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

Psalms 10:6 [HEB]  אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ בַּל אֶמּ֑וֹט לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא בְרָֽע
Psalms 10:6 [KJV]  He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

Psalms 10:7 [HEB]  אָלָ֤ה פִּ֣יהוּ מָ֭לֵא וּמִרְמ֣וֹת וָתֹ֑ךְ תַּ֥חַת לְ֝שׁוֹנ֗וֹ עָמָ֥ל וָאָֽוֶן
Psalms 10:7 [KJV]  His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

Psalms 10:8 [HEB]  יֵשֵׁ֤ב בְּמַאְרַ֬ב חֲצֵרִ֗ים בַּֽ֭מִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹ֣ג נָקִ֑י עֵ֝ינָ֗יו לְֽחֵלְכָ֥ה יִצְפֹּֽנוּ
Psalms 10:8 [KJV]  He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

Psalms 10:9 [HEB]  יֶאֱרֹ֬ב בַּמִּסְתָּ֨ר כְּאַרְיֵ֬ה בְסֻכֹּ֗ה יֶ֭אֱרֹב לַחֲט֣וֹף עָנִ֑י יַחְטֹ֥ף עָ֝נִ֗י בְּמָשְׁכ֥וֹ בְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ
Psalms 10:9 [KJV]  He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

Psalms 10:10 [HEB]  ודכה יִדְכֶּ֥ה יָשֹׁ֑חַ וְנָפַ֥ל בַּ֝עֲצוּמָ֗יו חלכאים חֵ֣יל כָּאִֽים
Psalms 10:10 [KJV]  He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

Psalms 10:11 [HEB]  אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ שָׁ֣כַֽח אֵ֑ל הִסְתִּ֥יר פָּ֝נָ֗יו בַּל רָאָ֥ה לָנֶֽצַח
Psalms 10:11 [KJV]  He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

Psalms 10:12 [HEB]  קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֭ל נְשָׂ֣א יָדֶ֑ךָ אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח עניים עֲנָוִֽים
Psalms 10:12 [KJV]  Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

Psalms 10:13 [HEB]  עַל מֶ֤ה נִאֵ֖ץ רָשָׁ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָמַ֥ר בְּ֝לִבּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִּדְרֹֽשׁ
Psalms 10:13 [KJV]  Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

Psalms 10:14 [HEB]  רָאִ֡תָה כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה עָ֘מָ֤ל וָכַ֨עַס תַּבִּיט֮ לָתֵ֪ת בְּיָ֫דֶ֥ךָ עָ֭לֶיךָ יַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵלֶ֑כָה יָ֝ת֗וֹם אַתָּ֤ה הָיִ֬יתָ עוֹזֵֽר
Psalms 10:14 [KJV]  Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

Psalms 10:15 [HEB]  שְׁ֭בֹר זְר֣וֹעַ רָשָׁ֑ע וָ֝רָ֗ע תִּֽדְרוֹשׁ רִשְׁע֥וֹ בַל תִּמְצָֽא
Psalms 10:15 [KJV]  Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

Psalms 10:16 [HEB]  יְהוָ֣ה מֶ֭לֶךְ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד אָבְד֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם מֵֽאַרְצֽוֹ
Psalms 10:16 [KJV]  The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

Psalms 10:17 [HEB]  תַּאֲוַ֬ת עֲנָוִ֣ים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה תָּכִ֥ין לִ֝בָּ֗ם תַּקְשִׁ֥יב אָזְנֶֽךָ
Psalms 10:17 [KJV]  LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

Psalms 10:18 [HEB]  לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט יָת֗וֹם וָ֫דָ֥ךְ בַּל יוֹסִ֥יף ע֑וֹד לַעֲרֹ֥ץ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ מִן הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 10:18 [KJV]  To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.


--- Psalms Chapter 11 ---
Psalms 11:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד בַּֽיהוָ֨ה חָסִ֗יתִי אֵ֭יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֑י נודו נ֝֗וּדִי הַרְכֶ֥ם צִפּֽוֹר
Psalms 11:1 [KJV]  In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?

Psalms 11:2 [HEB]  כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה הָרְשָׁעִ֡ים יִדְרְכ֬וּן קֶ֗שֶׁת כּוֹנְנ֣וּ חִצָּ֣ם עַל יֶ֑תֶר לִיר֥וֹת בְּמוֹ אֹ֝֗פֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
Psalms 11:2 [KJV]  For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

Psalms 11:3 [HEB]  כִּ֣י הַ֭שָּׁתוֹת יֵֽהָרֵס֑וּן צַ֝דִּ֗יק מַה פָּעָֽל
Psalms 11:3 [KJV]  If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

Psalms 11:4 [HEB]  יְהוָ֤ה בְּֽהֵ֘יכַ֤ל קָדְשׁ֗וֹ יְהוָה֮ בַּשָּׁמַ֪יִם כִּ֫סְא֥וֹ עֵינָ֥יו יֶחֱז֑וּ עַפְעַפָּ֥יו יִ֝בְחֲנ֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם
Psalms 11:4 [KJV]  The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD’s throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

Psalms 11:5 [HEB]  יְהוָה֮ צַדִּ֪יק יִ֫בְחָ֥ן וְ֭רָשָׁע וְאֹהֵ֣ב חָמָ֑ס שָֽׂנְאָ֥ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ
Psalms 11:5 [KJV]  The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

Psalms 11:6 [HEB]  יַמְטֵ֥ר עַל רְשָׁעִ֗ים פַּ֫חִ֥ים אֵ֣שׁ וְ֭גָפְרִית וְר֥וּחַ זִלְעָפ֗וֹת מְנָ֣ת כּוֹסָֽם
Psalms 11:6 [KJV]  Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

Psalms 11:7 [HEB]  כִּֽי צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה צְדָק֣וֹת אָהֵ֑ב יָ֝שָׁ֗ר יֶחֱז֥וּ פָנֵֽימוֹ
Psalms 11:7 [KJV]  For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.


--- Psalms Chapter 12 ---
Psalms 12:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 12:1 [KJV]  Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

Psalms 12:2 [HEB]  הוֹשִׁ֣יעָה יְ֭הוָה כִּי גָמַ֣ר חָסִ֑יד כִּי פַ֥סּוּ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
Psalms 12:2 [KJV]  They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

Psalms 12:3 [HEB]  שָׁ֤וְא יְֽדַבְּרוּ֮ אִ֤ישׁ אֶת רֵ֫עֵ֥הוּ שְׂפַ֥ת חֲלָק֑וֹת בְּלֵ֖ב וָלֵ֣ב יְדַבֵּֽרוּ
Psalms 12:3 [KJV]  The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

Psalms 12:4 [HEB]  יַכְרֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲלָק֑וֹת לָ֝שׁ֗וֹן מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת גְּדֹלֽוֹת
Psalms 12:4 [KJV]  Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

Psalms 12:5 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽמְר֨וּ לִלְשֹׁנֵ֣נוּ נַ֭גְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵ֣ינוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ מִ֖י אָד֣וֹן לָֽנוּ
Psalms 12:5 [KJV]  For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

Psalms 12:6 [HEB]  מִשֹּׁ֥ד עֲנִיִּים֮ מֵאַנְקַ֪ת אֶבְי֫וֹנִ֥ים עַתָּ֣ה אָ֭קוּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ית בְּ֝יֵ֗שַׁע יָפִ֥יחַֽ לֽוֹ
Psalms 12:6 [KJV]  The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

Psalms 12:7 [HEB]  אִֽמֲר֣וֹת יְהוָה֮ אֲמָר֪וֹת טְהֹ֫ר֥וֹת כֶּ֣סֶף צָ֭רוּף בַּעֲלִ֣יל לָאָ֑רֶץ מְ֝זֻקָּ֗ק שִׁבְעָתָֽיִם
Psalms 12:7 [KJV]  Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

Psalms 12:8 [HEB]  אַתָּֽה יְהוָ֥ה תִּשְׁמְרֵ֑ם תִּצְּרֶ֓נּוּ מִן הַדּ֖וֹר ז֣וּ לְעוֹלָֽם
Psalms 12:8 [KJV]  The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

Psalms 12:9 [HEB]  סָבִ֗יב רְשָׁעִ֥ים יִתְהַלָּכ֑וּן כְּרֻ֥ם זֻ֝לּ֗וּת לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
Psalms 12:9 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 13 ---
Psalms 13:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 13:1 [KJV]  How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

Psalms 13:2 [HEB]  עַד אָ֣נָה יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֣נִי נֶ֑צַח עַד אָ֓נָה תַּסְתִּ֖יר אֶת פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי
Psalms 13:2 [KJV]  How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

Psalms 13:3 [HEB]  עַד אָ֨נָה אָשִׁ֪ית עֵצ֡וֹת בְּנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וֹן בִּלְבָבִ֣י יוֹמָ֑ם עַד אָ֓נָה יָר֖וּם אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי
Psalms 13:3 [KJV]  Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

Psalms 13:4 [HEB]  הַבִּ֣יטָֽה עֲ֭נֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י הָאִ֥ירָה עֵ֝ינַ֗י פֶּן אִישַׁ֥ן הַמָּֽוֶת
Psalms 13:4 [KJV]  Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

Psalms 13:5 [HEB]  פֶּן יֹאמַ֣ר אֹיְבִ֣י יְכָלְתִּ֑יו צָרַ֥י יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ כִּ֣י אֶמּֽוֹט
Psalms 13:5 [KJV]  But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

Psalms 13:6 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֤י בְּחַסְדְּךָ֣ בָטַחְתִּי֮ יָ֤גֵ֥ל לִבִּ֗י בִּֽישׁוּעָ֫תֶ֥ךָ אָשִׁ֥ירָה לַיהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י גָמַ֣ל עָלָֽי
Psalms 13:6 [KJV]  I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.


--- Psalms Chapter 14 ---
Psalms 14:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽשְׁחִ֗יתוּ הִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עֲלִילָ֗ה אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה טֽוֹב
Psalms 14:1 [KJV]  The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.

Psalms 14:2 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל בְּנֵי אָ֫דָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵשׁ אֶת אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 14:2 [KJV]  The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.

Psalms 14:3 [HEB]  הַכֹּ֥ל סָר֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם אֶחָֽד
Psalms 14:3 [KJV]  They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

Psalms 14:4 [HEB]  הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ כָּל פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ
Psalms 14:4 [KJV]  Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.

Psalms 14:5 [HEB]  שָׁ֤ם פָּ֣חֲדוּ פָ֑חַד כִּֽי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּד֣וֹר צַדִּֽיק
Psalms 14:5 [KJV]  There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

Psalms 14:6 [HEB]  עֲצַת עָנִ֥י תָבִ֑ישׁוּ כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסֵֽהוּ
Psalms 14:6 [KJV]  Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

Psalms 14:7 [HEB]  מִ֥י יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיּוֹן֮ יְשׁוּעַ֪ת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָֽאֵל
Psalms 14:7 [KJV]  Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.


--- Psalms Chapter 15 ---
Psalms 15:1 [HEB]  מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְ֭הֹוָה מִי יָג֣וּר בְּאָהֳלֶ֑ךָ מִֽי יִ֝שְׁכֹּ֗ן בְּהַ֣ר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
Psalms 15:1 [KJV]  Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

Psalms 15:2 [HEB]  הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים וּפֹעֵ֥ל צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֥ר אֱ֝מֶ֗ת בִּלְבָבֽוֹ
Psalms 15:2 [KJV]  He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

Psalms 15:3 [HEB]  לֹֽא רָגַ֨ל עַל לְשֹׁנ֗וֹ לֹא עָשָׂ֣ה לְרֵעֵ֣הוּ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝חֶרְפָּ֗ה לֹא נָשָׂ֥א עַל קְרֹֽבוֹ
Psalms 15:3 [KJV]  He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

Psalms 15:4 [HEB]  נִבְזֶ֤ה בְּֽעֵ֘ינָ֤יו נִמְאָ֗ס וְאֶת יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה יְכַבֵּ֑ד נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְ֝הָרַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יָמִֽר
Psalms 15:4 [KJV]  In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.

Psalms 15:5 [HEB]  כַּסְפּ֤וֹ לֹא נָתַ֣ן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ֮ וְשֹׁ֥חַד עַל נָקִ֗י לֹ֥א לָ֫קָ֥ח עֹֽשֵׂה אֵ֑לֶּה לֹ֖א יִמּ֣וֹט לְעוֹלָֽם
Psalms 15:5 [KJV]  He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.


--- Psalms Chapter 16 ---
Psalms 16:1 [HEB]  מִכְתָּ֥ם לְדָוִ֑ד שָֽׁמְרֵ֥נִי אֵ֝֗ל כִּֽי חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ
Psalms 16:1 [KJV]  Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

Psalms 16:2 [HEB]  אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל עָלֶֽיךָ
Psalms 16:2 [KJV]  O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

Psalms 16:3 [HEB]  לִ֭קְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בָּאָ֣רֶץ הֵ֑מָּה וְ֝אַדִּירֵ֗י כָּל חֶפְצִי בָֽם
Psalms 16:3 [KJV]  But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

Psalms 16:4 [HEB]  יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָם֮ אַחֵ֪ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶ֣ם מִדָּ֑ם וּֽבַל אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗ם עַל שְׂפָתָֽי
Psalms 16:4 [KJV]  Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

Psalms 16:5 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה מְנָת חֶלְקִ֥י וְכוֹסִ֑י אַ֝תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי
Psalms 16:5 [KJV]  The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

Psalms 16:6 [HEB]  חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ לִ֭י בַּנְּעִמִ֑ים אַף נַ֝חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽי
Psalms 16:6 [KJV]  The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

Psalms 16:7 [HEB]  אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת יְ֭הוָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצָ֑נִי אַף לֵ֝יל֗וֹת יִסְּר֥וּנִי כִלְיוֹתָֽי
Psalms 16:7 [KJV]  I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

Psalms 16:8 [HEB]  שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהוָ֣ה לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝ימִינִ֗י בַּל אֶמּֽוֹט
Psalms 16:8 [KJV]  I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

Psalms 16:9 [HEB]  לָכֵ֤ן שָׂמַ֣ח לִ֭בִּי וַיָּ֣גֶל כְּבוֹדִ֑י אַף בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶֽטַח
Psalms 16:9 [KJV]  Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

Psalms 16:10 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹא תַעֲזֹ֣ב נַפְשִׁ֣י לִשְׁא֑וֹל לֹֽא תִתֵּ֥ן חֲ֝סִידְךָ֗ לִרְא֥וֹת שָֽׁחַת
Psalms 16:10 [KJV]  For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

Psalms 16:11 [HEB]  תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח
Psalms 16:11 [KJV]  Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.


--- Psalms Chapter 17 ---
Psalms 17:1 [HEB]  תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שִׁמְעָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה צֶ֗דֶק הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה רִנָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה תְפִלָּתִ֑י בְּ֝לֹ֗א שִׂפְתֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה
Psalms 17:1 [KJV]  Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

Psalms 17:2 [HEB]  מִ֭לְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י יֵצֵ֑א עֵ֝ינֶ֗יךָ תֶּחֱזֶ֥ינָה מֵישָׁרִֽים
Psalms 17:2 [KJV]  Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

Psalms 17:3 [HEB]  בָּ֘חַ֤נְתָּ לִבִּ֨י פָּ֘קַ֤דְתָּ לַּ֗יְלָה צְרַפְתַּ֥נִי בַל תִּמְצָ֑א זַ֝מֹּתִ֗י בַּל יַעֲבָר פִּֽי
Psalms 17:3 [KJV]  Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

Psalms 17:4 [HEB]  לִפְעֻלּ֣וֹת אָ֭דָם בִּדְבַ֣ר שְׂפָתֶ֑יךָ אֲנִ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אָרְח֥וֹת פָּרִֽיץ
Psalms 17:4 [KJV]  Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

Psalms 17:5 [HEB]  תָּמֹ֣ךְ אֲ֭שֻׁרַי בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתֶ֑יךָ בַּל נָמ֥וֹטּוּ פְעָמָֽי
Psalms 17:5 [KJV]  Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.

Psalms 17:6 [HEB]  אֲנִֽי קְרָאתִ֣יךָ כִֽי תַעֲנֵ֣נִי אֵ֑ל הַֽט אָזְנְךָ֥ לִ֝֗י שְׁמַ֣ע אִמְרָתִֽי
Psalms 17:6 [KJV]  I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

Psalms 17:7 [HEB]  הַפְלֵ֣ה חֲ֭סָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁ֣יעַ חוֹסִ֑ים מִ֝מִּתְקוֹמְמִ֗ים בִּֽימִינֶֽךָ
Psalms 17:7 [KJV]  Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.

Psalms 17:8 [HEB]  שָׁ֭מְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁ֣וֹן בַּת עָ֑יִן בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנִי
Psalms 17:8 [KJV]  Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

Psalms 17:9 [HEB]  מִפְּנֵ֣י רְ֭שָׁעִים ז֣וּ שַׁדּ֑וּנִי אֹיְבַ֥י בְּ֝נֶ֗פֶשׁ יַקִּ֥יפוּ עָלָֽי
Psalms 17:9 [KJV]  From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

Psalms 17:10 [HEB]  חֶלְבָּ֥מוֹ סָּגְר֑וּ פִּ֝֗ימוֹ דִּבְּר֥וּ בְגֵאֽוּת
Psalms 17:10 [KJV]  They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

Psalms 17:11 [HEB]  אַ֭שֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּ֣ה סבבוני סְבָב֑וּנוּ עֵינֵיהֶ֥ם יָ֝שִׁ֗יתוּ לִנְט֥וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 17:11 [KJV]  They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

Psalms 17:12 [HEB]  דִּמְיֹנ֗וֹ כְּ֭אַרְיֵה יִכְס֣וֹף לִטְר֑וֹף וְ֝כִכְפִ֗יר יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים
Psalms 17:12 [KJV]  Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

Psalms 17:13 [HEB]  קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה קַדְּמָ֣ה פָ֭נָיו הַכְרִיעֵ֑הוּ פַּלְּטָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מֵרָשָׁ֥ע חַרְבֶּֽךָ
Psalms 17:13 [KJV]  Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

Psalms 17:14 [HEB]  מִֽמְתִ֥ים יָדְךָ֨ יְהוָ֡ה מִֽמְתִ֬ים מֵחֶ֗לֶד חֶלְקָ֥ם בַּֽחַיִּים֮ וצפינך וּֽצְפוּנְךָ֮ תְּמַלֵּ֪א בִ֫טְנָ֥ם יִשְׂבְּע֥וּ בָנִ֑ים וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ יִ֝תְרָ֗ם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 17:14 [KJV]  From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

Psalms 17:15 [HEB]  אֲנִ֗י בְּ֭צֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶ֣ה פָנֶ֑יךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָ֥ה בְ֝הָקִ֗יץ תְּמוּנָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 17:15 [KJV]  As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.


--- Psalms Chapter 18 ---
Psalms 18:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ לְעֶ֥בֶד יְהוָ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר לַיהוָ֗ה אֶת דִּ֭בְרֵי הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּי֤וֹם הִֽצִּיל יְהוָ֘ה אוֹת֥וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל אֹ֝יְבָ֗יו וּמִיַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל
Psalms 18:1 [KJV]  I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

Psalms 18:2 [HEB]  וַיֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחָמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽי
Psalms 18:2 [KJV]  The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

Psalms 18:3 [HEB]  יְהוָ֤ה סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִ֗י וּמְפַ֫לְטִ֥י אֵלִ֣י צ֭וּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה בּ֑וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥י וְקֶֽרֶן יִ֝שְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי
Psalms 18:3 [KJV]  I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

Psalms 18:4 [HEB]  מְ֭הֻלָּל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמִן אֹ֝יְבַ֗י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ
Psalms 18:4 [KJV]  The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

Psalms 18:5 [HEB]  אֲפָפ֥וּנִי חֶבְלֵי מָ֑וֶת וְֽנַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי
Psalms 18:5 [KJV]  The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

Psalms 18:6 [HEB]  חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּנִי קִ֝דְּמ֗וּנִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
Psalms 18:6 [KJV]  In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

Psalms 18:7 [HEB]  בַּצַּר לִ֤י אֶֽקְרָ֣א יְהוָה֮ וְאֶל אֱלֹהַ֪י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ יִשְׁמַ֣ע מֵהֵיכָל֣וֹ קוֹלִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֤יו תָּב֬וֹא בְאָזְנָֽיו
Psalms 18:7 [KJV]  Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

Psalms 18:8 [HEB]  וַתִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַתִּרְעַ֨שׁ הָאָ֗רֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ
Psalms 18:8 [KJV]  There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

Psalms 18:9 [HEB]  עָ֘לָ֤ה עָשָׁ֨ן בְּאַפּ֗וֹ וְאֵשׁ מִפִּ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ
Psalms 18:9 [KJV]  He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

Psalms 18:10 [HEB]  וַיֵּ֣ט שָׁ֭מַיִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽיו
Psalms 18:10 [KJV]  And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

Psalms 18:11 [HEB]  וַיִּרְכַּ֣ב עַל כְּ֭רוּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַ֝יֵּ֗דֶא עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ
Psalms 18:11 [KJV]  He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

Psalms 18:12 [HEB]  יָ֤שֶׁת חֹ֨שֶׁךְ סִתְר֗וֹ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֥יו סֻכָּת֑וֹ חֶשְׁכַת מַ֝֗יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים
Psalms 18:12 [KJV]  At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

Psalms 18:13 [HEB]  מִנֹּ֗גַהּ נֶ֫גְדּ֥וֹ עָבָ֥יו עָבְר֑וּ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ
Psalms 18:13 [KJV]  The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

Psalms 18:14 [HEB]  וַיַּרְעֵ֬ם בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם יְֽהוָ֗ה וְ֭עֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן קֹל֑וֹ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ
Psalms 18:14 [KJV]  Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

Psalms 18:15 [HEB]  וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִ֭צָּיו וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם וּבְרָקִ֥ים רָ֝ב וַיְהֻמֵּֽם
Psalms 18:15 [KJV]  Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

Psalms 18:16 [HEB]  וַיֵּ֤רָא֨וּ אֲפִ֥יקֵי מַ֗יִם וַֽיִּגָּלוּ֮ מוֹסְד֪וֹת תֵּ֫בֵ֥ל מִגַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝נִּשְׁמַ֗ת ר֣וּחַ אַפֶּֽךָ
Psalms 18:16 [KJV]  He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

Psalms 18:17 [HEB]  יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽ֝מְשֵׁ֗נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים
Psalms 18:17 [KJV]  He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

Psalms 18:18 [HEB]  יַצִּילֵ֗נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֥י עָ֑ז וּ֝מִשֹּׂנְאַ֗י כִּֽי אָמְצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי
Psalms 18:18 [KJV]  They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

Psalms 18:19 [HEB]  יְקַדְּמ֥וּנִי בְיוֹם אֵידִ֑י וַֽיְהִי יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁעָ֣ן לִֽי
Psalms 18:19 [KJV]  He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

Psalms 18:20 [HEB]  וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֥נִי לַמֶּרְחָ֑ב יְ֝חַלְּצֵ֗נִי כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי
Psalms 18:20 [KJV]  The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

Psalms 18:21 [HEB]  יִגְמְלֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי
Psalms 18:21 [KJV]  For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

Psalms 18:22 [HEB]  כִּֽי שָׁ֭מַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא רָ֝שַׁ֗עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי
Psalms 18:22 [KJV]  For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

Psalms 18:23 [HEB]  כִּ֣י כָל מִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְ֝חֻקֹּתָ֗יו לֹא אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּי
Psalms 18:23 [KJV]  I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

Psalms 18:24 [HEB]  וָאֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑וֹ וָ֝אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי
Psalms 18:24 [KJV]  Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

Psalms 18:25 [HEB]  וַיָּֽשֶׁב יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י כְצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו
Psalms 18:25 [KJV]  With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

Psalms 18:26 [HEB]  עִם חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם
Psalms 18:26 [KJV]  With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

Psalms 18:27 [HEB]  עִם נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְעִם עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל
Psalms 18:27 [KJV]  For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

Psalms 18:28 [HEB]  כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה עַם עָנִ֣י תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינַ֖יִם רָמ֣וֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל
Psalms 18:28 [KJV]  For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

Psalms 18:29 [HEB]  כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי
Psalms 18:29 [KJV]  For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

Psalms 18:30 [HEB]  כִּֽי בְ֭ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝בֵֽאלֹהַ֗י אֲדַלֶּג שֽׁוּר
Psalms 18:30 [KJV]  As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

Psalms 18:31 [HEB]  הָאֵל֮ תָּמִ֪ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ אִמְרַֽת יְהוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְכֹ֤ל הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ
Psalms 18:31 [KJV]  For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?

Psalms 18:32 [HEB]  כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
Psalms 18:32 [KJV]  It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

Psalms 18:33 [HEB]  הָ֭אֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חָ֑יִל וַיִּתֵּ֖ן תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכִּֽי
Psalms 18:33 [KJV]  He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet, and setteth me upon my high places.

Psalms 18:34 [HEB]  מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַי כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗י יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי
Psalms 18:34 [KJV]  He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

Psalms 18:35 [HEB]  מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַי לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְֽנִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי
Psalms 18:35 [KJV]  Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

Psalms 18:36 [HEB]  וַתִּתֶּן לִי֮ מָגֵ֪ן יִ֫שְׁעֶ֥ךָ וִֽימִינְךָ֥ תִסְעָדֵ֑נִי וְֽעַנְוַתְךָ֥ תַרְבֵּֽנִי
Psalms 18:36 [KJV]  Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

Psalms 18:37 [HEB]  תַּרְחִ֣יב צַעֲדִ֣י תַחְתָּ֑י וְלֹ֥א מָ֝עֲד֗וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי
Psalms 18:37 [KJV]  I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

Psalms 18:38 [HEB]  אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵ֑ם וְלֹֽא אָ֝שׁוּב עַד כַּלּוֹתָֽם
Psalms 18:38 [KJV]  I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

Psalms 18:39 [HEB]  אֶ֭מְחָצֵם וְלֹא יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם יִ֝פְּל֗וּ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽי
Psalms 18:39 [KJV]  For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

Psalms 18:40 [HEB]  וַתְּאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חַ֭יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֖יעַ קָמַ֣י תַּחְתָּֽי
Psalms 18:40 [KJV]  Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

Psalms 18:41 [HEB]  וְֽאֹיְבַ֗י נָתַ֣תָּה לִּ֣י עֹ֑רֶף וּ֝מְשַׂנְאַ֗י אַצְמִיתֵֽם
Psalms 18:41 [KJV]  They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

Psalms 18:42 [HEB]  יְשַׁוְּע֥וּ וְאֵין מוֹשִׁ֑יעַ עַל יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְלֹ֣א עָנָֽם
Psalms 18:42 [KJV]  Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

Psalms 18:43 [HEB]  וְֽאֶשְׁחָקֵ֗ם כְּעָפָ֥ר עַל פְּנֵי ר֑וּחַ כְּטִ֖יט חוּצ֣וֹת אֲרִיקֵֽם
Psalms 18:43 [KJV]  Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

Psalms 18:44 [HEB]  תְּפַלְּטֵנִי֮ מֵרִ֪יבֵ֫י עָ֥ם תְּ֭שִׂימֵנִי לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֑ם עַ֖ם לֹא יָדַ֣עְתִּי יַֽעַבְדֽוּנִי
Psalms 18:44 [KJV]  As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

Psalms 18:45 [HEB]  לְשֵׁ֣מַֽע אֹ֭זֶן יִשָּׁ֣מְעוּ לִ֑י בְּנֵֽי נֵ֝כָ֗ר יְכַחֲשׁוּ לִֽי
Psalms 18:45 [KJV]  The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

Psalms 18:46 [HEB]  בְּנֵי נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 18:46 [KJV]  The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

Psalms 18:47 [HEB]  חַי יְ֭הוָה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְ֝יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי
Psalms 18:47 [KJV]  It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

Psalms 18:48 [HEB]  הָאֵ֗ל הַנּוֹתֵ֣ן נְקָמ֣וֹת לִ֑י וַיַּדְבֵּ֖ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽי
Psalms 18:48 [KJV]  He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

Psalms 18:49 [HEB]  מְפַלְּטִ֗י מֵאֹ֫יְבָ֥י אַ֣ף מִן קָ֭מַי תְּרוֹמְמֵ֑נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חָ֝מָ֗ס תַּצִּילֵֽנִי
Psalms 18:49 [KJV]  Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.

Psalms 18:50 [HEB]  עַל כֵּ֤ן אוֹדְךָ֖ בַגּוֹיִ֥ם יְהוָ֑ה וּלְשִׁמְךָ֥ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה
Psalms 18:50 [KJV]  Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

Psalms 18:51 [HEB]  מגדל מַגְדִּיל֮ יְשׁוּע֪וֹת מַ֫לְכּ֥וֹ וְעֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד לִמְשִׁיח֗וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֗וֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם
Psalms 18:51 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 19 ---
