Psalms 19:1 [KJV]  The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

Psalms 19:2 [HEB]  הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם מְֽסַפְּרִ֥ים כְּבֽוֹד אֵ֑ל וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דָ֗יו מַגִּ֥יד הָרָקִֽיעַ
Psalms 19:2 [KJV]  Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

Psalms 19:3 [HEB]  י֣וֹם לְ֭יוֹם יַבִּ֣יעַֽ אֹ֑מֶר וְלַ֥יְלָה לְּ֝לַ֗יְלָה יְחַוֶּה דָּֽעַת
Psalms 19:3 [KJV]  There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

Psalms 19:4 [HEB]  אֵֽין אֹ֭מֶר וְאֵ֣ין דְּבָרִ֑ים בְּ֝לִ֗י נִשְׁמָ֥ע קוֹלָֽם
Psalms 19:4 [KJV]  Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

Psalms 19:5 [HEB]  בְּכָל הָאָ֨רֶץ יָ֘צָ֤א קַוָּ֗ם וּבִקְצֵ֣ה תֵ֭בֵל מִלֵּיהֶ֑ם לַ֝שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ שָֽׂם אֹ֥הֶל בָּהֶֽם
Psalms 19:5 [KJV]  Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

Psalms 19:6 [HEB]  וְה֗וּא כְּ֭חָתָן יֹצֵ֣א מֵחֻפָּת֑וֹ יָשִׂ֥ישׂ כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר לָר֥וּץ אֹֽרַח
Psalms 19:6 [KJV]  His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

Psalms 19:7 [HEB]  מִקְצֵ֤ה הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם מֽוֹצָא֗וֹ וּתְקוּפָת֥וֹ עַל קְצוֹתָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ין נִ֝סְתָּ֗ר מֵֽחַמָּתוֹ
Psalms 19:7 [KJV]  The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.

Psalms 19:8 [HEB]  תּ֘וֹרַ֤ת יְהוָ֣ה תְּ֭מִימָה מְשִׁ֣יבַת נָ֑פֶשׁ עֵד֥וּת יְהוָ֥ה נֶ֝אֱמָנָ֗ה מַחְכִּ֥ימַת פֶּֽתִי
Psalms 19:8 [KJV]  The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.

Psalms 19:9 [HEB]  פִּקּ֘וּדֵ֤י יְהוָ֣ה יְ֭שָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי לֵ֑ב מִצְוַ֥ת יְהוָ֥ה בָּ֝רָ֗ה מְאִירַ֥ת עֵינָֽיִם
Psalms 19:9 [KJV]  The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.

Psalms 19:10 [HEB]  יִרְאַ֤ת יְהוָ֨ה טְהוֹרָה֮ עוֹמֶ֪דֶת לָ֫עַ֥ד מִֽשְׁפְּטֵי יְהוָ֥ה אֱמֶ֑ת צָֽדְק֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו
Psalms 19:10 [KJV]  More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

Psalms 19:11 [HEB]  הַֽנֶּחֱמָדִ֗ים מִ֭זָּהָב וּמִפַּ֣ז רָ֑ב וּמְתוּקִ֥ים מִ֝דְּבַ֗שׁ וְנֹ֣פֶת צוּפִֽים
Psalms 19:11 [KJV]  Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

Psalms 19:12 [HEB]  גַּֽם עַ֭בְדְּךָ נִזְהָ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְרָ֗ם עֵ֣קֶב רָֽב
Psalms 19:12 [KJV]  Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

Psalms 19:13 [HEB]  שְׁגִיא֥וֹת מִֽי יָבִ֑ין מִֽנִּסְתָּר֥וֹת נַקֵּֽנִי
Psalms 19:13 [KJV]  Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

Psalms 19:14 [HEB]  גַּ֤ם מִזֵּדִ֨ים חֲשֹׂ֬ךְ עַבְדֶּ֗ךָ אַֽל יִמְשְׁלוּ בִ֣י אָ֣ז אֵיתָ֑ם וְ֝נִקֵּ֗יתִי מִפֶּ֥שַֽׁע רָֽב
Psalms 19:14 [KJV]  Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

Psalms 19:15 [HEB]  יִֽהְי֥וּ לְרָצ֨וֹן אִמְרֵי פִ֡י וְהֶגְי֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה צוּרִ֥י וְגֹאֲלִֽי
Psalms 19:15 [KJV]

Psalms 20:2 [KJV]  Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

Psalms 20:3 [HEB]  יִשְׁלַֽח עֶזְרְךָ֥ מִקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּ֝מִצִּיּ֗וֹן יִסְעָדֶֽךָּ

Psalms 20:4 [KJV]  Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

Psalms 20:5 [HEB]  יִֽתֶּן לְךָ֥ כִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל עֲצָתְךָ֥ יְמַלֵּֽא
Psalms 20:5 [KJV]  We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

Psalms 20:6 [HEB]  נְרַנְּנָ֤ה בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 20:6 [KJV]  Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

Psalms 20:7 [HEB]  עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ
Psalms 20:7 [KJV]  Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

Psalms 20:8 [HEB]  אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר
Psalms 20:8 [KJV]  They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

Psalms 20:9 [HEB]  הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד
Psalms 20:9 [KJV]  Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

Psalms 20:10 [HEB]  יְהוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵֽנוּ
Psalms 20:10 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 21 ---
Psalms 21:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 21:1 [KJV]  The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

Psalms 21:2 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּעָזְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמַח מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ֝בִישׁ֥וּעָתְךָ֗ מַה יגיל יָּ֥גֶל מְאֹֽד
Psalms 21:2 [KJV]  Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

Psalms 21:3 [HEB]  תַּאֲוַ֣ת לִ֭בּוֹ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ וַאֲרֶ֥שֶׁת שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו בַּל מָנַ֥עְתָּ סֶּֽלָה
Psalms 21:3 [KJV]  For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

Psalms 21:4 [HEB]  כִּֽי תְ֭קַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכ֣וֹת ט֑וֹב תָּשִׁ֥ית לְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ עֲטֶ֣רֶת פָּֽז
Psalms 21:4 [KJV]  He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

Psalms 21:5 [HEB]  חַיִּ֤ים שָׁאַ֣ל מִ֭מְּךָ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ אֹ֥רֶךְ יָ֝מִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד
Psalms 21:5 [KJV]  His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

Psalms 21:6 [HEB]  גָּד֣וֹל כְּ֭בוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ ה֥וֹד וְ֝הָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽיו
Psalms 21:6 [KJV]  For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

Psalms 21:7 [HEB]  כִּֽי תְשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בְרָכ֣וֹת לָעַ֑ד תְּחַדֵּ֥הוּ בְ֝שִׂמְחָ֗ה אֶת פָּנֶֽיךָ
Psalms 21:7 [KJV]  For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

Psalms 21:8 [HEB]  כִּֽי הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּל יִמּֽוֹט
Psalms 21:8 [KJV]  Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

Psalms 21:9 [HEB]  תִּמְצָ֣א יָ֭דְךָ לְכָל אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יְ֝מִֽינְךָ תִּמְצָ֥א שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ
Psalms 21:9 [KJV]  Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

Psalms 21:10 [HEB]  תְּשִׁיתֵ֤מוֹ כְּתַנּ֥וּר אֵשׁ֮ לְעֵ֪ת פָּ֫נֶ֥יךָ יְ֭הוָה בְּאַפּ֣וֹ יְבַלְּעֵ֑ם וְֽתֹאכְלֵ֥ם אֵֽשׁ
Psalms 21:10 [KJV]  Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

Psalms 21:11 [HEB]  פִּ֭רְיָמוֹ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תְּאַבֵּ֑ד וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
Psalms 21:11 [KJV]  For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

Psalms 21:12 [HEB]  כִּי נָט֣וּ עָלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה חָֽשְׁב֥וּ מְ֝זִמָּ֗ה בַּל יוּכָֽלוּ
Psalms 21:12 [KJV]  Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

Psalms 21:13 [HEB]  כִּ֭י תְּשִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ שֶׁ֑כֶם בְּ֝מֵֽיתָרֶ֗יךָ תְּכוֹנֵ֥ן עַל פְּנֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 21:13 [KJV]  Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

Psalms 21:14 [HEB]  ר֣וּמָה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעֻזֶּ֑ךָ נָשִׁ֥ירָה וּֽ֝נְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 21:14 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 22 ---
Psalms 22:1 [HEB]  לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל אַיֶּ֥לֶת הַשַּׁ֗חַר מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 22:1 [KJV]  My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

Psalms 22:2 [HEB]  אֵלִ֣י אֵ֭לִי לָמָ֣ה עֲזַבְתָּ֑נִי רָח֥וֹק מִֽ֝ישׁוּעָתִ֗י דִּבְרֵ֥י שַׁאֲגָתִֽי
Psalms 22:2 [KJV]  O my God, I cry in the day time, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

Psalms 22:3 [HEB]  אֱֽלֹהַ֗י אֶקְרָ֣א י֭וֹמָם וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֶ֑ה וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה וְֽלֹא דֽוּמִיָּ֥ה לִֽי
Psalms 22:3 [KJV]  But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

Psalms 22:4 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
Psalms 22:4 [KJV]  Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

Psalms 22:5 [HEB]  בְּ֭ךָ בָּטְח֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ בָּ֝טְח֗וּ וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵֽמוֹ
Psalms 22:5 [KJV]  They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

Psalms 22:6 [HEB]  אֵלֶ֣יךָ זָעֲק֣וּ וְנִמְלָ֑טוּ בְּךָ֖ בָטְח֣וּ וְלֹא בֽוֹשׁוּ
Psalms 22:6 [KJV]  But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

Psalms 22:7 [HEB]  וְאָנֹכִ֣י תוֹלַ֣עַת וְלֹא אִ֑ישׁ חֶרְפַּ֥ת אָ֝דָ֗ם וּבְז֥וּי עָֽם
Psalms 22:7 [KJV]  All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,

Psalms 22:8 [HEB]  כָּל רֹ֭אַי יַלְעִ֣גוּ לִ֑י יַפְטִ֥ירוּ בְ֝שָׂפָ֗ה יָנִ֥יעוּ רֹֽאשׁ
Psalms 22:8 [KJV]  He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

Psalms 22:9 [HEB]  גֹּ֣ל אֶל יְהוָ֣ה יְפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ יַ֝צִּילֵ֗הוּ כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בּֽוֹ
Psalms 22:9 [KJV]  But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.

Psalms 22:10 [HEB]  כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה גֹחִ֣י מִבָּ֑טֶן מַ֝בְטִיחִ֗י עַל שְׁדֵ֥י אִמִּֽי
Psalms 22:10 [KJV]  I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother’s belly.

Psalms 22:11 [HEB]  עָ֭לֶיךָ הָשְׁלַ֣כְתִּי מֵרָ֑חֶם מִבֶּ֥טֶן אִ֝מִּ֗י אֵ֣לִי אָֽתָּה
Psalms 22:11 [KJV]  Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

Psalms 22:12 [HEB]  אַל תִּרְחַ֣ק מִ֭מֶּנִּי כִּי צָרָ֣ה קְרוֹבָ֑ה כִּי אֵ֥ין עוֹזֵֽר
Psalms 22:12 [KJV]  Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

Psalms 22:13 [HEB]  סְ֭בָבוּנִי פָּרִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים אַבִּירֵ֖י בָשָׁ֣ן כִּתְּרֽוּנִי
Psalms 22:13 [KJV]  They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

Psalms 22:14 [HEB]  פָּצ֣וּ עָלַ֣י פִּיהֶ֑ם אַ֝רְיֵ֗ה טֹרֵ֥ף וְשֹׁאֵֽג
Psalms 22:14 [KJV]  I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

Psalms 22:15 [HEB]  כַּמַּ֥יִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי֮ וְהִתְפָּֽרְד֗וּ כָּֽל עַצְמ֫וֹתָ֥י הָיָ֣ה לִ֭בִּי כַּדּוֹנָ֑ג נָ֝מֵ֗ס בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי
Psalms 22:15 [KJV]  My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

Psalms 22:16 [HEB]  יָ֘בֵ֤שׁ כַּחֶ֨רֶשׂ כֹּחִ֗י וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי מֻדְבָּ֣ק מַלְקוֹחָ֑י וְֽלַעֲפַר מָ֥וֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵֽנִי
Psalms 22:16 [KJV]  For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

Psalms 22:17 [HEB]  כִּ֥י סְבָב֗וּנִי כְּלָ֫בִ֥ים עֲדַ֣ת מְ֭רֵעִים הִקִּיפ֑וּנִי כָּ֝אֲרִ֗י יָדַ֥י וְרַגְלָֽי
Psalms 22:17 [KJV]  I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

Psalms 22:18 [HEB]  אֲסַפֵּ֥ר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָ֑י הֵ֥מָּה יַ֝בִּ֗יטוּ יִרְאוּ בִֽי
Psalms 22:18 [KJV]  They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

Psalms 22:19 [HEB]  יְחַלְּק֣וּ בְגָדַ֣י לָהֶ֑ם וְעַל לְ֝בוּשִׁ֗י יַפִּ֥ילוּ גוֹרָֽל
Psalms 22:19 [KJV]  But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

Psalms 22:20 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל תִּרְחָ֑ק אֱ֝יָלוּתִ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה
Psalms 22:20 [KJV]  Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

Psalms 22:21 [HEB]  הַצִּ֣ילָה מֵחֶ֣רֶב נַפְשִׁ֑י מִיַּד כֶּ֝֗לֶב יְחִידָתִֽי
Psalms 22:21 [KJV]  Save me from the lion’s mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

Psalms 22:22 [HEB]  ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּ֣י אַרְיֵ֑ה וּמִקַּרְנֵ֖י רֵמִ֣ים עֲנִיתָֽנִי

Psalms 22:23 [HEB]  אֲסַפְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְאֶחָ֑י בְּת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל אֲהַלְלֶֽךָּ

Psalms 22:24 [KJV]  For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

Psalms 22:25 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹֽא בָזָ֨ה וְלֹ֪א שִׁקַּ֡ץ עֱנ֬וּת עָנִ֗י וְלֹא הִסְתִּ֣יר פָּנָ֣יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּֽבְשַׁוְּע֖וֹ אֵלָ֣יו שָׁמֵֽעַ

Psalms 22:26 [KJV]  The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

Psalms 22:27 [HEB]  יֹאכְל֬וּ עֲנָוִ֨ים וְיִשְׂבָּ֗עוּ יְהַֽלְל֣וּ יְ֭הוָה דֹּ֣רְשָׁ֑יו יְחִ֖י לְבַבְכֶ֣ם לָעַֽד

Psalms 22:28 [KJV]  For the kingdom is the LORD’s: and he is the governor among the nations.

Psalms 22:29 [HEB]  כִּ֣י לַ֭יהוָה הַמְּלוּכָ֑ה וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם
Psalms 22:29 [KJV]  All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

Psalms 22:30 [HEB]  אָכְל֬וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֨וּ כָּֽל דִּשְׁנֵי אֶ֗רֶץ לְפָנָ֣יו יִ֭כְרְעוּ כָּל יוֹרְדֵ֣י עָפָ֑ר וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ לֹ֣א חִיָּֽה
Psalms 22:30 [KJV]  A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

Psalms 22:31 [HEB]  זֶ֥רַע יַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ יְסֻפַּ֖ר לַֽאדֹנָ֣י לַדּֽוֹר
Psalms 22:31 [KJV]  They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

Psalms 22:32 [HEB]  יָ֭בֹאוּ וְיַגִּ֣ידוּ צִדְקָת֑וֹ לְעַ֥ם נ֝וֹלָ֗ד כִּ֣י עָשָֽׂה
Psalms 22:32 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 23 ---
Psalms 23:1 [HEB]  מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד יְהוָ֥ה רֹ֝עִ֗י לֹ֣א אֶחְסָֽר
Psalms 23:1 [KJV]  The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

Psalms 23:2 [HEB]  בִּנְא֣וֹת דֶּ֭שֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵ֑נִי עַל מֵ֖י מְנֻח֣וֹת יְנַהֲלֵֽנִי
Psalms 23:2 [KJV]  He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

Psalms 23:3 [HEB]  נַפְשִׁ֥י יְשׁוֹבֵ֑ב יַֽנְחֵ֥נִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי צֶ֝֗דֶק לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֽוֹ
Psalms 23:3 [KJV]  He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

Psalms 23:4 [HEB]  גַּ֤ם כִּֽי אֵלֵ֨ךְ בְּגֵ֪יא צַלְמָ֡וֶת לֹא אִ֘ירָ֤א רָ֗ע כִּי אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּדִ֑י שִׁבְטְךָ֥ וּ֝מִשְׁעַנְתֶּ֗ךָ הֵ֣מָּה יְנַֽחֲמֻֽנִי
Psalms 23:4 [KJV]  Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

Psalms 23:5 [HEB]  תַּעֲרֹ֬ךְ לְפָנַ֨י שֻׁלְחָ֗ן נֶ֥גֶד צֹרְרָ֑י דִּשַּׁ֖נְתָּ בַשֶּׁ֥מֶן רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י כּוֹסִ֥י רְוָיָֽה
Psalms 23:5 [KJV]  Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

Psalms 23:6 [HEB]  אַ֤ךְ ט֤וֹב וָחֶ֣סֶד יִ֭רְדְּפוּנִי כָּל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑י וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְּבֵית יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים
Psalms 23:6 [KJV]  Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.


--- Psalms Chapter 24 ---
Psalms 24:1 [HEB]  לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר לַֽ֭יהוָה הָאָ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֑הּ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ
Psalms 24:1 [KJV]  The earth is the LORD’s, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

Psalms 24:2 [HEB]  כִּי ה֭וּא עַל יַמִּ֣ים יְסָדָ֑הּ וְעַל נְ֝הָר֗וֹת יְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ
Psalms 24:2 [KJV]  For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

Psalms 24:3 [HEB]  מִֽי יַעֲלֶ֥ה בְהַר יְהוָ֑ה וּמִי יָ֝קוּם בִּמְק֥וֹם קָדְשֽׁוֹ
Psalms 24:3 [KJV]  Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?

Psalms 24:4 [HEB]  נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽבַר לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא נָשָׂ֣א לַשָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְמִרְמָֽה
Psalms 24:4 [KJV]  He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

Psalms 24:5 [HEB]  יִשָּׂ֣א בְ֭רָכָה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽוֹ
Psalms 24:5 [KJV]  He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

Psalms 24:6 [HEB]  זֶ֭ה דּ֣וֹר דרשו דֹּרְשָׁ֑יו מְבַקְשֵׁ֨י פָנֶ֖יךָ יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה
Psalms 24:6 [KJV]  This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

Psalms 24:7 [HEB]  שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭הִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָב֗וֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד
Psalms 24:7 [KJV]  Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

Psalms 24:8 [HEB]  מִ֥י זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְ֭הוָה עִזּ֣וּז וְגִבּ֑וֹר יְ֝הוָ֗ה גִּבּ֥וֹר מִלְחָמָֽה
Psalms 24:8 [KJV]  Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

Psalms 24:9 [HEB]  שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וּ֭שְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָבֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד
Psalms 24:9 [KJV]  Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

Psalms 24:10 [HEB]  מִ֤י ה֣וּא זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת ה֤וּא מֶ֖לֶךְ הַכָּב֣וֹד סֶֽלָה
Psalms 24:10 [KJV]  Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

Psalms 25:1 [HEB]  לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא
Psalms 25:1 [KJV]  Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

Psalms 25:2 [HEB]  אֱֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי
Psalms 25:2 [KJV]  O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

Psalms 25:3 [HEB]  גַּ֣ם כָּל קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם
Psalms 25:3 [KJV]  Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

Psalms 25:4 [HEB]  דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי
Psalms 25:4 [KJV]  Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

Psalms 25:5 [HEB]  הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כָּל הַיּֽוֹם
Psalms 25:5 [KJV]  Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

Psalms 25:6 [HEB]  זְכֹר רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה
Psalms 25:6 [KJV]  Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

Psalms 25:7 [HEB]  חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכָר לִי אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 25:7 [KJV]  Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O LORD.

Psalms 25:8 [HEB]  טוֹב וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ
Psalms 25:8 [KJV]  Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

Psalms 25:9 [HEB]  יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ
Psalms 25:9 [KJV]  The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

Psalms 25:10 [HEB]  כָּל אָרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו
Psalms 25:10 [KJV]  All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

Psalms 25:11 [HEB]  לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב הֽוּא
Psalms 25:11 [KJV]  For thy name’s sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

Psalms 25:12 [HEB]  מִי זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר
Psalms 25:12 [KJV]  What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

Psalms 25:13 [HEB]  נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ
Psalms 25:13 [KJV]  His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

Psalms 25:14 [HEB]  ס֣וֹד יְ֭הוָה לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם
Psalms 25:14 [KJV]  The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

Psalms 25:15 [HEB]  עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא יוֹצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי
Psalms 25:15 [KJV]  Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

Psalms 25:16 [HEB]  פְּנֵה אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי
Psalms 25:16 [KJV]  Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

Psalms 25:17 [HEB]  צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתַ֗י הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי
Psalms 25:17 [KJV]  The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

Psalms 25:18 [HEB]  רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכָל חַטֹּאותָֽי
Psalms 25:18 [KJV]  Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

Psalms 25:19 [HEB]  רְאֵֽה אוֹיְבַ֥י כִּי רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי
Psalms 25:19 [KJV]  Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

Psalms 25:20 [HEB]  שָׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ
Psalms 25:20 [KJV]  O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

Psalms 25:21 [HEB]  תֹּם וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ
Psalms 25:21 [KJV]  Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

Psalms 25:22 [HEB]  פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָֽרוֹתָיו
Psalms 25:22 [KJV]  Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.


--- Psalms Chapter 26 ---
Psalms 26:1 [HEB]  לְדָוִ֨ד שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי אֲ֭נִי בְּתֻמִּ֣י הָלַ֑כְתִּי וּבַיהוָ֥ה בָּ֝טַ֗חְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶמְעָֽד
Psalms 26:1 [KJV]  Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.

Psalms 26:2 [HEB]  בְּחָנֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה וְנַסֵּ֑נִי צרופה צָרְפָ֖ה כִלְיוֹתַ֣י וְלִבִּֽי
Psalms 26:2 [KJV]  Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

Psalms 26:3 [HEB]  כִּֽי חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י וְ֝הִתְהַלַּ֗כְתִּי בַּאֲמִתֶּֽךָ
Psalms 26:3 [KJV]  For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

Psalms 26:4 [HEB]  לֹא יָ֭שַׁבְתִּי עִם מְתֵי שָׁ֑וְא וְעִ֥ם נַ֝עֲלָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א אָבֽוֹא
Psalms 26:4 [KJV]  I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

Psalms 26:5 [HEB]  שָׂ֭נֵאתִי קְהַ֣ל מְרֵעִ֑ים וְעִם רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א אֵשֵֽׁב
Psalms 26:5 [KJV]  I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

Psalms 26:6 [HEB]  אֶרְחַ֣ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּ֑י וַאֲסֹבְבָ֖ה אֶת מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 26:6 [KJV]  I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:

Psalms 26:7 [HEB]  לַ֭שְׁמִעַ בְּק֣וֹל תּוֹדָ֑ה וּ֝לְסַפֵּ֗ר כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 26:7 [KJV]  That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

Psalms 26:8 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה אָ֭הַבְתִּי מְע֣וֹן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מְק֗וֹם מִשְׁכַּ֥ן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ
Psalms 26:8 [KJV]  LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

Psalms 26:9 [HEB]  אַל תֶּאֱסֹ֣ף עִם חַטָּאִ֣ים נַפְשִׁ֑י וְעִם אַנְשֵׁ֖י דָמִ֣ים חַיָּֽי
Psalms 26:9 [KJV]  Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

Psalms 26:10 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁר בִּידֵיהֶ֥ם זִמָּ֑ה וִֽ֝ימִינָ֗ם מָ֣לְאָה שֹּֽׁחַד
Psalms 26:10 [KJV]  In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

Psalms 26:11 [HEB]  וַ֭אֲנִי בְּתֻמִּ֥י אֵלֵ֗ךְ פְּדֵ֣נִי וְחָנֵּֽנִי
Psalms 26:11 [KJV]  But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

Psalms 26:12 [HEB]  רַ֭גְלִי עָֽמְדָ֣ה בְמִישׁ֑וֹר בְּ֝מַקְהֵלִ֗ים אֲבָרֵ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 26:12 [KJV]  My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.


--- Psalms Chapter 27 ---
Psalms 27:1 [HEB]  לְדָוִ֨ד יְהוָ֤ה אוֹרִ֣י וְ֭יִשְׁעִי מִמִּ֣י אִירָ֑א יְהוָ֥ה מָֽעוֹז חַ֝יַּ֗י מִמִּ֥י אֶפְחָֽד
Psalms 27:1 [KJV]  The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

Psalms 27:2 [HEB]  בִּקְרֹ֤ב עָלַ֨י מְרֵעִים֮ לֶאֱכֹ֪ל אֶת בְּשָׂ֫רִ֥י צָרַ֣י וְאֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י הֵ֖מָּה כָשְׁל֣וּ וְנָפָֽלוּ
Psalms 27:2 [KJV]  When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

Psalms 27:3 [HEB]  אִם תַּחֲנֶ֬ה עָלַ֨י מַחֲנֶה֮ לֹֽא יִירָ֪א לִ֫בִּ֥י אִם תָּק֣וּם עָ֭לַי מִלְחָמָ֑ה בְּ֝זֹ֗את אֲנִ֣י בוֹטֵֽחַ
Psalms 27:3 [KJV]  Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

Psalms 27:4 [HEB]  אַחַ֤ת שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵֽאֵת יְהוָה֮ אוֹתָ֪הּ אֲבַ֫קֵּ֥שׁ שִׁבְתִּ֣י בְּבֵית יְ֭הוָה כָּל יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑י לַחֲז֥וֹת בְּנֹֽעַם יְ֝הוָ֗ה וּלְבַקֵּ֥ר בְּהֵיכָלֽוֹ
Psalms 27:4 [KJV]  One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.

Psalms 27:5 [HEB]  כִּ֤י יִצְפְּנֵ֨נִי בְּסֻכֹּה֮ בְּי֪וֹם רָ֫עָ֥ה יַ֭סְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵ֣תֶר אָהֳל֑וֹ בְּ֝צ֗וּר יְרוֹמְמֵֽנִי
Psalms 27:5 [KJV]  For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

Psalms 27:6 [HEB]  וְעַתָּ֨ה יָר֪וּם רֹאשִׁ֡י עַ֤ל אֹֽיְבַ֬י סְֽבִיבוֹתַ֗י וְאֶזְבְּחָ֣ה בְ֭אָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה לַיהוָֽה
Psalms 27:6 [KJV]  And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.

Psalms 27:7 [HEB]  שְׁמַע יְהוָ֖ה קוֹלִ֥י אֶקְרָ֗א וְחָנֵּ֥נִי וַעֲנֵֽנִי
Psalms 27:7 [KJV]  Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

Psalms 27:8 [HEB]  לְךָ֤ אָמַ֣ר לִ֭בִּי בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑י אֶת פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ
Psalms 27:8 [KJV]  When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.

Psalms 27:9 [HEB]  אַל תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ מִמֶּנִּי֮ אַֽל תַּט בְּאַ֗ף עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ עֶזְרָתִ֥י הָיִ֑יתָ אַֽל תִּטְּשֵׁ֥נִי וְאַל תַּֽ֝עַזְבֵ֗נִי אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי
Psalms 27:9 [KJV]  Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

Psalms 27:10 [HEB]  כִּי אָבִ֣י וְאִמִּ֣י עֲזָב֑וּנִי וַֽיהוָ֣ה יַֽאַסְפֵֽנִי
Psalms 27:10 [KJV]  When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

Psalms 27:11 [HEB]  ה֤וֹרֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֗ה דַּ֫רְכֶּ֥ךָ וּ֭נְחֵנִי בְּאֹ֣רַח מִישׁ֑וֹר לְ֝מַ֗עַן שׁוֹרְרָֽי
Psalms 27:11 [KJV]  Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

Psalms 27:12 [HEB]  אַֽל תִּ֭תְּנֵנִי בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ צָרָ֑י כִּ֥י קָֽמוּ בִ֥י עֵֽדֵי שֶׁ֝֗קֶר וִיפֵ֥חַ חָמָֽס
Psalms 27:12 [KJV]  Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

Psalms 27:13 [HEB]  לׅׄוּלֵׅׄ֗אׅׄ הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי לִרְא֥וֹת בְּֽטוּב יְהוָ֗ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּֽים
Psalms 27:13 [KJV]  I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

Psalms 27:14 [HEB]  קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל יְה֫וָ֥ה חֲ֭זַק וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל יְהוָֽה
Psalms 27:14 [KJV]  Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.


--- Psalms Chapter 28 ---
Psalms 28:1 [HEB]  לְדָוִ֡ד אֵ֘לֶ֤יךָ יְהוָ֨ה אֶקְרָ֗א צוּרִי֮ אַֽל תֶּחֱרַ֪שׁ מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי פֶּן תֶּֽחֱשֶׁ֥ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר
Psalms 28:1 [KJV]  Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

Psalms 28:2 [HEB]  שְׁמַ֤ע ק֣וֹל תַּ֭חֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ בְּנָשְׂאִ֥י יָ֝דַ֗י אֶל דְּבִ֥יר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
Psalms 28:2 [KJV]  Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

Psalms 28:3 [HEB]  אַל תִּמְשְׁכֵ֣נִי עִם רְשָׁעִים֮ וְעִם פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן דֹּבְרֵ֣י שָׁ֭לוֹם עִם רֵֽעֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝רָעָ֗ה בִּלְבָבָֽם
Psalms 28:3 [KJV]  Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

Psalms 28:4 [HEB]  תֶּן לָהֶ֣ם כְּפָעֳלָם֮ וּכְרֹ֪עַ מַֽעַלְלֵ֫יהֶ֥ם כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְ֭דֵיהֶם תֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֖ב גְּמוּלָ֣ם לָהֶֽם
Psalms 28:4 [KJV]  Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

Psalms 28:5 [KJV]  Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

Psalms 28:6 [HEB]  בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּי שָׁ֝מַע ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי
Psalms 28:6 [KJV]  Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

Psalms 28:7 [HEB]  יְהוָ֤ה עֻזִּ֥י וּמָגִנִּי֮ בּ֤וֹ בָטַ֥ח לִבִּ֗י וְֽנֶ֫עֱזָ֥רְתִּי וַיַּעֲלֹ֥ז לִבִּ֑י וּֽמִשִּׁירִ֥י אֲהוֹדֶֽנּוּ
Psalms 28:7 [KJV]  The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

Psalms 28:8 [HEB]  יְהוָ֥ה עֹֽז לָ֑מוֹ וּמָ֘ע֤וֹז יְשׁוּע֖וֹת מְשִׁיח֣וֹ הֽוּא
Psalms 28:8 [KJV]  The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

Psalms 28:9 [HEB]  הוֹשִׁ֤יעָה אֶת עַמֶּ֗ךָ וּבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וּֽרְעֵ֥ם וְ֝נַשְּׂאֵ֗ם עַד הָעוֹלָֽם
Psalms 28:9 [KJV]  Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

Psalms 29:6 [KJV]  He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

Psalms 29:9 [KJV]  The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

Psalms 29:10 [HEB]  יְ֭הוָה לַמַּבּ֣וּל יָשָׁ֑ב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְ֝הוָ֗ה מֶ֣לֶךְ לְעוֹלָֽם
Psalms 29:10 [KJV]  The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

Psalms 30:9 [HEB]  אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וְאֶל אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אֶתְחַנָּֽן

Psalms 31:5 [KJV]  Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

Psalms 31:6 [HEB]  בְּיָדְךָ֮ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָה אוֹתִ֥י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת
Psalms 31:6 [KJV]  I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.

Psalms 31:7 [HEB]  שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי שָׁ֑וְא וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶל יְהוָ֥ה בָּטָֽחְתִּי
Psalms 31:7 [KJV]  I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

Psalms 31:8 [HEB]  אָגִ֥ילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּחַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת עָנְיִ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּצָר֥וֹת נַפְשִֽׁי
Psalms 31:8 [KJV]  And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

Psalms 31:9 [HEB]  וְלֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד אוֹיֵ֑ב הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב רַגְלָֽי
Psalms 31:9 [KJV]  Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

Psalms 31:10 [KJV]  For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

Psalms 31:11 [KJV]  I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

Psalms 31:12 [HEB]  מִכָּל צֹרְרַ֨י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַ֨י מְאֹד֮ וּפַ֪חַד לִֽמְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥י רֹאַ֥י בַּח֑וּץ נָדְד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי
Psalms 31:12 [KJV]  I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

Psalms 31:13 [HEB]  נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵ֣ת מִלֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כִּכְלִ֥י אֹבֵֽד
Psalms 31:13 [KJV]  For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

Psalms 31:14 [HEB]  כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֪וֹר מִסָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּהִוָּסְדָ֣ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑י לָקַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣י זָמָֽמוּ
Psalms 31:14 [KJV]  But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.

Psalms 31:15 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֤י עָלֶ֣יךָ בָטַ֣חְתִּי יְהוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֥י אָֽתָּה
Psalms 31:15 [KJV]  My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

Psalms 31:16 [HEB]  בְּיָדְךָ֥ עִתֹּתָ֑י הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִיַּד א֝וֹיְבַ֗י וּמֵרֹדְפָֽי
Psalms 31:16 [KJV]  Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.

Psalms 31:17 [HEB]  הָאִ֣ירָה פָ֭נֶיךָ עַל עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ
Psalms 31:17 [KJV]  Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

Psalms 31:18 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל אֵ֭בוֹשָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑יךָ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יִדְּמ֥וּ לִשְׁאֽוֹל
Psalms 31:18 [KJV]  Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

Psalms 31:19 [HEB]  תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י שָׁ֥קֶר הַדֹּבְר֖וֹת עַל צַדִּ֥יק עָתָ֗ק בְּגַאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז
Psalms 31:19 [KJV]  Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

Psalms 31:20 [HEB]  מָ֤ה רַֽב טוּבְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר צָפַ֪נְתָּ לִּֽירֵ֫אֶ֥יךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ לַחֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָם
Psalms 31:20 [KJV]  Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

Psalms 31:21 [HEB]  תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵֽרֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת
Psalms 31:21 [KJV]  Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

Psalms 31:22 [HEB]  בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא חַסְדּ֥וֹ לִ֝֗י בְּעִ֣יר מָצֽוֹר
Psalms 31:22 [KJV]  For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

Psalms 31:23 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֤י אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֗י נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִנֶּ֪גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥יךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ ק֥וֹל תַּחֲנוּנַ֗י בְּשַׁוְּעִ֥י אֵלֶֽיךָ
Psalms 31:23 [KJV]  O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

Psalms 31:24 [HEB]  אֶֽהֱב֥וּ אֶת יְהוָ֗ה כָּֽל חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה
Psalms 31:24 [KJV]  Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

Psalms 31:25 [HEB]  חִ֭זְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כָּל הַ֝מְיַחֲלִ֗ים לַיהוָֽה
Psalms 31:25 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 32 ---
Psalms 32:1 [HEB]  לְדָוִ֗ד מַ֫שְׂכִּ֥יל אַשְׁרֵ֥י נְֽשׂוּי פֶּ֗שַׁע כְּס֣וּי חֲטָאָֽה
Psalms 32:1 [KJV]  Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

Psalms 32:2 [HEB]  אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָ֗ם לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב יְהוָ֣ה ל֣וֹ עָוֺ֑ן וְאֵ֖ין בְּרוּח֣וֹ רְמִיָּה
Psalms 32:2 [KJV]  Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

Psalms 32:3 [HEB]  כִּֽי הֶ֭חֱרַשְׁתִּי בָּל֣וּ עֲצָמָ֑י בְּ֝שַׁאֲגָתִ֗י כָּל הַיּֽוֹם

Psalms 32:4 [HEB]  כִּ֤י יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַיְלָה֮ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗י יָ֫דֶ֥ךָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְשַׁדִּ֑י בְּחַרְבֹ֖נֵי קַ֣יִץ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 32:4 [KJV]  For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

Psalms 32:5 [HEB]  חַטָּאתִ֨י אוֹדִ֪יעֲךָ֡ וַעֲוֺ֘נִ֤י לֹֽא כִסִּ֗יתִי אָמַ֗רְתִּי אוֹדֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַי לַיהוָ֑ה וְאַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֺ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣י סֶֽלָה
Psalms 32:5 [KJV]  I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

Psalms 32:6 [HEB]  עַל זֹ֡את יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל כָּל חָסִ֨יד אֵלֶיךָ֮ לְעֵ֪ת מְ֫צֹ֥א רַ֗ק לְ֭שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ
Psalms 32:6 [KJV]  For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

Psalms 32:7 [HEB]  אַתָּ֤ה סֵ֥תֶר לִי֮ מִצַּ֪ר תִּ֫צְּרֵ֥נִי רָנֵּ֥י פַלֵּ֑ט תְּס֖וֹבְבֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה
Psalms 32:7 [KJV]  Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

Psalms 32:8 [HEB]  אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ֨ וְֽאוֹרְךָ֗ בְּדֶֽרֶךְ ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ אִֽיעֲצָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יךָ עֵינִֽי
Psalms 32:8 [KJV]  I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

Psalms 32:9 [HEB]  אַל תִּֽהְי֤וּ כְּס֥וּס כְּפֶרֶד֮ אֵ֤ין הָ֫בִ֥ין בְּמֶֽתֶג וָרֶ֣סֶן עֶדְי֣וֹ לִבְל֑וֹם בַּ֝֗ל קְרֹ֣ב אֵלֶֽיךָ
Psalms 32:9 [KJV]  Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

Psalms 32:10 [HEB]  רַבִּ֥ים מַכְאוֹבִ֗ים לָרָ֫שָׁ֥ע וְהַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה חֶ֝֗סֶד יְסוֹבְבֶֽנּוּ
Psalms 32:10 [KJV]  Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.

Psalms 32:11 [HEB]  שִׂמְח֬וּ בַֽיהוָ֣ה וְ֭גִילוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝הַרְנִ֗ינוּ כָּל יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
Psalms 32:11 [KJV]  Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

Psalms 33:1 [KJV]  Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

Psalms 33:2 [KJV]  Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

Psalms 33:3 [HEB]  שִֽׁירוּ ל֭וֹ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ הֵיטִ֥יבוּ נַ֝גֵּ֗ן בִּתְרוּעָֽה
Psalms 33:3 [KJV]  Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

Psalms 33:4 [HEB]  כִּֽי יָשָׁ֥ר דְּבַר יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה

Psalms 33:8 [KJV]  Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

Psalms 33:9 [HEB]  כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַיֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא צִ֝וָּ֗ה וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד
Psalms 33:9 [KJV]  For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

Psalms 33:10 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת גּוֹיִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת עַמִּֽים
Psalms 33:10 [KJV]  The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

Psalms 33:11 [KJV]  The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

Psalms 33:12 [HEB]  אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו הָעָ֓ם בָּחַ֖ר לְנַחֲלָ֣ה לֽוֹ
Psalms 33:12 [KJV]  Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

Psalms 33:13 [HEB]  מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִבִּ֣יט יְהוָ֑ה רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת כָּל בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם
Psalms 33:13 [KJV]  The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

Psalms 33:14 [HEB]  מִֽמְּכוֹן שִׁבְתּ֥וֹ הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 33:14 [KJV]  From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

Psalms 33:15 [KJV]  He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

Psalms 33:16 [HEB]  אֵֽין הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁ֣ע בְּרָב חָ֑יִל גִּ֝בּ֗וֹר לֹֽא יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּרָב כֹּֽחַ
Psalms 33:16 [KJV]  There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

Psalms 33:17 [HEB]  שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭סּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּבְרֹ֥ב חֵ֝יל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט
Psalms 33:17 [KJV]  An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

Psalms 33:18 [HEB]  הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הוָה אֶל יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ
Psalms 33:18 [KJV]  Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

Psalms 33:19 [HEB]  לְהַצִּ֣יל מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וּ֝לְחַיּוֹתָ֗ם בָּרָעָֽב
Psalms 33:19 [KJV]  To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

Psalms 33:20 [HEB]  נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרֵ֖נוּ וּמָגִנֵּ֣נוּ הֽוּא
Psalms 33:20 [KJV]  Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.

Psalms 33:21 [HEB]  כִּי ב֭וֹ יִשְׂמַ֣ח לִבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י בְשֵׁ֖ם קָדְשׁ֣וֹ בָטָֽחְנוּ
Psalms 33:21 [KJV]  For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

Psalms 33:22 [HEB]  יְהִֽי חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ
Psalms 33:22 [KJV]  Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.


--- Psalms Chapter 34 ---
Psalms 34:1 [HEB]  לְדָוִ֗ד בְּשַׁנּוֹת֣וֹ אֶת טַ֭עְמוֹ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַֽ֝יְגָרֲשֵׁ֗הוּ וַיֵּלַֽךְ
Psalms 34:1 [KJV]  I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

Psalms 34:2 [KJV]  My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

Psalms 34:3 [HEB]  בַּ֭יהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל נַפְשִׁ֑י יִשְׁמְע֖וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ
Psalms 34:3 [KJV]  O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

Psalms 34:4 [HEB]  גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו
Psalms 34:4 [KJV]  I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

Psalms 34:5 [HEB]  דָּרַ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת יְהוָ֣ה וְעָנָ֑נִי וּמִכָּל מְ֝גוּרוֹתַ֗י הִצִּילָֽנִי
Psalms 34:5 [KJV]  They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

Psalms 34:6 [HEB]  הִבִּ֣יטוּ אֵלָ֣יו וְנָהָ֑רוּ וּ֝פְנֵיהֶ֗ם אַל יֶחְפָּֽרוּ
Psalms 34:6 [KJV]  This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

Psalms 34:7 [HEB]  זֶ֤ה עָנִ֣י קָ֭רָא וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל צָ֝רוֹתָ֗יו הוֹשִׁיעֽוֹ
Psalms 34:7 [KJV]  The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

Psalms 34:8 [HEB]  חֹנֶ֤ה מַלְאַךְ יְהוָ֓ה סָ֘בִ֤יב לִֽירֵאָ֗יו וַֽיְחַלְּצֵֽם
Psalms 34:8 [KJV]  O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

Psalms 34:9 [HEB]  טַעֲמ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ כִּי ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הַ֝גֶּ֗בֶר יֶחֱסֶה בּֽוֹ
Psalms 34:9 [KJV]  O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

Psalms 34:10 [HEB]  יְר֣אוּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה קְדֹשָׁ֑יו כִּי אֵ֥ין מַ֝חְס֗וֹר לִירֵאָֽיו
Psalms 34:10 [KJV]  The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.

Psalms 34:11 [HEB]  כְּ֭פִירִים רָשׁ֣וּ וְרָעֵ֑בוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹא יַחְסְר֥וּ כָל טֽוֹב
Psalms 34:11 [KJV]  Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

Psalms 34:12 [HEB]  לְֽכוּ בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ לִ֑י יִֽרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶֽם
Psalms 34:12 [KJV]  What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

Psalms 34:13 [HEB]  מִֽי הָ֭אִישׁ הֶחָפֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים אֹהֵ֥ב יָ֝מִ֗ים לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב
Psalms 34:13 [KJV]  Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

Psalms 34:14 [HEB]  נְצֹ֣ר לְשׁוֹנְךָ֣ מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר מִרְמָֽה
Psalms 34:14 [KJV]  Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

Psalms 34:15 [HEB]  ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְרָדְפֵֽהוּ
Psalms 34:15 [KJV]  The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

Psalms 34:16 [HEB]  עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה אֶל צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝אָזְנָ֗יו אֶל שַׁוְעָתָֽם
Psalms 34:16 [KJV]  The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

Psalms 34:17 [HEB]  פְּנֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בְּעֹ֣שֵׂי רָ֑ע לְהַכְרִ֖ית מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם
Psalms 34:17 [KJV]  The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

Psalms 34:18 [HEB]  צָעֲק֣וּ וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל צָ֝רוֹתָ֗ם הִצִּילָֽם
Psalms 34:18 [KJV]  The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

Psalms 34:19 [HEB]  קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי לֵ֑ב וְֽאֶת דַּכְּאֵי ר֥וּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ
Psalms 34:19 [KJV]  Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

Psalms 34:20 [HEB]  רַ֭בּוֹת רָע֣וֹת צַדִּ֑יק וּ֝מִכֻּלָּ֗ם יַצִּילֶ֥נּוּ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 34:20 [KJV]  He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

Psalms 34:21 [HEB]  שֹׁמֵ֥ר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָ֑יו אַחַ֥ת מֵ֝הֵ֗נָּה לֹ֣א נִשְׁבָּֽרָה
Psalms 34:21 [KJV]  Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

Psalms 34:22 [HEB]  תְּמוֹתֵ֣ת רָשָׁ֣ע רָעָ֑ה וְשֹׂנְאֵ֖י צַדִּ֣יק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ
Psalms 34:22 [KJV]  The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

Psalms 34:23 [HEB]  פּוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲבָדָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יֶ֝אְשְׁמ֗וּ כָּֽל הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ
Psalms 34:23 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 35 ---
Psalms 35:1 [HEB]  לְדָוִ֨ד רִיבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת יְרִיבַ֑י לְ֝חַ֗ם אֶת לֹֽחֲמָֽי
Psalms 35:1 [KJV]  Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

Psalms 35:2 [HEB]  הַחֲזֵ֣ק מָגֵ֣ן וְצִנָּ֑ה וְ֝ק֗וּמָה בְּעֶזְרָתִֽי
Psalms 35:2 [KJV]  Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

Psalms 35:3 [HEB]  וְהָ֘רֵ֤ק חֲנִ֣ית וּ֭סְגֹר לִקְרַ֣את רֹדְפָ֑י אֱמֹ֥ר לְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יְֽשֻׁעָתֵ֥ךְ אָֽנִי
Psalms 35:3 [KJV]  Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

Psalms 35:4 [HEB]  יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֣וֹר וְיַחְפְּר֑וּ חֹ֝שְׁבֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי
Psalms 35:4 [KJV]  Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

Psalms 35:5 [HEB]  יִֽהְי֗וּ כְּמֹ֥ץ לִפְנֵי ר֑וּחַ וּמַלְאַ֖ךְ יְהוָ֣ה דּוֹחֶֽה
Psalms 35:5 [KJV]  Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.

Psalms 35:6 [HEB]  יְֽהִי דַרְכָּ֗ם חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וַחֲלַקְלַקּ֑וֹת וּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְ֝הוָ֗ה רֹדְפָֽם
Psalms 35:6 [KJV]  Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.

Psalms 35:7 [HEB]  כִּֽי חִנָּ֣ם טָֽמְנוּ לִ֭י שַׁ֣חַת רִשְׁתָּ֑ם חִ֝נָּ֗ם חָפְר֥וּ לְנַפְשִֽׁי
Psalms 35:7 [KJV]  For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.

Psalms 35:8 [HEB]  תְּבוֹאֵ֣הוּ שׁוֹאָה֮ לֹֽא יֵ֫דָ֥ע וְרִשְׁתּ֣וֹ אֲשֶׁר טָמַ֣ן תִּלְכְּד֑וֹ בְּ֝שׁוֹאָ֗ה יִפָּל בָּֽהּ
Psalms 35:8 [KJV]  Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

Psalms 35:9 [HEB]  וְ֭נַפְשִׁי תָּגִ֣יל בַּיהוָ֑ה תָּ֝שִׂישׂ בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ
Psalms 35:9 [KJV]  And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

Psalms 35:10 [HEB]  כָּ֥ל עַצְמוֹתַ֨י תֹּאמַרְנָה֮ יְהוָ֗ה מִ֥י כָ֫מ֥וֹךָ מַצִּ֣יל עָ֭נִי מֵחָזָ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן מִגֹּזְלֽוֹ
Psalms 35:10 [KJV]  All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

Psalms 35:11 [HEB]  יְ֭קוּמוּן עֵדֵ֣י חָמָ֑ס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי יִשְׁאָלֽוּנִי
Psalms 35:11 [KJV]  False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

Psalms 35:12 [HEB]  יְשַׁלְּמ֣וּנִי רָ֭עָה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָ֗ה שְׁכ֣וֹל לְנַפְשִֽׁי
Psalms 35:12 [KJV]  They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

Psalms 35:13 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֤י בַּחֲלוֹתָ֡ם לְב֬וּשִׁי שָׂ֗ק עִנֵּ֣יתִי בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י עַל חֵיקִ֥י תָשֽׁוּב
Psalms 35:13 [KJV]  But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

Psalms 35:14 [HEB]  כְּרֵֽעַ כְּאָ֣ח לִ֭י הִתְהַלָּ֑כְתִּי כַּאֲבֶל אֵ֝֗ם קֹדֵ֥ר שַׁחֽוֹתִי
Psalms 35:14 [KJV]  I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

Psalms 35:15 [HEB]  וּבְצַלְעִי֮ שָׂמְח֪וּ וְֽנֶאֱ֫סָ֥פוּ נֶאֶסְפ֬וּ עָלַ֣י נֵ֭כִים וְלֹ֣א יָדַ֑עְתִּי קָֽרְע֥וּ וְלֹא דָֽמּוּ
Psalms 35:15 [KJV]  But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:

Psalms 35:16 [HEB]  בְּ֭חַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵ֣י מָע֑וֹג חָרֹ֖ק עָלַ֣י שִׁנֵּֽימוֹ
Psalms 35:16 [KJV]  With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

Psalms 35:17 [HEB]  אֲדֹנָי֮ כַּמָּ֪ה תִּ֫רְאֶ֥ה הָשִׁ֣יבָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶ֑ם מִ֝כְּפִירִ֗ים יְחִידָתִֽי
Psalms 35:17 [KJV]  Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

Psalms 35:18 [HEB]  א֭וֹדְךָ בְּקָהָ֣ל רָ֑ב בְּעַ֖ם עָצ֣וּם אֲהַֽלְלֶֽךָּ
Psalms 35:18 [KJV]  I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

Psalms 35:19 [HEB]  אַֽל יִשְׂמְחוּ לִ֣י אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר שֹׂנְאַ֥י חִ֝נָּ֗ם יִקְרְצוּ עָֽיִן
Psalms 35:19 [KJV]  Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

Psalms 35:20 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹ֥א שָׁל֗וֹם יְדַ֫בֵּ֥רוּ וְעַ֥ל רִגְעֵי אֶ֑רֶץ דִּבְרֵ֥י מִ֝רְמוֹת יַחֲשֹׁבֽוּן
Psalms 35:20 [KJV]  For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

Psalms 35:21 [HEB]  וַיַּרְחִ֥יבוּ עָלַ֗י פִּ֫יהֶ֥ם אָ֭מְרוּ הֶאָ֣ח הֶאָ֑ח רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֵֽינוּ
Psalms 35:21 [KJV]  Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.

Psalms 35:22 [HEB]  רָאִ֣יתָה יְ֭הוָה אַֽל תֶּחֱרַ֑שׁ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אֲל תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי
Psalms 35:22 [KJV]  This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

Psalms 35:23 [HEB]  הָעִ֣ירָה וְ֭הָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִ֑י אֱלֹהַ֖י וַֽאדֹנָ֣י לְרִיבִֽי
Psalms 35:23 [KJV]  Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

Psalms 35:24 [HEB]  שָׁפְטֵ֣נִי כְ֭צִדְקְךָ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֗י וְאַל יִשְׂמְחוּ לִֽי
Psalms 35:24 [KJV]  Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

Psalms 35:25 [HEB]  אַל יֹאמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם הֶאָ֣ח נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ אַל יֹ֝אמְר֗וּ בִּֽלַּעֲנֽוּהוּ
Psalms 35:25 [KJV]  Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

Psalms 35:26 [HEB]  יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ יַחְדָּו֮ שְׂמֵחֵ֪י רָעָ֫תִ֥י יִֽלְבְּשׁוּ בֹ֥שֶׁת וּכְלִמָּ֑ה הַֽמַּגְדִּילִ֥ים עָלָֽי
Psalms 35:26 [KJV]  Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

Psalms 35:27 [HEB]  יָרֹ֣נּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ֮ חֲפֵצֵ֪י צִ֫דְקִ֥י וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה הֶ֝חָפֵ֗ץ שְׁל֣וֹם עַבְדּֽוֹ
Psalms 35:27 [KJV]  Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

Psalms 35:28 [HEB]  וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקֶ֑ךָ כָּל הַ֝יּוֹם תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
Psalms 35:28 [KJV]  And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.


--- Psalms Chapter 36 ---
Psalms 36:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לְעֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֬ה לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 36:1 [KJV]  The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

Psalms 36:2 [HEB]  נְאֻֽם פֶּ֣שַׁע לָ֭רָשָׁע בְּקֶ֣רֶב לִבִּ֑י אֵֽין פַּ֥חַד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו
Psalms 36:2 [KJV]  For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

Psalms 36:3 [HEB]  כִּֽי הֶחֱלִ֣יק אֵלָ֣יו בְּעֵינָ֑יו לִמְצֹ֖א עֲוֺנ֣וֹ לִשְׂנֹֽא
Psalms 36:3 [KJV]  The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

Psalms 36:4 [HEB]  דִּבְרֵי פִ֭יו אָ֣וֶן וּמִרְמָ֑ה חָדַ֖ל לְהַשְׂכִּ֣יל לְהֵיטִֽיב
Psalms 36:4 [KJV]  He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

Psalms 36:5 [HEB]  אָ֤וֶן יַחְשֹׁ֗ב עַֽל מִשְׁכָּ֫ב֥וֹ יִ֭תְיַצֵּב עַל דֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא ט֑וֹב רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א יִמְאָֽס
Psalms 36:5 [KJV]  Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

Psalms 36:6 [HEB]  יְ֭הוָה בְּהַשָּׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ עַד שְׁחָקִֽים
Psalms 36:6 [KJV]  Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.

Psalms 36:7 [HEB]  צִדְקָֽתְךָ֨ כְּֽהַרְרֵי אֵ֗ל מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה אָ֤דָֽם וּבְהֵמָ֖ה תוֹשִׁ֣יעַ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 36:7 [KJV]  How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

Psalms 36:8 [HEB]  מַה יָּקָ֥ר חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים וּבְנֵ֥י אָדָ֑ם בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ יֶחֱסָיֽוּן
Psalms 36:8 [KJV]  They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

Psalms 36:9 [HEB]  יִ֭רְוְיֻן מִדֶּ֣שֶׁן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְנַ֖חַל עֲדָנֶ֣יךָ תַשְׁקֵֽם
Psalms 36:9 [KJV]  For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

Psalms 36:10 [HEB]  כִּֽי עִ֭מְּךָ מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים בְּ֝אוֹרְךָ֗ נִרְאֶה אֽוֹר
Psalms 36:10 [KJV]  O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

Psalms 36:11 [HEB]  מְשֹׁ֣ךְ חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶ֑יךָ וְ֝צִדְקָֽתְךָ֗ לְיִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
Psalms 36:11 [KJV]  Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

Psalms 36:12 [HEB]  אַל תְּ֭בוֹאֵנִי רֶ֣גֶל גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְיַד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַל תְּנִדֵֽנִי
Psalms 36:12 [KJV]  There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

Psalms 36:13 [HEB]  שָׁ֣ם נָ֭פְלוּ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן דֹּ֝ח֗וּ וְלֹא יָ֥כְלוּ קֽוּם
Psalms 36:13 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 37 ---
Psalms 37:1 [HEB]  לְדָוִ֨ד אַל תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בְּעֹשֵׂ֥י עַוְלָֽה
Psalms 37:1 [KJV]  Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

Psalms 37:2 [HEB]  כִּ֣י כֶ֭חָצִיר מְהֵרָ֣ה יִמָּ֑לוּ וּכְיֶ֥רֶק דֶּ֝֗שֶׁא יִבּוֹלֽוּן
Psalms 37:2 [KJV]  For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

Psalms 37:3 [HEB]  בְּטַ֣ח בַּֽ֭יהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה
Psalms 37:3 [KJV]  Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

Psalms 37:4 [HEB]  וְהִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל יְהוָ֑ה וְיִֽתֶּן לְ֝ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽךָ
Psalms 37:4 [KJV]  Delight thyself also in the LORD: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

Psalms 37:5 [HEB]  גּ֣וֹל עַל יְהוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וּבְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗יו וְה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה
Psalms 37:5 [KJV]  Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

Psalms 37:6 [HEB]  וְהוֹצִ֣יא כָא֣וֹר צִדְקֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטֶ֗ךָ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם
Psalms 37:6 [KJV]  And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

Psalms 37:7 [HEB]  דּ֤וֹם לַיהוָה֮ וְהִתְח֪וֹלֵ֫ל ל֥וֹ אַל תִּ֭תְחַר בְּמַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ בְּ֝אִ֗ישׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְזִמּֽוֹת
Psalms 37:7 [KJV]  Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

Psalms 37:8 [HEB]  הֶ֣רֶף מֵ֭אַף וַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵמָ֑ה אַל תִּ֝תְחַ֗ר אַךְ לְהָרֵֽעַ
Psalms 37:8 [KJV]  Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

Psalms 37:9 [HEB]  כִּֽי מְ֭רֵעִים יִכָּרֵת֑וּן וְקֹוֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה הֵ֣מָּה יִֽירְשׁוּ אָֽרֶץ
Psalms 37:9 [KJV]  For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

Psalms 37:10 [HEB]  וְע֣וֹד מְ֭עַט וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְהִתְבּוֹנַ֖נְתָּ עַל מְקוֹמ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ
Psalms 37:10 [KJV]  For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

Psalms 37:11 [HEB]  וַעֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הִתְעַנְּג֗וּ עַל רֹ֥ב שָׁלֽוֹם
Psalms 37:11 [KJV]  But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

Psalms 37:12 [HEB]  זֹמֵ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וְחֹרֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו שִׁנָּֽיו
Psalms 37:12 [KJV]  The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

Psalms 37:13 [HEB]  אֲדֹנָ֥י יִשְׂחַק ל֑וֹ כִּֽי רָ֝אָ֗ה כִּֽי יָבֹ֥א יוֹמֽוֹ
Psalms 37:13 [KJV]  The LORD shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

Psalms 37:14 [HEB]  חֶ֤רֶב פָּֽתְח֣וּ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְדָרְכ֪וּ קַ֫שְׁתָּ֥ם לְ֭הַפִּיל עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן לִ֝טְב֗וֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי דָֽרֶךְ
Psalms 37:14 [KJV]  The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

Psalms 37:15 [HEB]  חַ֭רְבָּם תָּב֣וֹא בְלִבָּ֑ם וְ֝קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֗ם תִּשָּׁבַֽרְנָה
Psalms 37:15 [KJV]  Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

Psalms 37:16 [HEB]  טוֹב מְ֭עַט לַצַּדִּ֑יק מֵ֝הֲמ֗וֹן רְשָׁעִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
Psalms 37:16 [KJV]  A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

Psalms 37:17 [HEB]  כִּ֤י זְרוֹע֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַ֑רְנָה וְסוֹמֵ֖ךְ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְהוָֽה
Psalms 37:17 [KJV]  For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

Psalms 37:18 [HEB]  יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה יְמֵ֣י תְמִימִ֑ם וְ֝נַחֲלָתָ֗ם לְעוֹלָ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה
Psalms 37:18 [KJV]  The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

Psalms 37:19 [HEB]  לֹֽא יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֖י רְעָב֣וֹן יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ
Psalms 37:19 [KJV]  They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

Psalms 37:20 [HEB]  כִּ֤י רְשָׁעִ֨ים יֹאבֵ֗דוּ וְאֹיְבֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה כִּיקַ֣ר כָּרִ֑ים כָּל֖וּ בֶעָשָׁ֣ן כָּֽלוּ
Psalms 37:20 [KJV]  But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

Psalms 37:21 [HEB]  לֹוֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע וְלֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק חוֹנֵ֥ן וְנוֹתֵֽן
Psalms 37:21 [KJV]  The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

Psalms 37:22 [HEB]  כִּ֣י מְ֭בֹרָכָיו יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝מְקֻלָּלָ֗יו יִכָּרֵֽתוּ
Psalms 37:22 [KJV]  For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

Psalms 37:23 [HEB]  מֵ֭יְהוָה מִֽצְעֲדֵי גֶ֥בֶר כּוֹנָ֗נוּ וְדַרְכּ֥וֹ יֶחְפָּֽץ
Psalms 37:23 [KJV]  The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.

Psalms 37:24 [HEB]  כִּֽי יִפֹּ֥ל לֹֽא יוּטָ֑ל כִּֽי יְ֝הוָ֗ה סוֹמֵ֥ךְ יָדֽוֹ
Psalms 37:24 [KJV]  Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.

Psalms 37:25 [HEB]  נַ֤עַר הָיִ֗יתִי גַּם זָ֫קַ֥נְתִּי וְֽלֹא רָ֭אִיתִי צַדִּ֣יק נֶעֱזָ֑ב וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ לָֽחֶם
Psalms 37:25 [KJV]  I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

Psalms 37:26 [HEB]  כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ לִבְרָכָֽה
Psalms 37:26 [KJV]  He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

Psalms 37:27 [HEB]  ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה ט֗וֹב וּשְׁכֹ֥ן לְעוֹלָֽם
Psalms 37:27 [KJV]  Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

Psalms 37:28 [HEB]  כִּ֤י יְהוָ֨ה אֹ֘הֵ֤ב מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וְלֹא יַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת חֲ֭סִידָיו לְעוֹלָ֣ם נִשְׁמָ֑רוּ וְזֶ֖רַע רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽת
Psalms 37:28 [KJV]  For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

Psalms 37:29 [HEB]  צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ
Psalms 37:29 [KJV]  The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

Psalms 37:30 [HEB]  פִּֽי צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט
Psalms 37:30 [KJV]  The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

Psalms 37:31 [HEB]  תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהָ֣יו בְּלִבּ֑וֹ לֹ֖א תִמְעַ֣ד אֲשֻׁרָיו
Psalms 37:31 [KJV]  The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

Psalms 37:32 [HEB]  צוֹפֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּ֝מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ
Psalms 37:32 [KJV]  The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

Psalms 37:33 [HEB]  יְ֭הוָה לֹא יַעַזְבֶ֣נּוּ בְיָד֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יַ֝רְשִׁיעֶ֗נּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטֽוֹ
Psalms 37:33 [KJV]  The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

Psalms 37:34 [HEB]  קַוֵּ֤ה אֶל יְהוָ֨ה וּשְׁמֹ֬ר דַּרְכּ֗וֹ וִֽ֭ירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אָ֑רֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה
Psalms 37:34 [KJV]  Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

Psalms 37:35 [HEB]  רָ֭אִיתִי רָשָׁ֣ע עָרִ֑יץ וּ֝מִתְעָרֶ֗ה כְּאֶזְרָ֥ח רַעֲנָֽן
Psalms 37:35 [KJV]  I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

Psalms 37:36 [HEB]  וַ֭יַּֽעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּ֣ה אֵינֶ֑נּוּ וָֽ֝אֲבַקְשֵׁ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָֽא
Psalms 37:36 [KJV]  Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

Psalms 37:37 [HEB]  שְׁמָר תָּ֭ם וּרְאֵ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ר כִּֽי אַחֲרִ֖ית לְאִ֣ישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם
Psalms 37:37 [KJV]  Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

Psalms 37:38 [HEB]  וּֽ֭פֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו אַחֲרִ֖ית רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽתָה
Psalms 37:38 [KJV]  But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

Psalms 37:39 [HEB]  וּתְשׁוּעַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים מֵיְהוָ֑ה מָֽ֝עוּזָּ֗ם בְּעֵ֣ת צָרָֽה
Psalms 37:39 [KJV]  But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

Psalms 37:40 [HEB]  וַֽיַּעְזְרֵ֥ם יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיְפַ֫לְּטֵ֥ם יְפַלְּטֵ֣ם מֵ֭רְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם כִּי חָ֥סוּ בֽוֹ
Psalms 37:40 [KJV]  And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.


--- Psalms Chapter 38 ---
Psalms 38:1 [HEB]  מִזְמ֖וֹר לְדָוִ֣ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר
Psalms 38:1 [KJV]  O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

Psalms 38:2 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל בְּקֶצְפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי
Psalms 38:2 [KJV]  For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

Psalms 38:3 [HEB]  כִּֽי חִ֭צֶּיךָ נִ֣חֲתוּ בִ֑י וַתִּנְחַ֖ת עָלַ֣י יָדֶֽךָ
Psalms 38:3 [KJV]  There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

Psalms 38:4 [HEB]  אֵין מְתֹ֣ם בִּ֭בְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵ֣י זַעְמֶ֑ךָ אֵין שָׁל֥וֹם בַּ֝עֲצָמַ֗י מִפְּנֵ֥י חַטָּאתִֽי
Psalms 38:4 [KJV]  For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

Psalms 38:5 [HEB]  כִּ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי עָבְר֣וּ רֹאשִׁ֑י כְּמַשָּׂ֥א כָ֝בֵ֗ד יִכְבְּד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי
Psalms 38:5 [KJV]  My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

Psalms 38:6 [HEB]  הִבְאִ֣ישׁוּ נָ֭מַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָ֑י מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י אִוַּלְתִּֽי
Psalms 38:6 [KJV]  I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

Psalms 38:7 [HEB]  נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי שַׁחֹ֣תִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם קֹדֵ֥ר הִלָּֽכְתִּי
Psalms 38:7 [KJV]  For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

Psalms 38:8 [HEB]  כִּֽי כְ֭סָלַי מָלְא֣וּ נִקְלֶ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין מְ֝תֹ֗ם בִּבְשָׂרִֽי
Psalms 38:8 [KJV]  I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

Psalms 38:9 [HEB]  נְפוּג֣וֹתִי וְנִדְכֵּ֣יתִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד שָׁ֝אַ֗גְתִּי מִֽנַּהֲמַ֥ת לִבִּֽי
Psalms 38:9 [KJV]  Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

Psalms 38:10 [HEB]  אֲֽדֹנָי נֶגְדְּךָ֥ כָל תַּאֲוָתִ֑י וְ֝אַנְחָתִ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא נִסְתָּֽרָה
Psalms 38:10 [KJV]  My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

Psalms 38:11 [HEB]  לִבִּ֣י סְ֭חַרְחַר עֲזָבַ֣נִי כֹחִ֑י וְֽאוֹר עֵינַ֥י גַּם הֵ֝֗ם אֵ֣ין אִתִּֽי
Psalms 38:11 [KJV]  My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

Psalms 38:12 [HEB]  אֹֽהֲבַ֨י וְרֵעַ֗י מִנֶּ֣גֶד נִגְעִ֣י יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וּ֝קְרוֹבַ֗י מֵרָחֹ֥ק עָמָֽדוּ
Psalms 38:12 [KJV]  They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

Psalms 38:13 [HEB]  וַיְנַקְשׁ֤וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י נַפְשִׁ֗י וְדֹרְשֵׁ֣י רָ֭עָתִי דִּבְּר֣וּ הַוּ֑וֹת וּ֝מִרְמ֗וֹת כָּל הַיּ֥וֹם יֶהְגּֽוּ
Psalms 38:13 [KJV]  But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

Psalms 38:14 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֣י כְ֭חֵרֵשׁ לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וּ֝כְאִלֵּ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח פִּֽיו
Psalms 38:14 [KJV]  Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

Psalms 38:15 [HEB]  וָאֱהִ֗י כְּ֭אִישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא שֹׁמֵ֑עַ וְאֵ֥ין בְּ֝פִ֗יו תּוֹכָחֽוֹת
Psalms 38:15 [KJV]  For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

Psalms 38:16 [KJV]  For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

Psalms 38:17 [HEB]  כִּֽי אָ֭מַרְתִּי פֶּן יִשְׂמְחוּ לִ֑י בְּמ֥וֹט רַ֝גְלִ֗י עָלַ֥י הִגְדִּֽילוּ
Psalms 38:17 [KJV]  For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

Psalms 38:18 [HEB]  כִּֽי אֲ֭נִי לְצֶ֣לַע נָכ֑וֹן וּמַכְאוֹבִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד
Psalms 38:18 [KJV]  For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

Psalms 38:19 [HEB]  כִּֽי עֲוֺנִ֥י אַגִּ֑יד אֶ֝דְאַ֗ג מֵֽחַטָּאתִֽי
Psalms 38:19 [KJV]  But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

Psalms 38:20 [HEB]  וְֽ֭אֹיְבַי חַיִּ֣ים עָצֵ֑מוּ וְרַבּ֖וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י שָֽׁקֶר
Psalms 38:20 [KJV]  They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

Psalms 38:21 [HEB]  וּמְשַׁלְּמֵ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה יִ֝שְׂטְנ֗וּנִי תַּ֣חַת רדופי רָֽדְפִי טֽוֹב
Psalms 38:21 [KJV]  Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.

Psalms 38:22 [HEB]  אַל תַּֽעַזְבֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי
Psalms 38:22 [KJV]  Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

Psalms 38:23 [HEB]  ח֥וּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתִֽי

Psalms 39:6 [KJV]  Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

Psalms 39:7 [HEB]  אַךְ בְּצֶ֤לֶם יִֽתְהַלֶּךְ אִ֗ישׁ אַךְ הֶ֥בֶל יֶהֱמָי֑וּן יִ֝צְבֹּ֗ר וְֽלֹא יֵדַ֥ע מִי אֹסְפָֽם
Psalms 39:7 [KJV]  And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

Psalms 39:8 [HEB]  וְעַתָּ֣ה מַה קִּוִּ֣יתִי אֲדֹנָ֑י תּ֝וֹחַלְתִּ֗י לְךָ֣ הִֽיא
Psalms 39:8 [KJV]  Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

Psalms 39:9 [KJV]  I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.

Psalms 39:10 [HEB]  נֶ֭אֱלַמְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶפְתַּח פִּ֑י כִּ֖י אַתָּ֣ה עָשִֽׂיתָ
Psalms 39:10 [KJV]  Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

Psalms 39:11 [HEB]  הָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י נִגְעֶ֑ךָ מִתִּגְרַ֥ת יָ֝דְךָ֗ אֲנִ֣י כָלִֽיתִי
Psalms 39:11 [KJV]  When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

Psalms 39:12 [HEB]  בְּֽתוֹכָ֘ח֤וֹת עַל עָוֺ֨ן יִסַּ֬רְתָּ אִ֗ישׁ וַתֶּ֣מֶס כָּעָ֣שׁ חֲמוּד֑וֹ אַ֤ךְ הֶ֖בֶל כָּל אָדָ֣ם סֶֽלָה

Psalms 39:13 [HEB]  שִֽׁמְעָ֥ה תְפִלָּתִ֨י יְהוָ֡ה וְשַׁוְעָתִ֨י הַאֲזִינָה֮ אֶֽל דִּמְעָתִ֗י אַֽל תֶּ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ כִּ֤י גֵ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י עִמָּ֑ךְ תּ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב כְּכָל אֲבוֹתָֽי
Psalms 39:13 [KJV]  O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

Psalms 39:14 [HEB]  הָשַׁ֣ע מִמֶּ֣נִּי וְאַבְלִ֑יגָה בְּטֶ֖רֶם אֵלֵ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶֽנִּי

--- Psalms Chapter 40 ---

Psalms 40:5 [KJV]  Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

Psalms 40:6 [KJV]  Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

Psalms 40:7 [KJV]  Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

Psalms 40:8 [HEB]  אָ֣ז אָ֭מַרְתִּי הִנֵּה בָ֑אתִי בִּמְגִלַּת סֵ֝֗פֶר כָּת֥וּב עָלָֽי
Psalms 40:8 [KJV]  I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

Psalms 40:9 [HEB]  לַֽעֲשֽׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֣י חָפָ֑צְתִּי וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי
Psalms 40:9 [KJV]  I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.

Psalms 40:10 [KJV]  I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

Psalms 40:11 [HEB]  צִדְקָתְךָ֬ לֹא כִסִּ֨יתִי בְּת֬וֹךְ לִבִּ֗י אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ אָמָ֑רְתִּי לֹא כִחַ֥דְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ לְקָהָ֥ל רָֽב
Psalms 40:11 [KJV]  Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

Psalms 40:12 [HEB]  אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה לֹא תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי
Psalms 40:12 [KJV]  For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

Psalms 40:13 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אָפְפ֥וּ עָלַ֨י רָע֡וֹת עַד אֵ֬ין מִסְפָּ֗ר הִשִּׂיג֣וּנִי עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי וְלֹא יָכֹ֣לְתִּי לִרְא֑וֹת עָצְמ֥וּ מִשַּֽׂעֲר֥וֹת רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י וְלִבִּ֥י עֲזָבָֽנִי
Psalms 40:13 [KJV]  Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.

Psalms 40:14 [HEB]  רְצֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה
Psalms 40:14 [KJV]  Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

Psalms 40:15 [HEB]  יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ יַחַד֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י לִסְפּ֫וֹתָ֥הּ יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי
Psalms 40:15 [KJV]  Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

Psalms 40:16 [HEB]  יָ֭שֹׁמּוּ עַל עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לִ֝֗י הֶ֘אָ֥ח הֶאָֽח
Psalms 40:16 [KJV]  Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

Psalms 40:17 [HEB]  יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ יֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה אֹֽ֝הֲבֵ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 40:17 [KJV]  But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

Psalms 40:18 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֤י עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֲדֹנָ֪י יַחֲשָׁ֫ב לִ֥י עֶזְרָתִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל תְּאַחַֽר
Psalms 40:18 [KJV]

Psalms 41:2 [HEB]  אַ֭שְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּ֣יל אֶל דָּ֑ל בְּי֥וֹם רָ֝עָ֗ה יְֽמַלְּטֵ֥הוּ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 41:2 [KJV]  The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

Psalms 41:3 [HEB]  יְהוָ֤ה יִשְׁמְרֵ֣הוּ וִֽ֭יחַיֵּהוּ יאשר וְאֻשַּׁ֣ר בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְאַֽל תִּ֝תְּנֵ֗הוּ בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ אֹיְבָֽיו
Psalms 41:3 [KJV]  The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

Psalms 41:4 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְעָדֶנּוּ עַל עֶ֣רֶשׂ דְּוָ֑י כָּל מִ֝שְׁכָּב֗וֹ הָפַ֥כְתָּ בְחָלְיֽוֹ
Psalms 41:4 [KJV]  I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

Psalms 41:5 [HEB]  אֲֽנִי אָ֭מַרְתִּי יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑נִי רְפָאָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י כִּי חָטָ֥אתִי לָֽךְ
Psalms 41:5 [KJV]  Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

Psalms 41:6 [HEB]  אוֹיְבַ֗י יֹאמְר֣וּ רַ֣ע לִ֑י מָתַ֥י יָ֝מ֗וּת וְאָבַ֥ד שְׁמֽוֹ
Psalms 41:6 [KJV]  And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

Psalms 41:7 [HEB]  וְאִם בָּ֤א לִרְא֨וֹת שָׁ֤וְא יְדַבֵּ֗ר לִבּ֗וֹ יִקְבָּץ אָ֥וֶן ל֑וֹ יֵצֵ֖א לַח֣וּץ יְדַבֵּֽר
Psalms 41:7 [KJV]  All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

Psalms 41:8 [HEB]  יַ֗חַד עָלַ֣י יִ֭תְלַחֲשׁוּ כָּל שֹׂנְאָ֑י עָלַ֓י יַחְשְׁב֖וּ רָעָ֣ה לִֽי
Psalms 41:8 [KJV]  An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

Psalms 41:9 [HEB]  דְּֽבַר בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָצ֣וּק בּ֑וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁ֝כַ֗ב לֹא יוֹסִ֥יף לָקֽוּם
Psalms 41:9 [KJV]  Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

Psalms 41:10 [HEB]  גַּם אִ֤ישׁ שְׁלוֹמִ֨י אֲשֶׁר בָּטַ֣חְתִּי ב֭וֹ אוֹכֵ֣ל לַחְמִ֑י הִגְדִּ֖יל עָלַ֣י עָקֵֽב
Psalms 41:10 [KJV]  But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

Psalms 41:11 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה חָנֵּ֥נִי וַהֲקִימֵ֑נִי וַֽאֲשַׁלְּמָ֥ה לָהֶֽם
Psalms 41:11 [KJV]  By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

Psalms 41:12 [HEB]  בְּזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּֽי חָפַ֣צְתָּ בִּ֑י כִּ֤י לֹֽא יָרִ֖יעַ אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי
Psalms 41:12 [KJV]  And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

Psalms 41:13 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֗י בְּ֭תֻמִּי תָּמַ֣כְתָּ בִּ֑י וַתַּצִּיבֵ֖נִי לְפָנֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָֽם
Psalms 41:13 [KJV]  Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

Psalms 41:14 [HEB]  בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵֽ֭הָעוֹלָם וְעַ֥ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן וְאָמֵֽן
Psalms 41:14 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 42 ---
Psalms 42:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לִבְנֵי קֹֽרַח

Psalms 42:2 [HEB]  כְּאַיָּ֗ל תַּעֲרֹ֥ג עַל אֲפִֽיקֵי מָ֑יִם כֵּ֤ן נַפְשִׁ֨י תַעֲרֹ֖ג אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 42:2 [KJV]  My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

Psalms 42:3 [HEB]  צָמְאָ֬ה נַפְשִׁ֨י לֵאלֹהִים֮ לְאֵ֪ל חָ֥י מָתַ֥י אָב֑וֹא וְ֝אֵרָאֶ֗ה פְּנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים

Psalms 42:4 [KJV]  When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

Psalms 42:5 [HEB]  אֵ֤לֶּה אֶזְכְּרָ֨ה וְאֶשְׁפְּכָ֬ה עָלַ֨י נַפְשִׁ֗י כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱבֹ֨ר בַּסָּךְ֮ אֶדַּדֵּ֗ם עַד בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים בְּקוֹל רִנָּ֥ה וְתוֹדָ֗ה הָמ֥וֹן חוֹגֵֽג
Psalms 42:5 [KJV]  Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

Psalms 42:6 [HEB]  מַה תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י נַפְשִׁי֮ וַתֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי ע֥וֹד אוֹדֶ֗נּוּ יְשׁוּע֥וֹת פָּנָֽיו
Psalms 42:6 [KJV]  O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

Psalms 42:7 [HEB]  אֱֽלֹהַ֗י עָלַי֮ נַפְשִׁ֪י תִשְׁתּ֫וֹחָ֥ח עַל כֵּ֗ן אֶ֭זְכָּרְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יַרְדֵּ֑ן וְ֝חֶרְמוֹנִ֗ים מֵהַ֥ר מִצְעָֽר
Psalms 42:7 [KJV]  Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

Psalms 42:8 [HEB]  תְּהֽוֹם אֶל תְּה֣וֹם ק֭וֹרֵא לְק֣וֹל צִנּוֹרֶ֑יךָ כָּֽל מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥יךָ וְ֝גַלֶּ֗יךָ עָלַ֥י עָבָֽרוּ
Psalms 42:8 [KJV]  Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

Psalms 42:9 [HEB]  יוֹמָ֤ם יְצַוֶּ֬ה יְהוָ֨ה חַסְדּ֗וֹ וּ֭בַלַּיְלָה שירה שִׁיר֣וֹ עִמִּ֑י תְּ֝פִלָּ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל חַיָּֽי
Psalms 42:9 [KJV]  I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

Psalms 42:10 [HEB]  אוֹמְרָ֤ה לְאֵ֥ל סַלְעִי֮ לָמָ֪ה שְׁכַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה קֹדֵ֥ר אֵלֵ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב
Psalms 42:10 [KJV]  As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

Psalms 42:11 [HEB]  בְּרֶ֤צַח בְּֽעַצְמוֹתַ֗י חֵרְפ֥וּנִי צוֹרְרָ֑י בְּאָמְרָ֥ם אֵלַ֥י כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אַיֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ
Psalms 42:11 [KJV]  Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

Psalms 42:12 [HEB]  מַה תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵֽאלֹהָֽי

--- Psalms Chapter 43 ---

Psalms 43:2 [KJV]  For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
