Psalms 43:3 [KJV]  O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

Psalms 43:4 [HEB]  וְאָב֤וֹאָה אֶל מִזְבַּ֬ח אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל אֵל֮ שִׂמְחַ֪ת גִּ֫ילִ֥י וְאוֹדְךָ֥ בְכִנּ֗וֹר אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהָֽי
Psalms 43:4 [KJV]  Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

Psalms 43:5 [HEB]  מַה תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵֽאלֹהָֽי
Psalms 43:5 [KJV]  Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.


--- Psalms Chapter 44 ---
Psalms 44:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִבְנֵי קֹ֬רַח מַשְׂכִּֽיל
Psalms 44:1 [KJV]  We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

Psalms 44:2 [HEB]  אֱלֹהִ֤ים בְּאָזְנֵ֬ינוּ שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵ֥ינוּ סִפְּרוּ לָ֑נוּ פֹּ֥עַל פָּעַ֥לְתָּ בִֽ֝ימֵיהֶ֗ם בִּ֣ימֵי קֶֽדֶם
Psalms 44:2 [KJV]  How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

Psalms 44:3 [HEB]  אַתָּ֤ה יָדְךָ֡ גּוֹיִ֣ם ה֭וֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵ֑ם תָּרַ֥ע לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽם
Psalms 44:3 [KJV]  For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

Psalms 44:4 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹ֪א בְחַרְבָּ֡ם יָ֥רְשׁוּ אָ֗רֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם֮ לֹא הוֹשִׁ֪יעָ֫ה לָּ֥מוֹ כִּֽי יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וּ֭זְרוֹעֲךָ וְא֥וֹר פָּנֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣י רְצִיתָֽם
Psalms 44:4 [KJV]  Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

Psalms 44:5 [HEB]  אַתָּה ה֣וּא מַלְכִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים צַ֝וֵּ֗ה יְשׁוּע֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב
Psalms 44:5 [KJV]  Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

Psalms 44:6 [HEB]  בְּ֭ךָ צָרֵ֣ינוּ נְנַגֵּ֑חַ בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ נָב֥וּס קָמֵֽינוּ
Psalms 44:6 [KJV]  For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

Psalms 44:7 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְקַשְׁתִּ֣י אֶבְטָ֑ח וְ֝חַרְבִּ֗י לֹ֣א תוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי
Psalms 44:7 [KJV]  But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

Psalms 44:8 [HEB]  כִּ֣י ה֭וֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵ֥ינוּ הֱבִישֽׁוֹתָ
Psalms 44:8 [KJV]  In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

Psalms 44:9 [HEB]  בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים הִלַּלְ֣נוּ כָל הַיּ֑וֹם וְשִׁמְךָ֓ לְעוֹלָ֖ם נוֹדֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה
Psalms 44:9 [KJV]  But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

Psalms 44:10 [HEB]  אַף זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא תֵ֝צֵ֗א בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ
Psalms 44:10 [KJV]  Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

Psalms 44:11 [HEB]  תְּשִׁיבֵ֣נוּ אָ֭חוֹר מִנִּי צָ֑ר וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֵ֗ינוּ שָׁ֣סוּ לָֽמוֹ
Psalms 44:11 [KJV]  Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

Psalms 44:12 [HEB]  תִּ֭תְּנֵנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן מַאֲכָ֑ל וּ֝בַגּוֹיִ֗ם זֵרִיתָֽנוּ
Psalms 44:12 [KJV]  Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.

Psalms 44:13 [HEB]  תִּמְכֹּֽר עַמְּךָ֥ בְלֹא ה֑וֹן וְלֹ֥א רִ֝בִּ֗יתָ בִּמְחִירֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 44:13 [KJV]  Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

Psalms 44:14 [HEB]  תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ
Psalms 44:14 [KJV]  Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

Psalms 44:15 [HEB]  תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭שָׁל בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם מְנֽוֹד רֹ֝֗אשׁ בַּל אֻמִּֽים
Psalms 44:15 [KJV]  My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

Psalms 44:16 [HEB]  כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִ֣י נֶגְדִּ֑י וּבֹ֖שֶׁת פָּנַ֣י כִּסָּֽתְנִי
Psalms 44:16 [KJV]  For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

Psalms 44:17 [HEB]  מִ֭קּוֹל מְחָרֵ֣ף וּמְגַדֵּ֑ף מִפְּנֵ֥י א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם
Psalms 44:17 [KJV]  All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

Psalms 44:18 [HEB]  כָּל זֹ֣את בָּ֭אַתְנוּ וְלֹ֣א שְׁכַחֲנ֑וּךָ וְלֹֽא שִׁ֝קַּ֗רְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶֽךָ
Psalms 44:18 [KJV]  Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

Psalms 44:19 [HEB]  לֹא נָס֣וֹג אָח֣וֹר לִבֵּ֑נוּ וַתֵּ֥ט אֲשֻׁרֵ֗ינוּ מִנִּ֥י אָרְחֶֽךָ
Psalms 44:19 [KJV]  Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

Psalms 44:20 [HEB]  כִּ֣י דִ֭כִּיתָנוּ בִּמְק֣וֹם תַּנִּ֑ים וַתְּכַ֖ס עָלֵ֣ינוּ בְצַלְמָֽוֶת
Psalms 44:20 [KJV]  If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

Psalms 48:5 [KJV]  They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

Psalms 48:6 [HEB]  הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ כֵּ֣ן תָּמָ֑הוּ נִבְהֲל֥וּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ
Psalms 48:6 [KJV]  Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

Psalms 48:7 [HEB]  רְ֭עָדָה אֲחָזָ֣תַם שָׁ֑ם חִ֝֗יל כַּיּוֹלֵֽדָה
Psalms 48:7 [KJV]  Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

Psalms 48:8 [HEB]  בְּר֥וּחַ קָדִ֑ים תְּ֝שַׁבֵּ֗ר אֳנִיּ֥וֹת תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ
Psalms 48:8 [KJV]  As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

Psalms 48:9 [HEB]  כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ כֵּ֤ן רָאִ֗ינוּ בְּעִיר יְהוָ֣ה צְ֭בָאוֹת בְּעִ֣יר אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֱלֹ֘הִ֤ים יְכוֹנְנֶ֖הָ עַד עוֹלָ֣ם סֶֽלָה
Psalms 48:9 [KJV]  We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

Psalms 48:10 [HEB]  דִּמִּ֣ינוּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ בְּ֝קֶ֗רֶב הֵיכָלֶֽךָ
Psalms 48:10 [KJV]  According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

Psalms 48:11 [HEB]  כְּשִׁמְךָ֤ אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן תְּ֭הִלָּתְךָ עַל קַצְוֵי אֶ֑רֶץ צֶ֝֗דֶק מָלְאָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ
Psalms 48:11 [KJV]  Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

Psalms 48:12 [HEB]  יִשְׂמַ֤ח הַר צִיּ֗וֹן תָּ֭גֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ
Psalms 48:12 [KJV]  Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

Psalms 48:13 [HEB]  סֹ֣בּוּ צִ֭יּוֹן וְהַקִּיפ֑וּהָ סִ֝פְר֗וּ מִגְדָּלֶֽיהָ
Psalms 48:13 [KJV]  Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

Psalms 48:14 [HEB]  שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּכֶ֨ם לְֽחֵילָ֗ה פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ לְד֣וֹר אַחֲרֽוֹן
Psalms 48:14 [KJV]  For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

Psalms 48:15 [HEB]  כִּ֤י זֶ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד ה֖וּא יְנַהֲגֵ֣נוּ עַל מֽוּת
Psalms 48:15 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 49 ---
Psalms 49:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִבְנֵי קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר
Psalms 49:1 [KJV]  Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:

Psalms 49:2 [HEB]  שִׁמְעוּ זֹ֭את כָּל הָֽעַמִּ֑ים הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינוּ כָּל יֹ֥שְׁבֵי חָֽלֶד
Psalms 49:2 [KJV]  Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

Psalms 49:3 [HEB]  גַּם בְּנֵ֣י אָ֭דָם גַּם בְּנֵי אִ֑ישׁ יַ֝֗חַד עָשִׁ֥יר וְאֶבְיֽוֹן
Psalms 49:3 [KJV]  My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

Psalms 49:4 [HEB]  פִּ֭י יְדַבֵּ֣ר חָכְמ֑וֹת וְהָג֖וּת לִבִּ֣י תְבוּנֽוֹת
Psalms 49:4 [KJV]  I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

Psalms 49:5 [HEB]  אַטֶּ֣ה לְמָשָׁ֣ל אָזְנִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֥ח בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר חִידָתִֽי
Psalms 49:5 [KJV]  Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

Psalms 49:6 [HEB]  לָ֣מָּה אִ֭ירָא בִּ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עֲוֺ֖ן עֲקֵבַ֣י יְסוּבֵּֽנִי
Psalms 49:6 [KJV]  They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

Psalms 49:7 [HEB]  הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים עַל חֵילָ֑ם וּבְרֹ֥ב עָ֝שְׁרָ֗ם יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ
Psalms 49:7 [KJV]  None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

Psalms 49:8 [HEB]  אָ֗ח לֹא פָדֹ֣ה יִפְדֶּ֣ה אִ֑ישׁ לֹא יִתֵּ֖ן לֵאלֹהִ֣ים כָּפְרֽוֹ
Psalms 49:8 [KJV]  (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

Psalms 49:9 [HEB]  וְ֭יֵקַר פִּדְי֥וֹן נַפְשָׁ֗ם וְחָדַ֥ל לְעוֹלָֽם
Psalms 49:9 [KJV]  That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

Psalms 49:10 [HEB]  וִֽיחִי ע֥וֹד לָנֶ֑צַח לֹ֖א יִרְאֶ֣ה הַשָּֽׁחַת
Psalms 49:10 [KJV]  For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

Psalms 49:11 [HEB]  כִּ֤י יִרְאֶ֨ה חֲכָ֘מִ֤ים יָמ֗וּתוּ יַ֤חַד כְּסִ֣יל וָבַ֣עַר יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וְעָזְב֖וּ לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים חֵילָֽם
Psalms 49:11 [KJV]  Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

Psalms 49:12 [HEB]  קִרְבָּ֤ם בָּתֵּ֨ימוֹ לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם מִ֭שְׁכְּנֹתָם לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר קָֽרְא֥וּ בִ֝שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עֲלֵ֣י אֲדָמֽוֹת
Psalms 49:12 [KJV]  Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

Psalms 49:13 [HEB]  וְאָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר בַּל יָלִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ
Psalms 49:13 [KJV]  This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

Psalms 49:14 [HEB]  זֶ֣ה דַ֭רְכָּם כֵּ֣סֶל לָ֑מוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֓ם בְּפִיהֶ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 49:14 [KJV]  Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

Psalms 49:15 [HEB]  כַּצֹּ֤אן לִֽשְׁא֣וֹל שַׁתּוּ֮ מָ֤וֶת יִ֫רְעֵ֥ם וַיִּרְדּ֘וּ בָ֤ם יְשָׁרִ֨ים לַבֹּ֗קֶר וצירם וְ֭צוּרָם לְבַלּ֥וֹת שְׁא֗וֹל מִזְּבֻ֥ל לֽוֹ
Psalms 49:15 [KJV]  But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

Psalms 49:16 [HEB]  אַךְ אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִפְדֶּ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִֽיַּד שְׁא֑וֹל כִּ֖י יִקָּחֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה
Psalms 49:16 [KJV]  Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

Psalms 49:17 [HEB]  אַל תִּ֭ירָא כִּֽי יַעֲשִׁ֣ר אִ֑ישׁ כִּֽי יִ֝רְבֶּה כְּב֣וֹד בֵּיתֽוֹ
Psalms 49:17 [KJV]  For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

Psalms 49:18 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְ֭מוֹתוֹ יִקַּ֣ח הַכֹּ֑ל לֹא יֵרֵ֖ד אַחֲרָ֣יו כְּבוֹדֽוֹ
Psalms 49:18 [KJV]  Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.

Psalms 49:19 [HEB]  כִּֽי נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּ֣יו יְבָרֵ֑ךְ וְ֝יוֹדֻ֗ךָ כִּי תֵיטִ֥יב לָֽךְ
Psalms 49:19 [KJV]  He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

Psalms 49:20 [HEB]  תָּ֭בוֹא עַד דּ֣וֹר אֲבוֹתָ֑יו עַד נֵ֝֗צַח לֹ֣א יִרְאוּ אֽוֹר
Psalms 49:20 [KJV]  Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.

Psalms 49:21 [HEB]  אָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר וְלֹ֣א יָבִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ
Psalms 49:21 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 50 ---
Psalms 50:1 [HEB]  מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֵ֤ל אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים יְֽהוָ֗ה דִּבֶּ֥ר וַיִּקְרָא אָ֑רֶץ מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ עַד מְבֹאֽוֹ
Psalms 50:1 [KJV]  The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

Psalms 50:2 [HEB]  מִצִּיּ֥וֹן מִכְלַל יֹ֗פִי אֱלֹהִ֥ים הוֹפִֽיעַ
Psalms 50:2 [KJV]  Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

Psalms 50:3 [HEB]  יָ֤בֹ֥א אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽאַל יֶ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ אֵשׁ לְפָנָ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּ֝סְבִיבָ֗יו נִשְׂעֲרָ֥ה מְאֹֽד
Psalms 50:3 [KJV]  Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

Psalms 50:4 [HEB]  יִקְרָ֣א אֶל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם מֵעָ֑ל וְאֶל הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ לָדִ֥ין עַמּֽוֹ
Psalms 50:4 [KJV]  He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

Psalms 50:5 [HEB]  אִסְפוּ לִ֥י חֲסִידָ֑י כֹּרְתֵ֖י בְרִיתִ֣י עֲלֵי זָֽבַח
Psalms 50:5 [KJV]  Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

Psalms 50:6 [HEB]  וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֓ים שֹׁפֵ֖ט ה֣וּא סֶֽלָה
Psalms 50:6 [KJV]  And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.

Psalms 50:7 [HEB]  שִׁמְעָ֤ה עַמִּ֨י וַאֲדַבֵּ֗רָה יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֶ֣יךָ אָנֹֽכִי
Psalms 50:7 [KJV]  Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.

Psalms 50:8 [HEB]  לֹ֣א עַל זְ֭בָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶ֖יךָ לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד
Psalms 50:8 [KJV]  I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

Psalms 50:9 [HEB]  לֹא אֶקַּ֣ח מִבֵּיתְךָ֣ פָ֑ר מִ֝מִּכְלְאֹתֶ֗יךָ עַתּוּדִֽים
Psalms 50:9 [KJV]  I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

Psalms 50:10 [HEB]  כִּי לִ֥י כָל חַיְתוֹ יָ֑עַר בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת בְּהַרְרֵי אָֽלֶף
Psalms 50:10 [KJV]  For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

Psalms 50:11 [HEB]  יָ֭דַעְתִּי כָּל ע֣וֹף הָרִ֑ים וְזִ֥יז שָׂ֝דַ֗י עִמָּדִֽי
Psalms 50:11 [KJV]  I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

Psalms 50:12 [HEB]  אִם אֶ֭רְעַב לֹא אֹ֣מַר לָ֑ךְ כִּי לִ֥י תֵ֝בֵ֗ל וּמְלֹאָֽהּ
Psalms 50:12 [KJV]  If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

Psalms 50:13 [HEB]  הַֽ֭אוֹכַל בְּשַׂ֣ר אַבִּירִ֑ים וְדַ֖ם עַתּוּדִ֣ים אֶשְׁתֶּֽה
Psalms 50:13 [KJV]  Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

Psalms 50:14 [HEB]  זְבַ֣ח לֵאלֹהִ֣ים תּוֹדָ֑ה וְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְעֶלְי֣וֹן נְדָרֶֽיךָ
Psalms 50:14 [KJV]  Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

Psalms 50:15 [HEB]  וּ֭קְרָאֵנִי בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלֶּצְךָ֗ וּֽתְכַבְּדֵֽנִי
Psalms 50:15 [KJV]  And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

Psalms 50:16 [HEB]  וְלָ֤רָשָׁ֨ע אָ֘מַ֤ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים מַה לְּ֭ךָ לְסַפֵּ֣ר חֻקָּ֑י וַתִּשָּׂ֖א בְרִיתִ֣י עֲלֵי פִֽיךָ
Psalms 50:16 [KJV]  But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

Psalms 50:17 [HEB]  וְ֭אַתָּה שָׂנֵ֣אתָ מוּסָ֑ר וַתַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ דְּבָרַ֣י אַחֲרֶֽיךָ
Psalms 50:17 [KJV]  Seeing thou hatest instruction, and casteth my words behind thee.

Psalms 50:18 [HEB]  אִם רָאִ֣יתָ גַ֭נָּב וַתִּ֣רֶץ עִמּ֑וֹ וְעִ֖ם מְנָאֲפִ֣ים חֶלְקֶֽךָ
Psalms 50:18 [KJV]  When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

Psalms 50:19 [HEB]  פִּ֭יךָ שָׁלַ֣חְתָּ בְרָעָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנְךָ֗ תַּצְמִ֥יד מִרְמָֽה
Psalms 50:19 [KJV]  Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

Psalms 50:20 [HEB]  תֵּ֭שֵׁב בְּאָחִ֣יךָ תְדַבֵּ֑ר בְּבֶֽן אִ֝מְּךָ֗ תִּתֶּן דֹּֽפִי
Psalms 50:20 [KJV]  Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.

Psalms 50:21 [HEB]  אֵ֤לֶּה עָשִׂ֨יתָ וְֽהֶחֱרַ֗שְׁתִּי דִּמִּ֗יתָ הֱֽיוֹת אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה כָמ֑וֹךָ אוֹכִיחֲךָ֖ וְאֶֽעֶרְכָ֣ה לְעֵינֶֽיךָ
Psalms 50:21 [KJV]  These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

Psalms 50:22 [HEB]  בִּֽינוּ נָ֣א זֹ֭את שֹׁכְחֵ֣י אֱל֑וֹהַּ פֶּן אֶ֝טְרֹ֗ף וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל
Psalms 50:22 [KJV]  Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

Psalms 50:23 [HEB]  זֹבֵ֥חַ תּוֹדָ֗ה יְֽכַ֫בְּדָ֥נְנִי וְשָׂ֥ם דֶּ֑רֶךְ אַ֝רְאֶ֗נּוּ בְּיֵ֣שַׁע אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 50:23 [KJV]  Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.


--- Psalms Chapter 51 ---
Psalms 51:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 51:1 [KJV]  Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

Psalms 51:2 [HEB]  בְּֽבוֹא אֵ֭לָיו נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֑יא כַּֽאֲשֶׁר בָּ֝֗א אֶל בַּת שָֽׁבַע
Psalms 51:2 [KJV]  Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

Psalms 51:3 [HEB]  חָנֵּ֣נִי אֱלֹהִ֣ים כְּחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ מְחֵ֣ה פְשָׁעָֽי
Psalms 51:3 [KJV]  For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

Psalms 51:4 [HEB]  הרבה הֶ֭רֶב כַּבְּסֵ֣נִי מֵעֲוֺנִ֑י וּֽמֵחַטָּאתִ֥י טַהֲרֵֽנִי
Psalms 51:4 [KJV]  Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

Psalms 51:5 [HEB]  כִּֽי פְ֭שָׁעַי אֲנִ֣י אֵדָ֑ע וְחַטָּאתִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד
Psalms 51:5 [KJV]  Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

Psalms 51:6 [HEB]  לְךָ֤ לְבַדְּךָ֨ חָטָאתִי֮ וְהָרַ֥ע בְּעֵינֶ֗יךָ עָ֫שִׂ֥יתִי לְ֭מַעַן תִּצְדַּ֥ק בְּדָבְרֶ֗ךָ תִּזְכֶּ֥ה בְשָׁפְטֶֽךָ
Psalms 51:6 [KJV]  Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

Psalms 51:7 [HEB]  הֵן בְּעָו֥וֹן חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי וּ֝בְחֵ֗טְא יֶֽחֱמַ֥תְנִי אִמִּֽי
Psalms 51:7 [KJV]  Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

Psalms 51:8 [HEB]  הֵן אֱ֭מֶת חָפַ֣צְתָּ בַטֻּח֑וֹת וּ֝בְסָתֻ֗ם חָכְמָ֥ה תוֹדִיעֵֽנִי
Psalms 51:8 [KJV]  Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

Psalms 51:9 [HEB]  תְּחַטְּאֵ֣נִי בְאֵז֣וֹב וְאֶטְהָ֑ר תְּ֝כַבְּסֵ֗נִי וּמִשֶּׁ֥לֶג אַלְבִּֽין
Psalms 51:9 [KJV]  Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

Psalms 51:10 [HEB]  תַּ֭שְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְשִׂמְחָ֑ה תָּ֝גֵ֗לְנָה עֲצָמ֥וֹת דִּכִּֽיתָ
Psalms 51:10 [KJV]  Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

Psalms 51:11 [HEB]  הַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאָ֑י וְֽכָל עֲוֺ֖נֹתַ֣י מְחֵֽה
Psalms 51:11 [KJV]  Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

Psalms 51:12 [HEB]  לֵ֣ב טָ֭הוֹר בְּרָא לִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ נָ֝כ֗וֹן חַדֵּ֥שׁ בְּקִרְבִּֽי
Psalms 51:12 [KJV]  Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

Psalms 51:13 [HEB]  אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵ֥נִי מִלְּפָנֶ֑יךָ וְר֥וּחַ קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ אַל תִּקַּ֥ח מִמֶּֽנִּי
Psalms 51:13 [KJV]  Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

Psalms 51:14 [HEB]  הָשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֭י שְׂשׂ֣וֹן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וְר֖וּחַ נְדִיבָ֣ה תִסְמְכֵֽנִי
Psalms 51:14 [KJV]  Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

Psalms 51:15 [HEB]  אֲלַמְּדָ֣ה פֹשְׁעִ֣ים דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים אֵלֶ֥יךָ יָשֽׁוּבוּ
Psalms 51:15 [KJV]  O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

Psalms 51:16 [HEB]  הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִדָּמִ֨ים אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְּשׁוּעָתִ֑י תְּרַנֵּ֥ן לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י צִדְקָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 51:16 [KJV]  For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

Psalms 51:17 [HEB]  אֲ֭דֹנָי שְׂפָתַ֣י תִּפְתָּ֑ח וּ֝פִ֗י יַגִּ֥יד תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
Psalms 51:17 [KJV]  The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

Psalms 51:18 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹא תַחְפֹּ֣ץ זֶ֣בַח וְאֶתֵּ֑נָה ע֝וֹלָ֗ה לֹ֣א תִרְצֶֽה
Psalms 51:18 [KJV]  Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

Psalms 51:19 [HEB]  זִֽבְחֵ֣י אֱלֹהִים֮ ר֪וּחַ נִשְׁבָּ֫רָ֥ה לֵב נִשְׁבָּ֥ר וְנִדְכֶּ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א תִבְזֶֽה
Psalms 51:19 [KJV]  Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

Psalms 51:20 [HEB]  הֵיטִ֣יבָה בִ֭רְצוֹנְךָ אֶת צִיּ֑וֹן תִּ֝בְנֶ֗ה חוֹמ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
Psalms 51:20 [KJV]  

Psalms 51:21 [HEB]  אָ֤ז תַּחְפֹּ֣ץ זִבְחֵי צֶ֭דֶק עוֹלָ֣ה וְכָלִ֑יל אָ֤ז יַעֲל֖וּ עַל מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ פָרִֽים
Psalms 51:21 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 52 ---

Psalms 52:2 [HEB]  בְּב֤וֹא דּוֹאֵ֣ג הָאֲדֹמִי֮ וַיַּגֵּ֪ד לְשָׁ֫א֥וּל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֑וֹ בָּ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד אֶל בֵּ֥ית אֲחִימֶֽלֶךְ
Psalms 52:2 [KJV]  Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

Psalms 52:3 [HEB]  מַה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל בְּ֭רָעָה הַגִּבּ֑וֹר חֶ֥סֶד אֵ֝֗ל כָּל הַיּֽוֹם
Psalms 52:3 [KJV]  Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

Psalms 52:4 [HEB]  הַ֭וּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁ֣ב לְשׁוֹנֶ֑ךָ כְּתַ֥עַר מְ֝לֻטָּ֗שׁ עֹשֵׂ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה
Psalms 52:4 [KJV]  Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

Psalms 52:5 [HEB]  אָהַ֣בְתָּ רָּ֣ע מִטּ֑וֹב שֶׁ֓קֶר מִדַּבֵּ֖ר צֶ֣דֶק סֶֽלָה
Psalms 52:5 [KJV]  God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

Psalms 52:6 [HEB]  אָהַ֥בְתָּ כָֽל דִּבְרֵי בָ֗לַע לְשׁ֣וֹן מִרְמָֽה
Psalms 52:6 [KJV]  The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

Psalms 52:7 [HEB]  גַּם אֵל֮ יִתָּצְךָ֪ לָ֫נֶ֥צַח יַחְתְּךָ֣ וְיִסָּחֲךָ֣ מֵאֹ֑הֶל וְשֵֽׁרֶשְׁךָ֨ מֵאֶ֖רֶץ חַיִּ֣ים סֶֽלָה
Psalms 52:7 [KJV]  Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

Psalms 52:8 [HEB]  וְיִרְא֖וּ צַדִּיקִ֥ים וְיִירָ֗אוּ וְעָלָ֥יו יִשְׂחָֽקוּ
Psalms 52:8 [KJV]  But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

Psalms 52:9 [HEB]  הִנֵּ֤ה הַגֶּ֗בֶר לֹ֤א יָשִׂ֥ים אֱלֹהִ֗ים מָֽע֫וּזּ֥וֹ וַ֭יִּבְטַח בְּרֹ֣ב עָשְׁר֑וֹ יָ֝עֹ֗ז בְּהַוָּתֽוֹ
Psalms 52:9 [KJV]  I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.

Psalms 52:10 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֤י כְּזַ֣יִת רַ֭עֲנָן בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּטַ֥חְתִּי בְחֶֽסֶד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד
Psalms 52:10 [KJV]  

Psalms 52:11 [HEB]  אוֹדְךָ֣ לְ֭עוֹלָם כִּ֣י עָשִׂ֑יתָ וַאֲקַוֶּ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֥ כִֽי ט֝֗וֹב נֶ֣גֶד חֲסִידֶֽיךָ
Psalms 52:11 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 53 ---
Psalms 53:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל מָחֲלַ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד

Psalms 53:3 [HEB]  אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל בְּנֵ֫י אָדָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵ֗שׁ אֶת אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 53:3 [KJV]  Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

Psalms 53:4 [HEB]  כֻּלּ֥וֹ סָג֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם אֶחָֽד
Psalms 53:4 [KJV]  Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

Psalms 53:5 [HEB]  הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ פֹּ֤עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ
Psalms 53:5 [KJV]  There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

Psalms 53:6 [HEB]  שָׁ֤ם פָּֽחֲדוּ פַחַד֮ לֹא הָ֪יָה֫ פָ֥חַד כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֗ים פִּ֭זַּר עַצְמ֣וֹת חֹנָ֑ךְ הֱ֝בִשֹׁ֗תָה כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים מְאָסָֽם
Psalms 53:6 [KJV]  Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

Psalms 53:7 [HEB]  מִ֥י יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיּוֹן֮ יְשֻׁע֪וֹת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב אֱ֭לֹהִים שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
Psalms 53:7 [KJV]

Psalms 54:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד

Psalms 54:5 [HEB]  כִּ֤י זָרִ֨ים קָ֤מוּ עָלַ֗י וְֽ֭עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י לֹ֤א שָׂ֨מוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְנֶגְדָּ֣ם סֶֽלָה
Psalms 54:5 [KJV]  He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

Psalms 54:6 [HEB]  הִנֵּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים עֹזֵ֣ר לִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י בְּֽסֹמְכֵ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי
Psalms 54:6 [KJV]  I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.

Psalms 54:7 [HEB]  ישוב יָשִׁ֣יב הָ֭רַע לְשֹׁרְרָ֑י בַּ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ הַצְמִיתֵֽם
Psalms 54:7 [KJV]  For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

Psalms 54:8 [HEB]  בִּנְדָבָ֥ה אֶזְבְּחָה לָּ֑ךְ א֤וֹדֶה שִּׁמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה כִּי טֽוֹב
Psalms 54:8 [KJV]  

Psalms 54:9 [HEB]  כִּ֣י מִכָּל צָ֭רָה הִצִּילָ֑נִי וּ֝בְאֹיְבַ֗י רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינִֽי
Psalms 54:9 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 55 ---
Psalms 55:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 55:1 [KJV]  Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

Psalms 55:2 [HEB]  הַאֲזִ֣ינָה אֱ֭לֹהִים תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְאַל תִּ֝תְעַלַּ֗ם מִתְּחִנָּתִֽי
Psalms 55:2 [KJV]  Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

Psalms 55:3 [HEB]  הַקְשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֣י וַעֲנֵ֑נִי אָרִ֖יד בְּשִׂיחִ֣י וְאָהִֽימָה
Psalms 55:3 [KJV]  Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

Psalms 55:4 [HEB]  מִקּ֤וֹל אוֹיֵ֗ב מִפְּנֵ֣י עָקַ֣ת רָשָׁ֑ע כִּי יָמִ֥יטוּ עָלַ֥י אָ֝֗וֶן וּבְאַ֥ף יִשְׂטְמֽוּנִי
Psalms 55:4 [KJV]  My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

Psalms 55:5 [HEB]  לִ֭בִּי יָחִ֣יל בְּקִרְבִּ֑י וְאֵימ֥וֹת מָ֝֗וֶת נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי
Psalms 55:5 [KJV]  Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

Psalms 55:6 [HEB]  יִרְאָ֣ה וָ֭רַעַד יָ֣בֹא בִ֑י וַ֝תְּכַסֵּ֗נִי פַּלָּצֽוּת
Psalms 55:6 [KJV]  And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

Psalms 55:7 [HEB]  וָאֹמַ֗ר מִֽי יִתֶּן לִּ֣י אֵ֭בֶר כַּיּוֹנָ֗ה אָע֥וּפָה וְאֶשְׁכֹּֽנָה
Psalms 55:7 [KJV]  Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

Psalms 55:8 [HEB]  הִ֭נֵּה אַרְחִ֣יק נְדֹ֑ד אָלִ֖ין בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר סֶֽלָה
Psalms 55:8 [KJV]  I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

Psalms 55:9 [HEB]  אָחִ֣ישָׁה מִפְלָ֣ט לִ֑י מֵר֖וּחַ סֹעָ֣ה מִסָּֽעַר
Psalms 55:9 [KJV]  Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

Psalms 55:10 [HEB]  בַּלַּ֣ע אֲ֭דֹנָי פַּלַּ֣ג לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם כִּֽי רָאִ֨יתִי חָמָ֖ס וְרִ֣יב בָּעִֽיר
Psalms 55:10 [KJV]  Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

Psalms 55:11 [HEB]  יוֹמָ֤ם וָלַ֗יְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻ֥הָ עַל חוֹמֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאָ֖וֶן וְעָמָ֣ל בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ
Psalms 55:11 [KJV]  Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

Psalms 55:12 [HEB]  הַוּ֥וֹת בְּקִרְבָּ֑הּ וְֽלֹא יָמִ֥ישׁ מֵ֝רְחֹבָ֗הּ תֹּ֣ךְ וּמִרְמָֽה
Psalms 55:12 [KJV]  For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

Psalms 55:13 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹֽא אוֹיֵ֥ב יְחָֽרְפֵ֗נִי וְאֶ֫שָּׂ֥א לֹֽא מְ֭שַׂנְאִי עָלַ֣י הִגְדִּ֑יל וְאֶסָּתֵ֥ר מִמֶּֽנּוּ
Psalms 55:13 [KJV]  But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

Psalms 55:14 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֣ה אֱנ֣וֹשׁ כְּעֶרְכִּ֑י אַ֝לּוּפִ֗י וּמְיֻדָּֽעִי
Psalms 55:14 [KJV]  We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

Psalms 55:15 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַ֭חְדָּו נַמְתִּ֣יק ס֑וֹד בְּבֵ֥ית אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים נְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּרָֽגֶשׁ
Psalms 55:15 [KJV]  Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

Psalms 55:16 [HEB]  ישימות יַשִּׁ֤י מָ֨וֶת עָלֵ֗ימוֹ יֵרְד֣וּ שְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים כִּֽי רָע֖וֹת בִּמְגוּרָ֣ם בְּקִרְבָּֽם
Psalms 55:16 [KJV]  As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.

Psalms 55:17 [HEB]  אֲ֭נִי אֶל אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וַ֝יהוָ֗ה יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי
Psalms 55:17 [KJV]  Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

Psalms 55:18 [HEB]  עֶ֤רֶב וָבֹ֣קֶר וְ֭צָהֳרַיִם אָשִׂ֣יחָה וְאֶהֱמֶ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹלִֽי
Psalms 55:18 [KJV]  He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

Psalms 55:19 [HEB]  פָּ֘דָ֤ה בְשָׁל֣וֹם נַ֭פְשִׁי מִקֲּרָב לִ֑י כִּֽי בְ֝רַבִּ֗ים הָי֥וּ עִמָּדִֽי
Psalms 55:19 [KJV]  God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

Psalms 55:20 [HEB]  יִשְׁמַ֤ע אֵ֨ל וְֽיַעֲנֵם֮ וְיֹ֤שֵׁ֥ב קֶ֗דֶם סֶ֥לָה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֣ין חֲלִיפ֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ וְלֹ֖א יָרְא֣וּ אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 55:20 [KJV]  He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

Psalms 55:21 [HEB]  שָׁלַ֣ח יָ֭דָיו בִּשְׁלֹמָ֗יו חִלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתֽוֹ
Psalms 55:21 [KJV]  The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

Psalms 55:22 [HEB]  חָלְק֤וּ מַחְמָאֹ֣ת פִּיו֮ וּֽקֲרָב לִ֫בּ֥וֹ רַכּ֖וּ דְבָרָ֥יו מִשֶּׁ֗מֶן וְהֵ֣מָּה פְתִחֽוֹת
Psalms 55:22 [KJV]  Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

Psalms 55:23 [HEB]  הַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עַל יְהוָ֨ה יְהָבְךָ֮ וְה֪וּא יְכַ֫לְכְּלֶ֥ךָ לֹא יִתֵּ֖ן לְעוֹלָ֥ם מ֗וֹט לַצַּדִּֽיק
Psalms 55:23 [KJV]  But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

Psalms 55:24 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֨ים תּוֹרִדֵ֬ם לִבְאֵ֬ר שַׁ֗חַת אַנְשֵׁ֤י דָמִ֣ים וּ֭מִרְמָה לֹא יֶחֱצ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶבְטַח בָּֽךְ
Psalms 55:24 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 56 ---
Psalms 56:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ עַל י֬וֹנַת אֵ֣לֶם רְ֭חֹקִים לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בֶּֽאֱחֹ֨ז אֹת֖וֹ פְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים בְּגַֽת
Psalms 56:1 [KJV]  Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

Psalms 56:2 [HEB]  חָנֵּ֣נִי אֱ֭לֹהִים כִּֽי שְׁאָפַ֣נִי אֱנ֑וֹשׁ כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם לֹחֵ֥ם יִלְחָצֵֽנִי
Psalms 56:2 [KJV]  Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.

Psalms 56:3 [HEB]  שָׁאֲפ֣וּ שׁ֭וֹרְרַי כָּל הַיּ֑וֹם כִּֽי רַבִּ֨ים לֹחֲמִ֖ים לִ֣י מָרֽוֹם
Psalms 56:3 [KJV]  What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

Psalms 56:4 [HEB]  י֥וֹם אִירָ֑א אֲ֝נִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֶבְטָֽח
Psalms 56:4 [KJV]  In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

Psalms 56:5 [HEB]  בֵּאלֹהִים֮ אֲהַלֵּ֪ל דְּבָ֫ר֥וֹ בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בָשָׂ֣ר לִֽי
Psalms 56:5 [KJV]  Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

Psalms 56:6 [HEB]  כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם דְּבָרַ֣י יְעַצֵּ֑בוּ עָלַ֖י כָּל מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֣ם לָרָֽע
Psalms 56:6 [KJV]  They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

Psalms 56:7 [HEB]  יָג֤וּרוּ יצפינו יִצְפּ֗וֹנוּ הֵ֭מָּה עֲקֵבַ֣י יִשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר קִוּ֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי
Psalms 56:7 [KJV]  Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.

Psalms 56:8 [HEB]  עַל אָ֥וֶן פַּלֶּט לָ֑מוֹ בְּ֝אַ֗ף עַמִּ֤ים הוֹרֵ֬ד אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 56:8 [KJV]  Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

Psalms 56:9 [HEB]  נֹדִי֮ סָפַ֪רְתָּ֫ה אָ֥תָּה שִׂ֣ימָה דִמְעָתִ֣י בְנֹאדֶ֑ךָ הֲ֝לֹ֗א בְּסִפְרָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 56:9 [KJV]  When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.

Psalms 56:10 [HEB]  אָ֥֨ז יָ֘שׁ֤וּבוּ אוֹיְבַ֣י אָ֭חוֹר בְּי֣וֹם אֶקְרָ֑א זֶה יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים לִֽי
Psalms 56:10 [KJV]  In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.

Psalms 56:11 [HEB]  בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּ֣ל דָּבָ֑ר בַּ֝יהוָ֗ה אֲהַלֵּ֥ל דָּבָֽר
Psalms 56:11 [KJV]  In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

Psalms 56:12 [HEB]  בֵּֽאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה אָדָ֣ם לִֽי
Psalms 56:12 [KJV]  Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

Psalms 56:13 [HEB]  עָלַ֣י אֱלֹהִ֣ים נְדָרֶ֑יךָ אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם תּוֹדֹ֣ת לָֽךְ
Psalms 56:13 [KJV]  For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

Psalms 56:14 [HEB]  כִּ֤י הִצַּ֪לְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֡י מִמָּוֶת֮ הֲלֹ֥א רַגְלַ֗י מִ֫דֶּ֥חִי לְ֭הִֽתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝א֗וֹר הַֽחַיִּֽים
Psalms 56:14 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 57 ---
Psalms 57:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל תַּ֭שְׁחֵת לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בְּבָרְח֥וֹ מִפְּנֵי שָׁ֝א֗וּל בַּמְּעָרָֽה
Psalms 57:1 [KJV]  Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

Psalms 57:2 [HEB]  חָנֵּ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים חָנֵּ֗נִי כִּ֥י בְךָ֮ חָסָ֪יָה נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י וּבְצֵֽל כְּנָפֶ֥יךָ אֶחְסֶ֑ה עַ֝֗ד יַעֲבֹ֥ר הַוּֽוֹת
Psalms 57:2 [KJV]  I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.

Psalms 57:3 [HEB]  אֶ֭קְרָא לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן לָ֝אֵ֗ל גֹּמֵ֥ר עָלָֽי
Psalms 57:3 [KJV]  He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

Psalms 57:4 [HEB]  יִשְׁלַ֤ח מִשָּׁמַ֨יִם וְֽיוֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי חֵרֵ֣ף שֹׁאֲפִ֣י סֶ֑לָה יִשְׁלַ֥ח אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים חַסְדּ֥וֹ וַאֲמִתּֽוֹ
Psalms 57:4 [KJV]  My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

Psalms 57:5 [HEB]  נַפְשִׁ֤י בְּת֥וֹךְ לְבָאִם֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה לֹ֫הֲטִ֥ים בְּֽנֵי אָדָ֗ם שִׁ֭נֵּיהֶם חֲנִ֣ית וְחִצִּ֑ים וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם חֶ֣רֶב חַדָּֽה
Psalms 57:5 [KJV]  Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.

Psalms 57:6 [HEB]  ר֣וּמָה עַל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ
Psalms 57:6 [KJV]  They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.

Psalms 57:7 [HEB]  רֶ֤שֶׁת הֵכִ֣ינוּ לִפְעָמַי֮ כָּפַ֪ף נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כָּר֣וּ לְפָנַ֣י שִׁיחָ֑ה נָפְל֖וּ בְתוֹכָ֣הּ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 57:7 [KJV]  My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

Psalms 57:8 [HEB]  נָ֘כ֤וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֑י אָ֝שִׁ֗ירָה וַאֲזַמֵּֽרָה
Psalms 57:8 [KJV]  Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

Psalms 57:9 [HEB]  ע֤וּרָה כְבוֹדִ֗י ע֭וּרָֽה הַנֵּ֥בֶל וְכִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר
Psalms 57:9 [KJV]  I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

Psalms 57:10 [HEB]  אוֹדְךָ֖ בָעַמִּ֥ים אֲדֹנָ֑י אֲ֝זַמֶּרְךָ֗ בַּל אֻמִּֽים
Psalms 57:10 [KJV]  For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

Psalms 57:11 [HEB]  כִּֽי גָדֹ֣ל עַד שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְֽעַד שְׁחָקִ֥ים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ
Psalms 57:11 [KJV]  Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

Psalms 57:12 [HEB]  ר֣וּמָה עַל שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ
Psalms 57:12 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 58 ---
Psalms 58:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל תַּשְׁחֵ֗ת לְדָוִ֥ד מִכְתָּֽם
Psalms 58:1 [KJV]  Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

Psalms 58:2 [HEB]  הַֽאֻמְנָ֗ם אֵ֣לֶם צֶ֭דֶק תְּדַבֵּר֑וּן מֵישָׁרִ֥ים תִּ֝שְׁפְּט֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם
Psalms 58:2 [KJV]  Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

Psalms 58:3 [HEB]  אַף בְּלֵב֮ עוֹלֹ֪ת תִּפְעָ֫ל֥וּן בָּאָ֡רֶץ חֲמַ֥ס יְ֝דֵיכֶ֗ם תְּפַלֵּֽסֽוּן
Psalms 58:3 [KJV]  The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

Psalms 58:4 [HEB]  זֹ֣רוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים מֵרָ֑חֶם תָּע֥וּ מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן דֹּבְרֵ֥י כָזָֽב
Psalms 58:4 [KJV]  Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

Psalms 58:5 [HEB]  חֲמַת לָ֗מוֹ כִּדְמ֥וּת חֲמַת נָחָ֑שׁ כְּמוֹ פֶ֥תֶן חֵ֝רֵ֗שׁ יַאְטֵ֥ם אָזְנֽוֹ
Psalms 58:5 [KJV]  Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

Psalms 58:6 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא יִ֭שְׁמַע לְק֣וֹל מְלַחֲשִׁ֑ים חוֹבֵ֖ר חֲבָרִ֣ים מְחֻכָּֽם
Psalms 58:6 [KJV]  Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

Psalms 58:7 [HEB]  אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים הֲרָס שִׁנֵּ֥ימוֹ בְּפִ֑ימוֹ מַלְתְּע֥וֹת כְּ֝פִירִ֗ים נְתֹ֣ץ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 58:7 [KJV]  Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

Psalms 58:8 [HEB]  יִמָּאֲס֣וּ כְמוֹ מַ֭יִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ לָ֑מוֹ יִדְרֹ֥ךְ חצו חִ֝צָּ֗יו כְּמ֣וֹ יִתְמֹלָֽלוּ
Psalms 58:8 [KJV]  As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

Psalms 58:9 [HEB]  כְּמ֣וֹ שַׁ֭בְּלוּל תֶּ֣מֶס יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ נֵ֥פֶל אֵ֝֗שֶׁת בַּל חָ֥זוּ שָֽׁמֶשׁ
Psalms 58:9 [KJV]  Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

Psalms 58:10 [HEB]  בְּטֶ֤רֶם יָבִ֣ינוּ סִּֽירֹתֵיכֶ֣ם אָטָ֑ד כְּמוֹ חַ֥י כְּמוֹ חָ֝ר֗וֹן יִשְׂעָרֶֽנּוּ
Psalms 58:10 [KJV]  The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

Psalms 58:11 [HEB]  יִשְׂמַ֣ח צַ֭דִּיק כִּי חָזָ֣ה נָקָ֑ם פְּעָמָ֥יו יִ֝רְחַ֗ץ בְּדַ֣ם הָרָשָֽׁע
Psalms 58:11 [KJV]  So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

Psalms 58:12 [HEB]  וְיֹאמַ֣ר אָ֭דָם אַךְ פְּרִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֑יק אַ֥ךְ יֵשׁ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים שֹׁפְטִ֥ים בָּאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 58:12 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 59 ---
Psalms 59:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל תַּשְׁחֵת֮ לְדָוִ֪ד מִ֫כְתָּ֥ם בִּשְׁלֹ֥חַ שָׁא֑וּל וַֽיִּשְׁמְר֥וּ אֶת הַ֝בַּ֗יִת לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ
Psalms 59:1 [KJV]  Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

Psalms 59:2 [KJV]  Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

Psalms 59:3 [HEB]  הַ֭צִּילֵנִי מִפֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וּֽמֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי

Psalms 59:4 [KJV]  They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

Psalms 59:5 [HEB]  בְּֽלִי עָ֭וֺן יְרוּצ֣וּן וְיִכּוֹנָ֑נוּ ע֖וּרָה לִקְרָאתִ֣י וּרְאֵה
Psalms 59:5 [KJV]  Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

Psalms 59:6 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָֽה אֱלֹהִ֥ים צְבָא֡וֹת אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הָקִ֗יצָה לִפְקֹ֥ד כָּֽל הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַל תָּחֹ֨ן כָּל בֹּ֖גְדֵי אָ֣וֶן סֶֽלָה
Psalms 59:6 [KJV]  They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

Psalms 59:7 [HEB]  יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב וִיס֥וֹבְבוּ עִֽיר
Psalms 59:7 [KJV]  Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?

Psalms 59:8 [HEB]  הִנֵּ֤ה יַבִּ֘יע֤וּן בְּפִיהֶ֗ם חֲ֭רָבוֹת בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי מִ֥י שֹׁמֵֽעַ
Psalms 59:8 [KJV]  But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

Psalms 59:9 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׂחַק לָ֑מוֹ תִּ֝לְעַ֗ג לְכָל גּוֹיִֽם
Psalms 59:9 [KJV]  Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

Psalms 59:10 [HEB]  עֻ֭זּוֹ אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑רָה כִּֽי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי
Psalms 59:10 [KJV]  The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

Psalms 59:11 [HEB]  אֱלֹהֵ֣י חסדו חַסְדִּ֣י יְקַדְּמֵ֑נִי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יַרְאֵ֥נִי בְשֹׁרְרָֽי
Psalms 59:11 [KJV]  Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

Psalms 59:12 [HEB]  אַל תַּהַרְגֵ֤ם פֶּֽן יִשְׁכְּח֬וּ עַמִּ֗י הֲנִיעֵ֣מוֹ בְ֭חֵילְךָ וְהוֹרִידֵ֑מוֹ מָֽגִנֵּ֣נוּ אֲדֹנָֽי
Psalms 59:12 [KJV]  For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

Psalms 59:13 [KJV]  Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

Psalms 59:14 [HEB]  כַּלֵּ֥ה בְחֵמָה֮ כַּלֵּ֪ה וְֽאֵ֫ינֵ֥מוֹ וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי אֱ֭לֹהִים מֹשֵׁ֣ל בְּיַעֲקֹ֑ב לְאַפְסֵ֖י הָאָ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 59:14 [KJV]  And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

Psalms 59:15 [HEB]  וְיָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב וִיס֥וֹבְבוּ עִֽיר
Psalms 59:15 [KJV]  Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

Psalms 59:16 [HEB]  הֵ֭מָּה ינועון יְנִיע֣וּן לֶאֱכֹ֑ל אִם לֹ֥א יִ֝שְׂבְּע֗וּ וַיָּלִֽינוּ
Psalms 59:16 [KJV]  But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

Psalms 59:17 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֤י אָשִׁ֣יר עֻזֶּךָ֮ וַאֲרַנֵּ֥ן לַבֹּ֗קֶר חַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ כִּֽי הָיִ֣יתָ מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לִ֑י וּ֝מָנ֗וֹס בְּי֣וֹם צַר לִֽי
Psalms 59:17 [KJV]  Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

Psalms 59:18 [HEB]  עֻ֭זִּי אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֲזַמֵּ֑רָה כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י אֱלֹהֵ֥י חַסְדִּֽי

--- Psalms Chapter 60 ---
Psalms 60:1 [HEB]  לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל שׁוּשַׁ֣ן עֵד֑וּת מִכְתָּ֖ם לְדָוִ֣ד לְלַמֵּֽד

Psalms 60:2 [KJV]  Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

Psalms 60:3 [HEB]  אֱ֭לֹהִים זְנַחְתָּ֣נוּ פְרַצְתָּ֑נוּ אָ֝נַ֗פְתָּ תְּשׁ֣וֹבֵ֥ב לָֽנוּ
Psalms 60:3 [KJV]  Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

Psalms 60:4 [HEB]  הִרְעַ֣שְׁתָּה אֶ֣רֶץ פְּצַמְתָּ֑הּ רְפָ֖ה שְׁבָרֶ֣יהָ כִי מָֽטָה
Psalms 60:4 [KJV]  Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

Psalms 60:5 [HEB]  הִרְאִ֣יתָה עַמְּךָ֣ קָשָׁ֑ה הִ֝שְׁקִיתָ֗נוּ יַ֣יִן תַּרְעֵלָֽה
Psalms 60:5 [KJV]  That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

Psalms 60:6 [HEB]  נָ֘תַ֤תָּה לִּירֵאֶ֣יךָ נֵּ֭ס לְהִתְנוֹסֵ֑ס מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י קֹ֣שֶׁט סֶֽלָה
Psalms 60:6 [KJV]  God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

Psalms 60:7 [HEB]  לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ ועננו וַעֲנֵֽנִי
Psalms 60:7 [KJV]  Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

Psalms 60:8 [HEB]  אֱלֹהִ֤ים דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקָדְשׁ֗וֹ אֶ֫עְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד
Psalms 60:8 [KJV]  Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

Psalms 60:9 [HEB]  לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד וְלִ֬י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹֽקְקִי
Psalms 60:9 [KJV]  Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

Psalms 60:10 [HEB]  מוֹאָ֤ב סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עָ֝לַ֗י פְּלֶ֣שֶׁת הִתְרֹעָֽעִֽי
Psalms 60:10 [KJV]  Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?

Psalms 60:11 [HEB]  מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מָצ֑וֹר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד אֱדֽוֹם
Psalms 60:11 [KJV]  Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

Psalms 60:12 [HEB]  הֲלֹֽא אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים זְנַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְֽלֹא תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ
Psalms 60:12 [KJV]  Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

Psalms 60:13 [HEB]  הָֽבָה לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָם
Psalms 60:13 [KJV]  

Psalms 60:14 [HEB]  בֵּֽאלֹהִ֥ים נַעֲשֶׂה חָ֑יִל וְ֝ה֗וּא יָב֥וּס צָרֵֽינוּ
Psalms 60:14 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 61 ---
Psalms 61:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל נְגִינַ֬ת לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 61:1 [KJV]  Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

Psalms 61:2 [HEB]  שִׁמְעָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִנָּתִ֑י הַ֝קְשִׁ֗יבָה תְּפִלָּתִֽי
Psalms 61:2 [KJV]  From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

Psalms 61:3 [HEB]  מִקְצֵ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֶ֭קְרָא בַּעֲטֹ֣ף לִבִּ֑י בְּצוּר יָר֖וּם מִמֶּ֣נִּי תַנְחֵֽנִי
Psalms 61:3 [KJV]  For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

Psalms 61:4 [HEB]  כִּֽי הָיִ֣יתָ מַחְסֶ֣ה לִ֑י מִגְדַּל עֹ֝֗ז מִפְּנֵ֥י אוֹיֵֽב
Psalms 61:4 [KJV]  I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

Psalms 61:5 [HEB]  אָג֣וּרָה בְ֭אָהָלְךָ עוֹלָמִ֑ים אֶֽחֱסֶ֨ה בְסֵ֖תֶר כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ סֶּֽלָה
Psalms 61:5 [KJV]  For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

Psalms 61:6 [HEB]  כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ לִנְדָרָ֑י נָתַ֥תָּ יְ֝רֻשַּׁ֗ת יִרְאֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ
Psalms 61:6 [KJV]  Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.

Psalms 61:7 [HEB]  יָמִ֣ים עַל יְמֵי מֶ֣לֶךְ תּוֹסִ֑יף שְׁ֝נוֹתָ֗יו כְּמוֹ דֹ֥ר וָדֹֽר
Psalms 61:7 [KJV]  He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

Psalms 61:8 [HEB]  יֵשֵׁ֣ב ע֭וֹלָם לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת מַ֣ן יִנְצְרֻֽהוּ
Psalms 61:8 [KJV]  So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

Psalms 61:9 [HEB]  כֵּ֤ן אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לָעַ֑ד לְֽשַׁלְּמִ֥י נְדָרַ֗י י֣וֹם יֽוֹם
Psalms 61:9 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 62 ---
Psalms 62:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל יְדוּת֗וּן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 62:1 [KJV]  Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

Psalms 62:2 [HEB]  אַ֣ךְ אֶל אֱ֭לֹהִים דּֽוּמִיָּ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִֽי
Psalms 62:2 [KJV]  He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

Psalms 62:3 [HEB]  אַךְ ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹא אֶמּ֥וֹט רַבָּֽה
Psalms 62:3 [KJV]  How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

Psalms 62:4 [HEB]  עַד אָ֤נָה תְּהֽוֹתְת֣וּ עַל אִישׁ֮ תְּרָצְּח֪וּ כֻ֫לְּכֶ֥ם כְּקִ֥יר נָט֑וּי גָּ֝דֵ֗ר הַדְּחוּיָֽה
Psalms 62:4 [KJV]  They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

Psalms 62:5 [HEB]  אַ֤ךְ מִשְּׂאֵת֨וֹ יָעֲצ֣וּ לְהַדִּיחַ֮ יִרְצ֪וּ כָ֫זָ֥ב בְּפִ֥יו יְבָרֵ֑כוּ וּ֝בְקִרְבָּ֗ם יְקַלְלוּ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 62:5 [KJV]  My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.

Psalms 62:6 [HEB]  אַ֣ךְ לֵ֭אלֹהִים דּ֣וֹמִּי נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּי מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תִּקְוָתִֽי
Psalms 62:6 [KJV]  He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

Psalms 62:7 [HEB]  אַךְ ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֶמּֽוֹט
Psalms 62:7 [KJV]  In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

Psalms 62:8 [HEB]  עַל אֱ֭לֹהִים יִשְׁעִ֣י וּכְבוֹדִ֑י צוּר עֻזִּ֥י מַ֝חְסִ֗י בֵּֽאלֹהִֽים
Psalms 62:8 [KJV]  Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.

Psalms 62:9 [HEB]  בִּטְח֘וּ ב֤וֹ בְכָל עֵ֨ת עָ֗ם שִׁפְכֽוּ לְפָנָ֥יו לְבַבְכֶ֑ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים מַחֲסֶה לָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 62:9 [KJV]  Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

Psalms 62:10 [HEB]  אַ֤ךְ הֶ֥בֶל בְּנֵֽי אָדָם֮ כָּזָ֪ב בְּנֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ בְּמֹאזְנַ֥יִם לַעֲל֑וֹת הֵ֝֗מָּה מֵהֶ֥בֶל יָֽחַד
Psalms 62:10 [KJV]  Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

Psalms 62:11 [HEB]  אַל תִּבְטְח֣וּ בְעֹשֶׁק֮ וּבְגָזֵ֪ל אַל תֶּ֫הְבָּ֥לוּ חַ֤יִל כִּֽי יָנ֑וּב אַל תָּשִׁ֥יתוּ לֵֽב
Psalms 62:11 [KJV]  God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.

Psalms 62:12 [HEB]  אַחַ֤ת דִּבֶּ֬ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים שְׁתַּֽיִם ז֥וּ שָׁמָ֑עְתִּי כִּ֥י עֹ֝֗ז לֵאלֹהִֽים
Psalms 62:12 [KJV]  Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.

Psalms 62:13 [HEB]  וּלְךָֽ אֲדֹנָ֥י חָ֑סֶד כִּֽי אַתָּ֨ה תְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּֽמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ
Psalms 62:13 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 63 ---
Psalms 63:1 [HEB]  מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בִּ֝הְיוֹת֗וֹ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה
Psalms 63:1 [KJV]  O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

Psalms 63:2 [HEB]  אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֵלִ֥י אַתָּ֗ה אֲֽשַׁחֲ֫רֶ֥ךָּ צָמְאָ֬ה לְךָ֨ נַפְשִׁ֗י כָּמַ֣הּ לְךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י בְּאֶֽרֶץ צִיָּ֖ה וְעָיֵ֣ף בְּלִי מָֽיִם
Psalms 63:2 [KJV]  To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

Psalms 63:3 [HEB]  כֵּ֭ן בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ חֲזִיתִ֑יךָ לִרְא֥וֹת עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ וּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ
Psalms 63:3 [KJV]  Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

Psalms 63:4 [HEB]  כִּי ט֣וֹב חַ֭סְדְּךָ מֵֽחַיִּ֗ים שְׂפָתַ֥י יְשַׁבְּחֽוּנְךָ
Psalms 63:4 [KJV]  Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

Psalms 63:5 [HEB]  כֵּ֣ן אֲבָרֶכְךָ֣ בְחַיָּ֑י בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂ֥א כַפָּֽי
Psalms 63:5 [KJV]  My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:

Psalms 63:6 [HEB]  כְּמ֤וֹ חֵ֣לֶב וָ֭דֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע נַפְשִׁ֑י וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י רְ֝נָנ֗וֹת יְהַלֶּל פִּֽי
Psalms 63:6 [KJV]  When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

Psalms 63:7 [HEB]  אִם זְכַרְתִּ֥יךָ עַל יְצוּעָ֑י בְּ֝אַשְׁמֻר֗וֹת אֶהְגֶּה בָּֽךְ
Psalms 63:7 [KJV]  Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

Psalms 63:8 [HEB]  כִּֽי הָיִ֣יתָ עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י וּבְצֵ֖ל כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן
Psalms 63:8 [KJV]  My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

Psalms 63:9 [HEB]  דָּבְקָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ בִּ֝֗י תָּמְכָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ
Psalms 63:9 [KJV]  But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

Psalms 63:10 [HEB]  וְהֵ֗מָּה לְ֭שׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 63:10 [KJV]  They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

Psalms 63:11 [HEB]  יַגִּירֻ֥הוּ עַל יְדֵי חָ֑רֶב מְנָ֖ת שֻׁעָלִ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ
Psalms 63:11 [KJV]  But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

Psalms 63:12 [HEB]  וְהַמֶּלֶךְ֮ יִשְׂמַ֪ח בֵּאלֹ֫הִ֥ים יִ֭תְהַלֵּל כָּל הַנִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בּ֑וֹ כִּ֥י יִ֝סָּכֵ֗ר פִּ֣י דֽוֹבְרֵי שָֽׁקֶר
Psalms 63:12 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 64 ---
Psalms 64:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד
Psalms 64:1 [KJV]  Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

Psalms 64:2 [HEB]  שְׁמַע אֱלֹהִ֣ים קוֹלִ֣י בְשִׂיחִ֑י מִפַּ֥חַד א֝וֹיֵ֗ב תִּצֹּ֥ר חַיָּֽי
Psalms 64:2 [KJV]  Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

Psalms 64:3 [HEB]  תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי מִסּ֣וֹד מְרֵעִ֑ים מֵ֝רִגְשַׁ֗ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
Psalms 64:3 [KJV]  Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

Psalms 64:4 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁנְנ֣וּ כַחֶ֣רֶב לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם דָּרְכ֥וּ חִ֝צָּ֗ם דָּבָ֥ר מָֽר
Psalms 64:4 [KJV]  That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

Psalms 64:5 [HEB]  לִיר֣וֹת בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֣ים תָּ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם יֹ֝רֻ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א יִירָֽאוּ
Psalms 64:5 [KJV]  They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

Psalms 64:6 [HEB]  יְחַזְּקוּ לָ֨מוֹ דָּ֘בָ֤ר רָ֗ע יְֽ֭סַפְּרוּ לִטְמ֣וֹן מוֹקְשִׁ֑ים אָ֝מְר֗וּ מִ֣י יִרְאֶה לָּֽמוֹ
Psalms 64:6 [KJV]  They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

Psalms 64:7 [HEB]  יַֽחְפְּֽשׂוּ עוֹלֹ֗ת תַּ֭מְנוּ חֵ֣פֶשׂ מְחֻפָּ֑שׂ וְקֶ֥רֶב אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֵ֣ב עָמֹֽק
Psalms 64:7 [KJV]  But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

Psalms 64:8 [HEB]  וַיֹּרֵ֗ם אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֥ץ פִּתְא֑וֹם הָ֝י֗וּ מַכּוֹתָֽם
Psalms 64:8 [KJV]  So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

Psalms 64:9 [HEB]  וַיַּכְשִׁיל֣וּהוּ עָלֵ֣ימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם יִ֝תְנֹדֲד֗וּ כָּל רֹ֥אֵה בָֽם
Psalms 64:9 [KJV]  And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

Psalms 64:10 [HEB]  וַיִּֽירְא֗וּ כָּל אָ֫דָ֥ם וַ֭יַּגִּידוּ פֹּ֥עַל אֱלֹהִ֗ים וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥הוּ הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ
Psalms 64:10 [KJV]  The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

Psalms 64:11 [HEB]  יִשְׂמַ֬ח צַדִּ֣יק בַּ֭יהוָה וְחָ֣סָה ב֑וֹ וְ֝יִתְהַֽלְל֗וּ כָּל יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
Psalms 64:11 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 65 ---
Psalms 65:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָוִ֥ד שִֽׁיר
Psalms 65:1 [KJV]  Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

Psalms 65:2 [HEB]  לְךָ֤ דֻֽמִיָּ֬ה תְהִלָּ֓ה אֱלֹ֘הִ֥ים בְּצִיּ֑וֹן וּ֝לְךָ֗ יְשֻׁלַּם נֶֽדֶר
Psalms 65:2 [KJV]  O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

Psalms 65:3 [HEB]  שֹׁמֵ֥עַ תְּפִלָּ֑ה עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ כָּל בָּשָׂ֥ר יָבֹֽאוּ
Psalms 65:3 [KJV]  Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

Psalms 65:4 [HEB]  דִּבְרֵ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹת גָּ֣בְרוּ מֶ֑נִּי פְּ֝שָׁעֵ֗ינוּ אַתָּ֥ה תְכַפְּרֵֽם
Psalms 65:4 [KJV]  Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

Psalms 65:5 [HEB]  אַשְׁרֵ֤י תִּֽבְחַ֣ר וּתְקָרֵב֮ יִשְׁכֹּ֪ן חֲצֵ֫רֶ֥יךָ נִ֭שְׂבְּעָה בְּט֣וּב בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ הֵיכָלֶֽךָ
Psalms 65:5 [KJV]  By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

Psalms 65:6 [HEB]  נ֤וֹרָא֨וֹת בְּצֶ֣דֶק תַּ֭עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ מִבְטָ֥ח כָּל קַצְוֵי אֶ֝֗רֶץ וְיָ֣ם רְחֹקִֽים
Psalms 65:6 [KJV]  Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

Psalms 65:7 [HEB]  מֵכִ֣ין הָרִ֣ים בְּכֹח֑וֹ נֶ֝אְזָ֗ר בִּגְבוּרָֽה
Psalms 65:7 [KJV]  Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

Psalms 65:8 [HEB]  מַשְׁבִּ֤יחַ שְׁא֣וֹן יַ֭מִּים שְׁא֥וֹן גַּלֵּיהֶ֗ם וַהֲמ֥וֹן לְאֻמִּֽים
Psalms 65:8 [KJV]  They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

Psalms 65:9 [HEB]  וַיִּ֤ירְא֨וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י קְ֭צָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶ֑יךָ מ֤וֹצָֽאֵי בֹ֖קֶר וָעֶ֣רֶב תַּרְנִֽין
Psalms 65:9 [KJV]  Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

Psalms 65:10 [HEB]  פָּקַ֥דְתָּ הָאָ֨רֶץ וַתְּשֹׁ֪קְקֶ֡הָ רַבַּ֬ת תַּעְשְׁרֶ֗נָּה פֶּ֣לֶג אֱ֭לֹהִים מָ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם תָּכִ֥ין דְּ֝גָנָ֗ם כִּי כֵ֥ן תְּכִינֶֽהָ
Psalms 65:10 [KJV]  Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

Psalms 65:11 [HEB]  תְּלָמֶ֣יהָ רַ֭וֵּה נַחֵ֣ת גְּדוּדֶ֑יהָ בִּרְבִיבִ֥ים תְּ֝מֹגְגֶ֗נָּה צִמְחָ֥הּ תְּבָרֵֽךְ
Psalms 65:11 [KJV]  Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

Psalms 65:12 [HEB]  עִ֭טַּרְתָּ שְׁנַ֣ת טוֹבָתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מַעְגָּלֶ֗יךָ יִרְעֲפ֥וּן דָּֽשֶׁן
Psalms 65:12 [KJV]  They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

Psalms 65:13 [HEB]  יִ֭רְעֲפוּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר וְ֝גִ֗יל גְּבָע֥וֹת תַּחְגֹּֽרְנָה
Psalms 65:13 [KJV]  The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

Psalms 65:14 [HEB]  לָבְשׁ֬וּ כָרִ֨ים הַצֹּ֗אן וַעֲמָקִ֥ים יַֽעַטְפוּ בָ֑ר יִ֝תְרוֹעֲע֗וּ אַף יָשִֽׁירוּ
Psalms 65:14 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 66 ---
Psalms 66:1 [HEB]  לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ שִׁ֣יר מִזְמ֑וֹר הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִים כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 66:1 [KJV]  Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

Psalms 66:2 [HEB]  זַמְּר֥וּ כְבֽוֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שִׂ֥ימוּ כָ֝ב֗וֹד תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ
Psalms 66:2 [KJV]  Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

Psalms 66:3 [HEB]  אִמְר֣וּ לֵ֭אלֹהִים מַה נּוֹרָ֣א מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ בְּרֹ֥ב עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ יְֽכַחֲשׁ֖וּ לְךָ֣ אֹיְבֶֽיךָ
Psalms 66:3 [KJV]  Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

Psalms 66:4 [HEB]  כָּל הָאָ֤רֶץ יִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְ֭ךָ וִֽיזַמְּרוּ לָ֑ךְ יְזַמְּר֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 66:4 [KJV]  All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.

Psalms 66:5 [HEB]  לְכ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֑ים נוֹרָ֥א עֲ֝לִילָ֗ה עַל בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
Psalms 66:5 [KJV]  Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

Psalms 66:6 [HEB]  הָ֤פַךְ יָ֨ם לְֽיַבָּשָׁ֗ה בַּ֭נָּהָר יַֽעַבְר֣וּ בְרָ֑גֶל שָׁ֝֗ם נִשְׂמְחָה בּֽוֹ
Psalms 66:6 [KJV]  He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

Psalms 66:7 [HEB]  מֹ֘שֵׁ֤ל בִּגְבוּרָת֨וֹ עוֹלָ֗ם עֵ֭ינָיו בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם תִּצְפֶּ֑ינָה הַסּוֹרְרִ֓ים אַל ירימו יָר֖וּמוּ לָ֣מוֹ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 66:7 [KJV]  He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

Psalms 66:8 [HEB]  בָּרְכ֖וּ עַמִּ֥ים אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝הַשְׁמִ֗יעוּ ק֣וֹל תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ
Psalms 66:8 [KJV]  O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

Psalms 66:9 [HEB]  הַשָּׂ֣ם נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ בַּֽחַיִּ֑ים וְלֹֽא נָתַ֖ן לַמּ֣וֹט רַגְלֵֽנוּ
Psalms 66:9 [KJV]  Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

Psalms 66:10 [HEB]  כִּֽי בְחַנְתָּ֥נוּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים צְ֝רַפְתָּ֗נוּ כִּצְרָף כָּֽסֶף
Psalms 66:10 [KJV]  For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

Psalms 66:11 [HEB]  הֲבֵאתָ֥נוּ בַמְּצוּדָ֑ה שַׂ֖מְתָּ מוּעָקָ֣ה בְמָתְנֵֽינוּ
Psalms 66:11 [KJV]  Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

Psalms 66:12 [HEB]  הִרְכַּ֥בְתָּ אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְרֹ֫אשֵׁ֥נוּ בָּֽאנוּ בָאֵ֥שׁ וּבַמַּ֑יִם וַ֝תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נוּ לָֽרְוָיָֽה
Psalms 66:12 [KJV]  Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

Psalms 66:13 [HEB]  אָב֣וֹא בֵיתְךָ֣ בְעוֹל֑וֹת אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְךָ֣ נְדָרָֽי
Psalms 66:13 [KJV]  I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

Psalms 66:14 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁר פָּצ֥וּ שְׂפָתָ֑י וְדִבֶּר פִּ֝֗י בַּצַּר לִֽי
Psalms 66:14 [KJV]  Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

Psalms 66:15 [HEB]  עֹ֘ל֤וֹת מֵחִ֣ים אַעֲלֶה לָּ֭ךְ עִם קְטֹ֣רֶת אֵילִ֑ים אֶ֥עֱשֶֽׂה בָקָ֖ר עִם עַתּוּדִ֣ים סֶֽלָה
Psalms 66:15 [KJV]  I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

Psalms 66:16 [HEB]  לְכֽוּ שִׁמְע֣וּ וַ֭אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל יִרְאֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשָׂ֣ה לְנַפְשִֽׁי
Psalms 66:16 [KJV]  Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

Psalms 66:17 [HEB]  אֵלָ֥יו פִּֽי קָרָ֑אתִי וְ֝רוֹמַ֗ם תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנִֽי
Psalms 66:17 [KJV]  I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

Psalms 66:18 [HEB]  אָ֭וֶן אִם רָאִ֣יתִי בְלִבִּ֑י לֹ֖א יִשְׁמַ֣ע אֲדֹנָֽי
Psalms 66:18 [KJV]  If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:

Psalms 66:19 [HEB]  אָ֭כֵן שָׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִ֝קְשִׁ֗יב בְּק֣וֹל תְּפִלָּתִֽי
Psalms 66:19 [KJV]  But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

Psalms 66:20 [HEB]  בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא הֵסִ֘יר תְּפִלָּתִ֥י וְ֝חַסְדּ֗וֹ מֵאִתִּֽי
Psalms 66:20 [KJV]  Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.


--- Psalms Chapter 67 ---
Psalms 67:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥ח בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר
Psalms 67:1 [KJV]  God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

Psalms 67:2 [HEB]  אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְחָנֵּ֥נוּ וִֽיבָרְכֵ֑נוּ יָ֤אֵ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו אִתָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 67:2 [KJV]  That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

Psalms 67:3 [HEB]  לָדַ֣עַת בָּאָ֣רֶץ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ בְּכָל גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 67:3 [KJV]  Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

Psalms 67:4 [HEB]  יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם
Psalms 67:4 [KJV]  O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

Psalms 67:5 [HEB]  יִֽשְׂמְח֥וּ וִֽירַנְּנ֗וּ לְאֻ֫מִּ֥ים כִּֽי תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט עַמִּ֣ים מִישׁ֑וֹר וּלְאֻמִּ֓ים בָּאָ֖רֶץ תַּנְחֵ֣ם סֶֽלָה
Psalms 67:5 [KJV]  Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

Psalms 67:6 [HEB]  יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם
Psalms 67:6 [KJV]  Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

Psalms 67:7 [HEB]  אֶ֭רֶץ נָתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ יְ֝בָרְכֵ֗נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
Psalms 67:7 [KJV]  God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

Psalms 67:8 [HEB]  יְבָרְכֵ֥נוּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְיִֽירְא֥וּ אֹ֝ת֗וֹ כָּל אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ
Psalms 67:8 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 68 ---
Psalms 68:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לְדָוִ֗ד מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר
Psalms 68:1 [KJV]  Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

Psalms 68:2 [HEB]  יָק֣וּם אֱ֭לֹהִים יָפ֣וּצוּ אוֹיְבָ֑יו וְיָנ֥וּסוּ מְ֝שַׂנְאָ֗יו מִפָּנָֽיו
Psalms 68:2 [KJV]  As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

Psalms 68:3 [HEB]  כְּהִנְדֹּ֥ף עָשָׁ֗ן תִּ֫נְדֹּ֥ף כְּהִמֵּ֣ס דּ֭וֹנַג מִפְּנֵי אֵ֑שׁ יֹאבְד֥וּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 68:3 [KJV]  But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

Psalms 68:4 [HEB]  וְֽצַדִּיקִ֗ים יִשְׂמְח֣וּ יַֽ֭עַלְצוּ לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֗ים וְיָשִׂ֥ישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָֽה
Psalms 68:4 [KJV]  Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.

Psalms 68:5 [HEB]  שִׁ֤ירוּ לֵֽאלֹהִים֮ זַמְּר֪וּ שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ סֹ֡לּוּ לָרֹכֵ֣ב בָּ֭עֲרָבוֹת בְּיָ֥הּ שְׁמ֗וֹ וְעִלְז֥וּ לְפָנָֽיו
Psalms 68:5 [KJV]  A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

Psalms 68:6 [HEB]  אֲבִ֣י יְ֭תוֹמִים וְדַיַּ֣ן אַלְמָנ֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בִּמְע֥וֹן קָדְשֽׁוֹ
Psalms 68:6 [KJV]  God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

Psalms 68:7 [HEB]  אֱלֹהִ֤ים מ֘וֹשִׁ֤יב יְחִידִ֨ים בַּ֗יְתָה מוֹצִ֣יא אֲ֭סִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁר֑וֹת אַ֥ךְ ס֝וֹרֲרִ֗ים שָׁכְנ֥וּ צְחִיחָֽה
Psalms 68:7 [KJV]  O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

Psalms 68:8 [HEB]  אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים בְּ֭צֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ֖ בִֽישִׁימ֣וֹן סֶֽלָה
Psalms 68:8 [KJV]  The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

Psalms 68:9 [HEB]  אֶ֤רֶץ רָעָ֨שָׁה אַף שָׁמַ֣יִם נָטְפוּ֮ מִפְּנֵ֪י אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים זֶ֥ה סִינַ֑י מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
Psalms 68:9 [KJV]  Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

Psalms 68:10 [HEB]  גֶּ֣שֶׁם נְ֭דָבוֹת תָּנִ֣יף אֱלֹהִ֑ים נַחֲלָתְךָ֥ וְ֝נִלְאָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה כֽוֹנַנְתָּֽהּ
Psalms 68:10 [KJV]  Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

Psalms 68:11 [HEB]  חַיָּתְךָ֥ יָֽשְׁבוּ בָ֑הּ תָּ֤כִ֥ין בְּטוֹבָתְךָ֖ לֶעָנִ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 68:11 [KJV]  The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.

Psalms 68:12 [HEB]  אֲדֹנָ֥י יִתֶּן אֹ֑מֶר הַֽ֝מְבַשְּׂר֗וֹת צָבָ֥א רָֽב
Psalms 68:12 [KJV]  Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

Psalms 68:13 [HEB]  מַלְכֵ֣י צְ֭בָאוֹת יִדֹּד֣וּן יִדֹּד֑וּן וּנְוַת בַּ֝֗יִת תְּחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל
Psalms 68:13 [KJV]  Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

Psalms 68:14 [HEB]  אִֽם תִּשְׁכְּבוּן֮ בֵּ֪ין שְׁפַ֫תָּ֥יִם כַּנְפֵ֣י י֭וֹנָה נֶחְפָּ֣ה בַכֶּ֑סֶף וְ֝אֶבְרוֹתֶ֗יהָ בִּֽירַקְרַ֥ק חָרֽוּץ
Psalms 68:14 [KJV]  When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.

Psalms 68:15 [HEB]  בְּפָ֘רֵ֤שׂ שַׁדַּ֓י מְלָ֘כִ֤ים בָּ֗הּ תַּשְׁלֵ֥ג בְּצַלְמֽוֹן
Psalms 68:15 [KJV]  The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.

Psalms 68:16 [HEB]  הַר אֱ֭לֹהִים הַר בָּשָׁ֑ן הַ֥ר גַּ֝בְנֻנִּ֗ים הַר בָּשָֽׁן
Psalms 68:16 [KJV]  Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.

Psalms 68:17 [HEB]  לָ֤מָּה תְּֽרַצְּדוּן֮ הָרִ֪ים גַּבְנֻ֫נִּ֥ים הָהָ֗ר חָמַ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְשִׁבְתּ֑וֹ אַף יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָנֶֽצַח
Psalms 68:17 [KJV]  The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.

Psalms 68:18 [HEB]  רֶ֤כֶב אֱלֹהִ֗ים רִבֹּתַ֣יִם אַלְפֵ֣י שִׁנְאָ֑ן אֲדֹנָ֥י בָ֝֗ם סִינַ֥י בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ
Psalms 68:18 [KJV]  Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.

Psalms 68:19 [HEB]  עָ֘לִ֤יתָ לַמָּר֨וֹם שָׁ֘בִ֤יתָ שֶּׁ֗בִי לָקַ֣חְתָּ מַ֭תָּנוֹת בָּאָדָ֑ם וְאַ֥ף ס֝וֹרְרִ֗ים לִשְׁכֹּ֤ן יָ֬הּ אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 68:19 [KJV]  Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

Psalms 68:20 [HEB]  בָּ֤ר֣וּךְ אֲדֹנָי֮ י֤וֹם י֥וֹם יַֽעֲמָס לָ֗נוּ הָ֘אֵ֤ל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵ֬נוּ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 68:20 [KJV]  He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.

Psalms 68:21 [HEB]  הָ֤אֵ֣ל לָנוּ֮ אֵ֤ל לְֽמוֹשָׁ֫ע֥וֹת וְלֵיהוִ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֑י לַ֝מָּ֗וֶת תּוֹצָאֽוֹת
Psalms 68:21 [KJV]  But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

Psalms 68:22 [HEB]  אַךְ אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִמְחַץ֮ רֹ֤אשׁ אֹ֫יְבָ֥יו קָדְקֹ֥ד שֵׂעָ֑ר מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָֽיו
Psalms 68:22 [KJV]  The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

Psalms 68:23 [HEB]  אָמַ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי מִבָּשָׁ֣ן אָשִׁ֑יב אָ֝שִׁ֗יב מִֽמְּצֻל֥וֹת יָֽם
Psalms 68:23 [KJV]  That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

--- Psalms Chapter 70 ---
Psalms 70:1 [HEB]  לַ֝מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָוִ֥ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר
Psalms 70:1 [KJV]  MAKE HASTE, O GOD, TO DELIVER ME; MAKE HASTE TO HELP ME, O LORD.

Psalms 70:2 [HEB]  אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָֽׁה
Psalms 70:2 [KJV]  Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

Psalms 70:3 [HEB]  יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי
Psalms 70:3 [KJV]  Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

Psalms 70:4 [HEB]  יָ֭שׁוּבוּ עַל עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָ֝אֹמְרִ֗ים הֶ֘אָ֥ח הֶאָֽח
Psalms 70:4 [KJV]  Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

Psalms 70:5 [HEB]  יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 70:5 [KJV]  But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.

Psalms 70:6 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֤י עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים חֽוּשָׁ֫ה לִּ֥י עֶזְרִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל תְּאַחַֽר
Psalms 70:6 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 71 ---
Psalms 71:1 [HEB]  בְּךָֽ יְהוָ֥ה חָסִ֑יתִי אַל אֵב֥וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָֽם
Psalms 71:1 [KJV]  In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

Psalms 71:2 [HEB]  בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֗ תַּצִּילֵ֥נִי וּֽתְפַלְּטֵ֑נִי הַטֵּֽה אֵלַ֥י אָ֝זְנְךָ֗ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי
Psalms 71:2 [KJV]  Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

Psalms 71:3 [HEB]  הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י לְצ֥וּר מָע֡וֹן לָב֗וֹא תָּמִ֗יד צִוִּ֥יתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּֽי סַלְעִ֖י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָֽתָּה
Psalms 71:3 [KJV]  Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

Psalms 71:4 [HEB]  אֱֽלֹהַ֗י פַּ֭לְּטֵנִי מִיַּ֣ד רָשָׁ֑ע מִכַּ֖ף מְעַוֵּ֣ל וְחוֹמֵץ
Psalms 71:4 [KJV]  Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

Psalms 71:5 [HEB]  כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה תִקְוָתִ֑י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְ֝הוִ֗ה מִבְטַחִ֥י מִנְּעוּרָֽי
Psalms 71:5 [KJV]  For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.

Psalms 71:6 [HEB]  עָלֶ֤יךָ נִסְמַ֬כְתִּי מִבֶּ֗טֶן מִמְּעֵ֣י אִ֭מִּי אַתָּ֣ה גוֹזִ֑י בְּךָ֖ תְהִלָּתִ֣י תָמִֽיד
Psalms 71:6 [KJV]  By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

Psalms 71:7 [HEB]  כְּ֭מוֹפֵת הָיִ֣יתִי לְרַבִּ֑ים וְ֝אַתָּ֗ה מַֽחֲסִי עֹֽז
Psalms 71:7 [KJV]  I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

Psalms 71:8 [HEB]  יִמָּ֣לֵא פִ֭י תְּהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ
Psalms 71:8 [KJV]  Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

Psalms 71:9 [HEB]  אַֽל תַּ֭שְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵ֣ת זִקְנָ֑ה כִּכְל֥וֹת כֹּ֝חִ֗י אַֽל תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי
Psalms 71:9 [KJV]  Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

Psalms 71:10 [HEB]  כִּֽי אָמְר֣וּ אוֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י נוֹעֲצ֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו
Psalms 71:10 [KJV]  For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

Psalms 71:11 [HEB]  לֵ֭אמֹר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֲזָב֑וֹ רִֽדְפ֥וּ וְ֝תִפְשׂ֗וּהוּ כִּי אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל
Psalms 71:11 [KJV]  Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

Psalms 71:12 [HEB]  אֱ֭לֹהִים אַל תִּרְחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חישה חֽוּשָׁה
Psalms 71:12 [KJV]  O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

Psalms 71:13 [HEB]  יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ יִכְלוּ֮ שֹׂטְנֵ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יַֽעֲט֣וּ חֶ֭רְפָּה וּכְלִמָּ֑ה מְ֝בַקְשֵׁ֗י רָעָתִֽי
Psalms 71:13 [KJV]  Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

Psalms 71:14 [HEB]  וַ֭אֲנִי תָּמִ֣יד אֲיַחֵ֑ל וְ֝הוֹסַפְתִּ֗י עַל כָּל תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
Psalms 71:14 [KJV]  But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

Psalms 71:15 [HEB]  פִּ֤י יְסַפֵּ֬ר צִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ כָּל הַיּ֥וֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹ֖א יָדַ֣עְתִּי סְפֹרֽוֹת
Psalms 71:15 [KJV]  My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

Psalms 71:16 [HEB]  אָב֗וֹא בִּ֭גְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אַזְכִּ֖יר צִדְקָתְךָ֣ לְבַדֶּֽךָ
Psalms 71:16 [KJV]  I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

Psalms 71:17 [HEB]  אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים לִמַּדְתַּ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י וְעַד הֵ֝֗נָּה אַגִּ֥יד נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 71:17 [KJV]  O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

Psalms 71:18 [HEB]  וְגַ֤ם עַד זִקְנָ֨ה וְשֵׂיבָה֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים אַֽל תַּעַ֫זְבֵ֥נִי עַד אַגִּ֣יד זְרוֹעֲךָ֣ לְד֑וֹר לְכָל יָ֝ב֗וֹא גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 71:18 [KJV]  Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.

Psalms 71:19 [HEB]  וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַד מָ֫ר֥וֹם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֥יתָ גְדֹל֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִ֣י כָמֽוֹךָ
Psalms 71:19 [KJV]  Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

Psalms 71:20 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֤ר הראיתנו הִרְאִיתַ֨נִי צָר֥וֹת רַבּ֗וֹת וְרָ֫ע֥וֹת תָּשׁ֥וּב תחיינו תְּחַיֵּ֑ינִי וּֽמִתְּהֹמ֥וֹת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ תָּשׁ֥וּב תַּעֲלֵֽנִי
Psalms 71:20 [KJV]  Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

Psalms 71:21 [HEB]  תֶּ֤רֶב גְּֽדֻלָּתִ֗י וְתִסֹּ֥ב תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי
Psalms 71:21 [KJV]  Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

Psalms 71:22 [HEB]  גַּם אֲנִ֤י אוֹדְךָ֣ בִכְלִי נֶבֶל֮ אֲמִתְּךָ֪ אֱלֹ֫הָ֥י אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה לְךָ֣ בְכִנּ֑וֹר קְ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
Psalms 71:22 [KJV]  I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

Psalms 71:23 [HEB]  תְּרַנֵּ֣נָּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי כִּ֣י אֲזַמְּרָה לָּ֑ךְ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּדִֽיתָ
Psalms 71:23 [KJV]  My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

Psalms 71:24 [HEB]  גַּם לְשׁוֹנִ֗י כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקָתֶ֑ךָ כִּי בֹ֥שׁוּ כִֽי חָ֝פְר֗וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י רָעָתִֽי
Psalms 71:24 [KJV]  My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.


--- Psalms Chapter 72 ---
Psalms 72:1 [HEB]  לִשְׁלֹמֹ֨ה אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ תֵּ֑ן וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ לְבֶן מֶֽלֶךְ
Psalms 72:1 [KJV]  Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king’s son.

Psalms 72:2 [HEB]  יָדִ֣ין עַמְּךָ֣ בְצֶ֑דֶק וַעֲנִיֶּ֥יךָ בְמִשְׁפָּֽט
Psalms 72:2 [KJV]  He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

Psalms 72:3 [HEB]  יִשְׂא֤וּ הָרִ֓ים שָׁ֘ל֥וֹם לָעָ֑ם וּ֝גְבָע֗וֹת בִּצְדָקָֽה
Psalms 72:3 [KJV]  The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

Psalms 72:4 [HEB]  יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט עֲֽנִיֵּי עָ֗ם י֭וֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶבְי֑וֹן וִֽידַכֵּ֣א עוֹשֵֽׁק
Psalms 72:4 [KJV]  He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

Psalms 72:5 [HEB]  יִֽירָא֥וּךָ עִם שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵ֥י יָ֝רֵ֗חַ דּ֣וֹר דּוֹרִֽים
Psalms 72:5 [KJV]  They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

Psalms 72:6 [HEB]  יֵ֭רֵד כְּמָטָ֣ר עַל גֵּ֑ז כִּ֝רְבִיבִ֗ים זַרְזִ֥יף אָֽרֶץ
Psalms 72:6 [KJV]  He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

Psalms 72:7 [HEB]  יִֽפְרַח בְּיָמָ֥יו צַדִּ֑יק וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַד בְּלִ֥י יָרֵֽחַ
Psalms 72:7 [KJV]  In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

Psalms 72:8 [HEB]  וְ֭יֵרְדְּ מִיָּ֣ם עַד יָ֑ם וּ֝מִנָּהָ֗ר עַד אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ
Psalms 72:8 [KJV]  He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

Psalms 72:9 [HEB]  לְ֭פָנָיו יִכְרְע֣וּ צִיִּ֑ים וְ֝אֹיְבָ֗יו עָפָ֥ר יְלַחֵֽכוּ
Psalms 72:9 [KJV]  They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

Psalms 72:10 [HEB]  מַלְכֵ֬י תַרְשִׁ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִיִּים מִנְחָ֣ה יָשִׁ֑יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י שְׁבָ֥א וּ֝סְבָ֗א אֶשְׁכָּ֥ר יַקְרִֽיבוּ
Psalms 72:10 [KJV]  The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

Psalms 72:11 [HEB]  וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ ל֥וֹ כָל מְלָכִ֑ים כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם יַֽעַבְדֽוּהוּ
Psalms 72:11 [KJV]  Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

Psalms 72:12 [HEB]  כִּֽי יַ֭צִּיל אֶבְי֣וֹן מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝עָנִ֗י וְֽאֵין עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ
Psalms 72:12 [KJV]  For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

Psalms 72:13 [HEB]  יָ֭חֹס עַל דַּ֣ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יוֹשִֽׁיעַ
Psalms 72:13 [KJV]  He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

Psalms 72:14 [HEB]  מִתּ֣וֹךְ וּ֭מֵחָמָס יִגְאַ֣ל נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְיֵיקַ֖ר דָּמָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו
Psalms 72:14 [KJV]  He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

Psalms 72:15 [HEB]  וִיחִ֗י וְיִתֶּן לוֹ֮ מִזְּהַ֪ב שְׁ֫בָ֥א וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲד֣וֹ תָמִ֑יד כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם יְבָרֲכֶֽנְהֽוּ
Psalms 72:15 [KJV]  And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

Psalms 72:16 [HEB]  יְהִ֤י פִסַּת בַּ֨ר בָּאָרֶץ֮ בְּרֹ֪אשׁ הָ֫רִ֥ים יִרְעַ֣שׁ כַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן פִּרְי֑וֹ וְיָצִ֥יצוּ מֵ֝עִ֗יר כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 72:16 [KJV]  There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

Psalms 72:17 [HEB]  יְהִ֤י שְׁמ֨וֹ לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם לִפְנֵי שֶׁמֶשׁ֮ ינין יִנּ֪וֹן שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ וְיִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ ב֑וֹ כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם יְאַשְּׁרֽוּהוּ
Psalms 72:17 [KJV]  His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

Psalms 72:18 [HEB]  בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹשֵׂ֖ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת לְבַדּֽוֹ
Psalms 72:18 [KJV]  Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

Psalms 72:19 [HEB]  וּבָר֤וּךְ שֵׁ֥ם כְּבוֹד֗וֹ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם וְיִמָּלֵ֣א כְ֭בוֹדוֹ אֶת כֹּ֥ל הָאָ֗רֶץ אָ֘מֵ֥ן וְאָמֵֽן
Psalms 72:19 [KJV]  And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

Psalms 72:20 [HEB]  כָּלּ֥וּ תְפִלּ֑וֹת דָּ֝וִ֗ד בֶּן יִשָֽׁי
Psalms 72:20 [KJV]  The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

Psalms 73:2 [KJV]  But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

Psalms 73:4 [KJV]  For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

Psalms 73:8 [KJV]  They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

Psalms 73:9 [KJV]  They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

Psalms 73:10 [HEB]  לָכֵ֤ן ישיב יָשׁ֣וּב עַמּ֣וֹ הֲלֹ֑ם וּמֵ֥י מָ֝לֵ֗א יִמָּ֥צוּ לָֽמוֹ
Psalms 73:10 [KJV]  Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

Psalms 73:11 [HEB]  וְֽאָמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֥ה יָדַֽע אֵ֑ל וְיֵ֖שׁ דֵּעָ֣ה בְעֶלְיֽוֹן
Psalms 73:11 [KJV]  And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

Psalms 73:12 [HEB]  הִנֵּה אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְשַׁלְוֵ֥י ע֝וֹלָ֗ם הִשְׂגּוּ חָֽיִל

Psalms 73:14 [KJV]  For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

Psalms 73:15 [KJV]  If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

Psalms 73:16 [KJV]  When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

Psalms 73:17 [HEB]  עַד אָ֭בוֹא אֶל מִקְדְּשֵׁי אֵ֑ל אָ֝בִ֗ינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם
Psalms 73:17 [KJV]  Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.

Psalms 73:18 [KJV]  Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

Psalms 73:20 [HEB]  כַּחֲל֥וֹם מֵהָקִ֑יץ אֲ֝דֹנָי בָּעִ֤יר צַלְמָ֬ם תִּבְזֶֽה
Psalms 73:20 [KJV]  As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

Psalms 73:21 [HEB]  כִּ֭י יִתְחַמֵּ֣ץ לְבָבִ֑י וְ֝כִלְיוֹתַ֗י אֶשְׁתּוֹנָֽן
Psalms 73:21 [KJV]  Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

Psalms 73:22 [HEB]  וַאֲנִי בַ֭עַר וְלֹ֣א אֵדָ֑ע בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת הָיִ֥יתִי עִמָּֽךְ
Psalms 73:22 [KJV]  So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

Psalms 73:23 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֣י תָמִ֣יד עִמָּ֑ךְ אָ֝חַ֗זְתָּ בְּיַד יְמִינִֽי
Psalms 73:23 [KJV]  Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

Psalms 73:24 [HEB]  בַּעֲצָתְךָ֥ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְ֝אַחַ֗ר כָּב֥וֹד תִּקָּחֵֽנִי
Psalms 73:24 [KJV]  Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

Psalms 73:25 [HEB]  מִי לִ֥י בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝עִמְּךָ֗ לֹא חָפַ֥צְתִּי בָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 73:25 [KJV]  Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

Psalms 73:26 [KJV]  My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

Psalms 73:27 [KJV]  For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
