Psalms 73:28 [KJV]  But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.

Psalms 74:8 [KJV]  They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

Psalms 74:9 [HEB]  אֽוֹתֹתֵ֗ינוּ לֹ֥א רָ֫אִ֥ינוּ אֵֽין ע֥וֹד נָבִ֑יא וְלֹֽא אִ֝תָּ֗נוּ יֹדֵ֥עַ עַד מָֽה
Psalms 74:9 [KJV]  We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

Psalms 74:10 [HEB]  עַד מָתַ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים יְחָ֣רֶף צָ֑ר יְנָ֘אֵ֤ץ אוֹיֵ֖ב שִׁמְךָ֣ לָנֶֽצַח
Psalms 74:10 [KJV]  O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

Psalms 74:11 [KJV]  Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

Psalms 74:12 [KJV]  For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

Psalms 74:18 [HEB]  זְכָר זֹ֗את א֭וֹיֵב חֵרֵ֣ף יְהוָ֑ה וְעַ֥ם נָ֝בָ֗ל נִֽאֲצ֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ

Psalms 74:19 [HEB]  אַל תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭חַיַּת נֶ֣פֶשׁ תּוֹרֶ֑ךָ חַיַּ֥ת עֲ֝נִיֶּ֗יךָ אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח
Psalms 74:19 [KJV]  O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

Psalms 74:20 [HEB]  הַבֵּ֥ט לַבְּרִ֑ית כִּ֥י מָלְא֥וּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי אֶ֝֗רֶץ נְא֣וֹת חָמָֽס
Psalms 74:20 [KJV]  Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

Psalms 74:21 [HEB]  אַל יָשֹׁ֣ב דַּ֣ךְ נִכְלָ֑ם עָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן יְֽהַלְל֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ
Psalms 74:21 [KJV]  O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

Psalms 74:22 [HEB]  קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִיבָ֣ה רִיבֶ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר חֶרְפָּתְךָ֥ מִנִּי נָ֝בָ֗ל כָּל הַיּֽוֹם
Psalms 74:22 [KJV]  Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

Psalms 74:23 [HEB]  אַל תִּ֭שְׁכַּח ק֣וֹל צֹרְרֶ֑יךָ שְׁא֥וֹן קָ֝מֶ֗יךָ עֹלֶ֥ה תָמִֽיד
Psalms 74:23 [KJV]  Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.


--- Psalms Chapter 75 ---
Psalms 75:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל תַּשְׁחֵ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְאָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר
Psalms 75:1 [KJV]  Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

Psalms 75:2 [HEB]  ה֘וֹדִ֤ינוּ לְּךָ֨ אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים ה֭וֹדִינוּ וְקָר֣וֹב שְׁמֶ֑ךָ סִ֝פְּר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 75:2 [KJV]  When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

Psalms 75:3 [HEB]  כִּ֭י אֶקַּ֣ח מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲ֝נִ֗י מֵישָׁרִ֥ים אֶשְׁפֹּֽט
Psalms 75:3 [KJV]  The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

Psalms 75:4 [KJV]  I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

Psalms 75:5 [KJV]  Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

Psalms 75:6 [HEB]  אַל תָּרִ֣ימוּ לַמָּר֣וֹם קַרְנְכֶ֑ם תְּדַבְּר֖וּ בְצַוָּ֣אר עָתָֽק
Psalms 75:6 [KJV]  For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

Psalms 75:7 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹ֣א מִ֭מּוֹצָא וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב וְ֝לֹ֗א מִמִּדְבַּ֥ר הָרִֽים
Psalms 75:7 [KJV]  But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

Psalms 75:8 [HEB]  כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים שֹׁפֵ֑ט זֶ֥ה יַ֝שְׁפִּ֗יל וְזֶ֣ה יָרִֽים
Psalms 75:8 [KJV]  For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

Psalms 75:9 [HEB]  כִּ֤י כ֪וֹס בְּֽיַד יְהוָ֡ה וְיַ֤יִן חָמַ֨ר מָ֥לֵא מֶסֶךְ֮ וַיַּגֵּ֪ר מִ֫זֶּ֥ה אַךְ שְׁ֭מָרֶיהָ יִמְצ֣וּ יִשְׁתּ֑וּ כֹּ֝֗ל רִשְׁעֵי אָֽרֶץ
Psalms 75:9 [KJV]  But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

Psalms 75:10 [HEB]  וַ֭אֲנִי אַגִּ֣יד לְעֹלָ֑ם אֲ֝זַמְּרָ֗ה לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב
Psalms 75:10 [KJV]  All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

Psalms 75:11 [HEB]  וְכָל קַרְנֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֲגַדֵּ֑עַ תְּ֝רוֹמַ֗מְנָה קַֽרְנ֥וֹת צַדִּֽיק

Psalms 76:8 [KJV]  Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

Psalms 76:9 [KJV]  When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

Psalms 76:10 [HEB]  בְּקוּם לַמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט אֱלֹהִ֑ים לְהוֹשִׁ֖יעַ כָּל עַנְוֵי אֶ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 76:10 [KJV]  Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

Psalms 77:5 [HEB]  אָ֭חַזְתָּ שְׁמֻר֣וֹת עֵינָ֑י נִ֝פְעַ֗מְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֲדַבֵּֽר
Psalms 77:5 [KJV]  I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

Psalms 77:11 [KJV]  I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

Psalms 77:12 [KJV]  I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

Psalms 77:13 [HEB]  וְהָגִ֥יתִי בְכָל פָּעֳלֶ֑ךָ וּֽבַעֲלִ֖ילוֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה
Psalms 77:13 [KJV]  Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?

Psalms 77:14 [HEB]  אֱ֭לֹהִים בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ מִי אֵ֥ל גָּ֝ד֗וֹל כֵּֽאלֹהִֽים
Psalms 77:14 [KJV]  Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

Psalms 77:15 [HEB]  אַתָּ֣ה הָ֭אֵל עֹ֣שֵׂה פֶ֑לֶא הוֹדַ֖עְתָּ בָעַמִּ֣ים עֻזֶּֽךָ

Psalms 77:17 [KJV]  The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.

Psalms 77:18 [HEB]  זֹ֤רְמוּ מַ֨יִם עָב֗וֹת ק֭וֹל נָתְנ֣וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים אַף חֲ֝צָצֶ֗יךָ יִתְהַלָּֽכוּ
Psalms 77:18 [KJV]  The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

Psalms 77:19 [KJV]  Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

Psalms 77:20 [HEB]  בַּיָּ֤ם דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ ושביליך וּֽ֭שְׁבִֽילְךָ בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝עִקְּבוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נֹדָֽעוּ
Psalms 77:20 [KJV]  Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

Psalms 77:21 [HEB]  נָחִ֣יתָ כַצֹּ֣אן עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּֽיַד מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן
Psalms 77:21 [KJV]

Psalms 78:1 [HEB]  מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף הַאֲזִ֣ינָה עַ֭מִּי תּוֹרָתִ֑י הַטּ֥וּ אָ֝זְנְכֶ֗ם לְאִמְרֵי פִֽי

Psalms 78:2 [KJV]  I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

Psalms 78:5 [KJV]  For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

Psalms 78:6 [HEB]  לְמַ֤עַן יֵדְע֨וּ דּ֣וֹר אַ֭חֲרוֹן בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 78:6 [KJV]  That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

Psalms 78:7 [HEB]  וְיָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵֽאלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥ם וְלֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי אֵ֑ל וּמִצְוֺתָ֥יו יִנְצֹֽרוּ
Psalms 78:7 [KJV]  That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

Psalms 78:8 [HEB]  וְלֹ֤א יִהְי֨וּ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֗ם דּוֹר֮ סוֹרֵ֪ר וּמֹ֫רֶ֥ה דּ֭וֹר לֹא הֵכִ֣ין לִבּ֑וֹ וְלֹא נֶאֶמְנָ֖ה אֶת אֵ֣ל רוּחֽוֹ
Psalms 78:8 [KJV]  And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

Psalms 78:9 [HEB]  בְּֽנֵי אֶפְרַ֗יִם נוֹשְׁקֵ֥י רוֹמֵי קָ֑שֶׁת הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּי֣וֹם קְרָֽב
Psalms 78:9 [KJV]  The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

Psalms 78:10 [HEB]  לֹ֣א שָׁ֭מְרוּ בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ֝בְתוֹרָת֗וֹ מֵאֲנ֥וּ לָלֶֽכֶת

Psalms 78:66 [KJV]  And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

Psalms 78:67 [HEB]  וַ֭יִּמְאַס בְּאֹ֣הֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף וּֽבְשֵׁ֥בֶט אֶ֝פְרַ֗יִם לֹ֣א בָחָֽר

Psalms 78:68 [KJV]  But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

Psalms 78:69 [HEB]  וַיִּ֣בֶן כְּמוֹ רָ֭מִים מִקְדָּשׁ֑וֹ כְּ֝אֶ֗רֶץ יְסָדָ֥הּ לְעוֹלָֽם
Psalms 78:69 [KJV]  And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.

Psalms 78:70 [HEB]  וַ֭יִּבְחַר בְּדָוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַ֝יִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ מִֽמִּכְלְאֹ֥ת צֹֽאן
Psalms 78:70 [KJV]  He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

Psalms 78:71 [HEB]  מֵאַחַ֥ר עָל֗וֹת הֱ֫בִיא֥וֹ לִ֭רְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹ֣ב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ
Psalms 78:71 [KJV]  From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

--- Psalms Chapter 79 ---
Psalms 79:1 [HEB]  מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים בָּ֤אוּ גוֹיִ֨ם בְּֽנַחֲלָתֶ֗ךָ טִ֭מְּאוּ אֶת הֵיכַ֣ל קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לְעִיִּֽים

Psalms 79:3 [KJV]  Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

Psalms 79:4 [HEB]  הָיִ֣ינוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ
Psalms 79:4 [KJV]  We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

Psalms 79:5 [HEB]  עַד מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תֶּאֱנַ֣ף לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֥ר כְּמוֹ אֵ֝֗שׁ קִנְאָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 79:5 [KJV]  How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

Psalms 79:6 [KJV]  Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

Psalms 79:7 [KJV]  For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

Psalms 79:8 [HEB]  אַֽל תִּזְכָּר לָנוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֪ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּנוּ רַחֲמֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י דַלּ֣וֹנוּ מְאֹֽד
Psalms 79:8 [KJV]  O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

Psalms 79:9 [KJV]  Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name’s sake.

Psalms 79:10 [HEB]  לָ֤מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִם֮ אַיֵּ֪ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫יהֶ֥ם יִוָּדַ֣ע בגיים בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם לְעֵינֵ֑ינוּ נִ֝קְמַ֗ת דַּֽם עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ הַשָּׁפֽוּךְ
Psalms 79:10 [KJV]  Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

Psalms 79:11 [HEB]  תָּ֤ב֣וֹא לְפָנֶיךָ֮ אֶנְקַ֪ת אָ֫סִ֥יר כְּגֹ֥דֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ֑ ה֝וֹתֵ֗ר בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה
Psalms 79:11 [KJV]  Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

Psalms 79:12 [HEB]  וְהָ֘שֵׁ֤ב לִשְׁכֵנֵ֣ינוּ שִׁ֭בְעָתַיִם אֶל חֵיקָ֑ם חֶרְפָּ֘תָ֤ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר חֵרְפ֣וּךָ אֲדֹנָֽי
Psalms 79:12 [KJV]  And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

Psalms 79:13 [HEB]  וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַמְּךָ֨ וְצֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתֶךָ֮ נ֤וֹדֶ֥ה לְּךָ֗ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֑ר נְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
Psalms 79:13 [KJV]  So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

Psalms 80:9 [KJV]  Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

Psalms 80:10 [HEB]  פִּנִּ֥יתָ לְפָנֶ֑יהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵ֥שׁ שָׁ֝רָשֶׁ֗יהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא אָֽרֶץ

Psalms 80:16 [HEB]  וְ֭כַנָּה אֲשֶׁר נָטְעָ֣ה יְמִינֶ֑ךָ וְעַל בֵּ֝֗ן אִמַּ֥צְתָּה לָּֽךְ
Psalms 80:16 [KJV]  It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

Psalms 80:17 [HEB]  שְׂרֻפָ֣ה בָאֵ֣שׁ כְּסוּחָ֑ה מִגַּעֲרַ֖ת פָּנֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵֽדוּ
Psalms 80:17 [KJV]  Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

Psalms 80:18 [HEB]  תְּֽהִי יָ֭דְךָ עַל אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינֶ֑ךָ עַל בֶּן אָ֝דָ֗ם אִמַּ֥צְתָּ לָּֽךְ
Psalms 80:18 [KJV]  So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

Psalms 80:19 [HEB]  וְלֹא נָס֥וֹג מִמֶּ֑ךָּ תְּ֝חַיֵּ֗נוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֥ נִקְרָֽא
Psalms 80:19 [KJV]  Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

Psalms 81:6 [KJV]  I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

Psalms 81:8 [KJV]  Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

Psalms 81:9 [HEB]  שְׁמַ֣ע עַ֭מִּי וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם תִּֽשְׁמַֽע לִֽי
Psalms 81:9 [KJV]  There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

Psalms 81:10 [HEB]  לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה בְ֭ךָ אֵ֣ל זָ֑ר וְלֹ֥א תִ֝שְׁתַּחֲוֶ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל נֵכָֽר
Psalms 81:10 [KJV]  I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

Psalms 81:11 [HEB]  אָנֹכִ֨י יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ הַֽ֭מַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַרְחֶב פִּ֝֗יךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵֽהוּ
Psalms 81:11 [KJV]  But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

Psalms 81:12 [HEB]  וְלֹא שָׁמַ֣ע עַמִּ֣י לְקוֹלִ֑י וְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹא אָ֥בָה לִֽי
Psalms 81:12 [KJV]  So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

Psalms 81:13 [HEB]  וָֽ֭אֲשַׁלְּחֵהוּ בִּשְׁרִיר֣וּת לִבָּ֑ם יֵ֝לְכ֗וּ בְּֽמוֹעֲצוֹתֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 81:13 [KJV]  Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!

Psalms 81:14 [HEB]  ל֗וּ עַ֭מִּי שֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֑י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל בִּדְרָכַ֥י יְהַלֵּֽכוּ
Psalms 81:14 [KJV]  I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

Psalms 81:15 [HEB]  כִּ֭מְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֣ם אַכְנִ֑יעַ וְעַ֥ל צָ֝רֵיהֶ֗ם אָשִׁ֥יב יָדִֽי
Psalms 81:15 [KJV]  The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

Psalms 81:16 [HEB]  מְשַׂנְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה יְכַֽחֲשׁוּ ל֑וֹ וִיהִ֖י עִתָּ֣ם לְעוֹלָֽם
Psalms 81:16 [KJV]  He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.

Psalms 81:17 [HEB]  וַֽ֭יַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵ֣לֶב חִטָּ֑ה וּ֝מִצּ֗וּר דְּבַ֣שׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶֽךָ
Psalms 81:17 [KJV]

Psalms 82:7 [KJV]  But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

Psalms 83:10 [KJV]  Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

Psalms 83:12 [KJV]  Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

Psalms 83:13 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָ֭מְרוּ נִ֣ירֲשָׁה לָּ֑נוּ אֵ֝֗ת נְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 83:13 [KJV]  O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

Psalms 83:14 [HEB]  אֱֽלֹהַ֗י שִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ כַגַּלְגַּ֑ל כְּ֝קַ֗שׁ לִפְנֵי רֽוּחַ
Psalms 83:14 [KJV]  As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

Psalms 83:16 [KJV]  Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.

Psalms 83:17 [HEB]  מַלֵּ֣א פְנֵיהֶ֣ם קָל֑וֹן וִֽיבַקְשׁ֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 83:17 [KJV]  Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

Psalms 83:18 [KJV]  That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.

Psalms 83:19 [HEB]  וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי אַתָּ֬ה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 83:19 [KJV]

Psalms 84:5 [KJV]  Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.

Psalms 84:7 [KJV]  They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.

Psalms 84:8 [HEB]  יֵ֭לְכוּ מֵחַ֣יִל אֶל חָ֑יִל יֵרָאֶ֖ה אֶל אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּצִיּֽוֹן
Psalms 84:8 [KJV]  O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

Psalms 84:9 [HEB]  יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְ֭בָאוֹת שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י הַאֲזִ֨ינָה אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה
Psalms 84:9 [KJV]  Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

Psalms 84:10 [HEB]  מָ֭גִנֵּנוּ רְאֵ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ֝הַבֵּ֗ט פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ
Psalms 84:10 [KJV]  For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

Psalms 84:11 [HEB]  כִּ֤י טֽוֹב י֥וֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶ֗יךָ מֵ֫אָ֥לֶף בָּחַ֗רְתִּי הִ֭סְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֑י מִ֝דּ֗וּר בְּאָהֳלֵי רֶֽשַׁע
Psalms 84:11 [KJV]  For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

Psalms 84:12 [HEB]  כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ וּמָגֵן֮ יְהוָ֪ה אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֣ן וְ֭כָבוֹד יִתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א יִמְנַע ט֝֗וֹב לַֽהֹלְכִ֥ים בְּתָמִֽים
Psalms 84:12 [KJV]  O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

Psalms 84:13 [HEB]  יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ

Psalms 85:1 [HEB]  לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִבְנֵי קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר

Psalms 85:5 [HEB]  שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּֽעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ

Psalms 85:6 [HEB]  הַלְעוֹלָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר
Psalms 85:6 [KJV]  Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

Psalms 85:7 [HEB]  הֲֽלֹא אַ֭תָּה תָּשׁ֣וּב תְּחַיֵּ֑נוּ וְ֝עַמְּךָ֗ יִשְׂמְחוּ בָֽךְ

Psalms 89:2 [HEB]  חַֽסְדֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עוֹלָ֣ם אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֓ר אוֹדִ֖יעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בְּפִֽי
Psalms 89:2 [KJV]  For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

Psalms 89:3 [HEB]  כִּֽי אָמַ֗רְתִּי ע֭וֹלָם חֶ֣סֶד יִבָּנֶ֑ה שָׁמַ֓יִם תָּכִ֖ן אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בָהֶֽם
Psalms 89:3 [KJV]  I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

Psalms 89:4 [HEB]  כָּרַ֣תִּֽי בְ֭רִית לִבְחִירִ֑י נִ֝שְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי לְדָוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי
Psalms 89:4 [KJV]  Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

Psalms 89:5 [HEB]  עַד ע֭וֹלָם אָכִ֣ין זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וּבָנִ֨יתִי לְדֹר וָד֖וֹר כִּסְאֲךָ֣ סֶֽלָה
Psalms 89:5 [KJV]  And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

Psalms 89:6 [HEB]  וְי֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה אַף אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ בִּקְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים
Psalms 89:6 [KJV]  For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?

Psalms 89:7 [HEB]  כִּ֤י מִ֣י בַ֭שַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹ֣ךְ לַיהוָ֑ה יִדְמֶ֥ה לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בִּבְנֵ֥י אֵלִים
Psalms 89:7 [KJV]  God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

Psalms 89:8 [HEB]  אֵ֣ל נַ֭עֲרָץ בְּסוֹד קְדֹשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝נוֹרָ֗א עַל כָּל סְבִיבָֽיו
Psalms 89:8 [KJV]  O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

Psalms 89:9 [HEB]  יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִֽי כָֽמ֖וֹךָ חֲסִ֥ין יָ֑הּ וֶ֝אֱמֽוּנָתְךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 89:9 [KJV]  Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

Psalms 89:10 [HEB]  אַתָּ֣ה מ֭וֹשֵׁל בְּגֵא֣וּת הַיָּ֑ם בְּשׂ֥וֹא גַ֝לָּ֗יו אַתָּ֥ה תְשַׁבְּחֵֽם
Psalms 89:10 [KJV]  Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

Psalms 89:11 [HEB]  אַתָּ֤ה דִכִּ֣אתָ כֶחָלָ֣ל רָ֑הַב בִּזְר֥וֹעַ עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ פִּזַּ֥רְתָּ אוֹיְבֶֽיךָ
Psalms 89:11 [KJV]  The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

Psalms 89:12 [HEB]  לְךָ֣ שָׁ֭מַיִם אַף לְךָ֥ אָ֑רֶץ תֵּבֵ֥ל וּ֝מְלֹאָ֗הּ אַתָּ֥ה יְסַדְתָּֽם
Psalms 89:12 [KJV]  The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

Psalms 89:13 [HEB]  צָפ֣וֹן וְ֭יָמִין אַתָּ֣ה בְרָאתָ֑ם תָּב֥וֹר וְ֝חֶרְמ֗וֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ
Psalms 89:13 [KJV]  Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

Psalms 89:14 [HEB]  לְךָ֣ זְ֭רוֹעַ עִם גְּבוּרָ֑ה תָּעֹ֥ז יָ֝דְךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם יְמִינֶֽךָ
Psalms 89:14 [KJV]  Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

Psalms 89:15 [HEB]  צֶ֣דֶק וּ֭מִשְׁפָּט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֶ֑ךָ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת יְֽקַדְּמ֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ
Psalms 89:15 [KJV]  Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.

Psalms 89:16 [HEB]  אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם יוֹדְעֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה בְּֽאוֹר פָּנֶ֥יךָ יְהַלֵּכֽוּן
Psalms 89:16 [KJV]  In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

Psalms 89:17 [HEB]  בְּ֭שִׁמְךָ יְגִיל֣וּן כָּל הַיּ֑וֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יָרֽוּמוּ
Psalms 89:17 [KJV]  For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

Psalms 89:18 [HEB]  כִּֽי תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֝בִרְצֹנְךָ֗ תרים תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֵֽנוּ
Psalms 89:18 [KJV]  For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

Psalms 89:19 [HEB]  כִּ֣י לַֽ֭יהוָה מָֽגִנֵּ֑נוּ וְלִקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְכֵּֽנוּ
Psalms 89:19 [KJV]  Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

Psalms 89:20 [HEB]  אָ֤ז דִּבַּ֥רְתָּֽ בְחָ֡זוֹן לַֽחֲסִידֶ֗יךָ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁוִּ֣יתִי עֵ֭זֶר עַל גִּבּ֑וֹר הֲרִימ֖וֹתִי בָח֣וּר מֵעָֽם
Psalms 89:20 [KJV]  I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

Psalms 89:21 [HEB]  מָ֭צָאתִי דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑י בְּשֶׁ֖מֶן קָדְשִׁ֣י מְשַׁחְתִּֽיו
Psalms 89:21 [KJV]  With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

Psalms 89:22 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָ֭דִי תִּכּ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ אַף זְרוֹעִ֥י תְאַמְּצֶֽנּוּ
Psalms 89:22 [KJV]  The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

Psalms 89:23 [HEB]  לֹֽא יַשִּׁ֣א אוֹיֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ וּבֶן עַ֝וְלָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽנּוּ
Psalms 89:23 [KJV]  And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

Psalms 89:24 [HEB]  וְכַתּוֹתִ֣י מִפָּנָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֥יו אֶגּֽוֹף
Psalms 89:24 [KJV]  But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

Psalms 89:25 [HEB]  וֶֽאֶֽמוּנָתִ֣י וְחַסְדִּ֣י עִמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בִשְׁמִ֗י תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֽוֹ
Psalms 89:25 [KJV]  I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

Psalms 89:26 [HEB]  וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י בַיָּ֣ם יָד֑וֹ וּֽבַנְּהָר֥וֹת יְמִינֽוֹ
Psalms 89:26 [KJV]  He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

Psalms 89:27 [HEB]  ה֣וּא יִ֭קְרָאֵנִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אֵ֝לִ֗י וְצ֣וּר יְשׁוּעָתִֽי
Psalms 89:27 [KJV]  Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

Psalms 89:28 [HEB]  אַף אָ֭נִי בְּכ֣וֹר אֶתְּנֵ֑הוּ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן לְמַלְכֵי אָֽרֶץ
Psalms 89:28 [KJV]  My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

Psalms 89:29 [HEB]  לְ֭עוֹלָ֗ם אשמור אֶשְׁמָר ל֣וֹ חַסְדִּ֑י וּ֝בְרִיתִ֗י נֶאֱמֶ֥נֶת לֽוֹ
Psalms 89:29 [KJV]  His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

Psalms 89:30 [HEB]  וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י לָעַ֣ד זַרְע֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ כִּימֵ֥י שָׁמָֽיִם
Psalms 89:30 [KJV]  If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

Psalms 89:31 [HEB]  אִם יַֽעַזְב֣וּ בָ֭נָיו תּוֹרָתִ֑י וּ֝בְמִשְׁפָּטַ֗י לֹ֣א יֵלֵכֽוּן
Psalms 89:31 [KJV]  If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

Psalms 89:32 [HEB]  אִם חֻקֹּתַ֥י יְחַלֵּ֑לוּ וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ
Psalms 89:32 [KJV]  Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

Psalms 89:33 [HEB]  וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י בְשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּבִנְגָעִ֥ים עֲוֺנָֽם
Psalms 89:33 [KJV]  Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

Psalms 89:34 [HEB]  וְ֭חַסְדִּי לֹֽא אָפִ֣יר מֵֽעִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא אֲ֝שַׁקֵּ֗ר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִֽי
Psalms 89:34 [KJV]  My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

Psalms 89:35 [HEB]  לֹא אֲחַלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתִ֑י וּמוֹצָ֥א שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י לֹ֣א אֲשַׁנֶּֽה
Psalms 89:35 [KJV]  Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

Psalms 89:36 [HEB]  אַ֭חַת נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁ֑י אִֽם לְדָוִ֥ד אֲכַזֵּֽב
Psalms 89:36 [KJV]  His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

Psalms 89:37 [HEB]  זַ֭רְעוֹ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה וְכִסְא֖וֹ כַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ נֶגְדִּֽי
Psalms 89:37 [KJV]  It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

Psalms 89:38 [HEB]  כְּ֭יָרֵחַ יִכּ֣וֹן עוֹלָ֑ם וְעֵ֥ד בַּ֝שַּׁ֗חַק נֶאֱמָ֥ן סֶֽלָה
Psalms 89:38 [KJV]  But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

Psalms 89:39 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֣ה זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָ֑ס הִ֝תְעַבַּ֗רְתָּ עִם מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ
Psalms 89:39 [KJV]  Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

Psalms 89:40 [HEB]  נֵ֭אַרְתָּה בְּרִ֣ית עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ לָאָ֣רֶץ נִזְרֽוֹ
Psalms 89:40 [KJV]  Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

Psalms 89:41 [HEB]  פָּרַ֥צְתָּ כָל גְּדֵרֹתָ֑יו שַׂ֖מְתָּ מִבְצָרָ֣יו מְחִתָּה
Psalms 89:41 [KJV]  All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

Psalms 89:42 [HEB]  שַׁ֭סֻּהוּ כָּל עֹ֣בְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הָיָ֥ה חֶ֝רְפָּ֗ה לִשְׁכֵנָֽיו
Psalms 89:42 [KJV]  Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

Psalms 89:43 [HEB]  הֲ֭רִימוֹתָ יְמִ֣ין צָרָ֑יו הִ֝שְׂמַ֗חְתָּ כָּל אוֹיְבָֽיו
Psalms 89:43 [KJV]  Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

Psalms 89:44 [HEB]  אַף תָּ֭שִׁיב צ֣וּר חַרְבּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א הֲ֝קֵימֹת֗וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה
Psalms 89:44 [KJV]  Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

Psalms 89:45 [HEB]  הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ מִטְּהָר֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ לָאָ֥רֶץ מִגַּֽרְתָּה
Psalms 89:45 [KJV]  The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

Psalms 89:46 [HEB]  הִ֭קְצַרְתָּ יְמֵ֣י עֲלוּמָ֑יו הֶֽעֱטִ֨יתָ עָלָ֖יו בּוּשָׁ֣ה סֶֽלָה
Psalms 89:46 [KJV]  How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

Psalms 89:47 [HEB]  עַד מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּסָּתֵ֣ר לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֖ר כְּמוֹ אֵ֣שׁ חֲמָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 89:47 [KJV]  Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

Psalms 89:48 [HEB]  זְכָר אֲנִ֥י מֶה חָ֑לֶד עַל מַה שָּׁ֝֗וְא בָּרָ֥אתָ כָל בְּנֵי אָדָֽם
Psalms 89:48 [KJV]  What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

Psalms 89:49 [HEB]  מִ֤י גֶ֣בֶר יִֽ֭חְיֶה וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶה מָּ֑וֶת יְמַלֵּ֨ט נַפְשׁ֖וֹ מִיַּד שְׁא֣וֹל סֶֽלָה
Psalms 89:49 [KJV]  Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

Psalms 89:50 [HEB]  אַיֵּ֤ה חֲסָדֶ֖יךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֥ים אֲדֹנָ֑י נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לְ֝דָוִ֗ד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 89:50 [KJV]  Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

Psalms 89:51 [HEB]  זְכֹ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי חֶרְפַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ שְׂאֵתִ֥י בְ֝חֵיקִ֗י כָּל רַבִּ֥ים עַמִּֽים
Psalms 89:51 [KJV]  Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

Psalms 89:52 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵרְפ֖וּ אוֹיְבֶ֥יךָ יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חֵ֝רְפ֗וּ עִקְּב֥וֹת מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ
Psalms 89:52 [KJV]  Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

Psalms 89:53 [HEB]  בָּר֖וּךְ יְהוָ֥ה לְ֝עוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן וְאָמֵֽן
Psalms 89:53 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 90 ---
Psalms 90:1 [HEB]  תְּפִלָּה֮ לְמֹשֶׁ֪ה אִֽישׁ הָאֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים אֲֽדֹנָ֗י מָע֣וֹן אַ֭תָּה הָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֗נוּ בְּדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר
Psalms 90:1 [KJV]  Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

Psalms 90:2 [HEB]  בְּטֶ֤רֶם הָ֘רִ֤ים יֻלָּ֗דוּ וַתְּח֣וֹלֵֽל אֶ֣רֶץ וְתֵבֵ֑ל וּֽמֵעוֹלָ֥ם עַד ע֝וֹלָ֗ם אַתָּ֥ה אֵֽל
Psalms 90:2 [KJV]  Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

Psalms 90:3 [HEB]  תָּשֵׁ֣ב אֱ֭נוֹשׁ עַד דַּכָּ֑א וַ֝תֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וּבוּ בְנֵי אָדָֽם
Psalms 90:3 [KJV]  Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

Psalms 90:4 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אֶ֪לֶף שָׁנִ֡ים בְּֽעֵינֶ֗יךָ כְּי֣וֹם אֶ֭תְמוֹל כִּ֣י יַעֲבֹ֑ר וְאַשְׁמוּרָ֥ה בַלָּֽיְלָה
Psalms 90:4 [KJV]  For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

Psalms 90:5 [HEB]  זְ֭רַמְתָּם שֵׁנָ֣ה יִהְי֑וּ בַּ֝בֹּ֗קֶר כֶּחָצִ֥יר יַחֲלֹֽף
Psalms 90:5 [KJV]  Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

Psalms 90:6 [HEB]  בַּ֭בֹּקֶר יָצִ֣יץ וְחָלָ֑ף לָ֝עֶ֗רֶב יְמוֹלֵ֥ל וְיָבֵֽשׁ
Psalms 90:6 [KJV]  In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

Psalms 90:7 [HEB]  כִּֽי כָלִ֥ינוּ בְאַפֶּ֑ךָ וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ נִבְהָֽלְנוּ
Psalms 90:7 [KJV]  For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

Psalms 90:8 [HEB]  שת שַׁתָּ֣ה עֲוֺנֹתֵ֣ינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝לֻמֵ֗נוּ לִמְא֥וֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ
Psalms 90:8 [KJV]  Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

Psalms 90:9 [HEB]  כִּ֣י כָל יָ֭מֵינוּ פָּנ֣וּ בְעֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּלִּ֖ינוּ שָׁנֵ֣ינוּ כְמוֹ הֶֽגֶה
Psalms 90:9 [KJV]  For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.

Psalms 90:10 [HEB]  יְמֵֽי שְׁנוֹתֵ֨ינוּ בָהֶ֥ם שִׁבְעִ֪ים שָׁנָ֡ה וְאִ֤ם בִּגְבוּרֹ֨ת שְׁמ֘וֹנִ֤ים שָׁנָ֗ה וְ֭רָהְבָּם עָמָ֣ל וָאָ֑וֶן כִּי גָ֥ז חִ֝֗ישׁ וַנָּעֻֽפָה
Psalms 90:10 [KJV]  The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

Psalms 90:11 [HEB]  מִֽי י֭וֹדֵעַ עֹ֣ז אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּ֝כְיִרְאָתְךָ֗ עֶבְרָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 90:11 [KJV]  Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.

Psalms 90:12 [HEB]  לִמְנ֣וֹת יָ֭מֵינוּ כֵּ֣ן הוֹדַ֑ע וְ֝נָבִ֗א לְבַ֣ב חָכְמָֽה
Psalms 90:12 [KJV]  So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

Psalms 90:13 [HEB]  שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה עַד מָתָ֑י וְ֝הִנָּחֵ֗ם עַל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ
Psalms 90:13 [KJV]  Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

Psalms 90:14 [HEB]  שַׂבְּעֵ֣נוּ בַבֹּ֣קֶר חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וּֽנְרַנְּנָ֥ה וְ֝נִשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּכָל יָמֵֽינוּ
Psalms 90:14 [KJV]  O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

Psalms 90:15 [HEB]  שַׂ֭מְּחֵנוּ כִּימ֣וֹת עִנִּיתָ֑נוּ שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת רָאִ֥ינוּ רָעָֽה
Psalms 90:15 [KJV]  Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.

Psalms 90:16 [HEB]  יֵרָאֶ֣ה אֶל עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ פָעֳלֶ֑ךָ וַ֝הֲדָרְךָ֗ עַל בְּנֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 90:16 [KJV]  Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

Psalms 90:17 [HEB]  וִיהִ֤י נֹ֤עַם אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עָ֫לֵ֥ינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֭דֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָ֥ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דֵ֗ינוּ כּוֹנְנֵֽהוּ
Psalms 90:17 [KJV]  And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

Psalms 91:6 [KJV]  Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

Psalms 91:8 [KJV]  Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

Psalms 91:9 [HEB]  כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן שַׂ֣מְתָּ מְעוֹנֶֽךָ

Psalms 91:10 [KJV]  There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

Psalms 91:11 [HEB]  כִּ֣י מַ֭לְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה לָּ֑ךְ לִ֝שְׁמָרְךָ֗ בְּכָל דְּרָכֶֽיךָ
Psalms 91:11 [KJV]  For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

Psalms 91:12 [KJV]  They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

Psalms 91:13 [KJV]  Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

Psalms 91:14 [HEB]  כִּ֤י בִ֣י חָ֭שַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ אֲ֝שַׂגְּבֵ֗הוּ כִּֽי יָדַ֥ע שְׁמִֽי
Psalms 91:14 [KJV]  Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

Psalms 91:15 [HEB]  יִקְרָאֵ֨נִי וְֽאֶעֱנֵ֗הוּ עִמּֽוֹ אָנֹכִ֥י בְצָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלְּצֵ֗הוּ וַֽאֲכַבְּדֵֽהוּ
Psalms 91:15 [KJV]  He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

Psalms 91:16 [HEB]  אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אַרְאֵ֗הוּ בִּֽישׁוּעָתִֽי
Psalms 91:16 [KJV]  With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

Psalms 92:5 [KJV]  O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

Psalms 92:6 [HEB]  מַה גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 92:6 [KJV]  A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

Psalms 92:8 [KJV]  But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.

Psalms 92:9 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֥ה מָר֗וֹם לְעֹלָ֥ם יְהוָֽה

Psalms 92:10 [HEB]  כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡יךָ יְֽהוָ֗ה כִּֽי הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
Psalms 92:10 [KJV]  But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

Psalms 92:12 [KJV]  The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

Psalms 92:13 [HEB]  צַ֭דִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה
Psalms 92:13 [KJV]  Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

Psalms 92:14 [HEB]  שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּחַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ
Psalms 92:14 [KJV]  They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

Psalms 92:15 [HEB]  ע֭וֹד יְנוּב֣וּן בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְרַֽעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ
Psalms 92:15 [KJV]  To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

Psalms 92:16 [HEB]  לְ֭הַגִּיד כִּֽי יָשָׁ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה צ֝וּרִ֗י וְֽלֹא עלתה עַוְלָ֥תָה בּֽוֹ
Psalms 92:16 [KJV]  


--- Psalms Chapter 93 ---
Psalms 93:1 [HEB]  יְהוָ֣ה מָלָךְ֮ גֵּא֪וּת לָ֫בֵ֥שׁ לָבֵ֣שׁ יְ֭הוָה עֹ֣ז הִתְאַזָּ֑ר אַף תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל בַּל תִּמּֽוֹט
Psalms 93:1 [KJV]  The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

Psalms 93:2 [KJV]  Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

Psalms 93:3 [HEB]  נָשְׂא֤וּ נְהָר֨וֹת יְֽהוָ֗ה נָשְׂא֣וּ נְהָר֣וֹת קוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂא֖וּ נְהָר֣וֹת דָּכְיָֽם
Psalms 93:3 [KJV]  The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

Psalms 93:4 [HEB]  מִקֹּל֨וֹת מַ֤יִם רַבִּ֗ים אַדִּירִ֣ים מִשְׁבְּרֵי יָ֑ם אַדִּ֖יר בַּמָּר֣וֹם יְהוָֽה
Psalms 93:4 [KJV]  The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

Psalms 93:5 [HEB]  עֵֽדֹתֶ֨יךָ נֶאֶמְנ֬וּ מְאֹ֗ד לְבֵיתְךָ֥ נַאֲוָה קֹ֑דֶשׁ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים
Psalms 93:5 [KJV]  Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.


--- Psalms Chapter 94 ---
Psalms 94:1 [HEB]  אֵל נְקָמ֥וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֖ל נְקָמ֣וֹת הוֹפִֽיַע
Psalms 94:1 [KJV]  O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

Psalms 94:2 [HEB]  הִ֭נָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵ֣ט הָאָ֑רֶץ הָשֵׁ֥ב גְּ֝מ֗וּל עַל גֵּאִֽים
Psalms 94:2 [KJV]  Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

Psalms 94:3 [HEB]  עַד מָתַ֖י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְהוָ֑ה עַד מָ֝תַ֗י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ
Psalms 94:3 [KJV]  LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

Psalms 94:4 [HEB]  יַבִּ֣יעוּ יְדַבְּר֣וּ עָתָ֑ק יִֽ֝תְאַמְּר֗וּ כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
Psalms 94:4 [KJV]  How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

Psalms 94:5 [HEB]  עַמְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה יְדַכְּא֑וּ וְֽנַחֲלָתְךָ֥ יְעַנּֽוּ
Psalms 94:5 [KJV]  They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.

Psalms 94:6 [HEB]  אַ֭לְמָנָה וְגֵ֣ר יַהֲרֹ֑גוּ וִֽיתוֹמִ֣ים יְרַצֵּֽחוּ
Psalms 94:6 [KJV]  They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

Psalms 94:7 [HEB]  וַ֭יֹּ֣אמְרוּ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶה יָּ֑הּ וְלֹא יָ֝בִ֗ין אֱלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב
Psalms 94:7 [KJV]  Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

Psalms 94:8 [HEB]  בִּ֭ינוּ בֹּעֲרִ֣ים בָּעָ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מָתַ֥י תַּשְׂכִּֽילוּ
Psalms 94:8 [KJV]  Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

Psalms 94:9 [HEB]  הֲנֹ֣טַֽע אֹ֭זֶן הֲלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִֽם יֹ֥צֵֽר עַ֝֗יִן הֲלֹ֣א יַבִּֽיט
Psalms 94:9 [KJV]  He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

Psalms 94:10 [HEB]  הֲיֹסֵ֣ר גּ֭וֹיִם הֲלֹ֣א יוֹכִ֑יחַ הַֽמְלַמֵּ֖ד אָדָ֣ם דָּֽעַת
Psalms 94:10 [KJV]  He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

Psalms 94:11 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה יֹ֭דֵעַ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָדָ֑ם כִּי הֵ֥מָּה הָֽבֶל
Psalms 94:11 [KJV]  The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

Psalms 94:12 [HEB]  אַשְׁרֵ֤י הַגֶּ֣בֶר אֲשֶׁר תְּיַסְּרֶ֣נּוּ יָּ֑הּ וּֽמִתּוֹרָתְךָ֥ תְלַמְּדֶֽנּוּ
Psalms 94:12 [KJV]  Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;

Psalms 94:13 [HEB]  לְהַשְׁקִ֣יט ל֭וֹ מִ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עַ֤ד יִכָּרֶ֖ה לָרָשָׁ֣ע שָֽׁחַת
Psalms 94:13 [KJV]  That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

Psalms 94:14 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹא יִטֹּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְ֝נַחֲלָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א יַעֲזֹֽב
Psalms 94:14 [KJV]  For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

Psalms 94:15 [HEB]  כִּֽי עַד צֶ֭דֶק יָשׁ֣וּב מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝אַחֲרָ֗יו כָּל יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
Psalms 94:15 [KJV]  But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

Psalms 94:16 [HEB]  מִֽי יָק֣וּם לִ֭י עִם מְרֵעִ֑ים מִֽי יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב לִ֝י עִם פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
Psalms 94:16 [KJV]  Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

Psalms 94:17 [HEB]  לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י כִּמְעַ֓ט שָֽׁכְנָ֖ה דוּמָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי
Psalms 94:17 [KJV]  Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

Psalms 94:18 [HEB]  אִם אָ֭מַרְתִּי מָ֣טָה רַגְלִ֑י חַסְדְּךָ֥ יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִסְעָדֵֽנִי
Psalms 94:18 [KJV]  When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.

Psalms 94:19 [HEB]  בְּרֹ֣ב שַׂרְעַפַּ֣י בְּקִרְבִּ֑י תַּ֝נְחוּמֶ֗יךָ יְֽשַׁעַשְׁע֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי
Psalms 94:19 [KJV]  In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

Psalms 94:20 [HEB]  הַֽ֭יְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּ֣א הַוּ֑וֹת יֹצֵ֖ר עָמָ֣ל עֲלֵי חֹֽק
Psalms 94:20 [KJV]  Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

Psalms 94:21 [HEB]  יָ֭גוֹדּוּ עַל נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְדָ֖ם נָקִ֣י יַרְשִֽׁיעוּ
Psalms 94:21 [KJV]  They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

Psalms 94:22 [HEB]  וַיְהִ֬י יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י לְמִשְׂגָּ֑ב וֵ֝אלֹהַ֗י לְצ֣וּר מַחְסִֽי
Psalms 94:22 [KJV]  But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

Psalms 94:23 [HEB]  וַיָּ֤שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֨ם אֶת אוֹנָ֗ם וּבְרָעָתָ֥ם יַצְמִיתֵ֑ם יַ֝צְמִיתֵ֗ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
Psalms 94:23 [KJV]  And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.


--- Psalms Chapter 95 ---
Psalms 95:1 [HEB]  לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ
Psalms 95:1 [KJV]  O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

Psalms 95:2 [HEB]  נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּתוֹדָ֑ה בִּ֝זְמִר֗וֹת נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽוֹ
Psalms 95:2 [KJV]  Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

Psalms 95:3 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אֵ֣ל גָּד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 95:3 [KJV]  For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

Psalms 95:4 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְתוֹעֲפ֖וֹת הָרִ֣ים לֽוֹ
Psalms 95:4 [KJV]  In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

Psalms 95:5 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁר ל֣וֹ הַ֭יָּם וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑הוּ וְ֝יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת יָדָ֥יו יָצָֽרוּ
Psalms 95:5 [KJV]  The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

Psalms 95:6 [HEB]  בֹּ֭אוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֣ה וְנִכְרָ֑עָה נִ֝בְרְכָ֗ה לִֽפְנֵי יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ
Psalms 95:6 [KJV]  O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

Psalms 95:7 [HEB]  כִּ֘י ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִיתוֹ וְצֹ֣אן יָד֑וֹ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אִֽם בְּקֹל֥וֹ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ
Psalms 95:7 [KJV]  For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

Psalms 95:8 [HEB]  אַל תַּקְשׁ֣וּ לְ֭בַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָ֑ה כְּי֥וֹם מַ֝סָּ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר
Psalms 95:8 [KJV]  Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

Psalms 95:9 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭סּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּ֝חָנ֗וּנִי גַּם רָא֥וּ פָעֳלִֽי
Psalms 95:9 [KJV]  When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

Psalms 95:10 [HEB]  אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּד֗וֹר וָאֹמַ֗ר עַ֤ם תֹּעֵ֣י לֵבָ֣ב הֵ֑ם וְ֝הֵ֗ם לֹא יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽי
Psalms 95:10 [KJV]  Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

Psalms 95:11 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי בְאַפִּ֑י אִם יְ֝בֹא֗וּן אֶל מְנוּחָתִֽי
Psalms 95:11 [KJV]  Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.


--- Psalms Chapter 96 ---
Psalms 96:1 [HEB]  שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֥ירוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 96:1 [KJV]  O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

Psalms 96:2 [HEB]  שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה בָּרֲכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם לְ֝י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ
Psalms 96:2 [KJV]  Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

Psalms 96:3 [HEB]  סַפְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֣ם כְּבוֹד֑וֹ בְּכָל הָֽ֝עַמִּ֗ים נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו
Psalms 96:3 [KJV]  Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

Psalms 96:4 [HEB]  כִּ֥י גָ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֥א ה֝֗וּא עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 96:4 [KJV]  For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

Psalms 96:5 [HEB]  כִּ֤י כָּל אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעַמִּ֣ים אֱלִילִ֑ים וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה
Psalms 96:5 [KJV]  For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

Psalms 96:6 [HEB]  הוֹד וְהָדָ֥ר לְפָנָ֑יו עֹ֥ז וְ֝תִפְאֶ֗רֶת בְּמִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ
Psalms 96:6 [KJV]  Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

Psalms 96:7 [HEB]  הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז
Psalms 96:7 [KJV]  Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

Psalms 96:8 [HEB]  הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂאֽוּ מִ֝נְחָ֗ה וּבֹ֥אוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָֽיו
Psalms 96:8 [KJV]  Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

Psalms 96:9 [HEB]  הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה בְּהַדְרַת קֹ֑דֶשׁ חִ֥ילוּ מִ֝פָּנָ֗יו כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 96:9 [KJV]  O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

Psalms 96:10 [HEB]  אִמְר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִ֨ם יְה֘וָ֤ה מָלָ֗ךְ אַף תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל תִּמּ֑וֹט יָדִ֥ין עַ֝מִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים
Psalms 96:10 [KJV]  Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

Psalms 96:11 [HEB]  יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִֽרְעַ֥ם הַ֝יָּ֗ם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ
Psalms 96:11 [KJV]  Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

Psalms 96:12 [HEB]  יַעֲלֹ֣ז שָׂ֭דַי וְכָל אֲשֶׁר בּ֑וֹ אָ֥ז יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ כָּל עֲצֵי יָֽעַר
Psalms 96:12 [KJV]  Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

Psalms 96:13 [HEB]  לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה כִּ֬י בָ֗א כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בֶּאֱמוּנָתֽוֹ
Psalms 96:13 [KJV]  Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.


--- Psalms Chapter 97 ---
Psalms 97:1 [HEB]  יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ תָּגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּֽים
Psalms 97:1 [KJV]  The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

Psalms 97:2 [HEB]  עָנָ֣ן וַעֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑יו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֽוֹ
Psalms 97:2 [KJV]  Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

Psalms 97:3 [HEB]  אֵ֭שׁ לְפָנָ֣יו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּתְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽיו
Psalms 97:3 [KJV]  A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

Psalms 97:4 [HEB]  הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקָ֣יו תֵּבֵ֑ל רָאֲתָ֖ה וַתָּחֵ֣ל הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 97:4 [KJV]  His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

Psalms 97:5 [HEB]  הָרִ֗ים כַּדּוֹנַ֗ג נָ֭מַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֲד֣וֹן כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 97:5 [KJV]  The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

Psalms 97:6 [HEB]  הִגִּ֣ידוּ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ וְרָא֖וּ כָל הָעַמִּ֣ים כְּבוֹדֽוֹ
Psalms 97:6 [KJV]  The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

Psalms 97:7 [HEB]  יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ כָּל עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ ל֝וֹ כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 97:7 [KJV]  Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

Psalms 97:8 [HEB]  שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַתִּשְׂמַ֨ח צִיּ֗וֹן וַ֭תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 97:8 [KJV]  Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.

Psalms 97:9 [HEB]  כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה עֶלְי֥וֹן עַל כָּל הָאָ֑רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים
Psalms 97:9 [KJV]  For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

Psalms 97:10 [HEB]  אֹהֲבֵ֥י יְהוָ֗ה שִׂנְא֫וּ רָ֥ע שֹׁ֭מֵר נַפְשׁ֣וֹת חֲסִידָ֑יו מִיַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם
Psalms 97:10 [KJV]  Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

Psalms 97:11 [HEB]  א֭וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּֽלְיִשְׁרֵי לֵ֥ב שִׂמְחָֽה
Psalms 97:11 [KJV]  Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

Psalms 97:12 [HEB]  שִׂמְח֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ
Psalms 97:12 [KJV]  Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

Psalms 98:2 [KJV]  The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

Psalms 98:3 [KJV]  He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

Psalms 98:4 [HEB]  הָרִ֣יעוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כָּל הָאָ֑רֶץ פִּצְח֖וּ וְרַנְּנ֣וּ וְזַמֵּֽרוּ
Psalms 98:4 [KJV]  Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

Psalms 98:5 [HEB]  זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר וְק֣וֹל זִמְרָֽה
Psalms 98:5 [KJV]  Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

Psalms 98:6 [HEB]  בַּ֭חֲצֹ֣צְרוֹת וְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לִפְנֵ֤י הַמֶּ֬לֶךְ יְהוָֽה
Psalms 98:6 [KJV]  With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.

Psalms 98:7 [HEB]  יִרְעַ֣ם הַ֭יָּם וּמְלֹא֑וֹ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ
Psalms 98:7 [KJV]  Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

Psalms 98:8 [HEB]  נְהָר֥וֹת יִמְחֲאוּ כָ֑ף יַ֝֗חַד הָרִ֥ים יְרַנֵּֽנוּ
Psalms 98:8 [KJV]  Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together

Psalms 98:9 [HEB]  לִֽפְֽנֵי יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים
Psalms 98:9 [KJV]  Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.


--- Psalms Chapter 99 ---
Psalms 99:1 [HEB]  יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָאָֽרֶץ

Psalms 99:3 [HEB]  יוֹד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְךָ גָּד֥וֹל וְנוֹרָ֗א קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא

Psalms 99:4 [KJV]  The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

Psalms 99:5 [HEB]  רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא
Psalms 99:5 [KJV]  Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

Psalms 99:6 [HEB]  מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם
Psalms 99:6 [KJV]  Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.

Psalms 99:7 [HEB]  בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן לָֽמוֹ
Psalms 99:7 [KJV]  He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

Psalms 99:8 [HEB]  יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֪ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל עֲלִילוֹתָֽם
Psalms 99:8 [KJV]  Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

Psalms 99:9 [HEB]  רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ כִּֽי קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
Psalms 99:9 [KJV]  Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.

Psalms 100:1 [KJV]  Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.

Psalms 100:4 [KJV]  Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

Psalms 100:5 [KJV]  For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.


--- Psalms Chapter 101 ---
Psalms 101:1 [HEB]  לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר חֶֽסֶד וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֲזַמֵּֽרָה
Psalms 101:1 [KJV]  I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.

Psalms 101:2 [HEB]  אַשְׂכִּ֤ילָה בְּדֶ֬רֶךְ תָּמִ֗ים מָ֭תַי תָּב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑י אֶתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּתָם לְ֝בָבִ֗י בְּקֶ֣רֶב בֵּיתִֽי
Psalms 101:2 [KJV]  I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

Psalms 101:3 [HEB]  לֹֽא אָשִׁ֨ית לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינַ֗י דְּֽבַר בְּלִ֫יָּ֥עַל עֲשֹֽׂה סֵטִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי לֹ֖א יִדְבַּ֣ק בִּֽי
Psalms 101:3 [KJV]  I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

Psalms 101:4 [HEB]  לֵבָ֣ב עִ֭קֵּשׁ יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נִּי רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א אֵדָֽע
Psalms 101:4 [KJV]  A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

Psalms 101:5 [HEB]  מלושני מְלָשְׁנִ֬י בַסֵּ֨תֶר רֵעֵהוּ֮ אוֹת֪וֹ אַ֫צְמִ֥ית גְּֽבַהּ עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַ֣ב לֵבָ֑ב אֹ֝ת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל
Psalms 101:5 [KJV]  Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

Psalms 101:6 [HEB]  עֵינַ֤י בְּנֶֽאֶמְנֵי אֶרֶץ֮ לָשֶׁ֪בֶת עִמָּ֫דִ֥י הֹ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ תָּמִ֑ים ה֝֗וּא יְשָׁרְתֵֽנִי
Psalms 101:6 [KJV]  Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

Psalms 101:7 [HEB]  לֹֽא יֵשֵׁ֨ב בְּקֶ֥רֶב בֵּיתִי֮ עֹשֵׂ֪ה רְמִ֫יָּ֥ה דֹּבֵ֥ר שְׁקָרִ֑ים לֹֽא יִ֝כּ֗וֹן לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽי
Psalms 101:7 [KJV]  He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

Psalms 101:8 [HEB]  לַבְּקָרִ֗ים אַצְמִ֥ית כָּל רִשְׁעֵי אָ֑רֶץ לְהַכְרִ֥ית מֵֽעִיר יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
Psalms 101:8 [KJV]  I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.


--- Psalms Chapter 102 ---
Psalms 102:1 [HEB]  תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ
Psalms 102:1 [KJV]  Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.

Psalms 102:2 [HEB]  יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ תָבֽוֹא
Psalms 102:2 [KJV]  Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

Psalms 102:3 [HEB]  אַל תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּי֪וֹם צַ֫ר לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה אֵלַ֥י אָזְנֶ֑ךָ בְּי֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי
Psalms 102:3 [KJV]  For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

Psalms 102:4 [HEB]  כִּֽי כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑י וְ֝עַצְמוֹתַ֗י כְּמוֹ קֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ
Psalms 102:4 [KJV]  My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

Psalms 102:5 [HEB]  הוּכָּֽה כָ֭עֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑י כִּֽי שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי
Psalms 102:5 [KJV]  By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

Psalms 102:6 [HEB]  מִקּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י לִבְשָׂרִֽי
Psalms 102:6 [KJV]  I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

Psalms 102:7 [HEB]  דָּ֭מִיתִי לִקְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּכ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת
Psalms 102:7 [KJV]  I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

Psalms 102:8 [HEB]  שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶֽהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝צִפּ֗וֹר בּוֹדֵ֥ד עַל גָּֽג
Psalms 102:8 [KJV]  Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

Psalms 102:9 [HEB]  כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם חֵרְפ֣וּנִי אוֹיְבָ֑י מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ
Psalms 102:9 [KJV]  For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

Psalms 102:10 [HEB]  כִּי אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי
Psalms 102:10 [KJV]  Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

Psalms 102:11 [HEB]  מִפְּנֵֽי זַֽעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי
Psalms 102:11 [KJV]  My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

Psalms 102:12 [HEB]  יָ֭מַי כְּצֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝אֲנִ֗י כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ
Psalms 102:12 [KJV]  But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

Psalms 102:13 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר
Psalms 102:13 [KJV]  Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

Psalms 102:14 [HEB]  אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי בָ֥א מוֹעֵֽד
Psalms 102:14 [KJV]  For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

Psalms 102:15 [HEB]  כִּֽי רָצ֣וּ עֲ֭בָדֶיךָ אֶת אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְֽאֶת עֲפָרָ֥הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ
Psalms 102:15 [KJV]  So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

--- Psalms Chapter 104 ---
Psalms 104:1 [HEB]  בָּרֲכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶת יְה֫וָ֥ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי גָּדַ֣לְתָּ מְּאֹ֑ד ה֭וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ
Psalms 104:1 [KJV]  Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

Psalms 104:2 [HEB]  עֹֽטֶה א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה
Psalms 104:2 [KJV]  Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

Psalms 104:3 [KJV]  Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

Psalms 104:4 [HEB]  עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣יו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט
Psalms 104:4 [KJV]  Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

Psalms 104:5 [HEB]  יָֽסַד אֶ֭רֶץ עַל מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד
Psalms 104:5 [KJV]  Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

Psalms 104:6 [HEB]  תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑וֹ עַל הָ֝רִ֗ים יַֽעַמְדוּ מָֽיִם
Psalms 104:6 [KJV]  Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

Psalms 104:7 [HEB]  מִן גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן
Psalms 104:7 [KJV]  At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

Psalms 104:8 [HEB]  יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם
Psalms 104:8 [KJV]  They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

Psalms 104:9 [HEB]  גְּֽבוּל שַׂ֭מְתָּ בַּל יַֽעֲבֹר֑וּן בַּל יְ֝שׁוּב֗וּן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 104:9 [KJV]  Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

Psalms 104:10 [HEB]  הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן
Psalms 104:10 [KJV]  He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

Psalms 104:11 [HEB]  יַ֭שְׁקוּ כָּל חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ פְרָאִ֣ים צְמָאָֽם
Psalms 104:11 [KJV]  They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

Psalms 104:12 [HEB]  עֲ֭לֵיהֶם עוֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׁכּ֑וֹן מִבֵּ֥ין עֳ֝פָאיִ֗ם יִתְּנוּ קֽוֹל
Psalms 104:12 [KJV]  By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

Psalms 104:13 [HEB]  מַשְׁקֶ֣ה הָ֭רִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָ֑יו מִפְּרִ֥י מַ֝עֲשֶׂ֗יךָ תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 104:13 [KJV]  He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

Psalms 104:14 [HEB]  מַצְמִ֤יחַ חָצִ֨יר לַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ֭עֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאָדָ֑ם לְה֥וֹצִיא לֶ֝֗חֶם מִן הָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 104:14 [KJV]  He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

Psalms 104:15 [HEB]  וְיַ֤יִן יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְֽבַב אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְהַצְהִ֣יל פָּנִ֣ים מִשָּׁ֑מֶן וְ֝לֶ֗חֶם לְֽבַב אֱנ֥וֹשׁ יִסְעָֽד
Psalms 104:15 [KJV]  And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.

Psalms 104:16 [HEB]  יִ֭שְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַֽרְזֵ֥י לְ֝בָנ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָטָֽע
Psalms 104:16 [KJV]  The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

Psalms 104:17 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֭ם צִפֳּרִ֣ים יְקַנֵּ֑נוּ חֲ֝סִידָ֗ה בְּרוֹשִׁ֥ים בֵּיתָֽהּ
Psalms 104:17 [KJV]  Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

Psalms 104:18 [HEB]  הָרִ֣ים הַ֭גְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִ֑ים סְ֝לָעִ֗ים מַחְסֶ֥ה לַֽשְׁפַנִּֽים
Psalms 104:18 [KJV]  The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

Psalms 104:19 [HEB]  עָשָׂ֣ה יָ֭רֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִ֑ים שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ יָדַ֥ע מְבוֹאֽוֹ
Psalms 104:19 [KJV]  He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

Psalms 104:20 [HEB]  תָּֽשֶׁת חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וִ֣יהִי לָ֑יְלָה בּֽוֹ תִ֝רְמֹ֗שׂ כָּל חַיְתוֹ יָֽעַר
Psalms 104:20 [KJV]  Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

Psalms 104:21 [HEB]  הַ֭כְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִ֣ים לַטָּ֑רֶף וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵאֵ֣ל אָכְלָֽם
Psalms 104:21 [KJV]  The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

Psalms 104:22 [HEB]  תִּזְרַ֣ח הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפ֑וּן וְאֶל מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗ם יִרְבָּצֽוּן
Psalms 104:22 [KJV]  The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

Psalms 104:23 [HEB]  יֵצֵ֣א אָדָ֣ם לְפָעֳל֑וֹ וְֽלַעֲבֹ֖דָת֣וֹ עֲדֵי עָֽרֶב
Psalms 104:23 [KJV]  Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

Psalms 104:24 [HEB]  מָֽה רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ יְֽהוָ֗ה כֻּ֭לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ
Psalms 104:24 [KJV]  O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

Psalms 104:25 [HEB]  זֶ֤ה הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּרְחַ֪ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת עִם גְּדֹלֽוֹת
Psalms 104:25 [KJV]  So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

Psalms 104:26 [HEB]  שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק בּֽוֹ
Psalms 104:26 [KJV]  There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

Psalms 104:27 [HEB]  כֻּ֭לָּם אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן לָתֵ֖ת אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ
Psalms 104:27 [KJV]  These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

Psalms 104:28 [HEB]  תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָֽ֝דְךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּן טֽוֹב
Psalms 104:28 [KJV]  That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

Psalms 104:29 [HEB]  תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן וְֽאֶל עֲפָרָ֥ם יְשׁוּבֽוּן
Psalms 104:29 [KJV]  Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

Psalms 104:30 [HEB]  תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּן וּ֝תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה
Psalms 104:30 [KJV]  Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

Psalms 104:31 [HEB]  יְהִ֤י כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו
Psalms 104:31 [KJV]  The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.

Psalms 104:32 [HEB]  הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ
Psalms 104:32 [KJV]  He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

Psalms 104:33 [HEB]  אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַיהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי
Psalms 104:33 [KJV]  I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

Psalms 104:34 [HEB]  יֶעֱרַ֣ב עָלָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּיהוָֽה
Psalms 104:34 [KJV]  My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.

Psalms 104:35 [HEB]  יִתַּ֤מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים מִן הָאָ֡רֶץ וּרְשָׁעִ֤ים ע֤וֹד אֵינָ֗ם בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת יְהוָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
Psalms 104:35 [KJV]  Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.


--- Psalms Chapter 105 ---
Psalms 105:1 [HEB]  הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִּשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו
Psalms 105:1 [KJV]  O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

Psalms 105:2 [HEB]  שִֽׁירוּ ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכָל נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו
Psalms 105:2 [KJV]  Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

Psalms 105:3 [HEB]  הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה
Psalms 105:3 [KJV]  Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

Psalms 105:4 [HEB]  דִּרְשׁ֣וּ יְהוָ֣ה וְעֻזּ֑וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֖וּ פָנָ֣יו תָּמִֽיד
Psalms 105:4 [KJV]  Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

Psalms 105:5 [HEB]  זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתָ֥יו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי פִֽיו
Psalms 105:5 [KJV]  Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

Psalms 105:6 [HEB]  זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדּ֑וֹ בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽיו
Psalms 105:6 [KJV]  O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

Psalms 105:7 [HEB]  ה֭וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ בְּכָל הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו
Psalms 105:7 [KJV]  He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

Psalms 105:8 [HEB]  זָכַ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִ֝וָּ֗ה לְאֶ֣לֶף דּֽוֹר
Psalms 105:8 [KJV]  He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

Psalms 105:9 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּ֭רַת אֶת אַבְרָהָ֑ם וּשְׁב֖וּעָת֣וֹ לְיִשְׂחָֽק
Psalms 105:9 [KJV]  Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

Psalms 105:10 [HEB]  וַיַּֽעֲמִידֶ֣הָ לְיַעֲקֹ֣ב לְחֹ֑ק לְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָֽם
Psalms 105:10 [KJV]  And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

Psalms 105:11 [HEB]  לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֗ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת אֶֽרֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן חֶ֝֗בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם
Psalms 105:11 [KJV]  Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

Psalms 105:12 [HEB]  בִּֽ֭הְיוֹתָם מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ
Psalms 105:12 [KJV]  When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

Psalms 105:13 [HEB]  וַֽ֭יִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל גּ֑וֹי מִ֝מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֶל עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר
Psalms 105:13 [KJV]  When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

Psalms 105:14 [HEB]  לֹֽא הִנִּ֣יחַ אָדָ֣ם לְעָשְׁקָ֑ם וַיּ֖וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מְלָכִֽים
Psalms 105:14 [KJV]  He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

Psalms 105:15 [HEB]  אַֽל תִּגְּע֥וּ בִמְשִׁיחָ֑י וְ֝לִנְבִיאַי אַל תָּרֵֽעוּ
Psalms 105:15 [KJV]  Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

Psalms 105:16 [HEB]  וַיִּקְרָ֣א רָ֭עָב עַל הָאָ֑רֶץ כָּֽל מַטֵּה לֶ֥חֶם שָׁבָֽר
Psalms 105:16 [KJV]  Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

Psalms 105:17 [HEB]  שָׁלַ֣ח לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ לְ֝עֶ֗בֶד נִמְכַּ֥ר יוֹסֵֽף
Psalms 105:17 [KJV]  He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

Psalms 105:18 [HEB]  עִנּ֣וּ בַכֶּ֣בֶל רגליו רַגְל֑וֹ בַּ֝רְזֶ֗ל בָּ֣אָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ
Psalms 105:18 [KJV]  Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

Psalms 105:19 [HEB]  עַד עֵ֥ת בֹּֽא דְבָר֑וֹ אִמְרַ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְרָפָֽתְהוּ
Psalms 105:19 [KJV]  Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.

Psalms 105:20 [HEB]  שָׁ֣לַח מֶ֭לֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵ֑הוּ מֹשֵׁ֥ל עַ֝מִּ֗ים וַֽיְפַתְּחֵֽהוּ
Psalms 105:20 [KJV]  The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

Psalms 105:21 [HEB]  שָׂמ֣וֹ אָד֣וֹן לְבֵית֑וֹ וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בְּכָל קִנְיָנֽוֹ
Psalms 105:21 [KJV]  He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

Psalms 105:22 [HEB]  לֶאְסֹ֣ר שָׂרָ֣יו בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּזְקֵנָ֥יו יְחַכֵּֽם
Psalms 105:22 [KJV]  To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

Psalms 105:23 [HEB]  וַיָּבֹ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ֝יַעֲקֹ֗ב גָּ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ חָֽם
Psalms 105:23 [KJV]  Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

Psalms 105:24 [HEB]  וַיֶּ֣פֶר אֶת עַמּ֣וֹ מְאֹ֑ד וַ֝יַּֽעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָֽיו
Psalms 105:24 [KJV]  And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

Psalms 105:25 [HEB]  הָפַ֣ךְ לִ֭בָּם לִשְׂנֹ֣א עַמּ֑וֹ לְ֝הִתְנַכֵּ֗ל בַּעֲבָדָֽיו
Psalms 105:25 [KJV]  He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

Psalms 105:26 [HEB]  שָׁ֭לַח מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֑וֹ אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽחַר בּֽוֹ
Psalms 105:26 [KJV]  He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

Psalms 105:27 [HEB]  שָֽׂמוּ בָ֭ם דִּבְרֵ֣י אֹתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מֹפְתִ֗ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָֽם
Psalms 105:27 [KJV]  They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

Psalms 105:28 [HEB]  שָׁ֣לַֽח חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא מָ֝ר֗וּ אֶת דברוו דְּבָרֽוֹ
Psalms 105:28 [KJV]  He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

Psalms 105:29 [HEB]  הָפַ֣ךְ אֶת מֵימֵיהֶ֣ם לְדָ֑ם וַ֝יָּ֗מֶת אֶת דְּגָתָֽם
Psalms 105:29 [KJV]  He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

Psalms 105:30 [HEB]  שָׁרַ֣ץ אַרְצָ֣ם צְפַרְדְּעִ֑ים בְּ֝חַדְרֵ֗י מַלְכֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 105:30 [KJV]  Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

Psalms 105:31 [HEB]  אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א עָרֹ֑ב כִּ֝נִּ֗ים בְּכָל גְּבוּלָֽם
Psalms 105:31 [KJV]  He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

Psalms 105:32 [HEB]  נָתַ֣ן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶ֣ם בָּרָ֑ד אֵ֖שׁ לֶהָב֣וֹת בְּאַרְצָֽם
Psalms 105:32 [KJV]  He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

Psalms 105:33 [HEB]  וַיַּ֣ךְ גַּ֭פְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָ֑ם וַ֝יְשַׁבֵּ֗ר עֵ֣ץ גְּבוּלָֽם
Psalms 105:33 [KJV]  He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

Psalms 105:34 [HEB]  אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א אַרְבֶּ֑ה וְ֝יֶ֗לֶק וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר
Psalms 105:34 [KJV]  He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

Psalms 105:35 [HEB]  וַיֹּ֣אכַל כָּל עֵ֣שֶׂב בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗אכַל פְּרִ֣י אַדְמָתָֽם
Psalms 105:35 [KJV]  And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

Psalms 105:36 [HEB]  וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל בְּכ֣וֹר בְּאַרְצָ֑ם רֵ֝אשִׁ֗ית לְכָל אוֹנָֽם
Psalms 105:36 [KJV]  He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

Psalms 105:37 [HEB]  וַֽ֭יּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ין בִּשְׁבָטָ֣יו כּוֹשֵֽׁל
Psalms 105:37 [KJV]  He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

Psalms 105:38 [HEB]  שָׂמַ֣ח מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּצֵאתָ֑ם כִּֽי נָפַ֖ל פַּחְדָּ֣ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 105:38 [KJV]  Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

Psalms 105:39 [HEB]  פָּרַ֣שׂ עָנָ֣ן לְמָסָ֑ךְ וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לְהָאִ֥יר לָֽיְלָה
Psalms 105:39 [KJV]  He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

Psalms 105:40 [HEB]  שָׁאַ֣ל וַיָּבֵ֣א שְׂלָ֑ו וְלֶ֥חֶם שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽם
Psalms 105:40 [KJV]  The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

Psalms 105:41 [HEB]  פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּצִּיּ֥וֹת נָהָֽר
Psalms 105:41 [KJV]  He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

Psalms 105:42 [HEB]  כִּֽי זָ֭כַר אֶת דְּבַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ אֶֽת אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדּֽוֹ
Psalms 105:42 [KJV]  For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

Psalms 105:43 [HEB]  וַיּוֹצִ֣א עַמּ֣וֹ בְשָׂשׂ֑וֹן בְּ֝רִנָּ֗ה אֶת בְּחִירָֽיו
Psalms 105:43 [KJV]  And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

Psalms 105:44 [HEB]  וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ
Psalms 105:44 [KJV]  And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

Psalms 105:45 [KJV]  That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.

Psalms 106:1 [HEB]  הַֽלְלוּ יָ֨הּ הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ

Psalms 106:34 [HEB]  לֹֽא הִ֭שְׁמִידוּ אֶת הָֽעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה לָהֶֽם

Psalms 106:35 [HEB]  וַיִּתְעָרְב֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ֝יִּלְמְד֗וּ מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם

Psalms 106:36 [HEB]  וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם וַיִּהְי֖וּ לָהֶ֣ם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ
Psalms 106:36 [KJV]  And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

Psalms 106:37 [HEB]  וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ אֶת בְּ֭נֵיהֶם וְאֶת בְּנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לַשֵּֽׁדִים
Psalms 106:37 [KJV]  Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

Psalms 106:38 [HEB]  וַיִּֽשְׁפְּכ֨וּ דָ֪ם נָקִ֡י דַּם בְּנֵ֘יהֶ֤ם וּֽבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זִ֭בְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּ֣י כְנָ֑עַן וַתֶּחֱנַ֥ף הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ בַּדָּמִֽים

Psalms 106:39 [HEB]  וַיִּטְמְא֥וּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּזְנוּ֗ בְּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 106:39 [KJV]  Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

Psalms 106:40 [HEB]  וַיִּֽחַר אַ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וַ֝יְתָעֵ֗ב אֶת נַחֲלָתֽוֹ
Psalms 106:40 [KJV]  Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

Psalms 106:41 [HEB]  וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּיַד גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽיִּמְשְׁל֥וּ בָ֝הֶ֗ם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 106:41 [KJV]  And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

Psalms 106:42 [HEB]  וַיִּלְחָצ֥וּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּכָּנְע֗וּ תַּ֣חַת יָדָֽם
Psalms 106:42 [KJV]  Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

Psalms 106:43 [HEB]  פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֗וֹת יַצִּ֫ילֵ֥ם וְ֭הֵמָּה יַמְר֣וּ בַעֲצָתָ֑ם וַ֝יָּמֹ֗כּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם
Psalms 106:43 [KJV]  Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

Psalms 106:44 [HEB]  וַ֭יַּרְא בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת רִנָּתָֽם
Psalms 106:44 [KJV]  Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

Psalms 106:45 [HEB]  וַיִּזְכֹּ֣ר לָהֶ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ וַ֝יִּנָּחֵ֗ם כְּרֹ֣ב חסדו חֲסָדָֽיו
Psalms 106:45 [KJV]  And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

Psalms 106:46 [HEB]  וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אוֹתָ֣ם לְרַחֲמִ֑ים לִ֝פְנֵ֗י כָּל שׁוֹבֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 106:46 [KJV]  He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

Psalms 106:47 [HEB]  הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ
Psalms 106:47 [KJV]  Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

Psalms 106:48 [HEB]  בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֪י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל מִן הָ֤עוֹלָ֨ם וְעַ֬ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם וְאָמַ֖ר כָּל הָעָ֥ם אָמֵ֗ן הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
Psalms 106:48 [KJV]  Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.


--- Psalms Chapter 107 ---
Psalms 107:1 [HEB]  הֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ
Psalms 107:1 [KJV]  O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psalms 107:2 [HEB]  יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד צָֽר
Psalms 107:2 [KJV]  Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

Psalms 107:3 [HEB]  וּֽמֵאֲרָצ֗וֹת קִ֫בְּצָ֥ם מִמִּזְרָ֥ח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב מִצָּפ֥וֹן וּמִיָּֽם
Psalms 107:3 [KJV]  And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

Psalms 109:1 [HEB]  לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ
