Psalms 109:3 [HEB]  וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם
Psalms 109:3 [KJV]  They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

Psalms 109:4 [HEB]  תַּֽחַת אַהֲבָתִ֥י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּנִי וַאֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה
Psalms 109:4 [KJV]  For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

Psalms 109:5 [HEB]  וַיָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽי
Psalms 109:5 [KJV]  And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

Psalms 109:6 [HEB]  הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣יו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל יְמִינֽוֹ
Psalms 109:6 [KJV]  Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

Psalms 109:7 [HEB]  בְּ֭הִשָּׁ֣פְטוֹ יֵצֵ֣א רָשָׁ֑ע וּ֝תְפִלָּת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַֽחֲטָאָֽה
Psalms 109:7 [KJV]  When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

Psalms 109:8 [HEB]  יִֽהְיֽוּ יָמָ֥יו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר
Psalms 109:8 [KJV]  Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

Psalms 109:9 [HEB]  יִֽהְיוּ בָנָ֥יו יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝אִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָֽה
Psalms 109:9 [KJV]  Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

Psalms 109:10 [HEB]  וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣יו וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 109:10 [KJV]  Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

Psalms 109:11 [HEB]  יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ נ֭וֹשֶׁה לְכָל אֲשֶׁר ל֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֖זּוּ זָרִ֣ים יְגִיעֽוֹ
Psalms 109:11 [KJV]  Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

Psalms 109:12 [HEB]  אַל יְהִי ל֭וֹ מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד וְֽאַל יְהִ֥י ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִיתוֹמָֽיו
Psalms 109:12 [KJV]  Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

Psalms 109:13 [HEB]  יְהִֽי אַחֲרִית֥וֹ לְהַכְרִ֑ית בְּד֥וֹר אַ֝חֵ֗ר יִמַּ֥ח שְׁמָֽם
Psalms 109:13 [KJV]  Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

Psalms 109:14 [HEB]  יִזָּכֵ֤ר עֲוֺ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָיו אֶל יְהוָ֑ה וְחַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗וֹ אַל תִּמָּֽח
Psalms 109:14 [KJV]  Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

Psalms 109:15 [HEB]  יִהְי֣וּ נֶֽגֶד יְהוָ֣ה תָּמִ֑יד וְיַכְרֵ֖ת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם
Psalms 109:15 [KJV]  Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

Psalms 109:16 [HEB]  יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֪וֹת חָ֥סֶד וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ עָנִ֣י וְ֭אֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְמוֹתֵֽת
Psalms 109:16 [KJV]  Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

Psalms 109:17 [HEB]  וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ב קְ֭לָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵ֑הוּ וְֽלֹא חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה וַתִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ
Psalms 109:17 [KJV]  As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

Psalms 109:18 [HEB]  וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ קְלָלָ֗ה כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א כַמַּ֣יִם בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו
Psalms 109:18 [KJV]  As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

Psalms 109:19 [HEB]  תְּהִי ל֭וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ
Psalms 109:19 [KJV]  Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

Psalms 109:20 [HEB]  זֹ֤את פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַי מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְהַדֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל נַפְשִֽׁי
Psalms 109:20 [KJV]  Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

Psalms 109:21 [HEB]  וְאַתָּ֤ה יְה֘וִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗י עֲֽשֵׂה אִ֭תִּי לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּי ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי
Psalms 109:21 [KJV]  But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

Psalms 109:22 [HEB]  כִּֽי עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ֝לִבִּ֗י חָלַ֥ל בְּקִרְבִּֽי
Psalms 109:22 [KJV]  For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

Psalms 109:23 [HEB]  כְּצֵל כִּנְטוֹת֥וֹ נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּֽאַרְבֶּֽה
Psalms 109:23 [KJV]  I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

Psalms 109:24 [HEB]  בִּ֭רְכַּי כָּשְׁל֣וּ מִצּ֑וֹם וּ֝בְשָׂרִ֗י כָּחַ֥שׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן
Psalms 109:24 [KJV]  My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

Psalms 109:25 [HEB]  וַאֲנִ֤י הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּנִי יְנִיע֥וּן רֹאשָֽׁם
Psalms 109:25 [KJV]  I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

Psalms 109:26 [HEB]  עָ֭זְרֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי כְחַסְדֶּֽךָ
Psalms 109:26 [KJV]  Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

Psalms 109:27 [HEB]  וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ
Psalms 109:27 [KJV]  That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.

Psalms 109:28 [HEB]  יְקַֽלְלוּ הֵמָּה֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ וַיֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח
Psalms 109:28 [KJV]  Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

Psalms 109:29 [HEB]  יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שׂוֹטְנַ֣י כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְיַעֲט֖וּ כַמְעִ֣יל בָּשְׁתָּֽם
Psalms 109:29 [KJV]  Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

Psalms 109:30 [HEB]  א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד בְּפִ֑י וּבְת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים אֲהַֽלְלֶֽנּוּ
Psalms 109:30 [KJV]  I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

Psalms 109:31 [HEB]  כִּֽי יַ֭עֲמֹד לִימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁוֹ
Psalms 109:31 [KJV]  For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.


--- Psalms Chapter 110 ---
Psalms 110:1 [HEB]  לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר נְאֻ֤ם יְהוָ֨ה לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ
Psalms 110:1 [KJV]  The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

Psalms 110:2 [HEB]  מַטֵּֽה עֻזְּךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ
Psalms 110:2 [KJV]  The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

Psalms 110:3 [HEB]  עַמְּךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּי֪וֹם חֵ֫ילֶ֥ךָ בְּֽהַדְרֵי קֹ֭דֶשׁ מֵרֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 110:3 [KJV]  Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

Psalms 110:4 [HEB]  נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָ֨ה וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה כֹהֵ֥ן לְעוֹלָ֑ם עַל דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי צֶֽדֶק
Psalms 110:4 [KJV]  The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

Psalms 110:5 [HEB]  אֲדֹנָ֥י עַל יְמִֽינְךָ֑ מָחַ֖ץ בְּיוֹם אַפּ֣וֹ מְלָכִֽים
Psalms 110:5 [KJV]  The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

Psalms 110:6 [HEB]  יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭גּוֹיִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיּ֑וֹת מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה
Psalms 110:6 [KJV]  He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

Psalms 110:7 [HEB]  מִ֭נַּחַל בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה עַל כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ
Psalms 110:7 [KJV]  He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.


--- Psalms Chapter 111 ---
Psalms 111:1 [HEB]  הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל לֵבָ֑ב בְּס֖וֹד יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְעֵדָֽה
Psalms 111:1 [KJV]  Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

Psalms 111:2 [HEB]  גְּ֭דֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה דְּ֝רוּשִׁ֗ים לְכָל חֶפְצֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 111:2 [KJV]  The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

Psalms 111:3 [HEB]  הוֹד וְהָדָ֥ר פָּֽעֳל֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד
Psalms 111:3 [KJV]  His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

Psalms 111:4 [HEB]  זֵ֣כֶר עָ֭שָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָ֑יו חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָֽה
Psalms 111:4 [KJV]  He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.

Psalms 111:5 [HEB]  טֶ֭רֶף נָתַ֣ן לִֽירֵאָ֑יו יִזְכֹּ֖ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִיתֽוֹ
Psalms 111:5 [KJV]  He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

Psalms 111:6 [HEB]  כֹּ֣חַ מַ֭עֲשָׂיו הִגִּ֣יד לְעַמּ֑וֹ לָתֵ֥ת לָ֝הֶ֗ם נַחֲלַ֥ת גּוֹיִֽם
Psalms 111:6 [KJV]  He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

Psalms 111:7 [HEB]  מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָ֭דָיו אֱמֶ֣ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נֶ֝אֱמָנִ֗ים כָּל פִּקּוּדָֽיו
Psalms 111:7 [KJV]  The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

Psalms 111:8 [HEB]  סְמוּכִ֣ים לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם עֲ֝שׂוּיִ֗ם בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת וְיָשָֽׁר
Psalms 111:8 [KJV]  They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

Psalms 111:9 [HEB]  פְּד֤וּת שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּֽה לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ
Psalms 111:9 [KJV]  He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

Psalms 111:10 [HEB]  רֵ֘אשִׁ֤ית חָכְמָ֨ה יִרְאַ֬ת יְהוָ֗ה שֵׂ֣כֶל ט֭וֹב לְכָל עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד
Psalms 111:10 [KJV]  The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.


--- Psalms Chapter 112 ---
Psalms 112:1 [HEB]  הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ אַשְׁרֵי אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝מִצְוֺתָ֗יו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד
Psalms 112:1 [KJV]  Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

Psalms 112:2 [HEB]  גִּבּ֣וֹר בָּ֭אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְע֑וֹ דּ֭וֹר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ
Psalms 112:2 [KJV]  His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

Psalms 112:3 [HEB]  הוֹן וָעֹ֥שֶׁר בְּבֵית֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד
Psalms 112:3 [KJV]  Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

Psalms 112:4 [HEB]  זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ א֭וֹר לַיְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם וְצַדִּֽיק
Psalms 112:4 [KJV]  Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

Psalms 112:5 [HEB]  טֽוֹב אִ֭ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט
Psalms 112:5 [KJV]  A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

Psalms 112:6 [HEB]  כִּֽי לְעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא יִמּ֑וֹט לְזֵ֥כֶר ע֝וֹלָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק
Psalms 112:6 [KJV]  Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

Psalms 112:7 [HEB]  מִשְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכ֥וֹן לִ֝בּ֗וֹ בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּיהוָֽה
Psalms 112:7 [KJV]  He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

Psalms 112:8 [HEB]  סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בּוֹ לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר יִרְאֶ֣ה בְצָרָֽיו
Psalms 112:8 [KJV]  His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

Psalms 112:9 [HEB]  פִּזַּ֤ר נָ֘תַ֤ן לָאֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָתוֹ עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָעַ֑ד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹ תָּר֥וּם בְּכָבֽוֹד
Psalms 112:9 [KJV]  He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

Psalms 112:10 [HEB]  רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה וְכָעָ֗ס שִׁנָּ֣יו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְנָמָ֑ס תַּאֲוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד
Psalms 112:10 [KJV]  The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

Psalms 113:2 [KJV]  Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

Psalms 113:3 [HEB]  מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ עַד מְבוֹא֑וֹ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה
Psalms 113:3 [KJV]  From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’s name is to be praised.

Psalms 113:4 [HEB]  רָ֖ם עַל כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם יְהוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ
Psalms 113:4 [KJV]  The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

Psalms 113:5 [HEB]  מִ֭י כַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ הַֽמַּגְבִּיהִ֥י לָשָֽׁבֶת
Psalms 113:5 [KJV]  Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

Psalms 113:6 [HEB]  הַֽמַּשְׁפִּילִ֥י לִרְא֑וֹת בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 113:6 [KJV]  Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

Psalms 113:7 [HEB]  מְקִֽימִ֣י מֵעָפָ֣ר דָּ֑ל מֵֽ֝אַשְׁפֹּ֗ת יָרִ֥ים אֶבְיֽוֹן
Psalms 113:7 [KJV]  He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

Psalms 113:8 [HEB]  לְהוֹשִׁיבִ֥י עִם נְדִיבִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם נְדִיבֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ
Psalms 113:8 [KJV]  That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

Psalms 113:9 [HEB]  מֽוֹשִׁיבִ֨י עֲקֶ֬רֶת הַבַּ֗יִת אֵֽם הַבָּנִ֥ים שְׂמֵחָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
Psalms 113:9 [KJV]  He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.

Psalms 114:3 [KJV]  The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

Psalms 114:4 [HEB]  הֶֽ֭הָרִים רָקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי צֹֽאן
Psalms 114:4 [KJV]  The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.

Psalms 114:5 [HEB]  מַה לְּךָ֣ הַ֭יָּם כִּ֣י תָנ֑וּס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן תִּסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר
Psalms 114:5 [KJV]  What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?

Psalms 114:6 [HEB]  הֶֽ֭הָרִים תִּרְקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי צֹֽאן
Psalms 114:6 [KJV]  Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?

Psalms 114:7 [HEB]  מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אָ֭דוֹן ח֣וּלִי אָ֑רֶץ מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲקֹֽב
Psalms 114:7 [KJV]  Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

Psalms 114:8 [KJV]  Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.


--- Psalms Chapter 115 ---
Psalms 115:1 [HEB]  לֹ֤א לָ֥נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֫א לָ֥נוּ כִּֽי לְ֭שִׁמְךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ עַל אֲמִתֶּֽךָ
Psalms 115:1 [KJV]  Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake.

Psalms 115:2 [HEB]  לָ֭מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַיֵּה נָ֝֗א אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם
Psalms 115:2 [KJV]  Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

Psalms 115:3 [KJV]  But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

Psalms 115:4 [KJV]  Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

Psalms 115:5 [HEB]  פֶּֽה לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ
Psalms 115:5 [KJV]  They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

Psalms 115:6 [HEB]  אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ אַ֥ף לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יְרִיחֽוּן
Psalms 115:6 [KJV]  They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

Psalms 115:7 [HEB]  יְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְלֹ֬א יְמִישׁ֗וּן רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם וְלֹ֣א יְהַלֵּ֑כוּ לֹֽא יֶ֝הְגּ֗וּ בִּגְרוֹנָֽם
Psalms 115:7 [KJV]  They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

Psalms 115:8 [HEB]  כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם
Psalms 115:8 [KJV]  They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

Psalms 115:9 [HEB]  יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בְּטַ֣ח בַּיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא
Psalms 115:9 [KJV]  O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

Psalms 115:10 [HEB]  בֵּ֣ית אַ֭הֲרֹן בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא
Psalms 115:10 [KJV]  O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

Psalms 115:11 [HEB]  יִרְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא
Psalms 115:11 [KJV]  Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

Psalms 115:12 [HEB]  יְהוָה֮ זְכָרָ֪נוּ יְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ יְ֭בָרֵךְ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְ֝בָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת בֵּ֥ית אַהֲרֹֽן
Psalms 115:12 [KJV]  The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

Psalms 115:13 [HEB]  יְ֭בָרֵךְ יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝קְּטַנִּ֗ים עִם הַגְּדֹלִֽים
Psalms 115:13 [KJV]  He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.

Psalms 115:14 [HEB]  יֹסֵ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם וְעַל בְּנֵיכֶֽם
Psalms 115:14 [KJV]  The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

Psalms 115:15 [HEB]  בְּרוּכִ֣ים אַ֭תֶּם לַיהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 115:15 [KJV]  Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.

Psalms 115:16 [HEB]  הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שָׁ֭מַיִם לַיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הָאָ֗רֶץ נָתַ֥ן לִבְנֵי אָדָֽם
Psalms 115:16 [KJV]  The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD’s: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

Psalms 115:17 [HEB]  לֹ֣א הַ֭מֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ יָ֑הּ וְ֝לֹ֗א כָּל יֹרְדֵ֥י דוּמָֽה
Psalms 115:17 [KJV]  The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.

Psalms 115:18 [HEB]  וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ נְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ יָ֗הּ מֵֽעַתָּ֥ה וְעַד עוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
Psalms 115:18 [KJV]  But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.


--- Psalms Chapter 116 ---
Psalms 116:1 [HEB]  אָ֭הַבְתִּי כִּֽי יִשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֑ה אֶת ק֝וֹלִ֗י תַּחֲנוּנָֽי
Psalms 116:1 [KJV]  I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

Psalms 116:2 [HEB]  כִּֽי הִטָּ֣ה אָזְנ֣וֹ לִ֑י וּבְיָמַ֥י אֶקְרָֽא
Psalms 116:2 [KJV]  Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

Psalms 116:3 [HEB]  אֲפָפ֤וּנִי חֶבְלֵי מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא
Psalms 116:3 [KJV]  The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

Psalms 116:4 [HEB]  וּבְשֵֽׁם יְהוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי
Psalms 116:4 [KJV]  Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

Psalms 116:5 [HEB]  חַנּ֣וּן יְהֹוָ֣ה וְצַדִּ֑יק וֵ֖אלֹהֵ֣ינוּ מְרַחֵֽם
Psalms 116:5 [KJV]  Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

Psalms 116:6 [HEB]  שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לּוֹתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ
Psalms 116:6 [KJV]  The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

Psalms 116:7 [HEB]  שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי יְ֝הוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי
Psalms 116:7 [KJV]  Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

Psalms 116:8 [HEB]  כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת עֵינִ֥י מִן דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי
Psalms 116:8 [KJV]  For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

Psalms 116:9 [HEB]  אֶ֭תְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝אַרְצ֗וֹת הַֽחַיִּֽים
Psalms 116:9 [KJV]  I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

Psalms 116:10 [HEB]  הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד
Psalms 116:10 [KJV]  I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

Psalms 116:11 [HEB]  אֲ֭נִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֑י כָּֽל הָאָדָ֥ם כֹּזֵֽב
Psalms 116:11 [KJV]  I said in my haste, All men are liars.

Psalms 116:12 [HEB]  מָֽה אָשִׁ֥יב לַיהוָ֑ה כָּֽל תַּגְמוּל֥וֹהִי עָלָֽי
Psalms 116:12 [KJV]  What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

Psalms 116:13 [HEB]  כּוֹס יְשׁוּע֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֑א וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא
Psalms 116:13 [KJV]  I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.

Psalms 116:14 [HEB]  נְ֭דָרַי לַיהוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה נָּ֝֗א לְכָל עַמּֽוֹ
Psalms 116:14 [KJV]  I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.

Psalms 116:15 [HEB]  יָ֭קָר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝מָּ֗וְתָה לַחֲסִידָֽיו
Psalms 116:15 [KJV]  Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.

Psalms 116:16 [HEB]  אָֽנָּ֣ה יְהוָה֮ כִּֽי אֲנִ֪י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲֽנִי עַ֭בְדְּךָ בֶּן אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָֽי
Psalms 116:16 [KJV]  O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

Psalms 116:17 [HEB]  לְֽךָ אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תּוֹדָ֑ה וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא
Psalms 116:17 [KJV]  I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.

Psalms 116:18 [HEB]  נְ֭דָרַי לַיהוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה נָּ֝֗א לְכָל עַמּֽוֹ
Psalms 116:18 [KJV]  I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,

Psalms 116:19 [HEB]  בְּחַצְר֤וֹת בֵּ֤ית יְהוָ֗ה בְּֽת֘וֹכֵ֤כִי יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
Psalms 116:19 [KJV]  In the courts of the LORD’s house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.


--- Psalms Chapter 117 ---
Psalms 117:1 [HEB]  הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת יְ֭הוָה כָּל גּוֹיִ֑ם שַׁ֝בְּח֗וּהוּ כָּל הָאֻמִּֽים
Psalms 117:1 [KJV]  O Praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

Psalms 117:2 [HEB]  כִּ֥י גָ֘בַ֤ר עָלֵ֨ינוּ חַסְדּ֗וֹ וֶֽאֱמֶת יְהוָ֥ה לְעוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
Psalms 117:2 [KJV]  For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.


--- Psalms Chapter 118 ---
Psalms 118:1 [HEB]  הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ
Psalms 118:1 [KJV]  O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

Psalms 118:2 [HEB]  יֹֽאמַר נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ
Psalms 118:2 [KJV]  Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

Psalms 118:3 [HEB]  יֹֽאמְרוּ נָ֥א בֵֽית אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ
Psalms 118:3 [KJV]  Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

Psalms 118:4 [HEB]  יֹֽאמְרוּ נָ֭א יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ
Psalms 118:4 [KJV]  Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

Psalms 118:5 [HEB]  מִֽן הַ֭מֵּצַ֥ר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ
Psalms 118:5 [KJV]  I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.

Psalms 118:6 [HEB]  יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם
Psalms 118:6 [KJV]  The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

Psalms 118:7 [HEB]  יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי
Psalms 118:7 [KJV]  The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

Psalms 118:8 [HEB]  ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם
Psalms 118:8 [KJV]  It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.

Psalms 118:9 [HEB]  ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים
Psalms 118:9 [KJV]  It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.

Psalms 118:10 [HEB]  כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם
Psalms 118:10 [KJV]  All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.

Psalms 118:11 [HEB]  סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם
Psalms 118:11 [KJV]  They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

Psalms 118:12 [HEB]  סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם
Psalms 118:12 [KJV]  They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

Psalms 118:13 [HEB]  דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי
Psalms 118:13 [KJV]  Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.

Psalms 118:14 [HEB]  עָזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה
Psalms 118:14 [KJV]  The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

Psalms 118:15 [HEB]  ק֤וֹל רִנָּ֬ה וִֽישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל
Psalms 118:15 [KJV]  The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

Psalms 118:16 [HEB]  יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל
Psalms 118:16 [KJV]  The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

Psalms 118:17 [HEB]  לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ
Psalms 118:17 [KJV]  I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.

Psalms 118:18 [HEB]  יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי
Psalms 118:18 [KJV]  The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

Psalms 118:19 [HEB]  פִּתְחוּ לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי צֶ֑דֶק אָֽבֹא בָ֝ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ
Psalms 118:19 [KJV]  Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:

Psalms 118:20 [HEB]  זֶֽה הַשַּׁ֥עַר לַיהוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֽוֹ
Psalms 118:20 [KJV]  This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.

Psalms 118:21 [HEB]  א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה
Psalms 118:21 [KJV]  I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

Psalms 118:22 [HEB]  אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבּוֹנִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה
Psalms 118:22 [KJV]  The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

Psalms 118:23 [HEB]  מֵאֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֑את הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ
Psalms 118:23 [KJV]  This is the LORD’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

Psalms 118:24 [HEB]  זֶה הַ֭יּוֹם עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֽוֹ
Psalms 118:24 [KJV]  This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

Psalms 118:25 [HEB]  אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָּֽא
Psalms 118:25 [KJV]  Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

Psalms 118:26 [HEB]  בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭בָּא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֝רַֽכְנוּכֶ֗ם מִבֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
Psalms 118:26 [KJV]  Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.

Psalms 118:27 [HEB]  אֵ֤ל יְהוָה֮ וַיָּ֪אֶר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ
Psalms 118:27 [KJV]  God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

Psalms 118:28 [HEB]  אֵלִ֣י אַתָּ֣ה וְאוֹדֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽךָּ
Psalms 118:28 [KJV]  Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

Psalms 118:29 [HEB]  הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ
Psalms 118:29 [KJV]  O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.


--- Psalms Chapter 119 ---
Psalms 119:1 [HEB]  אַשְׁרֵ֥י תְמִֽימֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הַֽ֝הֹלְכִ֗ים בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
Psalms 119:1 [KJV]  Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

Psalms 119:2 [HEB]  אַ֭שְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵ֥י עֵדֹתָ֗יו בְּכָל לֵ֥ב יִדְרְשֽׁוּהוּ
Psalms 119:2 [KJV]  Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

Psalms 119:3 [HEB]  אַ֭ף לֹֽא פָעֲל֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה בִּדְרָכָ֥יו הָלָֽכוּ
Psalms 119:3 [KJV]  They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

Psalms 119:4 [HEB]  אַ֭תָּה צִוִּ֥יתָה פִקֻּדֶ֗יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְאֹֽד
Psalms 119:4 [KJV]  Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

Psalms 119:5 [HEB]  אַ֭חֲלַי יִכֹּ֥נוּ דְרָכָ֗י לִשְׁמֹ֥ר חֻקֶּֽיךָ
Psalms 119:5 [KJV]  O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

Psalms 119:6 [HEB]  אָ֥ז לֹא אֵב֑וֹשׁ בְּ֝הַבִּיטִ֗י אֶל כָּל מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 119:6 [KJV]  Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

Psalms 119:7 [HEB]  א֭וֹדְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לָמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ
Psalms 119:7 [KJV]  I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

Psalms 119:8 [HEB]  אֶת חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑ר אַֽל תַּעַזְבֵ֥נִי עַד מְאֹֽד
Psalms 119:8 [KJV]  I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

Psalms 119:9 [HEB]  בַּמֶּ֣ה יְזַכֶּה נַּ֭עַר אֶת אָרְח֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ
Psalms 119:9 [KJV]  Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

Psalms 119:10 [HEB]  בְּכָל לִבִּ֥י דְרַשְׁתִּ֑יךָ אַל תַּ֝שְׁגֵּ֗נִי מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 119:10 [KJV]  With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

Psalms 119:11 [HEB]  בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶֽחֱטָא לָֽךְ
Psalms 119:11 [KJV]  Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

Psalms 119:12 [HEB]  בָּר֖וּךְ אַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֗ה לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ
Psalms 119:12 [KJV]  Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.

Psalms 119:13 [HEB]  בִּשְׂפָתַ֥י סִפַּ֑רְתִּי כֹּ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵי פִֽיךָ
Psalms 119:13 [KJV]  With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

Psalms 119:14 [HEB]  בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶ֥יךָ שַׂ֗שְׂתִּי כְּעַ֣ל כָּל הֽוֹן
Psalms 119:14 [KJV]  I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

Psalms 119:15 [HEB]  בְּפִקֻּדֶ֥יךָ אָשִׂ֑יחָה וְ֝אַבִּ֗יטָה אֹרְחֹתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 119:15 [KJV]  I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

Psalms 119:16 [HEB]  בְּחֻקֹּתֶ֥יךָ אֶֽשְׁתַּעֲשָׁ֑ע לֹ֭א אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח דְּבָרֶֽךָ
Psalms 119:16 [KJV]  I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

Psalms 119:17 [HEB]  גְּמֹ֖ל עַֽל עַבְדְּךָ֥ אֶֽחְיֶ֗ה וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה דְבָרֶֽךָ
Psalms 119:17 [KJV]  Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

Psalms 119:18 [HEB]  גַּל עֵינַ֥י וְאַבִּ֑יטָה נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶֽךָ
Psalms 119:18 [KJV]  Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

Psalms 119:19 [HEB]  גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 119:19 [KJV]  I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

Psalms 119:20 [HEB]  גָּרְסָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י לְתַאֲבָ֑ה אֶֽל מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ בְכָל עֵֽת
Psalms 119:20 [KJV]  My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

Psalms 119:21 [HEB]  גָּ֭עַרְתָּ זֵדִ֣ים אֲרוּרִ֑ים הַ֝שֹּׁגִים מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 119:21 [KJV]  Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

Psalms 119:22 [HEB]  גַּ֣ל מֵֽ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי
Psalms 119:22 [KJV]  Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

Psalms 119:23 [HEB]  גַּ֤ם יָֽשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ
Psalms 119:23 [KJV]  Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

Psalms 119:24 [HEB]  גַּֽם עֵ֭דֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֗י אַנְשֵׁ֥י עֲצָתִֽי
Psalms 119:24 [KJV]  Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

Psalms 119:25 [HEB]  דָּֽבְקָ֣ה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשִׁ֑י חַ֝יֵּ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ
Psalms 119:25 [KJV]  My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

Psalms 119:26 [HEB]  דְּרָכַ֣י סִ֭פַּרְתִּי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֗נִי לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ
Psalms 119:26 [KJV]  I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

Psalms 119:27 [HEB]  דֶּֽרֶךְ פִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָשִׂ֗יחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ
Psalms 119:27 [KJV]  Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

Psalms 119:28 [HEB]  דָּלְפָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִתּוּגָ֑ה קַ֝יְּמֵ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ
Psalms 119:28 [KJV]  My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

Psalms 119:29 [HEB]  דֶּֽרֶךְ שֶׁ֭קֶר הָסֵ֣ר מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ חָנֵּֽנִי
Psalms 119:29 [KJV]  Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

Psalms 119:30 [HEB]  דֶּֽרֶךְ אֱמוּנָ֥ה בָחָ֑רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ שִׁוִּֽיתִי
Psalms 119:30 [KJV]  I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

Psalms 119:31 [HEB]  דָּבַ֥קְתִּי בְעֵֽדְוֺתֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל תְּבִישֵֽׁנִי
Psalms 119:31 [KJV]  I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.

Psalms 119:32 [HEB]  דֶּֽרֶךְ מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אָר֑וּץ כִּ֖י תַרְחִ֣יב לִבִּֽי
Psalms 119:32 [KJV]  I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

Psalms 119:33 [HEB]  הוֹרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗יךָ וְאֶצְּרֶ֥נָּה עֵֽקֶב
Psalms 119:33 [KJV]  Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

Psalms 119:157 [HEB]  רַ֭בִּים רֹדְפַ֣י וְצָרָ֑י מֵ֝עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי
Psalms 119:157 [KJV]  Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.

Psalms 119:158 [HEB]  רָאִ֣יתִי בֹ֭גְדִים וָֽאֶתְקוֹטָ֑טָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִ֝מְרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ
Psalms 119:158 [KJV]  I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

Psalms 119:159 [HEB]  רְ֭אֵה כִּי פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ אָהָ֑בְתִּי יְ֝הוָ֗ה כְּֽחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי
Psalms 119:159 [KJV]  Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.

Psalms 119:160 [HEB]  רֹאשׁ דְּבָרְךָ֥ אֱמֶ֑ת וּ֝לְעוֹלָ֗ם כָּל מִשְׁפַּ֥ט צִדְקֶֽךָ
Psalms 119:160 [KJV]  Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.

Psalms 119:161 [HEB]  שָׂ֭רִים רְדָפ֣וּנִי חִנָּ֑ם ומדבריך וּ֝מִדְּבָרְךָ֗ פָּחַ֥ד לִבִּֽי
Psalms 119:161 [KJV]  Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

Psalms 119:162 [HEB]  שָׂ֣שׂ אָ֭נֹכִֽי עַל אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כְּ֝מוֹצֵ֗א שָׁלָ֥ל רָֽב
Psalms 119:162 [KJV]  I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

Psalms 119:163 [HEB]  שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂ֭נֵאתִי וַאֲתַעֵ֑בָה תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ אָהָֽבְתִּי
Psalms 119:163 [KJV]  I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

Psalms 119:164 [HEB]  שֶׁ֣בַע בַּ֭יּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּ֑יךָ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ
Psalms 119:164 [KJV]  Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

Psalms 119:165 [HEB]  שָׁל֣וֹם רָ֭ב לְאֹהֲבֵ֣י תוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ וְאֵֽין לָ֥מוֹ מִכְשֽׁוֹל
Psalms 119:165 [KJV]  Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

Psalms 119:166 [HEB]  שִׂבַּ֣רְתִּי לִֽישׁוּעָתְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וּֽמִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ עָשִֽׂיתִי
Psalms 119:166 [KJV]  LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

Psalms 119:167 [HEB]  שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי עֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ וָאֹהֲבֵ֥ם מְאֹֽד
Psalms 119:167 [KJV]  My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

Psalms 119:168 [HEB]  שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי פִ֭קּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י כָל דְּרָכַ֣י נֶגְדֶּֽךָ
Psalms 119:168 [KJV]  I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.

Psalms 119:169 [HEB]  תִּקְרַ֤ב רִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה כִּדְבָרְךָ֥ הֲבִינֵֽנִי
Psalms 119:169 [KJV]  Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.

Psalms 119:170 [HEB]  תָּב֣וֹא תְּחִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כְּ֝אִמְרָתְךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי
Psalms 119:170 [KJV]  Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

Psalms 119:171 [HEB]  תַּבַּ֣עְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י תְּהִלָּ֑ה כִּ֖י תְלַמְּדֵ֣נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ
Psalms 119:171 [KJV]  My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

Psalms 119:172 [HEB]  תַּ֣עַן לְ֭שׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י כָל מִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ צֶּֽדֶק
Psalms 119:172 [KJV]  My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.

Psalms 119:173 [HEB]  תְּהִֽי יָדְךָ֥ לְעָזְרֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ בָחָֽרְתִּי
Psalms 119:173 [KJV]  Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

Psalms 119:174 [HEB]  תָּאַ֣בְתִּי לִֽישׁוּעָתְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝תֽוֹרָתְךָ֗ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי
Psalms 119:174 [KJV]  I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.

Psalms 119:175 [HEB]  תְּֽחִי נַ֭פְשִׁי וּֽתְהַֽלְלֶ֑ךָּ וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ יַעֲזְרֻֽנִי
Psalms 119:175 [KJV]  Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

Psalms 119:176 [HEB]  תָּעִ֗יתִי כְּשֶׂ֣ה אֹ֭בֵד בַּקֵּ֣שׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י מִ֝צְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי
Psalms 119:176 [KJV]  I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.


--- Psalms Chapter 120 ---

Psalms 120:2 [KJV]  Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

Psalms 120:3 [KJV]  What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

Psalms 120:4 [KJV]  Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

Psalms 120:5 [HEB]  אֽוֹיָה לִ֭י כִּי גַ֣רְתִּי מֶ֑שֶׁךְ שָׁ֝כַ֗נְתִּי עִֽם אָהֳלֵ֥י קֵדָֽר
Psalms 120:5 [KJV]  Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

Psalms 120:6 [HEB]  רַ֭בַּת שָֽׁכְנָה לָּ֣הּ נַפְשִׁ֑י עִ֝֗ם שׂוֹנֵ֥א שָׁלֽוֹם
Psalms 120:6 [KJV]  My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

Psalms 120:7 [HEB]  אֲֽנִי שָׁ֭לוֹם וְכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר הֵ֝֗מָּה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה
Psalms 120:7 [KJV]  I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.


--- Psalms Chapter 121 ---

Psalms 121:1 [KJV]  I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

Psalms 121:2 [KJV]  My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

Psalms 121:3 [KJV]  He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

Psalms 121:4 [KJV]  Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

Psalms 121:5 [HEB]  יְהוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ
Psalms 121:5 [KJV]  The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.

Psalms 121:6 [HEB]  יוֹמָ֗ם הַשֶּׁ֥מֶשׁ לֹֽא יַכֶּ֗כָּה וְיָרֵ֥חַ בַּלָּֽיְלָה
Psalms 121:6 [KJV]  The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

Psalms 121:7 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָרְךָ֥ מִכָּל רָ֑ע יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת נַפְשֶֽׁךָ
Psalms 121:7 [KJV]  The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

Psalms 121:8 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָר צֵאתְךָ֥ וּבוֹאֶ֑ךָ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד עוֹלָֽם
Psalms 121:8 [KJV]  The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.


--- Psalms Chapter 122 ---

Psalms 122:2 [KJV]  Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

Psalms 122:3 [HEB]  יְרוּשָׁלִַ֥ם הַבְּנוּיָ֑ה כְּ֝עִ֗יר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה לָּ֥הּ יַחְדָּֽו
Psalms 122:3 [KJV]  Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

Psalms 122:4 [HEB]  שֶׁשָּׁ֨ם עָל֪וּ שְׁבָטִ֡ים שִׁבְטֵי יָ֭הּ עֵד֣וּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ֝הֹד֗וֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה
Psalms 122:4 [KJV]  Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.

Psalms 122:5 [HEB]  כִּ֤י שָׁ֨מָּה יָשְׁב֣וּ כִסְא֣וֹת לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֝סְא֗וֹת לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִֽיד
Psalms 122:5 [KJV]  For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

Psalms 122:6 [HEB]  שַׁ֭אֲלוּ שְׁל֣וֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם יִ֝שְׁלָ֗יוּ אֹהֲבָֽיִךְ
Psalms 122:6 [KJV]  Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

Psalms 122:7 [HEB]  יְהִֽי שָׁל֥וֹם בְּחֵילֵ֑ךְ שַׁ֝לְוָ֗ה בְּאַרְמְנוֹתָֽיִךְ
Psalms 122:7 [KJV]  Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

Psalms 122:8 [HEB]  לְ֭מַעַן אַחַ֣י וְרֵעָ֑י אֲדַבְּרָה נָּ֖א שָׁל֣וֹם בָּֽךְ
Psalms 122:8 [KJV]  For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

Psalms 122:9 [HEB]  לְ֭מַעַן בֵּית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁ֖ה ט֣וֹב לָֽךְ
Psalms 122:9 [KJV]  Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.


--- Psalms Chapter 123 ---
Psalms 123:1 [HEB]  שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֵ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת עֵינַ֑י הַ֝יֹּשְׁבִ֗י בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם
Psalms 123:1 [KJV]  Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

Psalms 123:2 [HEB]  הִנֵּ֨ה כְעֵינֵ֪י עֲבָדִ֡ים אֶל יַ֤ד אֲֽדוֹנֵיהֶ֗ם כְּעֵינֵ֣י שִׁפְחָה֮ אֶל יַ֪ד גְּבִ֫רְתָּ֥הּ כֵּ֣ן עֵ֭ינֵינוּ אֶל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ עַ֝֗ד שֶׁיְּחָנֵּֽנוּ
Psalms 123:2 [KJV]  Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

Psalms 123:3 [HEB]  חָנֵּ֣נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑נוּ כִּֽי רַ֝֗ב שָׂבַ֥עְנוּ בֽוּז
Psalms 123:3 [KJV]  Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

Psalms 123:4 [HEB]  רַבַּת֮ שָֽׂבְעָה לָּ֪הּ נַ֫פְשֵׁ֥נוּ הַלַּ֥עַג הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים הַ֝בּ֗וּז לִגְאֵ֥יוֹנִֽים
Psalms 123:4 [KJV]  Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.


--- Psalms Chapter 124 ---
Psalms 124:1 [HEB]  שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ יֹֽאמַר נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
Psalms 124:1 [KJV]  If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;

Psalms 124:2 [HEB]  לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ בְּק֖וּם עָלֵ֣ינוּ אָדָֽם
Psalms 124:2 [KJV]  If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

Psalms 124:3 [HEB]  אֲ֭זַי חַיִּ֣ים בְּלָע֑וּנוּ בַּחֲר֖וֹת אַפָּ֣ם בָּֽנוּ
Psalms 124:3 [KJV]  Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

Psalms 124:4 [HEB]  אֲ֭זַי הַמַּ֣יִם שְׁטָפ֑וּנוּ נַ֗֜חְלָה עָבַ֥ר עַל נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ
Psalms 124:4 [KJV]  Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

Psalms 124:5 [HEB]  אֲ֭זַי עָבַ֣ר עַל נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ הַ֝מַּ֗יִם הַזֵּֽידוֹנִֽים
Psalms 124:5 [KJV]  Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

Psalms 124:6 [HEB]  בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה שֶׁלֹּ֥א נְתָנָ֥נוּ טֶ֝֗רֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶֽם
Psalms 124:6 [KJV]  Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

Psalms 124:7 [HEB]  נַפְשֵׁ֗נוּ כְּצִפּ֥וֹר נִמְלְטָה֮ מִפַּ֪ח י֫וֹקְשִׁ֥ים הַפַּ֥ח נִשְׁבָּ֗ר וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ נִמְלָֽטְנוּ
Psalms 124:7 [KJV]  Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

Psalms 124:8 [HEB]  עֶ֭זְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ
Psalms 124:8 [KJV]  Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

Psalms 147:6 [HEB]  מְעוֹדֵ֣ד עֲנָוִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה מַשְׁפִּ֖יל רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֲדֵי אָֽרֶץ

Psalms 147:9 [KJV]  He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.

Psalms 147:10 [HEB]  לֹ֤א בִגְבוּרַ֣ת הַסּ֣וּס יֶחְפָּ֑ץ לֹֽא בְשׁוֹקֵ֖י הָאִ֣ישׁ יִרְצֶֽה
Psalms 147:10 [KJV]  He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.

Psalms 147:11 [HEB]  רוֹצֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת יְרֵאָ֑יו אֶת הַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ
Psalms 147:11 [KJV]  The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

Psalms 147:12 [HEB]  שַׁבְּחִ֣י יְ֭רוּשָׁלִַם אֶת יְהוָ֑ה הַֽלְלִ֖י אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִיּֽוֹן
Psalms 147:12 [KJV]  Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

Psalms 147:13 [HEB]  כִּֽי חִ֭זַּק בְּרִיחֵ֣י שְׁעָרָ֑יִךְ בֵּרַ֖ךְ בָּנַ֣יִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ
Psalms 147:13 [KJV]  For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.

Psalms 147:14 [HEB]  הַשָּׂם גְּבוּלֵ֥ךְ שָׁל֑וֹם חֵ֥לֶב חִ֝טִּ֗ים יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽךְ
Psalms 147:14 [KJV]  He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

Psalms 147:15 [KJV]  He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

Psalms 147:17 [KJV]  He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

Psalms 147:18 [HEB]  יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּבָר֣וֹ וְיַמְסֵ֑ם יַשֵּׁ֥ב ר֝וּח֗וֹ יִזְּלוּ מָֽיִם
Psalms 147:18 [KJV]  He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

Psalms 147:19 [HEB]  מַגִּ֣יד דברו דְּבָרָ֣יו לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב חֻקָּ֥יו וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטָ֗יו לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל
Psalms 147:19 [KJV]  He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

Psalms 147:20 [HEB]  לֹ֘א עָ֤שָׂה כֵ֨ן לְכָל גּ֗וֹי וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֥ים בַּל יְדָע֗וּם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
Psalms 147:20 [KJV]  He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.

Psalms 148:13 [KJV]  Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

Psalms 148:14 [KJV]  He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.

Psalms 149:9 [KJV]  To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.

--- Proverbs Chapter 1 ---
Proverbs 1:1 [HEB]  מִ֭שְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן דָּוִ֑ד מֶ֝֗לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
Proverbs 1:1 [KJV]  The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

Proverbs 1:2 [HEB]  לָדַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֣ה וּמוּסָ֑ר לְ֝הָבִ֗ין אִמְרֵ֥י בִינָֽה
Proverbs 1:2 [KJV]  To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

Proverbs 1:3 [HEB]  לָ֭קַחַת מוּסַ֣ר הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וּמֵישָׁרִֽים
Proverbs 1:3 [KJV]  To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;

Proverbs 1:4 [HEB]  לָתֵ֣ת לִפְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה לְ֝נַ֗עַר דַּ֣עַת וּמְזִמָּֽה
Proverbs 1:4 [KJV]  To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

Proverbs 1:5 [HEB]  יִשְׁמַ֣ע חָ֭כָם וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶ֑קַח וְ֝נָב֗וֹן תַּחְבֻּל֥וֹת יִקְנֶֽה
Proverbs 1:5 [KJV]  A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

Proverbs 1:6 [HEB]  לְהָבִ֣ין מָ֭שָׁל וּמְלִיצָ֑ה דִּבְרֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים וְחִידֹתָֽם
Proverbs 1:6 [KJV]  To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

Proverbs 1:7 [HEB]  יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּ֑עַת חָכְמָ֥ה וּ֝מוּסָ֗ר אֱוִילִ֥ים בָּֽזוּ
Proverbs 1:7 [KJV]  The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

Proverbs 1:8 [HEB]  שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַל תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ
Proverbs 1:8 [KJV]  My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

Proverbs 1:9 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לִוְיַ֤ת חֵ֓ן הֵ֬ם לְרֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲנָקִ֗ים לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ
Proverbs 1:9 [KJV]  For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.

Proverbs 1:10 [HEB]  בְּנִ֡י אִם יְפַתּ֥וּךָ חַ֝טָּאִ֗ים אַל תֹּבֵֽא
Proverbs 1:10 [KJV]  My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.

Proverbs 1:11 [HEB]  אִם יֹאמְרוּ֮ לְכָ֪ה אִ֫תָּ֥נוּ נֶאֶרְבָ֥ה לְדָ֑ם נִצְפְּנָ֖ה לְנָקִ֣י חִנָּֽם
Proverbs 1:11 [KJV]  If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

Proverbs 1:12 [HEB]  נִ֭בְלָעֵם כִּשְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים כְּי֣וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר
Proverbs 1:12 [KJV]  Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:

Proverbs 1:13 [HEB]  כָּל ה֣וֹן יָקָ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א נְמַלֵּ֖א בָתֵּ֣ינוּ שָׁלָֽל
Proverbs 1:13 [KJV]  We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

Proverbs 1:14 [HEB]  גּ֭וֹרָ֣לְךָ תַּפִּ֣יל בְּתוֹכֵ֑נוּ כִּ֥יס אֶ֝חָ֗ד יִהְיֶ֥ה לְכֻלָּֽנוּ
Proverbs 1:14 [KJV]  Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:

Proverbs 1:15 [HEB]  בְּנִ֗י אַל תֵּלֵ֣ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אִתָּ֑ם מְנַ֥ע רַ֝גְלְךָ֗ מִנְּתִיבָתָֽם
Proverbs 1:15 [KJV]  My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:

Proverbs 1:16 [HEB]  כִּ֣י רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם לָרַ֣ע יָר֑וּצוּ וִֽ֝ימַהֲר֗וּ לִשְׁפָּךְ דָּֽם
Proverbs 1:16 [KJV]  For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

Proverbs 1:17 [HEB]  כִּֽי חִ֭נָּם מְזֹרָ֣ה הָרָ֑שֶׁת בְּ֝עֵינֵ֗י כָל בַּ֥עַל כָּנָֽף
Proverbs 1:17 [KJV]  Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

Proverbs 1:18 [HEB]  וְ֭הֵם לְדָמָ֣ם יֶאֱרֹ֑בוּ יִ֝צְפְּנ֗וּ לְנַפְשֹׁתָֽם
Proverbs 1:18 [KJV]  And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.

Proverbs 1:19 [HEB]  כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל בֹּ֣צֵֽעַ בָּ֑צַע אֶת נֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלָ֣יו יִקָּֽח
Proverbs 1:19 [KJV]  So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

Proverbs 1:20 [HEB]  חָ֭כְמוֹת בַּח֣וּץ תָּרֹ֑נָּה בָּ֝רְחֹב֗וֹת תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ
Proverbs 1:20 [KJV]  Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:

Proverbs 1:21 [HEB]  בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הֹמִיּ֗וֹת תִּ֫קְרָ֥א בְּפִתְחֵ֖י שְׁעָרִ֥ים בָּעִ֗יר אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ תֹאמֵֽר
Proverbs 1:21 [KJV]  She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,

Proverbs 1:22 [HEB]  עַד מָתַ֣י פְּתָיִם֮ תְּֽאֵהֲב֫וּ פֶ֥תִי וְלֵצִ֗ים לָ֭צוֹן חָמְד֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים יִשְׂנְאוּ דָֽעַת
Proverbs 1:22 [KJV]  How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

Proverbs 1:23 [HEB]  תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ לְֽת֫וֹכַחְתִּ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה אַבִּ֣יעָה לָכֶ֣ם רוּחִ֑י אוֹדִ֖יעָה דְבָרַ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם
Proverbs 1:23 [KJV]  Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

Proverbs 1:24 [HEB]  יַ֣עַן קָ֭רָאתִי וַתְּמָאֵ֑נוּ נָטִ֥יתִי יָ֝דִ֗י וְאֵ֣ין מַקְשִֽׁיב
Proverbs 1:24 [KJV]  Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

Proverbs 1:25 [HEB]  וַתִּפְרְע֥וּ כָל עֲצָתִ֑י וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲבִיתֶֽם
Proverbs 1:25 [KJV]  But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

Proverbs 1:26 [HEB]  גַּם אֲ֭נִי בְּאֵידְכֶ֣ם אֶשְׂחָ֑ק אֶ֝לְעַ֗ג בְּבֹ֣א פַחְדְּכֶֽם
Proverbs 1:26 [KJV]  I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

Proverbs 1:27 [HEB]  בְּבֹ֤א כשאוה כְשׁוֹאָ֨ה פַּחְדְּכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭אֵידְכֶם כְּסוּפָ֣ה יֶאֱתֶ֑ה בְּבֹ֥א עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם צָרָ֥ה וְצוּקָֽה
Proverbs 1:27 [KJV]  When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.

Proverbs 1:28 [HEB]  אָ֣ז יִ֭קְרָאֻנְנִי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה יְ֝שַׁחֲרֻ֗נְנִי וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי
Proverbs 1:28 [KJV]  Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

Proverbs 1:29 [HEB]  תַּ֭חַת כִּי שָׂ֣נְאוּ דָ֑עַת וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לֹ֣א בָחָֽרוּ
Proverbs 1:29 [KJV]  For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:

Proverbs 1:30 [HEB]  לֹא אָב֥וּ לַעֲצָתִ֑י נָ֝אֲצ֗וּ כָּל תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי
Proverbs 1:30 [KJV]  They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.

Proverbs 1:31 [HEB]  וְֽ֭יֹאכְלוּ מִפְּרִ֣י דַרְכָּ֑ם וּֽמִמֹּעֲצֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ
Proverbs 1:31 [KJV]  Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

Proverbs 1:32 [HEB]  כִּ֤י מְשׁוּבַ֣ת פְּתָיִ֣ם תַּֽהַרְגֵ֑ם וְשַׁלְוַ֖ת כְּסִילִ֣ים תְּאַבְּדֵֽם
Proverbs 1:32 [KJV]  For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

Proverbs 1:33 [HEB]  וְשֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֭י יִשְׁכָּן בֶּ֑טַח וְ֝שַׁאֲנַ֗ן מִפַּ֥חַד רָעָֽה
Proverbs 1:33 [KJV]  But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.


--- Proverbs Chapter 2 ---
Proverbs 2:1 [HEB]  בְּ֭נִי אִם תִּקַּ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ
Proverbs 2:1 [KJV]  My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;

Proverbs 2:2 [HEB]  לְהַקְשִׁ֣יב לַֽחָכְמָ֣ה אָזְנֶ֑ךָ תַּטֶּ֥ה לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַתְּבוּנָֽה
Proverbs 2:2 [KJV]  So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;

Proverbs 2:3 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אִ֣ם לַבִּינָ֣ה תִקְרָ֑א לַ֝תְּבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֶֽךָ
Proverbs 2:3 [KJV]  Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;

Proverbs 2:4 [HEB]  אִם תְּבַקְשֶׁ֥נָּה כַכָּ֑סֶף וְֽכַמַּטְמוֹנִ֥ים תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂנָּה
Proverbs 2:4 [KJV]  If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;

Proverbs 2:5 [HEB]  אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת אֱלֹהִ֣ים תִּמְצָֽא
Proverbs 2:5 [KJV]  Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

Proverbs 2:6 [HEB]  כִּֽי יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה מִ֝פִּ֗יו דַּ֣עַת וּתְבוּנָֽה
Proverbs 2:6 [KJV]  For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

Proverbs 2:7 [HEB]  וצפן יִצְפֹּ֣ן לַ֭יְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּ֑ה מָ֝גֵ֗ן לְהֹ֣לְכֵי תֹֽם
Proverbs 2:7 [KJV]  He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

Proverbs 2:8 [HEB]  לִ֭נְצֹר אָרְח֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְדֶ֖רֶךְ חסידו חֲסִידָ֣יו יִשְׁמֹֽר
Proverbs 2:8 [KJV]  He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.

Proverbs 2:9 [HEB]  אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין צֶ֣דֶק וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מֵישָׁרִ֗ים כָּל מַעְגַּל טֽוֹב
Proverbs 2:9 [KJV]  Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.

Proverbs 2:10 [HEB]  כִּֽי תָב֣וֹא חָכְמָ֣ה בְלִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝דַ֗עַת לְֽנַפְשְׁךָ֥ יִנְעָֽם
Proverbs 2:10 [KJV]  When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;

Proverbs 2:11 [HEB]  מְ֭זִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹ֥ר עָלֶ֗יךָ תְּבוּנָ֥ה תִנְצְרֶֽכָּה
Proverbs 2:11 [KJV]  Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

Proverbs 2:12 [HEB]  לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ רָ֑ע מֵ֝אִ֗ישׁ מְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת
Proverbs 2:12 [KJV]  To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;

Proverbs 2:13 [HEB]  הַ֭עֹ֣זְבִים אָרְח֣וֹת יֹ֑שֶׁר לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת בְּדַרְכֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ
Proverbs 2:13 [KJV]  Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

Proverbs 2:14 [HEB]  הַ֭שְּׂמֵחִים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָ֑ע יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ בְּֽתַהְפֻּכ֥וֹת רָֽע
Proverbs 2:14 [KJV]  Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

Proverbs 2:15 [HEB]  אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָרְחֹתֵיהֶ֣ם עִקְּשִׁ֑ים וּ֝נְלוֹזִ֗ים בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָֽם
Proverbs 2:15 [KJV]  Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

Proverbs 2:16 [HEB]  לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה
Proverbs 2:16 [KJV]  To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;

Proverbs 2:17 [HEB]  הַ֭עֹזֶבֶת אַלּ֣וּף נְעוּרֶ֑יהָ וְאֶת בְּרִ֖ית אֱלֹהֶ֣יהָ שָׁכֵֽחָה
Proverbs 2:17 [KJV]  Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.

Proverbs 2:18 [HEB]  כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה אֶל מָ֣וֶת בֵּיתָ֑הּ וְאֶל רְ֝פָאִ֗ים מַעְגְּלֹתֶֽיהָ
Proverbs 2:18 [KJV]  For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

Proverbs 2:19 [HEB]  כָּל בָּ֭אֶיהָ לֹ֣א יְשׁוּב֑וּן וְלֹֽא יַ֝שִּׂ֗יגוּ אָרְח֥וֹת חַיִּֽים
Proverbs 2:19 [KJV]  None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

Proverbs 2:20 [HEB]  לְמַ֗עַן תֵּ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ טוֹבִ֑ים וְאָרְח֖וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים תִּשְׁמֹֽר
Proverbs 2:20 [KJV]  That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

Proverbs 2:21 [HEB]  כִּֽי יְשָׁרִ֥ים יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִוָּ֥תְרוּ בָֽהּ
Proverbs 2:21 [KJV]  For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

Proverbs 2:22 [HEB]  וּ֭רְשָׁעִים מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים יִסְּח֥וּ מִמֶּֽנָּה
Proverbs 2:22 [KJV]  But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.


--- Proverbs Chapter 3 ---
Proverbs 3:1 [HEB]  בְּ֭נִי תּוֹרָתִ֣י אַל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י יִצֹּ֥ר לִבֶּֽךָ
Proverbs 3:1 [KJV]  My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:

Proverbs 3:2 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים וּשְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּ֑ים וְ֝שָׁל֗וֹם יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לָֽךְ
Proverbs 3:2 [KJV]  For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.

Proverbs 3:3 [HEB]  חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֗ת אַֽל יַעַ֫זְבֻ֥ךָ קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ
Proverbs 3:3 [KJV]  Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:

Proverbs 3:4 [HEB]  וּמְצָא חֵ֖ן וְשֵֽׂכֶל ט֑וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאָדָֽם
Proverbs 3:4 [KJV]  So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

Proverbs 3:5 [HEB]  בְּטַ֣ח אֶל יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְאֶל בִּֽ֝ינָתְךָ֗ אַל תִּשָּׁעֵֽן
Proverbs 3:5 [KJV]  Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

Proverbs 3:6 [HEB]  בְּכָל דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ דָעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יְיַשֵּׁ֥ר אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ
Proverbs 3:6 [KJV]  In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

Proverbs 3:7 [HEB]  אַל תְּהִ֣י חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ יְרָ֥א אֶת יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְס֣וּר מֵרָֽע
Proverbs 3:7 [KJV]  Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

Proverbs 3:8 [HEB]  רִ֭פְאוּת תְּהִ֣י לְשָׁרֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝שִׁקּ֗וּי לְעַצְמוֹתֶֽיךָ
Proverbs 3:8 [KJV]  It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.

Proverbs 3:9 [HEB]  כַּבֵּ֣ד אֶת יְ֭הוָה מֵהוֹנֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מֵרֵאשִׁ֗ית כָּל תְּבוּאָתֶֽךָ
Proverbs 3:9 [KJV]  Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

Proverbs 3:10 [HEB]  וְיִמָּלְא֣וּ אֲסָמֶ֣יךָ שָׂבָ֑ע וְ֝תִיר֗וֹשׁ יְקָבֶ֥יךָ יִפְרֹֽצוּ
Proverbs 3:10 [KJV]  So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

Proverbs 3:11 [HEB]  מוּסַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה בְּנִ֣י אַל תִּמְאָ֑ס וְאַל תָּ֝קֹ֗ץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּֽוֹ
Proverbs 3:11 [KJV]  My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:

Proverbs 3:12 [HEB]  כִּ֤י אֶ֥ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶאֱהַ֣ב יְהוָ֣ה יוֹכִ֑יחַ וּ֝כְאָ֗ב אֶת בֵּ֥ן יִרְצֶֽה
Proverbs 3:12 [KJV]  For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

Proverbs 3:13 [HEB]  אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מָצָ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝אָדָ֗ם יָפִ֥יק תְּבוּנָֽה
Proverbs 3:13 [KJV]  Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

Proverbs 3:14 [HEB]  כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב סַ֭חְרָהּ מִסְּחַר כָּ֑סֶף וּ֝מֵחָר֗וּץ תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ
Proverbs 3:14 [KJV]  For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

Proverbs 3:15 [HEB]  יְקָ֣רָה הִ֭יא מפניים מִפְּנִינִ֑ים וְכָל חֲ֝פָצֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ בָֽהּ
Proverbs 3:15 [KJV]  She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

Proverbs 3:16 [HEB]  אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים בִּֽימִינָ֑הּ בִּ֝שְׂמֹאולָ֗הּ עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָבֽוֹד
Proverbs 3:16 [KJV]  Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.

Proverbs 3:17 [HEB]  דְּרָכֶ֥יהָ דַרְכֵי נֹ֑עַם וְֽכָל נְתִ֖יבוֹתֶ֣יהָ שָׁלֽוֹם
Proverbs 3:17 [KJV]  Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

Proverbs 3:18 [HEB]  עֵץ חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַמַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑הּ וְֽתֹמְכֶ֥יהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר
Proverbs 3:18 [KJV]  She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.

Proverbs 3:19 [HEB]  יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּחָכְמָ֥ה יָֽסַד אָ֑רֶץ כּוֹנֵ֥ן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם בִּתְבוּנָֽה
Proverbs 3:19 [KJV]  The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.

Proverbs 3:20 [HEB]  בְּ֭דַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמ֣וֹת נִבְקָ֑עוּ וּ֝שְׁחָקִ֗ים יִרְעֲפוּ טָֽל
Proverbs 3:20 [KJV]  By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

Proverbs 3:21 [HEB]  בְּ֭נִי אַל יָלֻ֣זוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ נְצֹ֥ר תֻּ֝שִׁיָּ֗ה וּמְזִמָּֽה
Proverbs 3:21 [KJV]  My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

Proverbs 3:22 [HEB]  וְיִֽהְי֣וּ חַיִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְ֝חֵ֗ן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ
Proverbs 3:22 [KJV]  So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

Proverbs 3:23 [HEB]  אָ֤ז תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לָבֶ֣טַח דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝רַגְלְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִגּֽוֹף
Proverbs 3:23 [KJV]  Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.

Proverbs 3:24 [HEB]  אִם תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב לֹֽא תִפְחָ֑ד וְ֝שָׁכַבְתָּ֗ וְֽעָרְבָ֥ה שְׁנָתֶֽךָ
Proverbs 3:24 [KJV]  When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

Proverbs 3:25 [HEB]  אַל תִּ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹ֑ם וּמִשֹּׁאַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים כִּ֣י תָבֹֽא
Proverbs 3:25 [KJV]  Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.

Proverbs 3:26 [HEB]  כִּֽי יְ֭הוָה יִהְיֶ֣ה בְכִסְלֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁמַ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מִלָּֽכֶד
Proverbs 3:26 [KJV]  For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.

Proverbs 3:27 [HEB]  אַל תִּמְנַע ט֥וֹב מִבְּעָלָ֑יו בִּהְי֨וֹת לְאֵ֖ל ידיך יָדְךָ֣ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת
Proverbs 3:27 [KJV]  Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.

Proverbs 3:28 [HEB]  אַל תֹּ֘אמַ֤ר לרעיך לְרֵֽעֲךָ֨ לֵ֣ךְ וָ֭שׁוּב וּמָחָ֥ר אֶתֵּ֗ן וְיֵ֣שׁ אִתָּֽךְ
Proverbs 3:28 [KJV]  Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.

Proverbs 3:29 [HEB]  אַל תַּחֲרֹ֣שׁ עַל רֵעֲךָ֣ רָעָ֑ה וְהֽוּא יוֹשֵׁ֖ב לָבֶ֣טַח אִתָּֽךְ
Proverbs 3:29 [KJV]  Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

Proverbs 3:30 [HEB]  אַל תרוב תָּרִ֣יב עִם אָדָ֣ם חִנָּ֑ם אִם לֹ֖א גְמָלְךָ֣ רָעָֽה
Proverbs 3:30 [KJV]  Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

Proverbs 3:31 [HEB]  אַל תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאִ֣ישׁ חָמָ֑ס וְאַל תִּ֝בְחַ֗ר בְּכָל דְּרָכָֽיו
Proverbs 3:31 [KJV]  Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.

Proverbs 3:32 [HEB]  כִּ֤י תוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה נָל֑וֹז וְֽאֶת יְשָׁרִ֥ים סוֹדֽוֹ
Proverbs 3:32 [KJV]  For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.

Proverbs 3:33 [HEB]  מְאֵרַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה בְּבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע וּנְוֵ֖ה צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְבָרֵֽךְ
Proverbs 3:33 [KJV]  The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.

Proverbs 3:34 [HEB]  אִם לַלֵּצִ֥ים הֽוּא יָלִ֑יץ ולעניים וְ֝לַעֲנָוִ֗ים יִתֶּן חֵֽן
Proverbs 3:34 [KJV]  Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

Proverbs 3:35 [HEB]  כָּ֭בוֹד חֲכָמִ֣ים יִנְחָ֑לוּ וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מֵרִ֥ים קָלֽוֹן
Proverbs 3:35 [KJV]  The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.


--- Proverbs Chapter 4 ---
Proverbs 4:1 [HEB]  שִׁמְע֣וּ בָ֭נִים מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לָדַ֥עַת בִּינָֽה
Proverbs 4:1 [KJV]  Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.

Proverbs 4:2 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֶ֣קַח ט֭וֹב נָתַ֣תִּי לָכֶ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹרָתִ֗י אַֽל תַּעֲזֹֽבוּ
Proverbs 4:2 [KJV]  For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.

Proverbs 4:3 [HEB]  כִּי בֵ֭ן הָיִ֣יתִי לְאָבִ֑י רַ֥ךְ וְ֝יָחִ֗יד לִפְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי
Proverbs 4:3 [KJV]  For I was my father’s son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

Proverbs 4:4 [HEB]  וַיֹּרֵ֗נִי וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֗י יִֽתְמָךְ דְּבָרַ֥י לִבֶּ֑ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶֽחְיֵֽה
Proverbs 4:4 [KJV]  He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.

Proverbs 4:5 [HEB]  קְנֵ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה בִינָ֑ה אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח וְאַל תֵּ֝֗ט מֵֽאִמְרֵי פִֽי
Proverbs 4:5 [KJV]  Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

Proverbs 4:6 [HEB]  אַל תַּעַזְבֶ֥הָ וְתִשְׁמְרֶ֑ךָּ אֱהָבֶ֥הָ וְתִצְּרֶֽךָּ
Proverbs 4:6 [KJV]  Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.

Proverbs 4:7 [HEB]  רֵאשִׁ֣ית חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְכָל קִ֝נְיָנְךָ֗ קְנֵ֣ה בִינָֽה
Proverbs 4:7 [KJV]  Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

Proverbs 4:8 [HEB]  סַלְסְלֶ֥הָ וּֽתְרוֹמְמֶ֑ךָּ תְּ֝כַבֵּ֗דְךָ כִּ֣י תְחַבְּקֶֽנָּה
Proverbs 4:8 [KJV]  Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

Proverbs 4:9 [HEB]  תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭רֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת חֵ֑ן עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת תְּמַגְּנֶֽךָּ
Proverbs 4:9 [KJV]  She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.

Proverbs 4:10 [HEB]  שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי וְקַ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וְיִרְבּ֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים
Proverbs 4:10 [KJV]  Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.

Proverbs 4:11 [HEB]  בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ חָ֭כְמָה הֹרֵתִ֑יךָ הִ֝דְרַכְתִּ֗יךָ בְּמַעְגְּלֵי יֹֽשֶׁר
Proverbs 4:11 [KJV]  I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.

Proverbs 4:12 [HEB]  בְּֽ֭לֶכְתְּךָ לֹא יֵצַ֣ר צַעֲדֶ֑ךָ וְאִם תָּ֝ר֗וּץ לֹ֣א תִכָּשֵֽׁל
Proverbs 4:12 [KJV]  When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

Proverbs 4:13 [HEB]  הַחֲזֵ֣ק בַּמּוּסָ֣ר אַל תֶּ֑רֶף נִ֝צְּרֶ֗הָ כִּי הִ֥יא חַיֶּֽיךָ
Proverbs 4:13 [KJV]  Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.

Proverbs 4:14 [HEB]  בְּאֹ֣רַח רְ֭שָׁעִים אַל תָּבֹ֑א וְאַל תְּ֝אַשֵּׁ֗ר בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ רָעִֽים
Proverbs 4:14 [KJV]  Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.

Proverbs 4:15 [HEB]  פְּרָעֵ֥הוּ אַל תַּעֲבָר בּ֑וֹ שְׂטֵ֖ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וַעֲבֽוֹר
Proverbs 4:15 [KJV]  Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.

Proverbs 4:16 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יִֽ֭שְׁנוּ אִם לֹ֣א יָרֵ֑עוּ וְֽנִגְזְלָ֥ה שְׁ֝נָתָ֗ם אִם לֹ֥א יכשולו יַכְשִֽׁילוּ
Proverbs 4:16 [KJV]  For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

Proverbs 4:17 [HEB]  כִּ֣י לָ֭חֲמוּ לֶ֣חֶם רֶ֑שַׁע וְיֵ֖ין חֲמָסִ֣ים יִשְׁתּֽוּ
Proverbs 4:17 [KJV]  For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

Proverbs 4:18 [HEB]  וְאֹ֣רַח צַ֭דִּיקִים כְּא֣וֹר נֹ֑גַהּ הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וָ֝א֗וֹר עַד נְכ֥וֹן הַיּֽוֹם
Proverbs 4:18 [KJV]  But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

Proverbs 4:19 [HEB]  דֶּ֣רֶךְ רְ֭שָׁעִים כָּֽאֲפֵלָ֑ה לֹ֥א יָ֝דְע֗וּ בַּמֶּ֥ה יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ
Proverbs 4:19 [KJV]  The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

Proverbs 4:20 [HEB]  בְּ֭נִי לִדְבָרַ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לַ֝אֲמָרַ֗י הַט אָזְנֶֽךָ
Proverbs 4:20 [KJV]  My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.

Proverbs 4:21 [HEB]  אַל יַלִּ֥יזוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝מְרֵ֗ם בְּת֣וֹךְ לְבָבֶֽךָ
Proverbs 4:21 [KJV]  Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.

Proverbs 4:22 [HEB]  כִּֽי חַיִּ֣ים הֵ֭ם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶ֑ם וּֽלְכָל בְּשָׂר֥וֹ מַרְפֵּֽא
Proverbs 4:22 [KJV]  For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.

Proverbs 4:23 [HEB]  מִֽכָּל מִ֭שְׁמָר נְצֹ֣ר לִבֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תּוֹצְא֥וֹת חַיִּֽים
Proverbs 4:23 [KJV]  Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

Proverbs 4:24 [HEB]  הָסֵ֣ר מִ֭מְּךָ עִקְּשׁ֣וּת פֶּ֑ה וּלְז֥וּת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם הַרְחֵ֥ק מִמֶּֽךָּ
Proverbs 4:24 [KJV]  Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.

Proverbs 4:25 [HEB]  עֵ֭ינֶיךָ לְנֹ֣כַח יַבִּ֑יטוּ וְ֝עַפְעַפֶּ֗יךָ יַיְשִׁ֥רוּ נֶגְדֶּֽךָ
Proverbs 4:25 [KJV]  Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

Proverbs 4:26 [HEB]  פַּ֭לֵּס מַעְגַּ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ יִכֹּֽנוּ
Proverbs 4:26 [KJV]  Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.

Proverbs 4:27 [HEB]  אַֽל תֵּט יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול הָסֵ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מֵרָֽע
Proverbs 4:27 [KJV]  Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.


--- Proverbs Chapter 5 ---
Proverbs 5:1 [HEB]  בְּ֭נִי לְחָכְמָתִ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לִ֝תְבוּנָתִ֗י הַט אָזְנֶֽךָ
Proverbs 5:1 [KJV]  My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:

Proverbs 5:2 [HEB]  לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְזִמּ֑וֹת וְ֝דַ֗עַת שְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ יִנְצֹֽרוּ
Proverbs 5:2 [KJV]  That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.

Proverbs 5:3 [HEB]  כִּ֤י נֹ֣פֶת תִּ֭טֹּפְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֣י זָרָ֑ה וְחָלָ֖ק מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן חִכָּֽהּ
Proverbs 5:3 [KJV]  For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:

Proverbs 5:4 [HEB]  וְֽ֭אַחֲרִיתָהּ מָרָ֣ה כַֽלַּעֲנָ֑ה חַ֝דָּ֗ה כְּחֶ֣רֶב פִּיּֽוֹת
Proverbs 5:4 [KJV]  But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.

Proverbs 5:5 [HEB]  רַ֭גְלֶיהָ יֹרְד֣וֹת מָ֑וֶת שְׁ֝א֗וֹל צְעָדֶ֥יהָ יִתְמֹֽכוּ
Proverbs 5:5 [KJV]  Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

Proverbs 5:6 [HEB]  אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים פֶּן תְּפַלֵּ֑ס נָע֥וּ מַ֝עְגְּלֹתֶ֗יהָ לֹ֣א תֵדָֽע
Proverbs 5:6 [KJV]  Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.

Proverbs 5:7 [HEB]  וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ לִ֑י וְאַל תָּ֝ס֗וּרוּ מֵאִמְרֵי פִֽי
Proverbs 5:7 [KJV]  Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

Proverbs 5:8 [HEB]  הַרְחֵ֣ק מֵעָלֶ֣יהָ דַרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְאַל תִּ֝קְרַ֗ב אֶל פֶּ֥תַח בֵּיתָֽהּ
Proverbs 5:8 [KJV]  Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

Proverbs 5:9 [HEB]  פֶּן תִּתֵּ֣ן לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וּ֝שְׁנֹתֶ֗יךָ לְאַכְזָרִֽי
Proverbs 5:9 [KJV]  Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:

Proverbs 5:10 [HEB]  פֶּֽן יִשְׂבְּע֣וּ זָרִ֣ים כֹּחֶ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲצָבֶ֗יךָ בְּבֵ֣ית נָכְרִֽי
Proverbs 5:10 [KJV]  Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;

Proverbs 5:11 [HEB]  וְנָהַמְתָּ֥ בְאַחֲרִיתֶ֑ךָ בִּכְל֥וֹת בְּ֝שָׂרְךָ֗ וּשְׁאֵרֶֽךָ
Proverbs 5:11 [KJV]  And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

Proverbs 5:12 [HEB]  וְֽאָמַרְתָּ֗ אֵ֭יךְ שָׂנֵ֣אתִי מוּסָ֑ר וְ֝תוֹכַ֗חַת נָאַ֥ץ לִבִּֽי
Proverbs 5:12 [KJV]  And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

Proverbs 5:13 [HEB]  וְֽלֹא שָׁ֭מַעְתִּי בְּק֣וֹל מוֹרָ֑י וְ֝לִֽמְלַמְּדַ֗י לֹא הִטִּ֥יתִי אָזְנִֽי
Proverbs 5:13 [KJV]  And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

Proverbs 9:7 [KJV]  He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.

Proverbs 9:8 [KJV]  Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

Proverbs 9:9 [KJV]  Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.

Proverbs 9:10 [KJV]  The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

Proverbs 9:11 [KJV]  For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.

Proverbs 9:12 [KJV]  If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.

Proverbs 9:13 [HEB]  אֵ֣שֶׁת כְּ֭סִילוּת הֹֽמִיָּ֑ה פְּ֝תַיּ֗וּת וּבַל יָ֥דְעָה מָּֽה
Proverbs 9:13 [KJV]  A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.

Proverbs 9:17 [KJV]  Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

Proverbs 9:18 [KJV]  But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.


--- Proverbs Chapter 10 ---
Proverbs 10:1 [HEB]  מִשְׁלֵ֗י שְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח אָ֑ב וּבֵ֥ן כְּ֝סִ֗יל תּוּגַ֥ת אִמּֽוֹ
Proverbs 10:1 [KJV]  The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

Proverbs 10:2 [HEB]  לֹא י֭וֹעִילוּ אוֹצְר֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת
Proverbs 10:2 [KJV]  Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.

Proverbs 10:3 [KJV]  The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.

Proverbs 10:4 [KJV]  He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

Proverbs 10:5 [HEB]  אֹגֵ֣ר בַּ֭קַּיִץ בֵּ֣ן מַשְׂכִּ֑יל נִרְדָּ֥ם בַּ֝קָּצִ֗יר בֵּ֣ן מֵבִֽישׁ
Proverbs 10:5 [KJV]  He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

Proverbs 10:6 [HEB]  בְּ֭רָכוֹת לְרֹ֣אשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס
Proverbs 10:6 [KJV]  Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

Proverbs 10:7 [KJV]  The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.

Proverbs 10:8 [HEB]  חֲכַם לֵ֭ב יִקַּ֣ח מִצְוֺ֑ת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט
Proverbs 10:8 [KJV]  The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.

Proverbs 10:9 [HEB]  הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בַּ֭תֹּם יֵ֣לֶךְ בֶּ֑טַח וּמְעַקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו יִוָּדֵֽעַ
Proverbs 10:9 [KJV]  He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

Proverbs 10:10 [HEB]  קֹ֣רֵֽץ עַ֭יִן יִתֵּ֣ן עַצָּ֑בֶת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט
Proverbs 10:10 [KJV]  He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.

Proverbs 10:11 [HEB]  מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים פִּ֣י צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס
Proverbs 10:11 [KJV]  The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

Proverbs 10:12 [KJV]  Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

Proverbs 10:14 [KJV]  Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.

Proverbs 10:16 [KJV]  The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

Proverbs 10:17 [KJV]  He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.

Proverbs 10:18 [HEB]  מְכַסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁ֑קֶר וּמוֹצִ֥א דִ֝בָּ֗ה ה֣וּא כְסִֽיל

Proverbs 10:19 [HEB]  בְּרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֶחְדַּל פָּ֑שַׁע וְחֹשֵׂ֖ךְ שְׂפָתָ֣יו מַשְׂכִּֽיל
Proverbs 10:19 [KJV]  In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.

Proverbs 10:20 [HEB]  כֶּ֣סֶף נִ֭בְחָר לְשׁ֣וֹן צַדִּ֑יק לֵ֖ב רְשָׁעִ֣ים כִּמְעָֽט
Proverbs 10:20 [KJV]  The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.

Proverbs 10:21 [HEB]  שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יִרְע֣וּ רַבִּ֑ים וֶֽ֝אֱוִילִ֗ים בַּחֲסַר לֵ֥ב יָמֽוּתוּ
Proverbs 10:21 [KJV]  The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

Proverbs 10:22 [HEB]  בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הִ֣יא תַעֲשִׁ֑יר וְלֹֽא יוֹסִ֖ף עֶ֣צֶב עִמָּֽהּ
Proverbs 10:22 [KJV]  The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.

Proverbs 10:24 [KJV]  The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

Proverbs 10:25 [KJV]  As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

Proverbs 10:26 [KJV]  As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.

Proverbs 10:27 [KJV]  The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

Proverbs 10:28 [HEB]  תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת צַדִּיקִ֣ים שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְתִקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד
Proverbs 10:28 [KJV]  The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

Proverbs 10:31 [KJV]  The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
