Proverbs 10:32 [KJV]  The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.


--- Proverbs Chapter 11 ---
Proverbs 11:1 [HEB]  מֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭רְמָה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶ֖בֶן שְׁלֵמָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ
Proverbs 11:1 [KJV]  A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.

Proverbs 11:2 [HEB]  בָּֽא זָ֭דוֹן וַיָּבֹ֣א קָל֑וֹן וְֽאֶת צְנוּעִ֥ים חָכְמָֽה
Proverbs 11:2 [KJV]  When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.

Proverbs 11:3 [HEB]  תֻּמַּ֣ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים תַּנְחֵ֑ם וְסֶ֖לֶף בּוֹגְדִ֣ים ושדם יְשָׁדֵּֽם
Proverbs 11:3 [KJV]  The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

Proverbs 11:4 [HEB]  לֹא יוֹעִ֣יל ה֭וֹן בְּי֣וֹם עֶבְרָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת
Proverbs 11:4 [KJV]  Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.

Proverbs 11:5 [HEB]  צִדְקַ֣ת תָּ֭מִים תְּיַשֵּׁ֣ר דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְרִשְׁעָת֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל רָשָֽׁע
Proverbs 11:5 [KJV]  The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

Proverbs 11:6 [HEB]  צִדְקַ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵ֑ם וּ֝בְהַוַּ֗ת בֹּגְדִ֥ים יִלָּכֵֽדוּ
Proverbs 11:6 [KJV]  The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.

Proverbs 11:7 [HEB]  בְּמ֤וֹת אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע תֹּאבַ֣ד תִּקְוָ֑ה וְתוֹחֶ֖לֶת אוֹנִ֣ים אָבָֽדָה
Proverbs 11:7 [KJV]  When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.

Proverbs 11:8 [HEB]  צַ֭דִּיק מִצָּרָ֣ה נֶחֱלָ֑ץ וַיָּבֹ֖א רָשָׁ֣ע תַּחְתָּֽיו
Proverbs 11:8 [KJV]  The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.

Proverbs 11:9 [HEB]  בְּפֶ֗ה חָ֭נֵף יַשְׁחִ֣ת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וּ֝בְדַ֗עַת צַדִּיקִ֥ים יֵחָלֵֽצוּ
Proverbs 11:9 [KJV]  An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.

Proverbs 11:10 [HEB]  בְּט֣וּב צַ֭דִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹ֣ץ קִרְיָ֑ה וּבַאֲבֹ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים רִנָּֽה
Proverbs 11:10 [KJV]  When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

Proverbs 11:11 [HEB]  בְּבִרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תָּר֣וּם קָ֑רֶת וּבְפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תֵּהָרֵֽס
Proverbs 11:11 [KJV]  By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

Proverbs 11:12 [HEB]  בָּז לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חֲסַר לֵ֑ב וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנ֣וֹת יַחֲרִֽישׁ
Proverbs 11:12 [KJV]  He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

Proverbs 11:13 [HEB]  הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָ֭כִיל מְגַלֶּה סּ֑וֹד וְנֶאֱמַן ר֝֗וּחַ מְכַסֶּ֥ה דָבָֽר
Proverbs 11:13 [KJV]  A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

Proverbs 11:14 [HEB]  בְּאֵ֣ין תַּ֭חְבֻּלוֹת יִפָּל עָ֑ם וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ
Proverbs 11:14 [KJV]  Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

Proverbs 11:15 [HEB]  רַע יֵ֭רוֹעַ כִּי עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תֹקְעִ֣ים בּוֹטֵֽחַ
Proverbs 11:15 [KJV]  He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.

Proverbs 11:16 [HEB]  אֵֽשֶׁת חֵ֭ן תִּתְמֹ֣ךְ כָּב֑וֹד וְ֝עָרִיצִ֗ים יִתְמְכוּ עֹֽשֶׁר
Proverbs 11:16 [KJV]  A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

Proverbs 11:17 [HEB]  גֹּמֵ֣ל נַ֭פְשׁוֹ אִ֣ישׁ חָ֑סֶד וְעֹכֵ֥ר שְׁ֝אֵר֗וֹ אַכְזָרִֽי
Proverbs 11:17 [KJV]  The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

Proverbs 11:18 [HEB]  רָשָׁ֗ע עֹשֶׂ֥ה פְעֻלַּת שָׁ֑קֶר וְזֹרֵ֥עַ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה שֶׂ֣כֶר אֱמֶֽת
Proverbs 11:18 [KJV]  The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.

Proverbs 11:19 [HEB]  כֵּן צְדָקָ֥ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רָעָ֣ה לְמוֹתֽוֹ
Proverbs 11:19 [KJV]  As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.

Proverbs 11:20 [HEB]  תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה עִקְּשֵׁי לֵ֑ב וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ תְּמִ֣ימֵי דָֽרֶךְ
Proverbs 11:20 [KJV]  They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.

Proverbs 11:21 [HEB]  יָ֣ד לְ֭יָד לֹא יִנָּ֣קֶה רָּ֑ע וְזֶ֖רַע צַדִּיקִ֣ים נִמְלָֽט
Proverbs 11:21 [KJV]  Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

Proverbs 11:22 [HEB]  נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב בְּאַ֣ף חֲזִ֑יר אִשָּׁ֥ה יָ֝פָ֗ה וְסָ֣רַת טָֽעַם
Proverbs 11:22 [KJV]  As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.

Proverbs 11:23 [HEB]  תַּאֲוַ֣ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים אַךְ ט֑וֹב תִּקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֶבְרָֽה
Proverbs 11:23 [KJV]  The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

Proverbs 11:24 [HEB]  יֵ֣שׁ מְ֭פַזֵּר וְנוֹסָ֥ף ע֑וֹד וְחוֹשֵׂ֥ךְ מִ֝יֹּ֗שֶׁר אַךְ לְמַחְסֽוֹר
Proverbs 11:24 [KJV]  There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.

Proverbs 11:25 [HEB]  נֶֽפֶשׁ בְּרָכָ֥ה תְדֻשָּׁ֑ן וּ֝מַרְוֶ֗ה גַּם ה֥וּא יוֹרֶֽא
Proverbs 11:25 [KJV]  The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

Proverbs 11:26 [HEB]  מֹ֣נֵֽעַ בָּ֭ר יִקְּבֻ֣הוּ לְא֑וֹם וּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ מַשְׁבִּֽיר
Proverbs 11:26 [KJV]  He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

Proverbs 11:27 [HEB]  שֹׁ֣חֵֽר ט֭וֹב יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ רָצ֑וֹן וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ רָעָ֣ה תְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ
Proverbs 11:27 [KJV]  He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.

Proverbs 11:28 [HEB]  בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭עָשְׁרוֹ ה֣וּא יִפֹּ֑ל וְ֝כֶעָלֶ֗ה צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִפְרָֽחוּ
Proverbs 11:28 [KJV]  He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.

Proverbs 11:29 [HEB]  עוֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ יִנְחַל ר֑וּחַ וְעֶ֥בֶד אֱ֝וִ֗יל לַחֲכַם לֵֽב
Proverbs 11:29 [KJV]  He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

Proverbs 11:30 [HEB]  פְּֽרִי צַ֭דִּיק עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְלֹקֵ֖חַ נְפָשׂ֣וֹת חָכָֽם
Proverbs 11:30 [KJV]  The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.

Proverbs 11:31 [HEB]  הֵ֣ן צַ֭דִּיק בָּאָ֣רֶץ יְשֻׁלָּ֑ם אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי רָשָׁ֥ע וְחוֹטֵֽא
Proverbs 11:31 [KJV]  Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.


--- Proverbs Chapter 12 ---
Proverbs 12:1 [HEB]  אֹהֵ֣ב מ֭וּסָר אֹ֣הֵֽב דָּ֑עַת וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת בָּֽעַר
Proverbs 12:1 [KJV]  Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.

Proverbs 12:2 [HEB]  ט֗וֹב יָפִ֣יק רָ֭צוֹן מֵיְהוָ֑ה וְאִ֖ישׁ מְזִמּ֣וֹת יַרְשִֽׁיעַ
Proverbs 12:2 [KJV]  A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

Proverbs 12:3 [HEB]  לֹא יִכּ֣וֹן אָדָ֣ם בְּרֶ֑שַׁע וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים בַּל יִמּֽוֹט
Proverbs 12:3 [KJV]  A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

Proverbs 12:4 [HEB]  אֵֽשֶׁת חַ֭יִל עֲטֶ֣רֶת בַּעְלָ֑הּ וּכְרָקָ֖ב בְּעַצְמוֹתָ֣יו מְבִישָֽׁה
Proverbs 12:4 [KJV]  A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

Proverbs 12:5 [HEB]  מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֑ט תַּחְבֻּל֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה
Proverbs 12:5 [KJV]  The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

Proverbs 12:6 [HEB]  דִּבְרֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֱרָב דָּ֑ם וּפִ֥י יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם
Proverbs 12:6 [KJV]  The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

Proverbs 12:7 [HEB]  הָפ֣וֹךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים וְאֵינָ֑ם וּבֵ֖ית צַדִּיקִ֣ים יַעֲמֹֽד
Proverbs 12:7 [KJV]  The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.

Proverbs 12:8 [HEB]  לְֽפִי שִׂ֭כְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל אִ֑ישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה לֵ֝֗ב יִהְיֶ֥ה לָבֽוּז
Proverbs 12:8 [KJV]  A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

Proverbs 12:9 [HEB]  ט֣וֹב נִ֭קְלֶה וְעֶ֣בֶד ל֑וֹ מִ֝מְּתַכַּבֵּ֗ד וַחֲסַר לָֽחֶם
Proverbs 12:9 [KJV]  He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

Proverbs 12:10 [HEB]  יוֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּ֑וֹ וְֽרַחֲמֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַכְזָרִֽי
Proverbs 12:10 [KJV]  A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

Proverbs 12:11 [HEB]  עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רֵיקִ֣ים חֲסַר לֵֽב
Proverbs 12:11 [KJV]  He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.

Proverbs 12:12 [HEB]  חָמַ֣ד רָ֭שָׁע מְצ֣וֹד רָעִ֑ים וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן
Proverbs 12:12 [KJV]  The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.

Proverbs 12:13 [HEB]  בְּפֶ֣שַׁע שְׂ֭פָתַיִם מוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָ֑ע וַיֵּצֵ֖א מִצָּרָ֣ה צַדִּֽיק
Proverbs 12:13 [KJV]  The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.

Proverbs 12:14 [HEB]  מִפְּרִ֣י פִי אִ֭ישׁ יִשְׂבַּע ט֑וֹב וּגְמ֥וּל יְדֵי אָ֝דָ֗ם ישוב יָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ
Proverbs 12:14 [KJV]  A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.

Proverbs 12:15 [HEB]  דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱ֭וִיל יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖עַ לְעֵצָ֣ה חָכָֽם
Proverbs 12:15 [KJV]  The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.

Proverbs 12:16 [HEB]  אֱוִ֗יל בַּ֭יּוֹם יִוָּדַ֣ע כַּעְס֑וֹ וְכֹסֶ֖ה קָל֣וֹן עָרֽוּם
Proverbs 12:16 [KJV]  A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.

Proverbs 12:17 [HEB]  יָפִ֣יחַ אֱ֭מוּנָה יַגִּ֣יד צֶ֑דֶק וְעֵ֖ד שְׁקָרִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה
Proverbs 12:17 [KJV]  He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.

Proverbs 12:18 [HEB]  יֵ֣שׁ בּ֭וֹטֶה כְּמַדְקְר֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב וּלְשׁ֖וֹן חֲכָמִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא
Proverbs 12:18 [KJV]  There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.

Proverbs 12:19 [HEB]  שְֽׂפַת אֱ֭מֶת תִּכּ֣וֹן לָעַ֑ד וְעַד אַ֝רְגִּ֗יעָה לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר
Proverbs 12:19 [KJV]  The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

Proverbs 12:20 [HEB]  מִ֭רְמָה בְּלֶב חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וּֽלְיֹעֲצֵ֖י שָׁל֣וֹם שִׂמְחָֽה
Proverbs 12:20 [KJV]  Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.

Proverbs 12:21 [HEB]  לֹא יְאֻנֶּ֣ה לַצַּדִּ֣יק כָּל אָ֑וֶן וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים מָ֣לְאוּ רָֽע
Proverbs 12:21 [KJV]  There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

Proverbs 12:22 [HEB]  תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁ֑קֶר וְעֹשֵׂ֖י אֱמוּנָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ
Proverbs 12:22 [KJV]  Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.

Proverbs 12:23 [HEB]  אָדָ֣ם עָ֭רוּם כֹּ֣סֶה דָּ֑עַת וְלֵ֥ב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים יִקְרָ֥א אִוֶּֽלֶת
Proverbs 12:23 [KJV]  A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

Proverbs 12:24 [HEB]  יַד חָרוּצִ֥ים תִּמְשׁ֑וֹל ו֝רְמִיָּ֗ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָמַֽס
Proverbs 12:24 [KJV]  The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.

Proverbs 12:25 [HEB]  דְּאָגָ֣ה בְלֶב אִ֣ישׁ יַשְׁחֶ֑נָּה וְדָבָ֖ר ט֣וֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶֽנָּה
Proverbs 12:25 [KJV]  Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

Proverbs 12:26 [HEB]  יָתֵ֣ר מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ צַדִּ֑יק וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּתְעֵֽם
Proverbs 12:26 [KJV]  The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.

Proverbs 12:27 [HEB]  לֹא יַחֲרֹ֣ךְ רְמִיָּ֣ה צֵיד֑וֹ וְהוֹן אָדָ֖ם יָקָ֣ר חָרֽוּץ
Proverbs 12:27 [KJV]  The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.

Proverbs 12:28 [HEB]  בְּאֹֽרַח צְדָקָ֥ה חַיִּ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ נְתִיבָ֣ה אַל מָֽוֶת
Proverbs 12:28 [KJV]  In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof there is no death.


--- Proverbs Chapter 13 ---
Proverbs 13:1 [HEB]  בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝לֵ֗ץ לֹא שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה
Proverbs 13:1 [KJV]  A wise son heareth his father’s instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.

Proverbs 13:2 [HEB]  מִפְּרִ֣י פִי אִ֭ישׁ יֹ֣אכַל ט֑וֹב וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בֹּגְדִ֣ים חָמָֽס
Proverbs 13:2 [KJV]  A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.

Proverbs 13:3 [HEB]  נֹצֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ פֹּשֵׂ֥ק שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו מְחִתָּה לֽוֹ
Proverbs 13:3 [KJV]  He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

Proverbs 13:4 [HEB]  מִתְאַוָּ֣ה וָ֭אַיִן נַפְשׁ֣וֹ עָצֵ֑ל וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ חָרֻצִ֣ים תְּדֻשָּֽׁן
Proverbs 13:4 [KJV]  The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

Proverbs 13:5 [HEB]  דְּבַר שֶׁ֭קֶר יִשְׂנָ֣א צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝רָשָׁ֗ע יַבְאִ֥ישׁ וְיַחְפִּֽיר
Proverbs 13:5 [KJV]  A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

Proverbs 13:6 [HEB]  צְ֭דָקָה תִּצֹּ֣ר תָּם דָּ֑רֶךְ וְ֝רִשְׁעָ֗ה תְּסַלֵּ֥ף חַטָּֽאת
Proverbs 13:6 [KJV]  Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

Proverbs 13:7 [HEB]  יֵ֣שׁ מִ֭תְעַשֵּׁר וְאֵ֣ין כֹּ֑ל מִ֝תְרוֹשֵׁ֗שׁ וְה֣וֹן רָֽב
Proverbs 13:7 [KJV]  There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.

Proverbs 13:8 [HEB]  כֹּ֣פֶר נֶֽפֶשׁ אִ֣ישׁ עָשְׁר֑וֹ וְ֝רָ֗שׁ לֹא שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה
Proverbs 13:8 [KJV]  The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.

Proverbs 13:9 [KJV]  The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

Proverbs 13:10 [HEB]  רַק בְּ֭זָדוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן מַצָּ֑ה וְאֶת נ֖וֹעָצִ֣ים חָכְמָֽה
Proverbs 13:10 [KJV]  Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.

Proverbs 13:11 [HEB]  ה֭וֹן מֵהֶ֣בֶל יִמְעָ֑ט וְקֹבֵ֖ץ עַל יָ֣ד יַרְבֶּֽה
Proverbs 13:11 [KJV]  Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.

Proverbs 13:12 [HEB]  תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת מְ֭מֻשָּׁכָה מַחֲלָה לֵ֑ב וְעֵ֥ץ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תַּאֲוָ֥ה בָאָֽה
Proverbs 13:12 [KJV]  Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

Proverbs 13:13 [HEB]  בָּ֣ז לְ֭דָבָר יֵחָ֣בֶל ל֑וֹ וִירֵ֥א מִ֝צְוָ֗ה ה֣וּא יְשֻׁלָּֽם
Proverbs 13:13 [KJV]  Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

Proverbs 13:14 [HEB]  תּוֹרַ֣ת חָ֭כָם מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
Proverbs 13:14 [KJV]  The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

Proverbs 13:15 [HEB]  שֵֽׂכֶל ט֭וֹב יִתֶּן חֵ֑ן וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֹּגְדִ֣ים אֵיתָֽן
Proverbs 13:15 [KJV]  Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.

Proverbs 13:16 [HEB]  כָּל עָ֭רוּם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה בְדָ֑עַת וּ֝כְסִ֗יל יִפְרֹ֥שׂ אִוֶּֽלֶת
Proverbs 13:16 [KJV]  Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.

Proverbs 13:17 [HEB]  מַלְאָ֣ךְ רָ֭שָׁע יִפֹּ֣ל בְּרָ֑ע וְצִ֖יר אֱמוּנִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא
Proverbs 13:17 [KJV]  A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.

Proverbs 13:18 [HEB]  רֵ֣ישׁ וְ֭קָלוֹן פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר וְשׁוֹמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יְכֻבָּֽד
Proverbs 13:18 [KJV]  Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

Proverbs 13:19 [HEB]  תַּאֲוָ֣ה נִ֭הְיָה תֶּעֱרַ֣ב לְנָ֑פֶשׁ וְתוֹעֲבַ֥ת כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע
Proverbs 13:19 [KJV]  The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

Proverbs 13:20 [KJV]  He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.

Proverbs 13:21 [HEB]  חַ֭טָּאִים תְּרַדֵּ֣ף רָעָ֑ה וְאֶת צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יְשַׁלֶּם טֽוֹב
Proverbs 13:21 [KJV]  Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

Proverbs 13:22 [HEB]  ט֗וֹב יַנְחִ֥יל בְּנֵֽי בָנִ֑ים וְצָפ֥וּן לַ֝צַּדִּ֗יק חֵ֣יל חוֹטֵֽא
Proverbs 13:22 [KJV]  A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

Proverbs 13:23 [HEB]  רָב אֹ֭כֶל נִ֣יר רָאשִׁ֑ים וְיֵ֥שׁ נִ֝סְפֶּ֗ה בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט
Proverbs 13:23 [KJV]  Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.

Proverbs 13:24 [HEB]  חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ שִׁ֭בְטוֹ שׂוֹנֵ֣א בְנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֹהֲב֗וֹ שִֽׁחֲר֥וֹ מוּסָֽר
Proverbs 13:24 [KJV]  He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

Proverbs 13:25 [HEB]  צַדִּ֗יק אֹ֭כֵל לְשֹׂ֣בַע נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֶ֖טֶן רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֶּחְסָֽר
Proverbs 13:25 [KJV]  The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.


--- Proverbs Chapter 14 ---
Proverbs 14:1 [HEB]  חַכְמ֣וֹת נָ֭שִׁים בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ וְ֝אִוֶּ֗לֶת בְּיָדֶ֥יהָ תֶהֶרְסֶֽנּוּ
Proverbs 14:1 [KJV]  Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.

Proverbs 14:2 [HEB]  הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּ֭יָשְׁרוֹ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּנְל֖וֹז דְּרָכָ֣יו בּוֹזֵֽהוּ
Proverbs 14:2 [KJV]  He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.

Proverbs 14:3 [KJV]  In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

Proverbs 14:4 [KJV]  Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

Proverbs 14:5 [HEB]  עֵ֣ד אֱ֭מוּנִים לֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר
Proverbs 14:5 [KJV]  A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.

Proverbs 14:6 [HEB]  בִּקֶּשׁ לֵ֣ץ חָכְמָ֣ה וָאָ֑יִן וְדַ֖עַת לְנָב֣וֹן נָקָֽל
Proverbs 14:6 [KJV]  A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.

Proverbs 14:7 [HEB]  לֵ֣ךְ מִ֭נֶּגֶד לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּסִ֑יל וּבַל יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ שִׂפְתֵי דָֽעַת
Proverbs 14:7 [KJV]  Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.

Proverbs 14:8 [HEB]  חָכְמַ֣ת עָ֭רוּם הָבִ֣ין דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְאִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה
Proverbs 14:8 [KJV]  The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.

Proverbs 14:9 [HEB]  אֱ֭וִלִים יָלִ֣יץ אָשָׁ֑ם וּבֵ֖ין יְשָׁרִ֣ים רָצֽוֹן
Proverbs 14:9 [KJV]  Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.

Proverbs 14:10 [HEB]  לֵ֗ב י֭וֹדֵעַ מָרַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בְשִׂמְחָת֗וֹ לֹא יִתְעָ֥רַב זָֽר
Proverbs 14:10 [KJV]  The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.

Proverbs 14:11 [HEB]  בֵּ֣ית רְ֭שָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵ֑ד וְאֹ֖הֶל יְשָׁרִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיחַ
Proverbs 14:11 [KJV]  The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.

Proverbs 14:12 [KJV]  There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

Proverbs 14:13 [KJV]  Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

Proverbs 14:14 [HEB]  מִדְּרָכָ֣יו יִ֭שְׂבַּע ס֣וּג לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵעָלָ֗יו אִ֣ישׁ טֽוֹב
Proverbs 14:14 [KJV]  The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.

Proverbs 14:15 [HEB]  פֶּ֭תִי יַאֲמִ֣ין לְכָל דָּבָ֑ר וְ֝עָר֗וּם יָבִ֥ין לַאֲשֻׁרֽוֹ
Proverbs 14:15 [KJV]  The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.

Proverbs 14:16 [HEB]  חָכָ֣ם יָ֭רֵא וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל מִתְעַבֵּ֥ר וּבוֹטֵֽחַ
Proverbs 14:16 [KJV]  A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.

Proverbs 14:17 [KJV]  He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.

Proverbs 14:18 [HEB]  נָחֲל֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם אִוֶּ֑לֶת וַֽ֝עֲרוּמִ֗ים יַכְתִּ֥רוּ דָֽעַת
Proverbs 14:18 [KJV]  The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

Proverbs 14:19 [HEB]  שַׁח֣וּ רָ֭עִים לִפְנֵ֣י טוֹבִ֑ים וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים עַֽל שַׁעֲרֵ֥י צַדִּֽיק
Proverbs 14:19 [KJV]  The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

Proverbs 14:20 [HEB]  גַּם לְ֭רֵעֵהוּ יִשָּׂ֣נֵא רָ֑שׁ וְאֹהֲבֵ֖י עָשִׁ֣יר רַבִּֽים
Proverbs 14:20 [KJV]  The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.

Proverbs 14:21 [HEB]  בָּז לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חוֹטֵ֑א וּמְחוֹנֵ֖ן עניים עֲנָוִ֣ים אַשְׁרָֽיו
Proverbs 14:21 [KJV]  He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.

Proverbs 14:22 [HEB]  הֲֽלוֹא יִ֭תְעוּ חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וְחֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת חֹ֣רְשֵׁי טֽוֹב
Proverbs 14:22 [KJV]  Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.

Proverbs 14:23 [HEB]  בְּכָל עֶ֭צֶב יִהְיֶ֣ה מוֹתָ֑ר וּדְבַר שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם אַךְ לְמַחְסֽוֹר
Proverbs 14:23 [KJV]  In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

Proverbs 14:24 [HEB]  עֲטֶ֣רֶת חֲכָמִ֣ים עָשְׁרָ֑ם אִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת
Proverbs 14:24 [KJV]  The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.

Proverbs 14:25 [KJV]  A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.

Proverbs 14:26 [HEB]  בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מִבְטַח עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְבָנָ֗יו יִהְיֶ֥ה מַחְסֶֽה
Proverbs 14:26 [KJV]  In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.

Proverbs 14:27 [HEB]  יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
Proverbs 14:27 [KJV]  The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

Proverbs 14:28 [HEB]  בְּרָב עָ֥ם הַדְרַת מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבְאֶ֥פֶס לְ֝אֹ֗ם מְחִתַּ֥ת רָזֽוֹן
Proverbs 14:28 [KJV]  In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

Proverbs 14:29 [HEB]  אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם רַב תְּבוּנָ֑ה וּקְצַר ר֝֗וּחַ מֵרִ֥ים אִוֶּֽלֶת
Proverbs 14:29 [KJV]  He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

Proverbs 14:30 [HEB]  חַיֵּ֣י בְ֭שָׂרִים לֵ֣ב מַרְפֵּ֑א וּרְקַ֖ב עֲצָמ֣וֹת קִנְאָֽה
Proverbs 14:30 [KJV]  A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

Proverbs 14:31 [HEB]  עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ וּ֝מְכַבְּד֗וֹ חֹנֵ֥ן אֶבְיֽוֹן
Proverbs 14:31 [KJV]  He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.

Proverbs 14:32 [HEB]  בְּֽ֭רָעָתוֹ יִדָּחֶ֣ה רָשָׁ֑ע וְחֹסֶ֖ה בְמוֹת֣וֹ צַדִּֽיק
Proverbs 14:32 [KJV]  The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.

Proverbs 14:33 [HEB]  בְּלֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן תָּנ֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְקֶ֥רֶב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים תִּוָּדֵֽעַ
Proverbs 14:33 [KJV]  Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.

Proverbs 14:34 [HEB]  צְדָקָ֥ה תְרֽוֹמֵֽם גּ֑וֹי וְחֶ֖סֶד לְאֻמִּ֣ים חַטָּֽאת
Proverbs 14:34 [KJV]  Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.

Proverbs 14:35 [HEB]  רְֽצוֹן מֶ֭לֶךְ לְעֶ֣בֶד מַשְׂכִּ֑יל וְ֝עֶבְרָת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה מֵבִֽישׁ
Proverbs 14:35 [KJV]  The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.


--- Proverbs Chapter 15 ---
Proverbs 15:1 [HEB]  מַֽעֲנֶה רַּ֭ךְ יָשִׁ֣יב חֵמָ֑ה וּדְבַר עֶ֝֗צֶב יַעֲלֶה אָֽף
Proverbs 15:1 [KJV]  A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

Proverbs 15:2 [HEB]  לְשׁ֣וֹן חֲ֭כָמִים תֵּיטִ֣יב דָּ֑עַת וּפִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ אִוֶּֽלֶת
Proverbs 15:2 [KJV]  The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.

Proverbs 15:3 [HEB]  בְּֽכָל מָ֭קוֹם עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה צֹ֝פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים וטוֹבִֽים
Proverbs 15:3 [KJV]  The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.

Proverbs 15:4 [HEB]  מַרְפֵּ֣א לָ֭שׁוֹן עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְסֶ֥לֶף בָּ֝֗הּ שֶׁ֣בֶר בְּרֽוּחַ
Proverbs 15:4 [KJV]  A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.

Proverbs 15:5 [HEB]  אֱוִ֗יל יִ֭נְאַץ מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יַעְרִֽם
Proverbs 15:5 [KJV]  A fool despiseth his father’s instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.

Proverbs 15:6 [HEB]  בֵּ֣ית צַ֭דִּיק חֹ֣סֶן רָ֑ב וּבִתְבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע נֶעְכָּֽרֶת
Proverbs 15:6 [KJV]  In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

Proverbs 15:7 [HEB]  שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲ֭כָמִים יְזָ֣רוּ דָ֑עַת וְלֵ֖ב כְּסִילִ֣ים לֹא כֵֽן
Proverbs 15:7 [KJV]  The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.

Proverbs 15:8 [HEB]  זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּתְפִלַּ֖ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים רְצוֹנֽוֹ
Proverbs 15:8 [KJV]  The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

Proverbs 15:9 [HEB]  תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ רָשָׁ֑ע וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף צְדָקָ֣ה יֶאֱהָֽב
Proverbs 15:9 [KJV]  The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

Proverbs 15:10 [HEB]  מוּסָ֣ר רָ֭ע לְעֹזֵ֣ב אֹ֑רַח שׂוֹנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת יָמֽוּת
Proverbs 15:10 [KJV]  Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.

Proverbs 15:11 [HEB]  שְׁא֣וֹל וַ֭אֲבַדּוֹן נֶ֣גֶד יְהוָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי לִבּ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי אָדָֽם
Proverbs 15:11 [KJV]  Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

Proverbs 15:12 [HEB]  לֹ֣א יֶאֱהַב לֵ֭ץ הוֹכֵ֣חַֽ ל֑וֹ אֶל חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א יֵלֵֽךְ
Proverbs 15:12 [KJV]  A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.

Proverbs 15:13 [HEB]  לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב פָּנִ֑ים וּבְעַצְּבַת לֵ֝ב ר֣וּחַ נְכֵאָֽה
Proverbs 15:13 [KJV]  A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

Proverbs 15:14 [HEB]  לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ דָּ֑עַת ופני וּפִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יִרְעֶ֥ה אִוֶּֽלֶת
Proverbs 15:14 [KJV]  The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

Proverbs 15:15 [HEB]  כָּל יְמֵ֣י עָנִ֣י רָעִ֑ים וְטֽוֹב לֵ֝֗ב מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד
Proverbs 15:15 [KJV]  All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.

Proverbs 15:16 [HEB]  טוֹב מְ֭עַט בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מֵאוֹצָ֥ר רָ֝֗ב וּמְה֥וּמָה בֽוֹ
Proverbs 15:16 [KJV]  Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.

Proverbs 15:17 [HEB]  ט֤וֹב אֲרֻחַ֣ת יָ֭רָק וְאַהֲבָה שָׁ֑ם מִשּׁ֥וֹר אָ֝ב֗וּס וְשִׂנְאָה בֽוֹ
Proverbs 15:17 [KJV]  Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

Proverbs 15:18 [HEB]  אִ֣ישׁ חֵ֭מָה יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וְאֶ֥רֶך אַ֝פַּ֗יִם יַשְׁקִ֥יט רִֽיב
Proverbs 15:18 [KJV]  A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

Proverbs 15:19 [HEB]  דֶּ֣רֶךְ עָ֭צֵל כִּמְשֻׂ֣כַת חָ֑דֶק וְאֹ֖רַח יְשָׁרִ֣ים סְלֻלָֽה
Proverbs 15:19 [KJV]  The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.

Proverbs 15:20 [HEB]  בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח אָ֑ב וּכְסִ֥יל אָ֝דָ֗ם בּוֹזֶ֥ה אִמּֽוֹ
Proverbs 15:20 [KJV]  A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.

Proverbs 15:21 [HEB]  אִ֭וֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַחֲסַר לֵ֑ב וְאִ֥ישׁ תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה יְיַשֶׁר לָֽכֶת
Proverbs 15:21 [KJV]  Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.

Proverbs 15:22 [HEB]  הָפֵ֣ר מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵ֣ין ס֑וֹד וּבְרֹ֖ב יוֹעֲצִ֣ים תָּקֽוּם
Proverbs 15:22 [KJV]  Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

Proverbs 15:23 [HEB]  שִׂמְחָ֣ה לָ֭אִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה פִ֑יו וְדָבָ֖ר בְּעִתּ֣וֹ מַה טּֽוֹב
Proverbs 15:23 [KJV]  A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!

Proverbs 15:24 [HEB]  אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לְמַ֣עְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְמַ֥עַן ס֝֗וּר מִשְּׁא֥וֹל מָֽטָּה
Proverbs 15:24 [KJV]  The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.

Proverbs 15:25 [HEB]  בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים יִסַּ֥ח יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה
Proverbs 15:25 [KJV]  The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

Proverbs 15:26 [HEB]  תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת רָ֑ע וּ֝טְהֹרִ֗ים אִמְרֵי נֹֽעַם
Proverbs 15:26 [KJV]  The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.

Proverbs 15:27 [HEB]  עֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וְשׂוֹנֵ֖א מַתָּנֹ֣ת יִחְיֶֽה
Proverbs 15:27 [KJV]  He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.

Proverbs 15:28 [HEB]  לֵ֣ב צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לַעֲנ֑וֹת וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ רָעֽוֹת
Proverbs 15:28 [KJV]  The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

Proverbs 15:29 [HEB]  רָח֣וֹק יְ֭הוָה מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים וּתְפִלַּ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע
Proverbs 15:29 [KJV]  The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

Proverbs 15:30 [HEB]  מְֽאוֹר עֵ֭ינַיִם יְשַׂמַּֽח לֵ֑ב שְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה תְּדַשֶּׁן עָֽצֶם
Proverbs 15:30 [KJV]  The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.

Proverbs 15:31 [HEB]  אֹ֗זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת תּוֹכַ֣חַת חַיִּ֑ים בְּקֶ֖רֶב חֲכָמִ֣ים תָּלִֽין
Proverbs 15:31 [KJV]  The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.

Proverbs 15:32 [HEB]  פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מ֭וּסָר מוֹאֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְשׁוֹמֵ֥עַ תּ֝וֹכַ֗חַת ק֣וֹנֶה לֵּֽב
Proverbs 15:32 [KJV]  He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.

Proverbs 15:33 [HEB]  יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מוּסַ֣ר חָכְמָ֑ה וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה
Proverbs 15:33 [KJV]  The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.


--- Proverbs Chapter 16 ---
Proverbs 16:1 [HEB]  לְאָדָ֥ם מַֽעַרְכֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה מַעֲנֵ֥ה לָשֽׁוֹן
Proverbs 16:1 [KJV]  The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.

Proverbs 16:2 [HEB]  כָּֽל דַּרְכֵי אִ֭ישׁ זַ֣ךְ בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן רוּח֣וֹת יְהוָֽה
Proverbs 16:2 [KJV]  All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.

Proverbs 16:3 [HEB]  גֹּ֣ל אֶל יְהוָ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝יִכֹּ֗נוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ
Proverbs 16:3 [KJV]  Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

Proverbs 16:4 [HEB]  כֹּ֤ל פָּעַ֣ל יְ֭הוָה לַֽמַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ וְגַם רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לְי֣וֹם רָעָֽה
Proverbs 16:4 [KJV]  The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

Proverbs 16:5 [HEB]  תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל גְּבַהּ לֵ֑ב יָ֥ד לְ֝יָ֗ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה
Proverbs 16:5 [KJV]  Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

Proverbs 16:6 [HEB]  בְּחֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יְכֻפַּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן וּבְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע
Proverbs 16:6 [KJV]  By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

Proverbs 16:7 [HEB]  בִּרְצ֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי אִ֑ישׁ גַּם א֝וֹיְבָ֗יו יַשְׁלִ֥ם אִתּֽוֹ
Proverbs 16:7 [KJV]  When a man’s ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

Proverbs 16:8 [HEB]  טוֹב מְ֭עַט בִּצְדָקָ֑ה מֵרֹ֥ב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט
Proverbs 16:8 [KJV]  Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

Proverbs 16:9 [HEB]  לֵ֣ב אָ֭דָם יְחַשֵּׁ֣ב דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה יָכִ֥ין צַעֲדֽוֹ
Proverbs 16:9 [KJV]  A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

Proverbs 16:10 [HEB]  קֶ֤סֶם עַֽל שִׂפְתֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לֹ֣א יִמְעַל פִּֽיו
Proverbs 16:10 [KJV]  A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

Proverbs 16:11 [HEB]  פֶּ֤לֶס וּמֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭שְׁפָּט לַֽיהוָ֑ה מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ כָּל אַבְנֵי כִֽיס
Proverbs 16:11 [KJV]  A just weight and balance are the LORD’s: all the weights of the bag are his work.

Proverbs 16:12 [HEB]  תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מְ֭לָכִים עֲשׂ֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע כִּ֥י בִ֝צְדָקָ֗ה יִכּ֥וֹן כִּסֵּֽא
Proverbs 16:12 [KJV]  It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.

Proverbs 16:13 [HEB]  רְצ֣וֹן מְ֭לָכִים שִׂפְתֵי צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֖ר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יֶאֱהָֽב
Proverbs 16:13 [KJV]  Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

Proverbs 16:14 [HEB]  חֲמַת מֶ֥לֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי מָ֑וֶת וְאִ֖ישׁ חָכָ֣ם יְכַפְּרֶֽנָּה
Proverbs 16:14 [KJV]  The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

Proverbs 16:15 [HEB]  בְּאוֹר פְּנֵי מֶ֥לֶךְ חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ כְּעָ֣ב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ
Proverbs 16:15 [KJV]  In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

Proverbs 16:16 [HEB]  קְֽנֹה חָכְמָ֗ה מַה טּ֥וֹב מֵחָר֑וּץ וּקְנ֥וֹת בִּ֝ינָ֗ה נִבְחָ֥ר מִכָּֽסֶף
Proverbs 16:16 [KJV]  How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

Proverbs 16:17 [HEB]  מְסִלַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים ס֣וּר מֵרָ֑ע שֹׁמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ נֹצֵ֥ר דַּרְכּֽוֹ
Proverbs 16:17 [KJV]  The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

Proverbs 16:18 [HEB]  לִפְנֵי שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּא֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י כִ֝שָּׁל֗וֹן גֹּ֣בַהּ רֽוּחַ
Proverbs 16:18 [KJV]  Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

Proverbs 16:19 [HEB]  ט֣וֹב שְׁפַל ר֭וּחַ אֶת עניים עֲנָוִ֑ים מֵֽחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁ֝לָ֗ל אֶת גֵּאִֽים
Proverbs 16:19 [KJV]  Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

Proverbs 16:20 [HEB]  מַשְׂכִּ֣יל עַל דָּ֭בָר יִמְצָא ט֑וֹב וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה אַשְׁרָֽיו
Proverbs 16:20 [KJV]  He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.

Proverbs 16:21 [HEB]  לַחֲכַם לֵ֭ב יִקָּרֵ֣א נָב֑וֹן וּמֶ֥תֶק שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח
Proverbs 16:21 [KJV]  The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

Proverbs 16:22 [HEB]  מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים שֵׂ֣כֶל בְּעָלָ֑יו וּמוּסַ֖ר אֱוִלִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת
Proverbs 16:22 [KJV]  Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.

Proverbs 16:23 [HEB]  לֵ֣ב חָ֭כָם יַשְׂכִּ֣יל פִּ֑יהוּ וְעַל שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח
Proverbs 16:23 [KJV]  The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

Proverbs 16:24 [HEB]  צוּף דְּ֭בַשׁ אִמְרֵי נֹ֑עַם מָת֥וֹק לַ֝נֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּ֥א לָעָֽצֶם
Proverbs 16:24 [KJV]  Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

Proverbs 16:25 [HEB]  יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי מָֽוֶת
Proverbs 16:25 [KJV]  There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

Proverbs 16:26 [HEB]  נֶ֣פֶשׁ עָ֭מֵל עָ֣מְלָה לּ֑וֹ כִּֽי אָכַ֖ף עָלָ֣יו פִּֽיהוּ
Proverbs 16:26 [KJV]  He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

Proverbs 16:27 [HEB]  אִ֣ישׁ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל כֹּרֶ֣ה רָעָ֑ה וְעַל שפתיו שְׂ֝פָת֗וֹ כְּאֵ֣שׁ צָרָֽבֶת
Proverbs 16:27 [KJV]  An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.

Proverbs 16:28 [HEB]  אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֭הְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָד֑וֹן וְ֝נִרְגָּ֗ן מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף
Proverbs 16:28 [KJV]  A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

Proverbs 16:29 [HEB]  אִ֣ישׁ חָ֭מָס יְפַתֶּ֣ה רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝הוֹלִיכ֗וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא טֽוֹב
Proverbs 16:29 [KJV]  A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.

Proverbs 16:30 [HEB]  עֹצֶ֣ה עֵ֭ינָיו לַחְשֹׁ֣ב תַּהְפֻּכ֑וֹת קֹרֵ֥ץ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו כִּלָּ֥ה רָעָֽה
Proverbs 16:30 [KJV]  He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.

Proverbs 16:31 [HEB]  עֲטֶ֣רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת שֵׂיבָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה תִּמָּצֵֽא
Proverbs 16:31 [KJV]  The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

Proverbs 16:32 [HEB]  ט֤וֹב אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם מִגִּבּ֑וֹר וּמֹשֵׁ֥ל בְּ֝רוּח֗וֹ מִלֹּכֵ֥ד עִֽיר
Proverbs 16:32 [KJV]  He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

Proverbs 16:33 [HEB]  בַּ֭חֵיק יוּטַ֣ל אֶת הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה כָּל מִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ
Proverbs 16:33 [KJV]  The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.


--- Proverbs Chapter 17 ---
Proverbs 17:1 [HEB]  ט֤וֹב פַּ֣ת חֲ֭רֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה בָ֑הּ מִ֝בַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֥א זִבְחֵי רִֽיב
Proverbs 17:1 [KJV]  Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

Proverbs 17:2 [HEB]  עֶֽבֶד מַשְׂכִּ֗יל יִ֭מְשֹׁל בְּבֵ֣ן מֵבִ֑ישׁ וּבְת֥וֹךְ אַ֝חִ֗ים יַחֲלֹ֥ק נַחֲלָֽה
Proverbs 17:2 [KJV]  A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

Proverbs 17:3 [HEB]  מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וּבֹחֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה
Proverbs 17:3 [KJV]  The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.

Proverbs 17:4 [HEB]  מֵ֭רַע מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל שְׂפַת אָ֑וֶן שֶׁ֥קֶר מֵ֝זִין עַל לְשׁ֥וֹן הַוֺּֽת
Proverbs 17:4 [KJV]  A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

Proverbs 17:5 [HEB]  לֹעֵ֣ג לָ֭רָשׁ חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ שָׂמֵ֥חַ לְ֝אֵ֗יד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה
Proverbs 17:5 [KJV]  Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

Proverbs 17:6 [HEB]  עֲטֶ֣רֶת זְ֭קֵנִים בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְתִפְאֶ֖רֶת בָּנִ֣ים אֲבוֹתָֽם
Proverbs 17:6 [KJV]  Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

Proverbs 17:7 [HEB]  לֹא נָאוָ֣ה לְנָבָ֣ל שְׂפַת יֶ֑תֶר אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי לְנָדִ֥יב שְׂפַת שָֽׁקֶר
Proverbs 17:7 [KJV]  Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.

Proverbs 17:8 [HEB]  אֶֽבֶן חֵ֣ן הַ֭שֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵ֣י בְעָלָ֑יו אֶֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִפְנֶ֣ה יַשְׂכִּֽיל
Proverbs 17:8 [KJV]  A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

Proverbs 17:9 [HEB]  מְֽכַסֶּה פֶּ֭שַׁע מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה וְשֹׁנֶ֥ה בְ֝דָבָ֗ר מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף
Proverbs 17:9 [KJV]  He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

Proverbs 17:10 [HEB]  תֵּ֣חַת גְּעָרָ֣ה בְמֵבִ֑ין מֵהַכּ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל מֵאָֽה
Proverbs 17:10 [KJV]  A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.

Proverbs 17:11 [HEB]  אַךְ מְרִ֥י יְבַקֶּשׁ רָ֑ע וּמַלְאָ֥ךְ אַ֝כְזָרִ֗י יְשֻׁלַּח בּֽוֹ
Proverbs 17:11 [KJV]  An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

Proverbs 17:12 [HEB]  פָּג֬וֹשׁ דֹּ֣ב שַׁכּ֣וּל בְּאִ֑ישׁ וְאַל כְּ֝סִ֗יל בְּאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ
Proverbs 17:12 [KJV]  Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

Proverbs 17:13 [HEB]  מֵשִׁ֣יב רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה לֹא תמיש תָמ֥וּשׁ רָ֝עָ֗ה מִבֵּיתֽוֹ
Proverbs 17:13 [KJV]  Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

Proverbs 17:14 [HEB]  פּ֣וֹטֵֽר מַ֭יִם רֵאשִׁ֣ית מָד֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הִ֝תְגַּלַּ֗ע הָרִ֥יב נְטֽוֹשׁ
Proverbs 17:14 [KJV]  The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

Proverbs 17:15 [HEB]  מַצְדִּ֣יק רָ֭שָׁע וּמַרְשִׁ֣יעַ צַדִּ֑יק תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם שְׁנֵיהֶֽם
Proverbs 17:15 [KJV]  He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD.

Proverbs 17:16 [HEB]  לָמָּה זֶּ֣ה מְחִ֣יר בְּיַד כְּסִ֑יל לִקְנ֖וֹת חָכְמָ֣ה וְלֶב אָֽיִן
Proverbs 17:16 [KJV]  Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?

Proverbs 17:17 [HEB]  בְּכָל עֵ֭ת אֹהֵ֣ב הָרֵ֑עַ וְאָ֥ח לְ֝צָרָ֗ה יִוָּלֵֽד
Proverbs 17:17 [KJV]  A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

Proverbs 17:18 [HEB]  אָדָ֣ם חֲסַר לֵ֭ב תּוֹקֵ֣עַ כָּ֑ף עֹרֵ֥ב עֲ֝רֻבָּ֗ה לִפְנֵ֥י רֵעֵֽהוּ
Proverbs 17:18 [KJV]  A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.

Proverbs 17:19 [HEB]  אֹ֣הֵֽב פֶּ֭שַׁע אֹהֵ֣ב מַצָּ֑ה מַגְבִּ֥יהַּ פִּ֝תְח֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ שָֽׁבֶר
Proverbs 17:19 [KJV]  He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

Proverbs 17:20 [HEB]  עִקֶּשׁ לֵ֭ב לֹ֣א יִמְצָא ט֑וֹב וְנֶהְפָּ֥ךְ בִּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה
Proverbs 17:20 [KJV]  He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

Proverbs 17:21 [HEB]  יֹלֵ֣ד כְּ֭סִיל לְת֣וּגָה ל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח אֲבִ֣י נָבָֽל
Proverbs 17:21 [KJV]  He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.

Proverbs 17:22 [HEB]  לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב גֵּהָ֑ה וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה תְּיַבֶּשׁ גָּֽרֶם
Proverbs 17:22 [KJV]  A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

Proverbs 17:23 [HEB]  שֹׁ֣חַד מֵ֭חֵיק רָשָׁ֣ע יִקָּ֑ח לְ֝הַטּ֗וֹת אָרְח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט
Proverbs 17:23 [KJV]  A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

Proverbs 17:24 [HEB]  אֶת פְּנֵ֣י מֵבִ֣ין חָכְמָ֑ה וְעֵינֵ֥י כְ֝סִ֗יל בִּקְצֵה אָֽרֶץ
Proverbs 17:24 [KJV]  Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

Proverbs 17:25 [HEB]  כַּ֣עַס לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וּ֝מֶ֗מֶר לְיוֹלַדְתּֽוֹ
Proverbs 17:25 [KJV]  A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

Proverbs 17:26 [HEB]  גַּ֤ם עֲנ֣וֹשׁ לַצַּדִּ֣יק לֹא ט֑וֹב לְהַכּ֖וֹת נְדִיבִ֣ים עַל יֹֽשֶׁר
Proverbs 17:26 [KJV]  Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.

Proverbs 17:27 [HEB]  חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ אֲ֭מָרָיו יוֹדֵ֣עַ דָּ֑עַת וקר יְקַר ר֝֗וּחַ אִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה
Proverbs 17:27 [KJV]  He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

Proverbs 17:28 [HEB]  גַּ֤ם אֱוִ֣יל מַ֭חֲרִישׁ חָכָ֣ם יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב אֹטֵ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֣יו נָבֽוֹן
Proverbs 17:28 [KJV]  Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.


--- Proverbs Chapter 18 ---
Proverbs 18:1 [HEB]  לְֽ֭תַאֲוָה יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ נִפְרָ֑ד בְּכָל תּ֝וּשִׁיָּ֗ה יִתְגַּלָּֽע
Proverbs 18:1 [KJV]  Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

Proverbs 18:2 [HEB]  לֹֽא יַחְפֹּ֣ץ כְּ֭סִיל בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֝֗י אִֽם בְּהִתְגַּלּ֥וֹת לִבּֽוֹ
Proverbs 18:2 [KJV]  A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.

Proverbs 18:3 [HEB]  בְּֽבוֹא רָ֭שָׁע בָּ֣א גַם בּ֑וּז וְֽעִם קָל֥וֹן חֶרְפָּֽה
Proverbs 18:3 [KJV]  When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

Proverbs 18:4 [KJV]  The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.

Proverbs 18:5 [HEB]  שְׂאֵ֣ת פְּנֵי רָשָׁ֣ע לֹא ט֑וֹב לְהַטּ֥וֹת צַ֝דִּ֗יק בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט
Proverbs 18:5 [KJV]  It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

Proverbs 18:6 [HEB]  שִׂפְתֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל יָבֹ֣אֽוּ בְרִ֑יב וּ֝פִ֗יו לְֽמַהֲלֻמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא
Proverbs 18:6 [KJV]  A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

Proverbs 18:7 [HEB]  פִּֽי כְ֭סִיל מְחִתָּה ל֑וֹ וּ֝שְׂפָתָ֗יו מוֹקֵ֥שׁ נַפְשֽׁוֹ
Proverbs 18:7 [KJV]  A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

Proverbs 18:8 [HEB]  דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן
Proverbs 18:8 [KJV]  The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

Proverbs 18:9 [HEB]  גַּ֭ם מִתְרַפֶּ֣ה בִמְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ אָ֥ח ה֝֗וּא לְבַ֣עַל מַשְׁחִֽית
Proverbs 18:9 [KJV]  He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

Proverbs 18:10 [HEB]  מִגְדַּל עֹ֭ז שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בּֽוֹ יָר֖וּץ צַדִּ֣יק וְנִשְׂגָּֽב
Proverbs 18:10 [KJV]  The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

Proverbs 18:11 [HEB]  ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ וּכְחוֹמָ֥ה נִ֝שְׂגָּבָ֗ה בְּמַשְׂכִּיתֽוֹ
Proverbs 18:11 [KJV]  The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.

Proverbs 18:12 [HEB]  לִפְנֵי שֶׁ֭בֶר יִגְבַּ֣הּ לֵב אִ֑ישׁ וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה
Proverbs 18:12 [KJV]  Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.

Proverbs 18:13 [KJV]  He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.

Proverbs 18:14 [HEB]  רֽוּחַ אִ֭ישׁ יְכַלְכֵּ֣ל מַחֲלֵ֑הוּ וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה מִ֣י יִשָּׂאֶֽנָּה
Proverbs 18:14 [KJV]  The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

Proverbs 18:15 [HEB]  לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יִקְנֶה דָּ֑עַת וְאֹ֥זֶן חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תְּבַקֶּשׁ דָּֽעַת
Proverbs 18:15 [KJV]  The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

Proverbs 18:16 [HEB]  מַתָּ֣ן אָ֭דָם יַרְחִ֣יב ל֑וֹ וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְדֹלִ֣ים יַנְחֶֽנּוּ
Proverbs 18:16 [KJV]  A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

Proverbs 18:17 [HEB]  צַדִּ֣יק הָרִאשׁ֣וֹן בְּרִיב֑וֹ יבא וּבָֽא רֵ֝עֵ֗הוּ וַחֲקָרֽוֹ
Proverbs 18:17 [KJV]  He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

Proverbs 18:18 [HEB]  מִ֭דְיָנִים יַשְׁבִּ֣ית הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּבֵ֖ין עֲצוּמִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיד
Proverbs 18:18 [KJV]  The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

Proverbs 18:19 [HEB]  אָ֗ח נִפְשָׁ֥ע מִקִּרְיַת עֹ֑ז ומדונים וּ֝מִדְיָנִ֗ים כִּבְרִ֥יחַ אַרְמֽוֹן
Proverbs 18:19 [KJV]  A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

Proverbs 18:20 [HEB]  מִפְּרִ֣י פִי אִ֭ישׁ תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע בִּטְנ֑וֹ תְּבוּאַ֖ת שְׂפָתָ֣יו יִשְׂבָּֽע
Proverbs 18:20 [KJV]  A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

Proverbs 18:21 [HEB]  מָ֣וֶת וְ֭חַיִּים בְּיַד לָשׁ֑וֹן וְ֝אֹהֲבֶ֗יהָ יֹאכַ֥ל פִּרְיָֽהּ
Proverbs 18:21 [KJV]  Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

Proverbs 18:22 [HEB]  מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה
Proverbs 18:22 [KJV]  Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.

Proverbs 18:23 [HEB]  תַּחֲנוּנִ֥ים יְדַבֶּר רָ֑שׁ וְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר יַעֲנֶ֥ה עַזּֽוֹת
Proverbs 18:23 [KJV]  The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

Proverbs 18:24 [HEB]  אִ֣ישׁ רֵ֭עִים לְהִתְרֹעֵ֑עַ וְיֵ֥שׁ אֹ֝הֵ֗ב דָּבֵ֥ק מֵאָֽח
Proverbs 18:24 [KJV]  A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

Proverbs 19:1 [HEB]  טֽוֹב רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו וְה֣וּא כְסִֽיל
Proverbs 19:1 [KJV]  Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

Proverbs 19:2 [HEB]  גַּ֤ם בְּלֹא דַ֣עַת נֶ֣פֶשׁ לֹא ט֑וֹב וְאָ֖ץ בְּרַגְלַ֣יִם חוֹטֵֽא
Proverbs 19:2 [KJV]  Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

Proverbs 19:3 [HEB]  אִוֶּ֣לֶת אָ֭דָם תְּסַלֵּ֣ף דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְעַל יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִזְעַ֥ף לִבּֽוֹ
Proverbs 19:3 [KJV]  The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.

Proverbs 19:4 [HEB]  ה֗וֹן יֹ֭סִיף רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝דָ֗ל מֵרֵ֥עהוּ יִפָּרֵֽד
Proverbs 19:4 [KJV]  Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

Proverbs 19:5 [HEB]  עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִמָּלֵֽט
Proverbs 19:5 [KJV]  A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.

Proverbs 19:6 [HEB]  רַ֭בִּים יְחַלּ֣וּ פְנֵֽי נָדִ֑יב וְכָל הָ֝רֵ֗עַ לְאִ֣ישׁ מַתָּֽן
Proverbs 19:6 [KJV]  Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

Proverbs 19:7 [HEB]  כָּ֥ל אֲחֵי רָ֨שׁ שְֽׂנֵאֻ֗הוּ אַ֤ף כִּ֣י מְ֭רֵעֵהוּ רָחֲק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ מְרַדֵּ֖ף אֲמָרִ֣ים לא לוֹ הֵֽמָּה
Proverbs 19:7 [KJV]  All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.

Proverbs 19:8 [HEB]  קֹֽנֶה לֵּ֭ב אֹהֵ֣ב נַפְשׁ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֥ר תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה לִמְצֹא טֽוֹב
Proverbs 19:8 [KJV]  He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.

Proverbs 19:9 [HEB]  עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֖יחַ כְּזָבִ֣ים יֹאבֵֽד
Proverbs 19:9 [KJV]  A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.

Proverbs 19:10 [HEB]  לֹֽא נָאוֶ֣ה לִכְסִ֣יל תַּעֲנ֑וּג אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי לְעֶ֤בֶד מְשֹׁ֬ל בְּשָׂרִֽים
Proverbs 19:10 [KJV]  Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

Proverbs 19:11 [HEB]  שֵׂ֣כֶל אָ֭דָם הֶאֱרִ֣יךְ אַפּ֑וֹ וְ֝תִפאַרְתּ֗וֹ עֲבֹ֣ר עַל פָּֽשַׁע
Proverbs 19:11 [KJV]  The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

Proverbs 19:12 [HEB]  נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר זַ֣עַף מֶ֑לֶךְ וּכְטַ֖ל עַל עֵ֣שֶׂב רְצוֹנֽוֹ
Proverbs 19:12 [KJV]  The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

Proverbs 19:13 [HEB]  הַוֺּ֣ת לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וְדֶ֥לֶף טֹ֝רֵ֗ד מִדְיְנֵ֥י אִשָּֽׁה
Proverbs 19:13 [KJV]  A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

Proverbs 19:14 [HEB]  בַּ֣יִת וָ֭הוֹן נַחֲלַ֣ת אָב֑וֹת וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה אִשָּׁ֥ה מַשְׂכָּֽלֶת
Proverbs 19:14 [KJV]  House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.

Proverbs 19:15 [KJV]  Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

Proverbs 19:16 [HEB]  שֹׁמֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ בּוֹזֵ֖ה דְרָכָ֣יו יומת יָמֽוּת
Proverbs 19:16 [KJV]  He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.

Proverbs 19:17 [HEB]  מַלְוֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה ח֣וֹנֵֽן דָּ֑ל וּ֝גְמֻל֗וֹ יְשַׁלֶּם לֽוֹ
Proverbs 19:17 [KJV]  He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.

Proverbs 19:18 [HEB]  יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ כִּי יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְאֶל הֲ֝מִית֗וֹ אַל תִּשָּׂ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁךָ
Proverbs 19:18 [KJV]  Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.

Proverbs 19:19 [HEB]  גרל גְּֽדָל חֵ֭מָה נֹ֣שֵׂא עֹ֑נֶשׁ כִּ֥י אִם תַּ֝צִּ֗יל וְע֣וֹד תּוֹסִֽף
Proverbs 19:19 [KJV]  A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.

Proverbs 19:20 [HEB]  שְׁמַ֣ע עֵ֭צָה וְקַבֵּ֣ל מוּסָ֑ר לְ֝מַ֗עַן תֶּחְכַּ֥ם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ
Proverbs 19:20 [KJV]  Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

Proverbs 19:21 [HEB]  רַבּ֣וֹת מַחֲשָׁב֣וֹת בְּלֶב אִ֑ישׁ וַעֲצַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תָקֽוּם
Proverbs 19:21 [KJV]  There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.

Proverbs 19:22 [HEB]  תַּאֲוַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְטֽוֹב רָ֝שׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ כָּזָֽב
Proverbs 19:22 [KJV]  The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

Proverbs 19:23 [KJV]  The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

Proverbs 19:24 [KJV]  A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

Proverbs 19:25 [HEB]  לֵ֣ץ תַּ֭כֶּה וּפֶ֣תִי יַעְרִ֑ם וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ לְ֝נָב֗וֹן יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת
Proverbs 19:25 [KJV]  Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

Proverbs 19:26 [KJV]  He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

Proverbs 19:27 [HEB]  חַֽדַל בְּ֭נִי לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר לִ֝שְׁג֗וֹת מֵֽאִמְרֵי דָֽעַת
Proverbs 19:27 [KJV]  Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

Proverbs 19:29 [KJV]  Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.


--- Proverbs Chapter 20 ---
Proverbs 20:1 [HEB]  לֵ֣ץ הַ֭יַּין הֹמֶ֣ה שֵׁכָ֑ר וְכָל שֹׁ֥גֶה בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א יֶחְכָּֽם

Proverbs 20:8 [KJV]  A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

Proverbs 20:27 [KJV]  The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.

Proverbs 20:28 [KJV]  Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.

Proverbs 20:29 [HEB]  תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בַּחוּרִ֣ים כֹּחָ֑ם וַהֲדַ֖ר זְקֵנִ֣ים שֵׂיבָֽה
Proverbs 20:29 [KJV]  The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.

Proverbs 20:30 [HEB]  חַבֻּר֣וֹת פֶּ֭צַע תמריק תַּמְר֣וּק בְּרָ֑ע וּ֝מַכּ֗וֹת חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן
Proverbs 20:30 [KJV]  The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.


--- Proverbs Chapter 21 ---
Proverbs 21:1 [HEB]  פַּלְגֵי מַ֣יִם לֶב מֶ֭לֶךְ בְּיַד יְהוָ֑ה עַֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יַחְפֹּ֣ץ יַטֶּֽנּוּ
Proverbs 21:1 [KJV]  The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.

Proverbs 21:2 [HEB]  כָּֽל דֶּרֶךְ אִ֭ישׁ יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה
Proverbs 21:2 [KJV]  Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.

Proverbs 21:3 [HEB]  עֲ֭שֹׂה צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נִבְחָ֖ר לַיהוָ֣ה מִזָּֽבַח
Proverbs 21:3 [KJV]  To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

Proverbs 21:4 [HEB]  רוּם עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַב לֵ֑ב נִ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים חַטָּֽאת
Proverbs 21:4 [KJV]  An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.

Proverbs 21:5 [HEB]  מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת חָ֭רוּץ אַךְ לְמוֹתָ֑ר וְכָל אָ֝֗ץ אַךְ לְמַחְסֽוֹר
Proverbs 21:5 [KJV]  The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.

Proverbs 21:6 [HEB]  פֹּ֣עַל א֭וֹצָרוֹת בִּלְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר הֶ֥בֶל נִ֝דָּ֗ף מְבַקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
Proverbs 21:6 [KJV]  The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

Proverbs 21:7 [HEB]  שֹׁד רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְגוֹרֵ֑ם כִּ֥י מֵ֝אֲנ֗וּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט
Proverbs 21:7 [KJV]  The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.

Proverbs 21:8 [HEB]  הֲפַכְפַּ֬ךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ אִ֣ישׁ וָזָ֑ר וְ֝זַ֗ךְ יָשָׁ֥ר פָּעֳלֽוֹ
Proverbs 21:8 [KJV]  The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.

Proverbs 21:9 [HEB]  ט֗וֹב לָשֶׁ֥בֶת עַל פִּנַּת גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים וּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר
Proverbs 21:9 [KJV]  It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.

Proverbs 21:10 [HEB]  נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָ֭שָׁע אִוְּתָה רָ֑ע לֹא יֻחַ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֣יו רֵעֵֽהוּ
Proverbs 21:10 [KJV]  The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

Proverbs 21:11 [HEB]  בַּעְנָשׁ לֵ֭ץ יֶחְכַּם פֶּ֑תִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ֝חָכָ֗ם יִקַּח דָּֽעַת
Proverbs 21:11 [KJV]  When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

Proverbs 21:12 [HEB]  מַשְׂכִּ֣יל צַ֭דִּיק לְבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע מְסַלֵּ֖ף רְשָׁעִ֣ים לָרָֽע
Proverbs 21:12 [KJV]  The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.

Proverbs 21:13 [KJV]  Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

Proverbs 21:14 [HEB]  מַתָּ֣ן בַּ֭סֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה אָ֑ף וְשֹׁ֥חַד בַּ֝חֵ֗ק חֵמָ֥ה עַזָּֽה
Proverbs 21:14 [KJV]  A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

Proverbs 21:15 [HEB]  שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַ֭צַּדִּיק עֲשׂ֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
Proverbs 21:15 [KJV]  It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

Proverbs 21:16 [HEB]  אָדָ֗ם תּ֭וֹעֶה מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל בִּקְהַ֖ל רְפָאִ֣ים יָנֽוּחַ
Proverbs 21:16 [KJV]  The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.

Proverbs 21:17 [HEB]  אִ֣ישׁ מַ֭חְסוֹר אֹהֵ֣ב שִׂמְחָ֑ה אֹהֵ֥ב יַֽיִן וָ֝שֶׁ֗מֶן לֹ֣א יַעֲשִֽׁיר
Proverbs 21:17 [KJV]  He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

Proverbs 21:18 [HEB]  כֹּ֣פֶר לַצַּדִּ֣יק רָשָׁ֑ע וְתַ֖חַת יְשָׁרִ֣ים בּוֹגֵֽד
Proverbs 21:18 [KJV]  The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

Proverbs 21:19 [HEB]  ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת בְּאֶֽרֶץ מִדְבָּ֑ר מֵאֵ֖שֶׁת מדונים מִדְיָנִ֣ים וָכָֽעַס
Proverbs 21:19 [KJV]  It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.

Proverbs 21:20 [HEB]  אוֹצָ֤ר נֶחְמָ֣ד וָ֭שֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וּכְסִ֖יל אָדָ֣ם יְבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ
Proverbs 21:20 [KJV]  There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.

Proverbs 21:24 [KJV]  Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.

Proverbs 21:25 [HEB]  תַּאֲוַ֣ת עָצֵ֣ל תְּמִיתֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי מֵאֲנ֖וּ יָדָ֣יו לַעֲשֽׂוֹת
Proverbs 21:25 [KJV]  The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.

Proverbs 21:26 [KJV]  He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.

Proverbs 21:27 [HEB]  זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי בְזִמָּ֥ה יְבִיאֶֽנּוּ
Proverbs 21:27 [KJV]  The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?

Proverbs 21:28 [KJV]  A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.

Proverbs 21:29 [KJV]  A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.

Proverbs 21:30 [HEB]  אֵ֣ין חָ֭כְמָה וְאֵ֣ין תְּבוּנָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין עֵ֝צָ֗ה לְנֶ֣גֶד יְהוָֽה
Proverbs 21:30 [KJV]  There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

Proverbs 21:31 [HEB]  ס֗וּס מ֭וּכָן לְי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ֝לַֽיהוָ֗ה הַתְּשׁוּעָֽה
Proverbs 21:31 [KJV]  The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.


--- Proverbs Chapter 22 ---
Proverbs 22:1 [HEB]  נִבְחָ֣ר שֵׁ֭ם מֵעֹ֣שֶׁר רָ֑ב מִכֶּ֥סֶף וּ֝מִזָּהָ֗ב חֵ֣ן טֽוֹב

Proverbs 22:2 [KJV]  The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.

Proverbs 22:3 [KJV]  A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.

Proverbs 22:4 [KJV]  By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.

Proverbs 22:5 [KJV]  Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.

Proverbs 22:6 [KJV]  Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

Proverbs 22:7 [KJV]  The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

Proverbs 22:8 [HEB]  זוֹרֵ֣עַ עַ֭וְלָה יקצור יִקְצָר אָ֑וֶן וְשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָת֣וֹ יִכְלֶֽה
Proverbs 22:8 [KJV]  He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.

Proverbs 22:9 [HEB]  טֽוֹב עַ֭יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי נָתַ֖ן מִלַּחְמ֣וֹ לַדָּֽל
Proverbs 22:9 [KJV]  He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.

Proverbs 22:10 [HEB]  גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְיֵצֵ֣א מָד֑וֹן וְ֝יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת דִּ֣ין וְקָלֽוֹן
Proverbs 22:10 [KJV]  Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.

Proverbs 22:11 [KJV]  He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.

Proverbs 22:12 [HEB]  עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה נָ֣צְרוּ דָ֑עַת וַ֝יְסַלֵּ֗ף דִּבְרֵ֥י בֹגֵֽד
Proverbs 22:12 [KJV]  The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.

Proverbs 22:13 [HEB]  אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל אֲרִ֣י בַח֑וּץ בְּת֥וֹךְ רְ֝חֹב֗וֹת אֵֽרָצֵֽחַ
Proverbs 22:13 [KJV]  The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.

Proverbs 22:14 [HEB]  שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקָּה פִּ֣י זָר֑וֹת זְע֥וּם יְ֝הוָ֗ה יפול יִפָּל שָֽׁם
Proverbs 22:14 [KJV]  The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.

Proverbs 22:15 [HEB]  אִ֭וֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָ֣ה בְלֶב נָ֑עַר שֵׁ֥בֶט מ֝וּסָ֗ר יַרְחִיקֶ֥נָּה מִמֶּֽנּוּ
Proverbs 22:15 [KJV]  Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

Proverbs 22:16 [KJV]  He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.

Proverbs 22:17 [KJV]  Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.

Proverbs 22:18 [HEB]  כִּֽי נָ֭עִים כִּֽי תִשְׁמְרֵ֣ם בְּבִטְנֶ֑ךָ יִכֹּ֥נוּ יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו עַל שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ
Proverbs 22:18 [KJV]  For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.

Proverbs 22:19 [HEB]  לִהְי֣וֹת בַּ֭יהוָה מִבְטַחֶ֑ךָ הוֹדַעְתִּ֖יךָ הַיּ֣וֹם אַף אָֽתָּה
Proverbs 22:19 [KJV]  That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.

Proverbs 22:20 [HEB]  הֲלֹ֤א כָתַ֣בְתִּי לְ֭ךָ שלשום שָׁלִישִׁ֑ים בְּמ֖וֹעֵצֹ֣ת וָדָֽעַת
Proverbs 22:20 [KJV]  Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

Proverbs 22:21 [HEB]  לְהוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֗ קֹ֭שְׁטְ אִמְרֵ֣י אֱמֶ֑ת לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֲמָרִ֥ים אֱ֝מֶ֗ת לְשֹׁלְחֶֽיךָ
Proverbs 22:21 [KJV]  That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?

Proverbs 22:22 [KJV]  Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:

Proverbs 22:25 [KJV]  Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

Proverbs 22:27 [KJV]  If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

Proverbs 22:28 [KJV]  Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.

Proverbs 22:29 [KJV]  Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.

Proverbs 23:1 [HEB]  כִּֽי תֵ֭שֵׁב לִלְח֣וֹם אֶת מוֹשֵׁ֑ל בִּ֥ין תָּ֝בִ֗ין אֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְפָנֶֽיךָ
Proverbs 23:1 [KJV]  When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:

Proverbs 23:2 [KJV]  And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.

Proverbs 23:3 [HEB]  אַל תִּ֭תְאָו לְמַטְעַמּוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝ה֗וּא לֶ֣חֶם כְּזָבִֽים

Proverbs 23:4 [KJV]  Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.

Proverbs 23:9 [KJV]  Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

Proverbs 23:11 [KJV]  For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.

Proverbs 23:35 [KJV]  They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.


--- Proverbs Chapter 24 ---
Proverbs 24:1 [HEB]  אַל תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאַנְשֵׁ֣י רָעָ֑ה וְאַל תתאו תִּ֝תְאָ֗יו לִהְי֥וֹת אִתָּֽם

Proverbs 24:2 [KJV]  For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

Proverbs 24:4 [HEB]  וּ֭בְדַעַת חֲדָרִ֣ים יִמָּלְא֑וּ כָּל ה֖וֹן יָקָ֣ר וְנָעִֽים
Proverbs 24:4 [KJV]  And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

Proverbs 24:5 [HEB]  גֶּֽבֶר חָכָ֥ם בַּע֑וֹז וְאִֽישׁ דַּ֝֗עַת מְאַמֶּץ כֹּֽחַ

Proverbs 24:6 [HEB]  כִּ֣י בְ֭תַחְבֻּלוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְּךָ֣ מִלְחָמָ֑ה וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ
Proverbs 24:6 [KJV]  For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.

Proverbs 24:7 [KJV]  Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

Proverbs 24:8 [KJV]  He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

Proverbs 24:9 [HEB]  זִמַּ֣ת אִוֶּ֣לֶת חַטָּ֑את וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת לְאָדָ֣ם לֵֽץ
Proverbs 24:9 [KJV]  The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.

Proverbs 24:10 [HEB]  הִ֭תְרַפִּיתָ בְּי֥וֹם צָרָ֗ה צַ֣ר כֹּחֶֽכָה
Proverbs 24:10 [KJV]  If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.

Proverbs 24:11 [HEB]  הַ֭צֵּל לְקֻחִ֣ים לַמָּ֑וֶת וּמָטִ֥ים לַ֝הֶ֗רֶג אִם תַּחְשֽׂוֹךְ
Proverbs 24:11 [KJV]  If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;

Proverbs 24:12 [HEB]  כִּֽי תֹאמַ֗ר הֵן֮ לֹא יָדַ֪עְנ֫וּ זֶ֥ה הֲֽלֹא תֹ֘כֵ֤ן לִבּ֨וֹת הֽוּא יָבִ֗ין וְנֹצֵ֣ר נַ֭פְשְׁךָ ה֣וּא יֵדָ֑ע וְהֵשִׁ֖יב לְאָדָ֣ם כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ
Proverbs 24:12 [KJV]  If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?

Proverbs 24:21 [HEB]  יְרָֽא אֶת יְהוָ֣ה בְּנִ֣י וָמֶ֑לֶךְ עִם שׁ֝וֹנִ֗ים אַל תִּתְעָרָֽב

Proverbs 25:16 [KJV]  Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.

Proverbs 25:20 [HEB]  מַ֥עֲדֶה בֶּ֨גֶד בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָה חֹ֣מֶץ עַל נָ֑תֶר וְשָׁ֥ר בַּ֝שִּׁרִ֗ים עַ֣ל לֶב רָֽע

Proverbs 25:26 [HEB]  מַעְיָ֣ן נִ֭רְפָּשׂ וּמָק֣וֹר מָשְׁחָ֑ת צַ֝דִּ֗יק מָ֣ט לִפְנֵֽי רָשָֽׁע
Proverbs 25:26 [KJV]  A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.

Proverbs 25:27 [KJV]  It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.

Proverbs 25:28 [HEB]  עִ֣יר פְּ֭רוּצָה אֵ֣ין חוֹמָ֑ה אִ֝֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֖ין מַעְצָ֣ר לְרוּחֽוֹ
Proverbs 25:28 [KJV]  He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.


--- Proverbs Chapter 26 ---
Proverbs 26:1 [HEB]  כַּשֶּׁ֤לֶג בַּקַּ֗יִץ וְכַמָּטָ֥ר בַּקָּצִ֑יר כֵּ֤ן לֹא נָאוֶ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל כָּבֽוֹד
Proverbs 26:1 [KJV]  As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.

Proverbs 26:2 [HEB]  כַּצִּפּ֣וֹר לָ֭נוּד כַּדְּר֣וֹר לָע֑וּף כֵּ֥ן קִֽלְלַ֥ת חִ֝נָּ֗ם לא ל֣וֹ תָבֹֽא
Proverbs 26:2 [KJV]  As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.

Proverbs 26:3 [HEB]  שׁ֣וֹט לַ֭סּוּס מֶ֣תֶג לַחֲמ֑וֹר וְ֝שֵׁ֗בֶט לְגֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים
Proverbs 26:3 [KJV]  A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.

Proverbs 26:4 [HEB]  אַל תַּ֣עַן כְּ֭סִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּ֑וֹ פֶּֽן תִּשְׁוֶה לּ֥וֹ גַם אָֽתָּה
Proverbs 26:4 [KJV]  Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.

Proverbs 26:5 [HEB]  עֲנֵ֣ה כְ֭סִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּ֑וֹ פֶּן יִהְיֶ֖ה חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו
Proverbs 26:5 [KJV]  Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.

Proverbs 26:6 [HEB]  מְקַצֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַיִם חָמָ֣ס שֹׁתֶ֑ה שֹׁלֵ֖חַ דְּבָרִ֣ים בְּיַד כְּסִֽיל
Proverbs 26:6 [KJV]  He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.

Proverbs 26:7 [HEB]  דַּלְי֣וּ שֹׁ֭קַיִם מִפִּסֵּ֑חַ וּ֝מָשָׁ֗ל בְּפִ֣י כְסִילִֽים
Proverbs 26:7 [KJV]  The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

Proverbs 26:8 [HEB]  כִּצְר֣וֹר אֶ֭בֶן בְּמַרְגֵּמָ֑ה כֵּן נוֹתֵ֖ן לִכְסִ֣יל כָּבֽוֹד
Proverbs 26:8 [KJV]  As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.

Proverbs 26:9 [HEB]  ח֭וֹחַ עָלָ֣ה בְיַד שִׁכּ֑וֹר וּ֝מָשָׁ֗ל בְּפִ֣י כְסִילִֽים
Proverbs 26:9 [KJV]  As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

Proverbs 26:10 [HEB]  רַ֥ב מְחֽוֹלֵֽל כֹּ֑ל וְשֹׂכֵ֥ר כְּ֝סִ֗יל וְשֹׂכֵ֥ר עֹבְרִֽים
Proverbs 26:10 [KJV]  The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.

Proverbs 26:11 [HEB]  כְּ֭כֶלֶב שָׁ֣ב עַל קֵא֑וֹ כְּ֝סִ֗יל שׁוֹנֶ֥ה בְאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ
Proverbs 26:11 [KJV]  As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.

Proverbs 26:12 [HEB]  רָאִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ
Proverbs 26:12 [KJV]  Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

Proverbs 26:13 [HEB]  אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל שַׁ֣חַל בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ אֲ֝רִ֗י בֵּ֣ין הָרְחֹבֽוֹת
Proverbs 26:13 [KJV]  The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.

Proverbs 26:14 [HEB]  הַ֭דֶּלֶת תִּסּ֣וֹב עַל צִירָ֑הּ וְ֝עָצֵ֗ל עַל מִטָּתֽוֹ
Proverbs 26:14 [KJV]  As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.

Proverbs 26:15 [HEB]  טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת נִ֝לְאָ֗ה לַֽהֲשִׁיבָ֥הּ אֶל פִּֽיו
Proverbs 26:15 [KJV]  The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.

Proverbs 26:16 [HEB]  חָכָ֣ם עָצֵ֣ל בְּעֵינָ֑יו מִ֝שִּׁבְעָ֗ה מְשִׁ֣יבֵי טָֽעַם
Proverbs 26:16 [KJV]  The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.

Proverbs 26:17 [HEB]  מַחֲזִ֥יק בְּאָזְנֵי כָ֑לֶב עֹבֵ֥ר מִ֝תְעַבֵּ֗ר עַל רִ֥יב לֹּֽא לֽוֹ
Proverbs 26:17 [KJV]  He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.

Proverbs 26:18 [HEB]  כְּֽ֭מִתְלַהְלֵהַּ הַיֹּרֶ֥ה זִקִּ֗ים חִצִּ֥ים וָמָֽוֶת
Proverbs 26:18 [KJV]  As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,

Proverbs 26:19 [HEB]  כֵּֽן אִ֭ישׁ רִמָּ֣ה אֶת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אָמַ֗ר הֲֽלֹא מְשַׂחֵ֥ק אָֽנִי
Proverbs 26:19 [KJV]  So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?

Proverbs 26:20 [HEB]  בְּאֶ֣פֶס עֵ֭צִים תִּכְבֶּה אֵ֑שׁ וּבְאֵ֥ין נִ֝רְגָּ֗ן יִשְׁתֹּ֥ק מָדֽוֹן
Proverbs 26:20 [KJV]  Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.

Proverbs 26:21 [HEB]  פֶּחָ֣ם לְ֭גֶחָלִים וְעֵצִ֣ים לְאֵ֑שׁ וְאִ֥ישׁ מדונים מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים לְחַרְחַר רִֽיב
Proverbs 26:21 [KJV]  As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.

Proverbs 26:22 [HEB]  דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן
Proverbs 26:22 [KJV]  The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

Proverbs 26:23 [HEB]  כֶּ֣סֶף סִ֭יגִים מְצֻפֶּ֣ה עַל חָ֑רֶשׂ שְׂפָתַ֖יִם דֹּלְקִ֣ים וְלֶב רָֽע
Proverbs 26:23 [KJV]  Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.

Proverbs 26:24 [HEB]  בשפתו בִּ֭שְׂפָתָיו יִנָּכֵ֣ר שׂוֹנֵ֑א וּ֝בְקִרְבּ֗וֹ יָשִׁ֥ית מִרְמָֽה
Proverbs 26:24 [KJV]  He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;

Proverbs 26:25 [HEB]  כִּֽי יְחַנֵּ֣ן ק֭וֹלוֹ אַל תַּֽאֲמֶן בּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י שֶׁ֖בַע תּוֹעֵב֣וֹת בְּלִבּֽוֹ
Proverbs 26:25 [KJV]  When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.

Proverbs 26:26 [HEB]  תִּכַּסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה בְּמַשָּׁא֑וֹן תִּגָּלֶ֖ה רָעָת֣וֹ בְקָהָֽל
Proverbs 26:26 [KJV]  Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.

Proverbs 26:27 [HEB]  כֹּֽרֶה שַּׁ֭חַת בָּ֣הּ יִפֹּ֑ל וְגֹ֥לֵ֥ל אֶ֝בֶן אֵלָ֥יו תָּשֽׁוּב
Proverbs 26:27 [KJV]  Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.

Proverbs 26:28 [HEB]  לְֽשׁוֹן שֶׁ֭קֶר יִשְׂנָ֣א דַכָּ֑יו וּפֶ֥ה חָ֝לָ֗ק יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה מִדְחֶֽה
Proverbs 26:28 [KJV]  A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.


--- Proverbs Chapter 27 ---
Proverbs 27:1 [HEB]  אַֽל תִּ֭תְהַלֵּל בְּי֣וֹם מָחָ֑ר כִּ֤י לֹא תֵ֝דַ֗ע מַה יֵּ֥לֶד יֽוֹם
Proverbs 27:1 [KJV]  Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.

Proverbs 27:2 [HEB]  יְהַלֶּלְךָ֣ זָ֣ר וְלֹא פִ֑יךָ נָ֝כְרִ֗י וְאַל שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ
Proverbs 27:2 [KJV]  Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.

Proverbs 27:3 [HEB]  כֹּֽבֶד אֶ֭בֶן וְנֵ֣טֶל הַח֑וֹל וְכַ֥עַס אֱ֝וִ֗יל כָּבֵ֥ד מִשְּׁנֵיהֶֽם
Proverbs 27:3 [KJV]  A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.

Proverbs 27:4 [HEB]  אַכְזְרִיּ֣וּת חֵ֭מָה וְשֶׁ֣טֶף אָ֑ף וּמִ֥י יַ֝עֲמֹד לִפְנֵ֥י קִנְאָֽה
Proverbs 27:4 [KJV]  Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?

Proverbs 27:5 [HEB]  ט֭וֹבָה תּוֹכַ֣חַת מְגֻלָּ֑ה מֵֽאַהֲבָ֥ה מְסֻתָּֽרֶת
Proverbs 27:5 [KJV]  Open rebuke is better than secret love.

Proverbs 27:6 [HEB]  נֶ֭אֱמָנִים פִּצְעֵ֣י אוֹהֵ֑ב וְ֝נַעְתָּר֗וֹת נְשִׁיק֥וֹת שׂוֹנֵֽא
Proverbs 27:6 [KJV]  Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.

Proverbs 27:7 [HEB]  נֶ֣פֶשׁ שְׂ֭בֵעָה תָּב֣וּס נֹ֑פֶת וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָ֗ה כָּל מַ֥ר מָתֽוֹק
Proverbs 27:7 [KJV]  The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.

Proverbs 27:8 [HEB]  כְּ֭צִפּוֹר נוֹדֶ֣דֶת מִן קִנָּ֑הּ כֵּֽן אִ֝֗ישׁ נוֹדֵ֥ד מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ
Proverbs 27:8 [KJV]  As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.

Proverbs 27:9 [HEB]  שֶׁ֣מֶן וּ֭קְטֹרֶת יְשַׂמַּֽח לֵ֑ב וּמֶ֥תֶק רֵ֝עֵ֗הוּ מֵֽעֲצַת נָֽפֶשׁ
Proverbs 27:9 [KJV]  Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.

Proverbs 27:10 [HEB]  רֵֽעֲךָ֨ ורעה וְרֵ֪עַ אָבִ֡יךָ אַֽל תַּעֲזֹ֗ב וּבֵ֥ית אָחִ֗יךָ אַל תָּ֭בוֹא בְּי֣וֹם אֵידֶ֑ךָ ט֥וֹב שָׁכֵ֥ן קָ֝ר֗וֹב מֵאָ֥ח רָחֽוֹק
Proverbs 27:10 [KJV]  Thine own friend, and thy father’s friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.

Proverbs 27:11 [HEB]  חֲכַ֣ם בְּ֭נִי וְשַׂמַּ֣ח לִבִּ֑י וְאָשִׁ֖יבָה חֹרְפִ֣י דָבָֽר
Proverbs 27:11 [KJV]  My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.

Proverbs 27:12 [HEB]  עָר֤וּם רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה נִסְתָּ֑ר פְּ֝תָאיִ֗ם עָבְר֥וּ נֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ
Proverbs 27:12 [KJV]  A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.

Proverbs 27:13 [HEB]  קַח בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּבְעַ֖ד נָכְרִיָּ֣ה חַבְלֵֽהוּ
Proverbs 27:13 [KJV]  Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

Proverbs 27:14 [HEB]  מְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ רֵעֵ֨הוּ בְּק֣וֹל גָּ֭דוֹל בַּבֹּ֣קֶר הַשְׁכֵּ֑ים קְ֝לָלָ֗ה תֵּחָ֥שֶׁב לֽוֹ
Proverbs 27:14 [KJV]  He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.

Proverbs 27:15 [HEB]  דֶּ֣לֶף ט֭וֹרֵד בְּי֣וֹם סַגְרִ֑יר וְאֵ֥שֶׁת מדונים מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים נִשְׁתָּוָֽה
Proverbs 27:15 [KJV]  A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.

Proverbs 27:16 [HEB]  צֹפְנֶ֥יהָ צָֽפַן ר֑וּחַ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן יְמִינ֣וֹ יִקְרָֽא
Proverbs 27:16 [KJV]  Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.

Proverbs 27:17 [HEB]  בַּרְזֶ֣ל בְּבַרְזֶ֣ל יָ֑חַד וְ֝אִ֗ישׁ יַ֣חַד פְּנֵֽי רֵעֵֽהוּ
Proverbs 27:17 [KJV]  Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

Proverbs 27:18 [HEB]  נֹצֵ֣ר תְּ֭אֵנָה יֹאכַ֣ל פִּרְיָ֑הּ וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣יו יְכֻבָּֽד
Proverbs 27:18 [KJV]  Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.

Proverbs 27:19 [HEB]  כַּ֭מַּיִם הַפָּנִ֣ים לַפָּנִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן לֵֽב הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לָאָדָֽם
Proverbs 27:19 [KJV]  As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.

Proverbs 27:20 [HEB]  שְׁא֣וֹל ואבדה וַ֭אֲבַדּוֹ לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה וְעֵינֵ֥י הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּֽעְנָה
Proverbs 27:20 [KJV]  Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.

Proverbs 27:21 [HEB]  מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וְ֝אִ֗ישׁ לְפִ֣י מַהֲלָלֽוֹ
Proverbs 27:21 [KJV]  As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.

Proverbs 27:22 [HEB]  אִ֥ם תִּכְתּֽוֹשׁ אֶת הָאֱוִ֨יל בַּֽמַּכְתֵּ֡שׁ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָ֭רִיפוֹת בַּֽעֱלִ֑י לֹא תָס֥וּר מֵ֝עָלָ֗יו אִוַּלְתּֽוֹ
Proverbs 27:22 [KJV]  Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.

Proverbs 27:23 [HEB]  יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּ֭דַע פְּנֵ֣י צֹאנֶ֑ךָ שִׁ֥ית לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַעֲדָרִֽים
Proverbs 27:23 [KJV]  Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.

Proverbs 27:24 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לְעוֹלָ֣ם חֹ֑סֶן וְאִם נֵ֝֗זֶר לְד֣וֹר דור וָדֽוֹר
Proverbs 27:24 [KJV]  For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?

Proverbs 27:25 [HEB]  גָּלָ֣ה חָ֭צִיר וְנִרְאָה דֶ֑שֶׁא וְ֝נֶאֶסְפ֗וּ עִשְּׂב֥וֹת הָרִֽים
Proverbs 27:25 [KJV]  The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.

Proverbs 27:26 [HEB]  כְּבָשִׂ֥ים לִלְבוּשֶׁ֑ךָ וּמְחִ֥יר שָׂ֝דֶ֗ה עַתּוּדִֽים
Proverbs 27:26 [KJV]  The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.

Proverbs 27:27 [HEB]  וְדֵ֤י חֲלֵ֬ב עִזִּ֗ים לְֽ֭לַחְמְךָ לְלֶ֣חֶם בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְ֝חַיִּ֗ים לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ
Proverbs 27:27 [KJV]  And thou shalt have goats’ milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
