Proverbs 28:1 [HEB]  נָ֣סוּ וְאֵין רֹדֵ֣ף רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים כִּכְפִ֥יר יִבְטָֽח
Proverbs 28:1 [KJV]  The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.

Proverbs 28:2 [HEB]  בְּפֶ֣שַֽׁע אֶ֭רֶץ רַבִּ֣ים שָׂרֶ֑יהָ וּבְאָדָ֥ם מֵבִ֥ין יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ כֵּ֣ן יַאֲרִֽיךְ
Proverbs 28:2 [KJV]  For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.

Proverbs 28:3 [HEB]  גֶּ֣בֶר רָ֭שׁ וְעֹשֵׁ֣ק דַּלִּ֑ים מָטָ֥ר סֹ֝חֵ֗ף וְאֵ֣ין לָֽחֶם
Proverbs 28:3 [KJV]  A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

Proverbs 28:4 [HEB]  עֹזְבֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָה יְהַֽלְל֣וּ רָשָׁ֑ע וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י ת֝וֹרָ֗ה יִתְגָּ֥רוּ בָֽם
Proverbs 28:4 [KJV]  They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.

Proverbs 28:5 [HEB]  אַנְשֵׁי רָ֭ע לֹא יָבִ֣ינוּ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּמְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יָבִ֥ינוּ כֹֽל
Proverbs 28:5 [KJV]  Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.

Proverbs 28:6 [HEB]  טֽוֹב רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם וְה֣וּא עָשִֽׁיר
Proverbs 28:6 [KJV]  Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.

Proverbs 28:7 [HEB]  נוֹצֵ֣ר תּ֭וֹרָה בֵּ֣ן מֵבִ֑ין וְרֹעֶה זֽ֝וֹלְלִ֗ים יַכְלִ֥ים אָבִֽיו
Proverbs 28:7 [KJV]  Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.

Proverbs 28:8 [HEB]  מַרְבֶּ֣ה ה֭וֹנוֹ בְּנֶ֣שֶׁךְ ובתרבית וְתַרְבִּ֑ית לְחוֹנֵ֖ן דַּלִּ֣ים יִקְבְּצֶֽנּוּ
Proverbs 28:8 [KJV]  He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.

Proverbs 28:9 [HEB]  מֵסִ֣יר אָ֭זְנוֹ מִשְּׁמֹ֣עַ תּוֹרָ֑ה גַּֽם תְּ֝פִלָּת֗וֹ תּוֹעֵבָֽה
Proverbs 28:9 [KJV]  He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.

Proverbs 28:10 [HEB]  מַשְׁגֶּ֤ה יְשָׁרִ֨ים בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ רָ֗ע בִּשְׁחוּת֥וֹ הֽוּא יִפּ֑וֹל וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִנְחֲלוּ טֽוֹב
Proverbs 28:10 [KJV]  Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.

Proverbs 28:11 [HEB]  חָכָ֣ם בְּ֭עֵינָיו אִ֣ישׁ עָשִׁ֑יר וְדַ֖ל מֵבִ֣ין יַחְקְרֶֽנּוּ
Proverbs 28:11 [KJV]  The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.

Proverbs 28:12 [HEB]  בַּעֲלֹ֣ץ צַ֭דִּיקִים רַבָּ֣ה תִפְאָ֑רֶת וּבְק֥וּם רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְחֻפַּ֥שׂ אָדָֽם
Proverbs 28:12 [KJV]  When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.

Proverbs 28:13 [HEB]  מְכַסֶּ֣ה פְ֭שָׁעָיו לֹ֣א יַצְלִ֑יחַ וּמוֹדֶ֖ה וְעֹזֵ֣ב יְרֻחָֽם
Proverbs 28:13 [KJV]  He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.

Proverbs 28:14 [HEB]  אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מְפַחֵ֣ד תָּמִ֑יד וּמַקְשֶׁ֥ה לִ֝בּ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה
Proverbs 28:14 [KJV]  Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

Proverbs 28:15 [HEB]  אֲרִי נֹ֭הֵם וְדֹ֣ב שׁוֹקֵ֑ק מֹשֵׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע עַ֣ל עַם דָּֽל
Proverbs 28:15 [KJV]  As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.

Proverbs 28:16 [HEB]  נָגִ֗יד חֲסַ֣ר תְּ֭בוּנוֹת וְרַ֥ב מַעֲשַׁקּ֑וֹת שנאי שֹׂ֥נֵא בֶ֝֗צַע יַאֲרִ֥יךְ יָמִֽים
Proverbs 28:16 [KJV]  The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.

Proverbs 28:17 [HEB]  אָ֭דָם עָשֻׁ֣ק בְּדַם נָפֶשׁ עַד בּ֥וֹר יָ֝נ֗וּס אַל יִתְמְכוּ בֽוֹ
Proverbs 28:17 [KJV]  A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.

Proverbs 28:18 [HEB]  הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים יִוָּשֵׁ֑עַ וְנֶעְקַ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם יִפּ֥וֹל בְּאֶחָֽת
Proverbs 28:18 [KJV]  Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.

Proverbs 28:19 [HEB]  עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֥ף רֵ֝קִ֗ים יִֽשְׂבַּֽע רִֽישׁ
Proverbs 28:19 [KJV]  He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

Proverbs 28:20 [HEB]  אִ֣ישׁ אֱ֭מוּנוֹת רַב בְּרָכ֑וֹת וְאָ֥ץ לְ֝הַעֲשִׁ֗יר לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה
Proverbs 28:20 [KJV]  A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

Proverbs 28:21 [HEB]  הַֽכֵּר פָּנִ֥ים לֹא ט֑וֹב וְעַל פַּת לֶ֝֗חֶם יִפְשַׁע גָּֽבֶר
Proverbs 28:21 [KJV]  To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.

Proverbs 28:22 [HEB]  נִֽבֳהָ֥ל לַה֗וֹן אִ֭ישׁ רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְלֹֽא יֵ֝דַע כִּי חֶ֥סֶר יְבֹאֶֽנּוּ
Proverbs 28:22 [KJV]  He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.

Proverbs 28:23 [KJV]  He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.

Proverbs 28:24 [HEB]  גּוֹזֵ֤ל אָ֘בִ֤יו וְאִמּ֗וֹ וְאֹמֵ֥ר אֵֽין פָּ֑שַׁע חָבֵ֥ר ה֝֗וּא לְאִ֣ישׁ מַשְׁחִֽית

Proverbs 28:25 [HEB]  רְחַב נֶ֭פֶשׁ יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ עַל יְהוָ֣ה יְדֻשָּֽׁן
Proverbs 28:25 [KJV]  He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.

Proverbs 28:26 [HEB]  בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭לִבּוֹ ה֣וּא כְסִ֑יל וְהוֹלֵ֥ךְ בְּ֝חָכְמָ֗ה ה֣וּא יִמָּלֵֽט
Proverbs 28:26 [KJV]  He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

Proverbs 28:27 [HEB]  נוֹתֵ֣ן לָ֭רָשׁ אֵ֣ין מַחְס֑וֹר וּמַעְלִ֥ים עֵ֝ינָ֗יו רַב מְאֵרֽוֹת
Proverbs 28:27 [KJV]  He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.

Proverbs 28:28 [KJV]  When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.


--- Proverbs Chapter 29 ---
Proverbs 29:1 [HEB]  אִ֣ישׁ תּ֭וֹכָחוֹת מַקְשֶׁה עֹ֑רֶף פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא
Proverbs 29:1 [KJV]  He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

Proverbs 29:4 [KJV]  The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.

Proverbs 29:5 [KJV]  A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.

Proverbs 29:6 [HEB]  בְּפֶ֤שַֽׁע אִ֣ישׁ רָ֣ע מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יָר֥וּן וְשָׂמֵֽחַ
Proverbs 29:6 [KJV]  In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

Proverbs 29:7 [HEB]  יֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק דִּ֣ין דַּלִּ֑ים רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לֹא יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת
Proverbs 29:7 [KJV]  The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.

Proverbs 29:8 [KJV]  Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.

Proverbs 29:9 [HEB]  אִֽישׁ חָכָ֗ם נִ֭שְׁפָּט אֶת אִ֣ישׁ אֱוִ֑יל וְרָגַ֥ז וְ֝שָׂחַ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין נָֽחַת
Proverbs 29:9 [KJV]  If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.

Proverbs 29:10 [HEB]  אַנְשֵׁ֣י דָ֭מִים יִשְׂנְאוּ תָ֑ם וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ
Proverbs 29:10 [KJV]  The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.

Proverbs 29:11 [HEB]  כָּל ר֭וּחוֹ יוֹצִ֣יא כְסִ֑יל וְ֝חָכָ֗ם בְּאָח֥וֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶֽנָּה
Proverbs 29:11 [KJV]  A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.

Proverbs 29:14 [KJV]  The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.

Proverbs 29:18 [KJV]  Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.

Proverbs 29:19 [HEB]  בִּ֭דְבָרִים לֹא יִוָּ֣סֶר עָ֑בֶד כִּֽי יָ֝בִ֗ין וְאֵ֣ין מַעֲנֶֽה
Proverbs 29:19 [KJV]  A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.

Proverbs 29:20 [HEB]  חָזִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ אָ֣ץ בִּדְבָרָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ
Proverbs 29:20 [KJV]  Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

Proverbs 29:21 [HEB]  מְפַנֵּ֣ק מִנֹּ֣עַר עַבְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝אַחֲרִית֗וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנֽוֹן
Proverbs 29:21 [KJV]  He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.

Proverbs 29:22 [HEB]  אִֽישׁ אַ֭ף יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבַ֖עַל חֵמָ֣ה רַב פָּֽשַׁע
Proverbs 29:22 [KJV]  An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.

Proverbs 29:23 [KJV]  A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.

Proverbs 29:24 [HEB]  חוֹלֵ֣ק עִם גַּ֭נָּב שׂוֹנֵ֣א נַפְשׁ֑וֹ אָלָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יַגִּֽיד
Proverbs 29:24 [KJV]  Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.

Proverbs 29:25 [HEB]  חֶרְדַּ֣ת אָ֭דָם יִתֵּ֣ן מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה יְשֻׂגָּֽב
Proverbs 29:25 [KJV]  The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.

Proverbs 31:17 [HEB]  חָֽגְרָ֣ה בְע֣וֹז מָתְנֶ֑יהָ וַ֝תְּאַמֵּ֗ץ זְרֹעוֹתֶֽיהָ
Proverbs 31:17 [KJV]  She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

Proverbs 31:18 [HEB]  טָ֭עֲמָה כִּי ט֣וֹב סַחְרָ֑הּ לֹֽא יִכְבֶּ֖ה בליל בַלַּ֣יְלָה נֵרָֽהּ
Proverbs 31:18 [KJV]  She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.

Proverbs 31:19 [HEB]  יָ֭דֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָ֣ה בַכִּישׁ֑וֹר וְ֝כַפֶּ֗יהָ תָּ֣מְכוּ פָֽלֶךְ
Proverbs 31:19 [KJV]  She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.

Proverbs 31:20 [HEB]  כַּ֭פָּהּ פָּרְשָׂ֣ה לֶעָנִ֑י וְ֝יָדֶ֗יהָ שִׁלְּחָ֥ה לָֽאֶבְיֽוֹן
Proverbs 31:20 [KJV]  She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

Proverbs 31:21 [HEB]  לֹא תִירָ֣א לְבֵיתָ֣הּ מִשָּׁ֑לֶג כִּ֥י כָל בֵּ֝יתָ֗הּ לָבֻ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים
Proverbs 31:21 [KJV]  She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

Proverbs 31:22 [HEB]  מַרְבַדִּ֥ים עָֽשְׂתָה לָּ֑הּ שֵׁ֖שׁ וְאַרְגָּמָ֣ן לְבוּשָֽׁהּ
Proverbs 31:22 [KJV]  She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.

Proverbs 31:23 [HEB]  נוֹדָ֣ע בַּשְּׁעָרִ֣ים בַּעְלָ֑הּ בְּ֝שִׁבְתּ֗וֹ עִם זִקְנֵי אָֽרֶץ
Proverbs 31:23 [KJV]  Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.

Proverbs 31:24 [HEB]  סָדִ֣ין עָ֭שְׂתָה וַתִּמְכֹּ֑ר וַ֝חֲג֗וֹר נָתְנָ֥ה לַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי
Proverbs 31:24 [KJV]  She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

Proverbs 31:25 [HEB]  עֹז וְהָדָ֥ר לְבוּשָׁ֑הּ וַ֝תִּשְׂחַ֗ק לְי֣וֹם אַחֲרֽוֹן
Proverbs 31:25 [KJV]  Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

Proverbs 31:26 [HEB]  פִּ֭יהָ פָּתְחָ֣ה בְחָכְמָ֑ה וְתֽוֹרַת חֶ֝֗סֶד עַל לְשׁוֹנָֽהּ
Proverbs 31:26 [KJV]  She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.

Proverbs 31:27 [HEB]  צ֭וֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכ֣וֹת בֵּיתָ֑הּ וְלֶ֥חֶם עַ֝צְל֗וּת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵֽל
Proverbs 31:27 [KJV]  She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

Proverbs 31:28 [HEB]  קָ֣מוּ בָ֭נֶיהָ וַֽיְאַשְּׁר֑וּהָ בַּ֝עְלָ֗הּ וַֽיְהַֽלְלָהּ
Proverbs 31:28 [KJV]  Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.

Proverbs 31:29 [HEB]  רַבּ֣וֹת בָּ֭נוֹת עָ֣שׂוּ חָ֑יִל וְ֝אַ֗תְּ עָלִ֥ית עַל כֻּלָּֽנָה
Proverbs 31:29 [KJV]  Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.

Proverbs 31:30 [HEB]  שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭חֵן וְהֶ֣בֶל הַיֹּ֑פִי אִשָּׁ֥ה יִרְאַת יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תִתְהַלָּֽל
Proverbs 31:30 [KJV]  Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.

Proverbs 31:31 [HEB]  תְּנוּ לָ֭הּ מִפְּרִ֣י יָדֶ֑יהָ וִֽיהַלְל֖וּהָ בַשְּׁעָרִ֣ים מַעֲשֶֽׂיהָ
Proverbs 31:31 [KJV]  Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.


############################################################
  ECCLESIASTES
############################################################

--- Ecclesiastes Chapter 1 ---
Ecclesiastes 1:1 [HEB]  דִּבְרֵי֙ קֹהֶ֣לֶת בֶּן דָּוִ֔ד מֶ֖לֶךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם
Ecclesiastes 1:1 [KJV]  The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

Ecclesiastes 1:2 [HEB]  הֲבֵ֤ל הֲבָלִים֙ אָמַ֣ר קֹהֶ֔לֶת הֲבֵ֥ל הֲבָלִ֖ים הַכֹּ֥ל הָֽבֶל
Ecclesiastes 1:2 [KJV]  Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.

Ecclesiastes 1:3 [HEB]  מַה יִּתְר֖וֹן לָֽאָדָ֑ם בְּכָל עֲמָל֔וֹ שֶֽׁיַּעֲמֹ֖ל תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ
Ecclesiastes 1:3 [KJV]  What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?

Ecclesiastes 1:4 [HEB]  דּ֤וֹר הֹלֵךְ֙ וְד֣וֹר בָּ֔א וְהָאָ֖רֶץ לְעוֹלָ֥ם עֹמָֽדֶת
Ecclesiastes 1:4 [KJV]  One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.

Ecclesiastes 1:5 [HEB]  וְזָרַ֥ח הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וּבָ֣א הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְאֶ֨ל מְקוֹמ֔וֹ שׁוֹאֵ֛ף זוֹרֵ֥חַֽ ה֖וּא שָֽׁם
Ecclesiastes 1:5 [KJV]  The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.

Ecclesiastes 1:6 [HEB]  הוֹלֵךְ֙ אֶל דָּר֔וֹם וְסוֹבֵ֖ב אֶל צָפ֑וֹן סוֹבֵ֤ב סֹבֵב֙ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ הָר֔וּחַ וְעַל סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו שָׁ֥ב הָרֽוּחַ
Ecclesiastes 1:6 [KJV]  The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.

Ecclesiastes 1:7 [HEB]  כָּל הַנְּחָלִים֙ הֹלְכִ֣ים אֶל הַיָּ֔ם וְהַיָּ֖ם אֵינֶ֣נּוּ מָלֵ֑א אֶל מְק֗וֹם שֶׁ֤הַנְּחָלִים֙ הֹֽלְכִ֔ים שָׁ֛ם הֵ֥ם שָׁבִ֖ים לָלָֽכֶת
Ecclesiastes 1:7 [KJV]  All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.

Ecclesiastes 1:8 [HEB]  כָּל הַדְּבָרִ֣ים יְגֵעִ֔ים לֹא יוּכַ֥ל אִ֖ישׁ לְדַבֵּ֑ר לֹא תִשְׂבַּ֥ע עַ֨יִן֙ לִרְא֔וֹת וְלֹא תִמָּלֵ֥א אֹ֖זֶן מִשְּׁמֹֽעַ
Ecclesiastes 1:8 [KJV]  All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

Ecclesiastes 1:9 [HEB]  מַה שֶּֽׁהָיָה֙ ה֣וּא שֶׁיִּהְיֶ֔ה וּמַה שֶׁנַּֽעֲשָׂ֔ה ה֖וּא שֶׁיֵּעָשֶׂ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין כָּל חָדָ֖שׁ תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ
Ecclesiastes 1:9 [KJV]  The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.

Ecclesiastes 1:10 [HEB]  יֵ֥שׁ דָּבָ֛ר שֶׁיֹּאמַ֥ר רְאֵה זֶ֖ה חָדָ֣שׁ ה֑וּא כְּבָר֙ הָיָ֣ה לְעֹֽלָמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה מִלְּפָנֵֽנוּ
Ecclesiastes 1:10 [KJV]  Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.

Ecclesiastes 1:11 [HEB]  אֵ֥ין זִכְר֖וֹן לָרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וְגַ֨ם לָאַחֲרֹנִ֜ים שֶׁיִּהְי֗וּ לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ זִכָּר֔וֹן עִ֥ם שֶׁיִּהְי֖וּ לָאַחֲרֹנָֽה
Ecclesiastes 1:11 [KJV]  There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.

Ecclesiastes 1:12 [HEB]  אֲנִ֣י קֹהֶ֗לֶת הָיִ֥יתִי מֶ֛לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם
Ecclesiastes 1:12 [KJV]  I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

Ecclesiastes 1:13 [HEB]  וְנָתַ֣תִּי אֶת לִבִּ֗י לִדְר֤וֹשׁ וְלָתוּר֙ בַּֽחָכְמָ֔ה עַ֛ל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם ה֣וּא עִנְיַ֣ן רָ֗ע נָתַ֧ן אֱלֹהִ֛ים לִבְנֵ֥י הָאָדָ֖ם לַעֲנ֥וֹת בּֽוֹ
Ecclesiastes 1:13 [KJV]  And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.

Ecclesiastes 1:14 [HEB]  רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת כָּל הַֽמַּעֲשִׂ֔ים שֶֽׁנַּעֲשׂ֖וּ תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַכֹּ֛ל הֶ֖בֶל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
Ecclesiastes 1:14 [KJV]  I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

Ecclesiastes 1:15 [HEB]  מְעֻוָּ֖ת לֹא יוּכַ֣ל לִתְקֹ֑ן וְחֶסְר֖וֹן לֹא יוּכַ֥ל לְהִמָּנֽוֹת
Ecclesiastes 1:15 [KJV]  That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.

Ecclesiastes 1:16 [HEB]  דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי אֲנִ֤י עִם לִבִּי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֲנִ֗י הִנֵּ֨ה הִגְדַּ֤לְתִּי וְהוֹסַ֨פְתִּי֙ חָכְמָ֔ה עַ֛ל כָּל אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה לְפָנַ֖י עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְלִבִּ֛י רָאָ֥ה הַרְבֵּ֖ה חָכְמָ֥ה וָדָֽעַת
Ecclesiastes 1:16 [KJV]  I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.

Ecclesiastes 1:17 [HEB]  וָאֶתְּנָ֤ה לִבִּי֙ לָדַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֔ה וְדַ֥עַת הוֹלֵל֖וֹת וְשִׂכְל֑וּת יָדַ֕עְתִּי שֶׁגַּם זֶ֥ה ה֖וּא רַעְי֥וֹן רֽוּחַ
Ecclesiastes 1:17 [KJV]  And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.

Ecclesiastes 1:18 [HEB]  כִּ֛י בְּרֹ֥ב חָכְמָ֖ה רָב כָּ֑עַס וְיוֹסִ֥יף דַּ֖עַת יוֹסִ֥יף מַכְאֽוֹב
Ecclesiastes 1:18 [KJV]  For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.


--- Ecclesiastes Chapter 2 ---
Ecclesiastes 2:1 [HEB]  אָמַ֤רְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ בְּלִבִּ֔י לְכָה נָּ֛א אֲנַסְּכָ֛ה בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה וּרְאֵ֣ה בְט֑וֹב וְהִנֵּ֥ה גַם ה֖וּא הָֽבֶל
Ecclesiastes 2:1 [KJV]  I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.

Ecclesiastes 2:2 [HEB]  לִשְׂח֖וֹק אָמַ֣רְתִּי מְהוֹלָ֑ל וּלְשִׂמְחָ֖ה מַה זֹּ֥ה עֹשָֽׂה
Ecclesiastes 2:2 [KJV]  I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?

Ecclesiastes 2:3 [HEB]  תַּ֣רְתִּי בְלִבִּ֔י לִמְשׁ֥וֹךְ בַּיַּ֖יִן אֶת בְּשָׂרִ֑י וְלִבִּ֞י נֹהֵ֤ג בַּֽחָכְמָה֙ וְלֶאֱחֹ֣ז בְּסִכְל֔וּת עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁר אֶרְאֶ֗ה אֵי זֶ֨ה ט֜וֹב לִבְנֵ֤י הָאָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַעֲשׂוּ֙ תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם מִסְפַּ֖ר יְמֵ֥י חַיֵּיהֶֽם
Ecclesiastes 2:3 [KJV]  I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.

Ecclesiastes 2:4 [HEB]  הִגְדַּ֖לְתִּי מַעֲשָׂ֑י בָּנִ֤יתִי לִי֙ בָּתִּ֔ים נָטַ֥עְתִּי לִ֖י כְּרָמִֽים
Ecclesiastes 2:4 [KJV]  I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:

Ecclesiastes 2:5 [HEB]  עָשִׂ֣יתִי לִ֔י גַּנּ֖וֹת וּפַרְדֵּסִ֑ים וְנָטַ֥עְתִּי בָהֶ֖ם עֵ֥ץ כָּל פֶּֽרִי
Ecclesiastes 2:5 [KJV]  I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:

Ecclesiastes 2:6 [HEB]  עָשִׂ֥יתִי לִ֖י בְּרֵכ֣וֹת מָ֑יִם לְהַשְׁק֣וֹת מֵהֶ֔ם יַ֖עַר צוֹמֵ֥חַ עֵצִֽים
Ecclesiastes 2:6 [KJV]  I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:

Ecclesiastes 2:7 [HEB]  קָנִ֨יתִי֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים וּשְׁפָח֔וֹת וּבְנֵי בַ֖יִת הָ֣יָה לִ֑י גַּ֣ם מִקְנֶה֩ בָקָ֨ר וָצֹ֤אן הַרְבֵּה֙ הָ֣יָה לִ֔י מִכֹּ֛ל שֶֽׁהָי֥וּ לְפָנַ֖י בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם
Ecclesiastes 2:7 [KJV]  I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:

Ecclesiastes 2:8 [HEB]  כָּנַ֤סְתִּי לִי֙ גַּם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב וּסְגֻלַּ֥ת מְלָכִ֖ים וְהַמְּדִינ֑וֹת עָשִׂ֨יתִי לִ֜י שָׁרִ֣ים וְשָׁר֗וֹת וְתַעֲנוּגֹ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָ֖ם שִׁדָּ֥ה וְשִׁדּֽוֹת
Ecclesiastes 2:8 [KJV]  I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.

Ecclesiastes 2:9 [HEB]  וְגָדַ֣לְתִּי וְהוֹסַ֔פְתִּי מִכֹּ֛ל שֶׁהָיָ֥ה לְפָנַ֖י בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אַ֥ף חָכְמָתִ֖י עָ֥מְדָה לִּֽי
Ecclesiastes 2:9 [KJV]  So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.

Ecclesiastes 2:10 [HEB]  וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָֽׁאֲל֣וּ עֵינַ֔י לֹ֥א אָצַ֖לְתִּי מֵהֶ֑ם לֹֽא מָנַ֨עְתִּי אֶת לִבִּ֜י מִכָּל שִׂמְחָ֗ה כִּֽי לִבִּ֤י שָׂמֵ֨חַ֙ מִכָּל עֲמָלִ֔י וְזֶֽה הָיָ֥ה חֶלְקִ֖י מִכָּל עֲמָלִֽי
Ecclesiastes 2:10 [KJV]  And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.

Ecclesiastes 2:11 [HEB]  וּפָנִ֣יתִֽי אֲנִ֗י בְּכָל מַעֲשַׂי֙ שֶֽׁעָשׂ֣וּ יָדַ֔י וּבֶֽעָמָ֖ל שֶׁעָמַ֣לְתִּי לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת וְהִנֵּ֨ה הַכֹּ֥ל הֶ֨בֶל֙ וּרְע֣וּת ר֔וּחַ וְאֵ֥ין יִתְר֖וֹן תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ
Ecclesiastes 2:11 [KJV]  Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.

Ecclesiastes 2:12 [HEB]  וּפָנִ֤יתִֽי אֲנִי֙ לִרְא֣וֹת חָכְמָ֔ה וְהוֹלֵל֖וֹת וְסִכְל֑וּת כִּ֣י מֶ֣ה הָאָדָ֗ם שֶׁיָּבוֹא֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר כְּבָ֖ר עָשֽׂוּהוּ
Ecclesiastes 2:12 [KJV]  And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.

Ecclesiastes 2:13 [HEB]  וְרָאִ֣יתִי אָ֔נִי שֶׁיֵּ֥שׁ יִתְר֛וֹן לַֽחָכְמָ֖ה מִן הַסִּכְל֑וּת כִּֽיתְר֥וֹן הָא֖וֹר מִן הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ
Ecclesiastes 2:13 [KJV]  Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.

Ecclesiastes 2:14 [HEB]  הֶֽחָכָם֙ עֵינָ֣יו בְּרֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְהַכְּסִ֖יל בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ הוֹלֵ֑ךְ וְיָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם אָ֔נִי שֶׁמִּקְרֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד יִקְרֶ֥ה אֶת כֻּלָּֽם
Ecclesiastes 2:14 [KJV]  The wise man’s eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.

Ecclesiastes 2:15 [HEB]  וְאָמַ֨רְתִּֽי אֲנִ֜י בְּלִבִּ֗י כְּמִקְרֵ֤ה הַכְּסִיל֙ גַּם אֲנִ֣י יִקְרֵ֔נִי וְלָ֧מָּה חָכַ֛מְתִּי אֲנִ֖י אָ֣ז יוֹתֵ֑ר וְדִבַּ֣רְתִּי בְלִבִּ֔י שֶׁגַּם זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל
Ecclesiastes 2:15 [KJV]  Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.

Ecclesiastes 2:16 [HEB]  כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין זִכְר֧וֹן לֶחָכָ֛ם עִֽם הַכְּסִ֖יל לְעוֹלָ֑ם בְּשֶׁכְּבָ֞ר הַיָּמִ֤ים הַבָּאִים֙ הַכֹּ֣ל נִשְׁכָּ֔ח וְאֵ֛יךְ יָמ֥וּת הֶחָכָ֖ם עִֽם הַכְּסִֽיל
Ecclesiastes 2:16 [KJV]  For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.

Ecclesiastes 2:17 [HEB]  וְשָׂנֵ֨אתִי֙ אֶת הַ֣חַיִּ֔ים כִּ֣י רַ֤ע עָלַי֙ הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ כִּֽי הַכֹּ֥ל הֶ֖בֶל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
Ecclesiastes 2:17 [KJV]  Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

Ecclesiastes 2:18 [HEB]  וְשָׂנֵ֤אתִֽי אֲנִי֙ אֶת כָּל עֲמָלִ֔י שֶׁאֲנִ֥י עָמֵ֖ל תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ שֶׁ֣אַנִּיחֶ֔נּוּ לָאָדָ֖ם שֶׁיִּהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרָֽי
Ecclesiastes 2:18 [KJV]  Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.

Ecclesiastes 2:19 [HEB]  וּמִ֣י יוֹדֵ֗עַ הֶֽחָכָ֤ם יִהְיֶה֙ א֣וֹ סָכָ֔ל וְיִשְׁלַט֙ בְּכָל עֲמָלִ֔י שֶֽׁעָמַ֥לְתִּי וְשֶׁחָכַ֖מְתִּי תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ גַּם זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל
Ecclesiastes 2:19 [KJV]  And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.

Ecclesiastes 2:20 [HEB]  וְסַבּ֥וֹתִֽי אֲנִ֖י לְיַאֵ֣שׁ אֶת לִבִּ֑י עַ֚ל כָּל הֶ֣עָמָ֔ל שֶׁעָמַ֖לְתִּי תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ
Ecclesiastes 2:20 [KJV]  Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.

Ecclesiastes 2:21 [HEB]  כִּי יֵ֣שׁ אָדָ֗ם שֶׁעֲמָל֛וֹ בְּחָכְמָ֥ה וּבְדַ֖עַת וּבְכִשְׁר֑וֹן וּלְאָדָ֞ם שֶׁלֹּ֤א עָֽמַל בּוֹ֙ יִתְּנֶ֣נּוּ חֶלְק֔וֹ גַּם זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וְרָעָ֥ה רַבָּֽה
Ecclesiastes 2:21 [KJV]  For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.

Ecclesiastes 2:22 [HEB]  כִּ֠י מֶֽה הֹוֶ֤ה לָֽאָדָם֙ בְּכָל עֲמָל֔וֹ וּבְרַעְי֖וֹן לִבּ֑ו שֶׁה֥וּא עָמֵ֖ל תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ
Ecclesiastes 2:22 [KJV]  For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?

Ecclesiastes 2:23 [HEB]  כִּ֧י כָל יָמָ֣יו מַכְאֹבִ֗ים וָכַ֨עַס֙ עִנְיָנ֔וֹ גַּם בַּלַּ֖יְלָה לֹא שָׁכַ֣ב לִבּ֑וֹ גַּם זֶ֖ה הֶ֥בֶל הֽוּא
Ecclesiastes 2:23 [KJV]  For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.

Ecclesiastes 2:24 [HEB]  אֵֽין ט֤וֹב בָּאָדָם֙ שֶׁיֹּאכַ֣ל וְשָׁתָ֔ה וְהֶרְאָ֧ה אֶת נַפְשׁ֛וֹ ט֖וֹב בַּעֲמָל֑וֹ גַּם זֹה֙ רָאִ֣יתִי אָ֔נִי כִּ֛י מִיַּ֥ד הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽיא
Ecclesiastes 2:24 [KJV]  There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.

Ecclesiastes 2:25 [HEB]  כִּ֣י מִ֥י יֹאכַ֛ל וּמִ֥י יָח֖וּשׁ ח֥וּץ מִמֶּֽנִּי
Ecclesiastes 2:25 [KJV]  For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?

Ecclesiastes 2:26 [HEB]  כִּ֤י לְאָדָם֙ שֶׁטּ֣וֹב לְפָנָ֔יו נָתַ֛ן חָכְמָ֥ה וְדַ֖עַת וְשִׂמְחָ֑ה וְלַחוֹטֶא֩ נָתַ֨ן עִנְיָ֜ן לֶאֱס֣וֹף וְלִכְנ֗וֹס לָתֵת֙ לְטוֹב֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים גַּם זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
Ecclesiastes 2:26 [KJV]  For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.


--- Ecclesiastes Chapter 3 ---
Ecclesiastes 3:1 [HEB]  לַכֹּ֖ל זְמָ֑ן וְעֵ֥ת לְכָל חֵ֖פֶץ תַּ֥חַת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם
Ecclesiastes 3:1 [KJV]  To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

Ecclesiastes 3:2 [HEB]  עֵ֥ת לָלֶ֖דֶת וְעֵ֣ת לָמ֑וּת עֵ֣ת לָטַ֔עַת וְעֵ֖ת לַעֲק֥וֹר נָטֽוּעַ
Ecclesiastes 3:2 [KJV]  A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

Ecclesiastes 3:3 [HEB]  עֵ֤ת לַהֲרוֹג֙ וְעֵ֣ת לִרְפּ֔וֹא עֵ֥ת לִפְר֖וֹץ וְעֵ֥ת לִבְנֽוֹת
Ecclesiastes 3:3 [KJV]  A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

Ecclesiastes 3:4 [HEB]  עֵ֤ת לִבְכּוֹת֙ וְעֵ֣ת לִשְׂח֔וֹק עֵ֥ת סְפ֖וֹד וְעֵ֥ת רְקֽוֹד
Ecclesiastes 3:4 [KJV]  A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

Ecclesiastes 3:5 [HEB]  עֵ֚ת לְהַשְׁלִ֣יךְ אֲבָנִ֔ים וְעֵ֖ת כְּנ֣וֹס אֲבָנִ֑ים עֵ֣ת לַחֲב֔וֹק וְעֵ֖ת לִרְחֹ֥ק מֵחַבֵּֽק
Ecclesiastes 3:5 [KJV]  A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

Ecclesiastes 3:6 [HEB]  עֵ֤ת לְבַקֵּשׁ֙ וְעֵ֣ת לְאַבֵּ֔ד עֵ֥ת לִשְׁמ֖וֹר וְעֵ֥ת לְהַשְׁלִֽיךְ
Ecclesiastes 3:6 [KJV]  A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

Ecclesiastes 3:7 [HEB]  עֵ֤ת לִקְר֨וֹעַ֙ וְעֵ֣ת לִתְפּ֔וֹר עֵ֥ת לַחֲשׁ֖וֹת וְעֵ֥ת לְדַבֵּֽר
Ecclesiastes 3:7 [KJV]  A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

Ecclesiastes 3:8 [HEB]  עֵ֤ת לֶֽאֱהֹב֙ וְעֵ֣ת לִשְׂנֹ֔א עֵ֥ת מִלְחָמָ֖ה וְעֵ֥ת שָׁלֽוֹם
Ecclesiastes 3:8 [KJV]  A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.

Ecclesiastes 3:9 [HEB]  מַה יִּתְרוֹן֙ הָֽעוֹשֶׂ֔ה בַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר ה֥וּא עָמֵֽל
Ecclesiastes 3:9 [KJV]  What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?

Ecclesiastes 3:10 [HEB]  רָאִ֣יתִי אֶת הָֽעִנְיָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן אֱלֹהִ֛ים לִבְנֵ֥י הָאָדָ֖ם לַעֲנ֥וֹת בּֽוֹ
Ecclesiastes 3:10 [KJV]  I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.

Ecclesiastes 3:11 [HEB]  אֶת הַכֹּ֥ל עָשָׂ֖ה יָפֶ֣ה בְעִתּ֑וֹ גַּ֤ם אֶת הָעֹלָם֙ נָתַ֣ן בְּלִבָּ֔ם מִבְּלִ֞י אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא יִמְצָ֣א הָאָדָ֗ם אֶת הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֛ה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵרֹ֥אשׁ וְעַד סֽוֹף
Ecclesiastes 3:11 [KJV]  He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

Ecclesiastes 3:12 [HEB]  יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין ט֖וֹב בָּ֑ם כִּ֣י אִם לִשְׂמ֔וֹחַ וְלַעֲשׂ֥וֹת ט֖וֹב בְּחַיָּֽיו
Ecclesiastes 3:12 [KJV]  I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.

Ecclesiastes 3:13 [HEB]  וְגַ֤ם כָּל הָאָדָם֙ שֶׁיֹּאכַ֣ל וְשָׁתָ֔ה וְרָאָ֥ה ט֖וֹב בְּכָל עֲמָל֑וֹ מַתַּ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽיא
Ecclesiastes 3:13 [KJV]  And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.

Ecclesiastes 3:14 [HEB]  יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֠י כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה הָאֱלֹהִים֙ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֔ם עָלָיו֙ אֵ֣ין לְהוֹסִ֔יף וּמִמֶּ֖נּוּ אֵ֣ין לִגְרֹ֑עַ וְהָאֱלֹהִ֣ים עָשָׂ֔ה שֶׁיִּֽרְא֖וּ מִלְּפָנָֽיו
Ecclesiastes 3:14 [KJV]  I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.

Ecclesiastes 3:15 [HEB]  מַה שֶּֽׁהָיָה֙ כְּבָ֣ר ה֔וּא וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לִהְי֖וֹת כְּבָ֣ר הָיָ֑ה וְהָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת נִרְדָּֽף
Ecclesiastes 3:15 [KJV]  That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.

Ecclesiastes 3:16 [HEB]  וְע֥וֹד רָאִ֖יתִי תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ מְק֤וֹם הַמִּשְׁפָּט֙ שָׁ֣מָּה הָרֶ֔שַׁע וּמְק֥וֹם הַצֶּ֖דֶק שָׁ֥מָּה הָרָֽשַׁע
Ecclesiastes 3:16 [KJV]  And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.

Ecclesiastes 3:17 [HEB]  אָמַ֤רְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ בְּלִבִּ֔י אֶת הַצַּדִּיק֙ וְאֶת הָ֣רָשָׁ֔ע יִשְׁפֹּ֖ט הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּי עֵ֣ת לְכָל חֵ֔פֶץ וְעַ֥ל כָּל הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה שָֽׁם
Ecclesiastes 3:17 [KJV]  I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.

Ecclesiastes 3:18 [HEB]  אָמַ֤רְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ בְּלִבִּ֔י עַל דִּבְרַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָאָדָ֔ם לְבָרָ֖ם הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְלִרְא֕וֹת שְׁהֶם בְּהֵמָ֥ה הֵ֖מָּה לָהֶֽם
Ecclesiastes 3:18 [KJV]  I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.

Ecclesiastes 3:19 [HEB]  כִּי֩ מִקְרֶ֨ה בְֽנֵי הָאָדָ֜ם וּמִקְרֶ֣ה הַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וּמִקְרֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ לָהֶ֔ם כְּמ֥וֹת זֶה֙ כֵּ֣ן מ֣וֹת זֶ֔ה וְר֥וּחַ אֶחָ֖ד לַכֹּ֑ל וּמוֹתַ֨ר הָאָדָ֤ם מִן הַבְּהֵמָה֙ אָ֔יִן כִּ֥י הַכֹּ֖ל הָֽבֶל
Ecclesiastes 3:19 [KJV]  For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.

Ecclesiastes 3:20 [HEB]  הַכֹּ֥ל הוֹלֵ֖ךְ אֶל מָק֣וֹם אֶחָ֑ד הַכֹּל֙ הָיָ֣ה מִן הֶֽעָפָ֔ר וְהַכֹּ֖ל שָׁ֥ב אֶל הֶעָפָֽר
Ecclesiastes 3:20 [KJV]  All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.

Ecclesiastes 3:21 [HEB]  מִ֣י יוֹדֵ֗עַ ר֚וּחַ בְּנֵ֣י הָאָדָ֔ם הָעֹלָ֥ה הִ֖יא לְמָ֑עְלָה וְר֨וּחַ֙ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה הַיֹּרֶ֥דֶת הִ֖יא לְמַ֥טָּה לָאָֽרֶץ
Ecclesiastes 3:21 [KJV]  Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?

Ecclesiastes 3:22 [HEB]  וְרָאִ֗יתִי כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין טוֹב֙ מֵאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׂמַ֤ח הָאָדָם֙ בְּֽמַעֲשָׂ֔יו כִּי ה֖וּא חֶלְק֑וֹ כִּ֣י מִ֤י יְבִיאֶ֨נּוּ֙ לִרְא֔וֹת בְּמֶ֖ה שֶׁיִּהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרָֽיו
Ecclesiastes 3:22 [KJV]  Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?


--- Ecclesiastes Chapter 4 ---
Ecclesiastes 4:1 [HEB]  וְשַׁ֣בְתִּֽי אֲנִ֗י וָאֶרְאֶה֙ אֶת כָּל הָ֣עֲשֻׁקִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשִׂ֖ים תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְהִנֵּ֣ה דִּמְעַ֣ת הָעֲשֻׁקִ֗ים וְאֵ֤ין לָהֶם֙ מְנַחֵ֔ם וּמִיַּ֤ד עֹֽשְׁקֵיהֶם֙ כֹּ֔חַ וְאֵ֥ין לָהֶ֖ם מְנַחֵֽם
Ecclesiastes 4:1 [KJV]  So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

Ecclesiastes 4:2 [HEB]  וְשַׁבֵּ֧חַ אֲנִ֛י אֶת הַמֵּתִ֖ים שֶׁכְּבָ֣ר מֵ֑תוּ מִן הַ֣חַיִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥מָּה חַיִּ֖ים עֲדֶֽנָה
Ecclesiastes 4:2 [KJV]  Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.

Ecclesiastes 4:3 [HEB]  וְטוֹב֙ מִשְּׁנֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר עֲדֶ֖ן לֹ֣א הָיָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא רָאָה֙ אֶת הַמַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה הָרָ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ
Ecclesiastes 4:3 [KJV]  Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

Ecclesiastes 4:4 [HEB]  וְרָאִ֨יתִֽי אֲנִ֜י אֶת כָּל עָמָ֗ל וְאֵת֙ כָּל כִּשְׁר֣וֹן הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כִּ֛י הִ֥יא קִנְאַת אִ֖ישׁ מֵרֵעֵ֑הוּ גַּם זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
Ecclesiastes 4:4 [KJV]  Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.

Ecclesiastes 4:5 [HEB]  הַכְּסִיל֙ חֹבֵ֣ק אֶת יָדָ֔יו וְאֹכֵ֖ל אֶת בְּשָׂרֽוֹ
Ecclesiastes 4:5 [KJV]  The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.

Ecclesiastes 4:6 [HEB]  ט֕וֹב מְלֹ֥א כַ֖ף נָ֑חַת מִמְּלֹ֥א חָפְנַ֛יִם עָמָ֖ל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
Ecclesiastes 4:6 [KJV]  Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.

Ecclesiastes 4:7 [HEB]  וְשַׁ֧בְתִּי אֲנִ֛י וָאֶרְאֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ
Ecclesiastes 4:7 [KJV]  Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.

Ecclesiastes 4:8 [HEB]  יֵ֣שׁ אֶחָד֩ וְאֵ֨ין שֵׁנִ֜י גַּ֣ם בֵּ֧ן וָאָ֣ח אֵֽין ל֗וֹ וְאֵ֥ין קֵץ֙ לְכָל עֲמָל֔וֹ גַּם עיניו עֵינ֖וֹ לֹא תִשְׂבַּ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁר וּלְמִ֣י אֲנִ֣י עָמֵ֗ל וּמְחַסֵּ֤ר אֶת נַפְשִׁי֙ מִטּוֹבָ֔ה גַּם זֶ֥ה הֶ֛בֶל וְעִנְיַ֥ן רָ֖ע הֽוּא
Ecclesiastes 4:8 [KJV]  There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.

Ecclesiastes 4:9 [HEB]  טוֹבִ֥ים הַשְּׁנַ֖יִם מִן הָאֶחָ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵשׁ לָהֶ֛ם שָׂכָ֥ר ט֖וֹב בַּעֲמָלָֽם
Ecclesiastes 4:9 [KJV]  Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.

Ecclesiastes 4:10 [HEB]  כִּ֣י אִם יִפֹּ֔לוּ הָאֶחָ֖ד יָקִ֣ים אֶת חֲבֵר֑וֹ וְאִ֣יל֗וֹ הָֽאֶחָד֙ שֶׁיִּפּ֔וֹל וְאֵ֥ין שֵׁנִ֖י לַהֲקִימֽוֹ
Ecclesiastes 4:10 [KJV]  For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

Ecclesiastes 4:11 [HEB]  גַּ֛ם אִם יִשְׁכְּב֥וּ שְׁנַ֖יִם וְחַ֣ם לָהֶ֑ם וּלְאֶחָ֖ד אֵ֥יךְ יֵחָֽם
Ecclesiastes 4:11 [KJV]  Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?

Ecclesiastes 4:12 [HEB]  וְאִֽם יִתְקְפוֹ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד הַשְּׁנַ֖יִם יַעַמְד֣וּ נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְהַחוּט֙ הַֽמְשֻׁלָּ֔שׁ לֹ֥א בִמְהֵרָ֖ה יִנָּתֵֽק
Ecclesiastes 4:12 [KJV]  And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

Ecclesiastes 4:13 [HEB]  ט֛וֹב יֶ֥לֶד מִסְכֵּ֖ן וְחָכָ֑ם מִמֶּ֤לֶךְ זָקֵן֙ וּכְסִ֔יל אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא יָדַ֥ע לְהִזָּהֵ֖ר עֽוֹד
Ecclesiastes 4:13 [KJV]  Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.

Ecclesiastes 4:14 [HEB]  כִּֽי מִבֵּ֥ית הָסוּרִ֖ים יָצָ֣א לִמְלֹ֑ךְ כִּ֛י גַּ֥ם בְּמַלְכוּת֖וֹ נוֹלַ֥ד רָֽשׁ
Ecclesiastes 4:14 [KJV]  For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.

Ecclesiastes 4:15 [HEB]  רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת כָּל הַ֣חַיִּ֔ים הַֽמְהַלְּכִ֖ים תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ עִ֚ם הַיֶּ֣לֶד הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲמֹ֖ד תַּחְתָּֽיו
Ecclesiastes 4:15 [KJV]  I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.

Ecclesiastes 4:16 [HEB]  אֵֽין קֵ֣ץ לְכָל הָעָ֗ם לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם גַּ֥ם הָאַחֲרוֹנִ֖ים לֹ֣א יִשְׂמְחוּ ב֑וֹ כִּֽי גַם זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וְרַעְי֥וֹן רֽוּחַ
Ecclesiastes 4:16 [KJV]  There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.

Ecclesiastes 4:17 [HEB]  שְׁמֹ֣ר רגליך רַגְלְךָ֗ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר תֵּלֵךְ֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְקָר֣וֹב לִשְׁמֹ֔עַ מִתֵּ֥ת הַכְּסִילִ֖ים זָ֑בַח כִּֽי אֵינָ֥ם יוֹדְעִ֖ים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָֽע
